tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 7 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan ga bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang gozhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rteng dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i 'o bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po dhi khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkhe 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rting dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rning dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa /lo rgyus/rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mab na rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsi se / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo — 1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos da/nga rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces nga/ de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong spru la rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /'es gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad chul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnam/sa kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud/ 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i chor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsong nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'as na yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skye sa 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chang / pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams garbedus/ 'a9/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mche/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu ri las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyan/sa po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod chul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum nga / yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos sno nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yo de pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'jam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dnge/ skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'gyung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / se sgro 1 6 3 6 5 grang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes nga/ las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs nga/ sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mjad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

dzo pa lan po dang/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/ chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mjad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3 —

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bzhes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po dhī ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni ba ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul phi gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnam sa dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi kho shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa snyel ya mtshan chen ngo/ byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzang byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pa/sa/ —chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/ 1rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/ 111sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snying po'i 'khrul 'khore gyi sdoms bzhu/gas/ 389zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag gsal byed nyung/(kyi spra//spres// 394

ldan zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ snyu sti/ na mo gu ru ba khyu bo dhi sa te khyuX rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba jo/na ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / phyag rgya chen po zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa mchog gi bdud rtsis yang dag par ngom pa'i dam pa rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig phun tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /bla med go 'phang yid bzhin nor/ /'gro ba kun la nyer stsol ba/ /bla ma'i zhabs la gus nga/sa 'dud/ /kun khyab dbyings ni rnam pa thams cad pa/ /sems nyid rang bzhin yon tan kun gyi gter/ /dbyer med gdod nas rnam grol chos kyi sku/ /nang rig 'gyur med don dam rgyal gyur cig /gang yang rgyud sde'i chu bo 'bum phrag gis/ /blo yi mtsho chen bres las mngon 'phags pa/ /de las snying gi bum pa gang gyur pa'i/ /gdams pa'i rgyun gyis phyogs 'di skal bzang bya/ /'dir mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bla na med pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog mthar thug /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma sne1 rdo'i 'jug ngogs/ khams drug ldan pa

rdo rje'i lus dang ldan par gang zag rnams tshe gcig lus gcig skye ba gcig nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu mchog la yang dag par 'god nus pa'i nye lam myur lam khyad par can/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gi sbas pa'i don/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud du ma sbas shing gsal bar bstan la/ mchog gi dang po sangs rgyas la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa thams cad du dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis bstan pa'i don mchog phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'am/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yid ches pa rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa'i lam yin no/ /'di lta bus 'khrid par byed pa la/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi snod du rung bar byed pa sngon 'gro'i 'khrid dang / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi sgom pa'i rim pa dang / rjes lam gyi yan lag sa mtshams/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs pa dang bcas pa ste gsum las/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro la/ chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa zhes dmigs bskor gsum du mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rim pa'i myong 'khrid skyong pa la dmigs bskor lngar byas na bde bas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ chos spyi'i rtsa ba skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid/ theg chen kyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi 'khrid/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba yeg —2—

brgya'i 'khrid/ tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yed de lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun tsam byas/ sems rnal du phab nas/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams chen po yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i dbus su/rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gzhal med khang rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ de'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rab tu rgyas pa/ /de'i rtse mo la seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan dpangs mtho zhing rgya che ba la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dang / shing de'i rtsa ba na/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyang bdag la skyob pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gi phyogs bzhir gzhal yas khang gi nang gi sa gzhi la seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan dpangs mtho zhing rgya che ba re re gsal btab ste/ bla ma'i sku'i mdun gyi phyogs su dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams dang /g.yas phyogs su 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / g.yon phyogs su shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang / rgyab phyogs su chos dkon mchog rngams —3—

rnam pa gles/sa0bam gyi tshul can rnams bzhugs par mos/ yang na rgyab tu sangs rgyas dang / mdun du dam chos bzhugs par mos kyang chog ste/ blo la gang bde ba zhig bya'o/ /de nas rang dang lhan cig tu mkha' mnyam kyi sems can thams cad kyang / bla ma dkon mchog skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mos gus kyi gdung ba chen pos skyabs 'gro byed pa mos shing / khyad par sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol snyam nga/ ched thad du gsal btab nas/ nam ma/spa' dang mnyam pa'i sems can tham/sa cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying ngo/ la rma chis kyi bar du / chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams 'a skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnam/rnga/ la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha‘spru 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'es brjod cing bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan dran pa dang / lo bor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pas dkon mchog la blo lings kyis bkal nas skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ bla ma dko/na mchog rin po che rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ skyabs 'gro'i dge ba bsngo ba yang bya ste/ dge ba 'di yi sa skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye —4—

shes las byung ba'i/ dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ dmigs bskor dang po skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid tshar/ de ltar dmigs pa phog rjes/ slob ma rnams zhag gsum sogs ci rigs par skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa skyong du 'jug gzhan yang slob ma nyan par spro/ bla ma 'chad par spro/ slob mas go ru rung / slob dpon gyis 'chad shes/ /dgos don gal che ba bshad na go zhing blo chos su 'gyur/ ma bshad na sngar ma go bas blo sna chos la mi 'gyur ba sogs/ nges par bshad dgos pa'i rigs yin na/ slob ma rnams dmigs pa skyong ba'i skabs su/ nyin re bzhin mdo dang sngags sam/theg pa che chung gi skyabs 'gro'i go don rnams blo la 'byor nges par rim gyis bshad do/ /'di skabs nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs yul rmams ma bsdus par bla ma'i sku'i mdun gyi phyogs kyi sa gzhi la pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid nyal bar mos te/ skyabs yul la mos gus sgom bzhin pas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /zhar byung gi man ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sngar bzhin las/ lan mang nyung ran tsam/ byas te/ skyabs yul rang la bstim pa'i rjes su/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams la blos gzhig 'brel zhig btang la/ phyogs bcu ga la phyin kyang nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams la mtha' med/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rigs drug gi sems can gyis go mtshams med par khyab/sems can de thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ de thams cad 'dod ni bde ba 'dod kyang / bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs la ni mi mkhas pas/ sdug bsngal 'ba' —5—

zhig la spyod pa snying re rje/ de rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las drangs/ thar pa rnams kyi mchog bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la myur du 'god par bya/ da lta de'i nus pa bdag la med pas nus pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod cing don bsam pa ci nus su bya/ thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngo ba skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin no/ /dmigs bskor gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi 'khrid tshar/ 'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/ zhag gsum sogs sems bskyed bsgom pa'i ring la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi don zhib mor bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sems bskyed kyi skabs ltar las/ de rnams dmigs pa gsal zhing 'jur la yun thung ba re byas nas/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i de ma thag tu/ rang gi spyi bor pa las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hu las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hū gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hu la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal —6—

gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āthugs kar spru/ lte bar ho thugs ka'i hū las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dza : ba ho gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pa lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka tī no pa nga ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa / u nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po khyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra byu sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shri ya/ ku ru hū ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me musmahe ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa u hu phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus bzlas mthar/bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ skabs 'dir dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis —7—

myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun//sogs gong bzhin/ dmigs bskor gsum pa yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid tshar/ 'di la long skabs yod cing nus na/ zla ba gcig gnyis su bsgom bzlas byed du gzhug dgos/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags byung byung du sgom dgos pa yin/ de la rtags ni nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / khrus byas pa dang/ chu bo chen po las brgal ba dang / 'khru skyugs dang / lus las rnag khrag zag pa la sogs pa nyams kyi tshul du byung ba'am/ rmi lam shin du gsal ba lan mang du byung na yin/g.yin yang 'di bsgom pas dngos su sngar las rig pa dwangs pa dang / dmigs pa gsal ba dang / lus yang ba dang / dad pa dang snying rje nges 'byung sogs cher song ba dang / gnyid rmugs le lo chags sdang sogs chung du song bar mngon na sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags mchog yin no/ /yang mgyogs khrid kyi skabs zhag gnyis gsum sogs las byed long ma byung na/ 'khrid grol gyi bar la/ thun mgo la 'di ma chag par rtag tu sgom dgos so/ /'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang / bshags bsdam byed tshul dang / bsgom bzlas kyi go don rnams kyang zhib mor spyod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ skyabs sems gong bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams skyabs yul gyi skabs ltar yid kyis gsal btab/ de nas phyag 'tshal/ skyabs 'gro/ maṇ+ḍal rnams bya ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba —8—

gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces pa'am/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas/ /mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pas steng du ni/ /lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang / khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang / khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do/ khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'am/bsdu na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas lus kyi las su maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bkod/ yid kyi dmigs pa 'og gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri la rten pa'i gling bzhi ri rab 'khor yug dang bcas pa/ steng phyogs srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khams gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i dngos po bzang la gya nom pas go mtshams med cing phyur bur bkang ste/ bla ma dkon mchog rnams la phul/ de'i rjes su bdag myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'ebyor gyi nyams rtogs skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de dag gi skabs ngag tu 'di skad ces/ o badz+ra bhu mi ā hū/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa —9—

gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khā+e ā hūṃ/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gi bskor ba'i dbus su/ hu ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yis dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'am/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces brjod/ tshul des maṇ+ḍal ci nus su 'bul/thun 'jog khar/ mchod yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba bsngo ba gong skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin bya/ dmigs bskor bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid tshar/ 'di yang 'khrid kyi dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs skye ba'i rgyu gsar du tshogs bsag thub pa'i rtags byung byung du byed dgos pas zla ba la sogs par skyong dgos/ rtags ni seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa dang / con pan 'ching ba dang / chas gos bzang po dang / skye bo mang pos rang la phyag 'tshal ba —10—

sogs nyams dang rmi lam du byung na yin/ dngos kyi rtags ni sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags dang 'dra/ mgyogs 'khrid la zhag gsum sogs las byed long ma byung na/'khrid rdzogs kyi bar du thun mgo la 'di yang byed dgos la/ skabs 'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/ maṇ+ḍal gyi phan yon dang / dus 'khor rang lugs kyi 'jig rten khams kyi bkod pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs sgo du ma nas bsag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams zhib mor bshad do/ /lnga pa ni/ skyabs sems sngar bzhin/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa / 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang / chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchodi do/ /sdig pa bshags so/ /dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu —11—

bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bla na med pa'i lam bsten par bgyi'o/ /bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bar 'dir spro na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs logs na yod pa rnams bya zhing / bsdus pa la dga' na ma byas kyang choganges par gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma: skyabs mchog mtshungs med:'dren mchog mtshungs med: thar ba'i lam ston: dngos grub 'gyung gnas: ma rig mun sel bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par: sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar sgrub pa snying po nyams su longs par sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par: byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par: zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par: nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar: zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mthar phyin par: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma'i sku'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par ā snying gar hū/ lte bar ho : rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor zhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral par thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ ā las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/—12—

ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ hū las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dgashes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ ho las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ chags rtog gi bag chags dag /bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin ཿsa zhugs / slar yang mos gus dung ba dang yid kyi gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/ de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer ram bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de lta bu bskyar 'debs byed kyin ci nus su bsgoms/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba gong dang 'dra/ gzhan yang / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / zhes sogs ci rigs pa'ang brjod/ dmigs bskor lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid tshar/sngags lam gyi nyams rtogs thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi sgo nas lam du byed dgos pas/ 'di yang lo dang zla bar sgom dgos/ mgyogs khrid kyi skabs zhag gnyis gsum tsam las sgom long ma byung na/ 'di yang 'khrid yongs rdzogs ma tshar gyi bar du thun mgor ma chag pa sgom pa gal che/ skabs 'di dag tu'ang spro zhing dgos na/ bla ma'i mos gus lam du byed dgos tshul/mos gus kyi phan yon/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ bla ma bsten tshul sogs zhib du bshad do/ /—13—

dmigs pa 'di'i yan lag nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nye ba la bla ma sku tshad tshon gang tsam dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal du bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang las gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi nyer bsdogs khyad par can dben pa gsum bsten pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim la gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin na / sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ lha lnga'am lha dgu ma'i bar du rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa yod pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom pa yin yang / 'dir rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ gtso bo yab yum tsam gyi lha'i rnal 'byor bsdus pas chog cing / de las kyang lhag par bsdus pa lhan skyes nyid bsngags pas/ de'i sgom tshul ni/ skyabs sems sngar bzhin bsgom/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra sā bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang / g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang / sor —14—

tshigs rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing / me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no/ /de la 'byud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing /zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing / dbu skra phyed grol ba'o/ /dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ gsang gnas su snyu/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par gzhagade ltar yang yang bsgoms kyang legs/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo sogs dang / gong bzhin dge ba bsngo/ 'di 'khrid kyi skabs yin pas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa ma gtogs bzlas pa byed mi dgos/ 'on kyang cung zad sngags bzla bar spro na/ bzlas kyang mi 'gal bas lha sku stong nyid du bsdu ba'i sngon du/ oX sgre swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci rigs par bzla ba yin/ 'di la ye shes dgug spyi gzhug dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab rgyas pa'i srol yang gda' ba/ klo de ltar byas na rgyas pa'i lugs su 'gyur bas shin tu rung mod/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung las 'di tsam las ma bshad cing / lhan skyes kyi phyogs la 'di kho nas go chod pas/ 'jug pa bde ba 'di legs so/ /bla ma —15—

gong ma 'ga' res yi dam kun gyi smar 'khrid kyi man ngag 'di la sbyar ba yang yod do/ /dmigs skor drug pa bskyed rim gyi 'khrid tshar/ bskyed rim gyi go don rgyas pa skabs 'dir zugad kyi mi lang zhing logs su yod pas 'dir mi 'chad/ spro zhing dgos na lhan skyes sgrub thabs kyi go don zhib tu bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bar 'dir rdzogs rim gyi ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i don du/ mchog dbang gong ma bla ma'i man ngag dang ldan pa bskur dgos te/de'i yi ge logs su yod pa ltar yin la/ de yang dben gsum gyi/ rjes so sor sdud pa'i sngon du byed pa thob thang gi dus skabs yin yang deng sang de lag len mi bde bas skabs 'dir byed pa'i lag len gtso che'o/ /de nas 'khrid 'bogs pa ni/ rgyud las/ bdud rtsi lnga la 〈bdud rtsi lnga ste gzugs phung la sogs pa phung po lnga la ltos pa med pa dang / sogs sgras bstan pa'i dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa dang / chu gter zhes pa bzhi'i ming ste/ lus dang / ngag dang / yid dang / 'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang ltos med drug rgyud las bstan pa des dngos gzhi rdo rje bzhi smin par byed dgos/bskyed rim gyi skabs su lha 'grub pa'i ched du sngags kyi bzlas pa dang tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul ba sogs kyis bsgrub pa'i don du rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rlung las rung du gyur pa'i ched du 'gyung khug gi rlung rags pa sbyong ba rnams dgos〉sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis bsnyen pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'grel par ltos med bzhi ldan du gsungs shing / gsang 'dus las kyang / lus ngag sems rnams sgom pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa'i —16—

man ngag ste/ ltos med bzhi ldan nam/ dben pa gsum ldan zhes bya'o/ /de yang lus kyi longs spyod dang / bde sdug sogs gang la'ang chags sdang spangs shing /ji snyam pa mi byed la/ dgag sgrub blang dor gyi rtog pa spangs pa ni/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa zhes bya ba yin/ de bzhin du ngag dang / yid dang /'pho ba'i longs spyod la'ang sbyar bas/ ltos med bzhi ldan gyi gdams pa zhes bya la/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid gsum bya byed kho na la 'das kyang don med dang don log par song nas/ yang dag pa'i 'bras bu gang yang ma grub/ da phyin chad byar med du bzhag na/ grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa thob nges pas/ nang gi khams 'khrug nga/ sogs gegs dang gol sa spang ba'i phyir du/ lus gnad bca' zhing / rlung ro bsal ba dang / yang dag pa'i don la sems gnas pa'i phyir dran pa bsten tsam ma gtogs/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan lta ci smos/ ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtan pa cung zad ma thob kyi bar du dge las kyi spros pa yang phal cher bskyungs nas/ lus bya byed kyis dben pa/ ngag smrar brjod kyis dben pa/ sems rnam rtog gis dben pa gcig rnams dgos pas/ dben pa gsum bsten pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de la 'di skabs su/ mun /spang dang blta stangs nges pa can la sogs pa mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin yang / dngos gzhi sor sdud la myur du 'jug dgos pas de'i lam byang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mun khang dang blta stangs nges pa can yang phyag len la mdzad par gda'/ des na 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ /—17—

bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa/ /der ni rnal 'byor yang dag brtsams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yul phyogs dang / yang mdo sde rgyan las/ /blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes dang / ji skad du/las dang po yi gang zag gis/ /lus 〈bya byed ngag smra brjod kyis 〉dben pa la ma brten par/ /sems 〈rnam rtog gis 〉dben rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ /〈chags sdang gi rnam rtog skye ba'i rgyu rang yul sogs dang 〉'dres spangs dben par gnas par bya/ /〈yul mi sogs dang 〉'dres pas 'dris shing chags par byed/ /de yis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ /de bas 'dres pa spang pa la/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu 'grul med pa/ mtshan mo sgra'i brlag cor med pa/ 'tshe ba'i 'jigs pa med cing / 'thung rgyu'i chu lus la mi gnod pa cig dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas kyi khyad par 'byor ldan yin na/ steng khang ngam bar khang mun khang sgo 'khyog rim pa gsum pa/ skar khung phyi chung la nang yangs pa/ phye na mthong dkar zhing / de 'bo rdo sogs kyis bkag na snang ba rta rnga tsam yang mi 'byung ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ kun spangs kyi gnas ni/ sa phug dang / brag phug dang / khyim la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa ste/ 'on kyang skam zhing sa rlangs med pa/ mun pa shin tu gnag pa zhig dgos la/ de ltar yod na gang du'ang rung ngo / /gnas der sngon 'gro sgom pa'i tshul ni/ thun dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bskyed rim rnams lus gnad ci bde ba'i ngang nas bya/ thun phyi ma rnams la skyabs 'gro sems —18—

bskyed bsdus pa dang / bla ma la mos gus dung tsam byas pas chog sngar bsags sbyang gi 'khrid gnyis la nyams myong ma skyes na/ thun dang po la yig brgya dang maṇ+ḍal yang byed dgos pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed grub ma thag rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang / de'i rgyun la maṇ+ḍal dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang/ hūṃ n+ya tas stong par sbyangs pa nas/ sems 'dzin pa'i bar gyis bskyed rim kyang byed/ de'i nang nas kyang cung zad rgyas pa la spro na sngar bshad pa bzhin dang / bsdu na skyabs 'gro'i skabs skyabs yul rang la ma bstim par mdun du bzhugs su gsol ba la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs su maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / de kha la gsol 'debs man chad kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams byas pas zor yang zhing gnad la 'byor bar 'ong / thun gyi sngon 'gro nyams su len lugs dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir ma zad/ 'di man chad dngos gzhi'i skabs sogs thams cad du 'dra ba yin no/ /dben gsum gyi nyams len dngos ni/ mun khang der bsam gtan 'bol chung btings nas/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung / sgal tshigs dang ltag pa bsrang / lkog mas ol mdud non tsam gyis mgrin pa dgugaso mchu rang sar bzhag lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig gi lta stangs dang lag pa ni skabs 'dir ji ltar bde ba yin mod kyang / dngos gzhi'i skabs lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag dgos pas de 'byongs pa'i phyir 'dir yang bya ste/ mthe bos srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan pa la sor mo rnams kyis phyi nas bsdams pa'i khu tshur gyis brla'i rtsa bar mnan la lag ngar bsrang / mig kyang dngos gzhi dang phyogs —19—

mtshungs par steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' la blta ba'i tshul gyis gyen du bsgril nas 'byed 'dzus sogs mi byed par g.yo med du bzhag /de ltar lus gnad bcas ma thag tu sngar rlung 'khrugs pa dang 'khyams pa sel zhing phyis rlung skyon mi 'byung ba'i phyir rlung ro lan gsum sna sgo nas sangs kyis 'bud/ de rjes nas thun grol gyi bar du rlung rang babs su bzhag ci bder rgyu ru gzhugasems kyi gnad gang yang bsam du med pa/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa/ ched du ma sgrim/ ched du ma klod/ phar nam mkha' sogs la cher gyis blta ba yang ma yin/ tshur rang nyid la ched du lta ba yang ma yin/ gang la yang mi brten/ cir yang 'char rung tsam de la bzo bcos med pa lhod de bzhag de kha la gnas shing sgom tu btub na legs/ gal te sems 'phro na de'i gnyen po brten dgos/ de la 'phro lugs gnyis te/ sems gnas 'phro la rnam rtog thol thol skye zhing gzugs sogs yul kyi rnam pa yid la wal wal 'char la/ shar ma thag tu sems 'phros pa rang gi shes kyin 'dug na/ de la dga' mi dga' dang rtog dpyod gang yang mi bya bar de nyid 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas/ sems 'jog tshul sngar gyi de kha bskyangs pas chog yang rnam rtog gcig la gcig brgyud pa sna tshogs pa 'phro zhing / yun ring por 'byams 'gro na skyon che ste/ 'on kyang 'di la nam dran pas zin ma thag tu/ da phyin chad 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro ba 'di ma byung ba byed dgos/ nam 'phro ba na dran pas zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po skabs skabs su btang/ gang yang bsam du med pa'i ngang nas rig pa khong sgrim/ sems gnas sam mi gnas/ 'phro'am mi 'phro snyam pa'i dran shes kyi —20—

bya ra yang yang btang bas/ 'og 'gyu rgyu 'byams kyi song ba de rje chung rje chung la sogs pa/ mi ring ba na sangs te 'gro/ de ltar rtse gcig tu 'jur la sgom zhing /thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngo ba gong dang 'dra/ thun mtshams su'ang sems bzo med kyi gdangs dang ma bral ba bya zhing / gtam cal col mi smra/ sku mnye dang kha zas kyi lcag gis bskul/ 'di ltar bsgoms pas lus nyams/ ngag nyams/sems nyams/ mthong nyams/ rmi nyams sogs gang byung kyang / nyams gyi sne mi bskyil mi bkag par rang babs la gang byung de ka byung rgyal lhug par bskyang dgos/ 〈dbang mdor bstan 〉ji skad du/ gang la'ang skyon du mi blta ling / /ci yang ma yin nyams su blangs/ /drod rtags la sogs 'dod mi bya/ /sgom du med par bstan mod kyang / /le lo btang snyoms dbang mi btang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ thun thun mtshams thams cad du bzang du re ba dang / skyon gyis dogs pa mi bya/ spyod lam drag shul dang / 'dod yon la dga' ba sogs kyi rnam rtog spangs/ kun da byang chub kyi sems ma nyams par bsrung / gos sogs grang dro ran pa dang / mtshan mo'i gnyid tshim par log nyin mo'i gnyid spangs thun gyi skabs rtse gcig tu shugs phyung la sgom zhing / thun yun bsring ba legs so/ /dmigs bskor bdun pa dben gsum gyi 'khrid tshar/ 'di skabs theg gnyis gsum sgom du bcug cing / de bar la spro zhing dgos na/ dben pa'i phan yon dang / zhi lhag gi rang bzhin/ dben gsum gyi gnad rnams zhib mor bshad/ de ltar legs por nges su bcug nas/ lag len bslab/ byin brlabs bya/ lag len/ sbyos pa la dga' na/ byin rlabs 'bebs shing gtor —21—

dbang yang bskur te/ de'i tshul ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyis logs su yi ge mdzad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ de rjes nas mun 'khrid kyi mtshams la 'juga'akhrid lta yang yang bya zhing / gnad du ma 'bye tshor ba rnams bcos/ gegs sel ba dang ngo sprod pa sogs skabs su gang bab bya'o/ /de dag gis ni zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i 'khrid rnams tshar ba yin no//gnyis pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi dngos gzhi sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang / gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang / srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ ces gsungs shing / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang / /bde bas kyang ni 'gru ba par 'gyu byer/ 〈zhes yan lag drug gi nang tshan gyi 'bras bu gsum bstan pas rgyu sor stud sogs kyang bstan to/〉 /zhes dang / dgyes rdor las kyang / yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs te/ mdor na yan lag drug ni/sor sdud kyi yan lag bsam gtan/ srog rtsol/ 'dzin pa/ rjes dran/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste drug po de yin la/ de dag rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang du byas na/ sor bsam sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ srog 'dzin gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ rjes dran thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ltar na/ 〈sor bsam gnyis mthar thug zung 'jug ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'i rgyu stong gzugs mngon du gyur zhing snang sems dbyer med du snang ba'i rnal 'byor yin pas de gnyis zung 'jug mchog gi sku 'grub pa la thog mar nye lam yin —22—

—ngh+ru ra nyer sgrub dang / srog 'dzin gnyis ma dag pa'i rlung bkags nas rlung thig dbyer med du byed pa'i rnal 'byor yin pas de gnyis sngar las ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa la lhag par nye phyir nyer sgrub dang / rjes dran ni 'bar snang gi lha sku 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor yin pas sgrub pa dang / ting 'dzin mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yin pas sgrub chen no/〉 sor bsam bsnyen pa/ srog 'dzin nyer sgrub/ rjes dran sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin sgrub chen no/ /dge ba gsum ltar na/ sor bsam thog mar dge ba/ srog 'dzin bar du dge ba/ dran ting tha mar dge ba'o/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis ltar na/ sor sdud srog rtsol rjes dran gsum rgyu'i yan lag bsam gtan 'dzin pa ting nge 'dzin gsum 'bras bu'i yan lag go /thams cad kyang phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor du gcig la/ yan lag dngos rnam/sa ni snga ma snga ma mthar phyin nas phyi ma phyi ma rgyud la skye bas thog mar skye ba'i dus skabs rim can du gnas shing / de dag skye ba'i rgyu tshogs la bslab pa yan lag drug rjes mthun pa ni/ thog mar so sor zhus shing sbyang nas/ de rjes stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par nyams su len no/ /des na skabs 'dir dngos gzhi la/ thog mar dge ba'i 'khrid/ bar du dge ba'i 'khrid/ tha mar dge ba'i 'khrid de gsum las/ dang po la/ so sor sdud pa'i 'brid dang / bsam gto gyi 'khrid do/ /dang po ni/ gong ma mang po dag dus zhabs snyan brgyud las/ kun la'ang drug tu shes bya ste/ /zhes pa'i go don du mdzad nas/ yan lag thams cad la sa bcad drug gis 'chad par gda'/ sa bcad ni bshad pa yin pas ji ltar sbyar kyang rung mod/ skabs 'dir gong ma'i gsung las kyang mi 'da' zhing / go bde bar sbyar na 'di ltar —23—

legs te/ so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang / sgom don blo la 'god pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ sor sdud dngos dang / bogs 'don spogs pa'i cho ga gnyis so/ /dang po sor sdud dngos la/ mtshan mo gseng med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dang / nyin mo sprin med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ 〈mun pa'i 〉nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i 〈zhon pa ste mngon sum du mthong ba'i sems g.yo med du byas te〉sems dang mig ni 〈mig 'byed 'dzum mi byed par gyen du bltas te rdo rje'i lam zhes pa dbu mar zhugs par byas te bsgoms 〉mi 'dzu/ma rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin btang / gnas khang skabs 'dir nges par mun khang kho na yin zhing / rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nges par dgos te/ dri med 'od las/ bla ma'i 〈rtogs pa'am 〉nges pa'i 〈gdams ngag gi 〉dbang gis sgom pa'i dus dang / 'dod pa'i 〈lhag pa'i 〉lha la bstod pa'i dus 〈kyi 〉su grangs bzhin du sangs rgyas 〈pa'i tshe 〉pa rnams la rdo rje'i 〈skyil krung gi gdan〉gdan bsngags shing / zhes gsungs/ lag pa'ang mnyam bzhag gam khu tshur brla bzhag gang drang zhig dgos par gsungs pas gzhan mi bya/ lta stangs ni rgyud las/ bsnyen pa 〈sor bsam gnyis 〉la ni dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam 〈sa bcu 〉bcu mkha' la 〈gtsug tor 〉'khor lo can gyi khro bo'i lta bas so/ /zhes 'byung bas/ gtsug tor 'khordo ra los bsgyur ba'i lta stangs zhes bya ba/ smin mtshams nas sor bcu drug gzhal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la lta ba 'di kho na dgos/ de yang dbang mdor bstan las/ bkab dang ma bkab mig dag —24—

gis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mig ha cang gdangs pa ma yin pa/ ha cing btsum pa ma yin pa rang babs kyi ngang nas mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa yin/ dmigs gsal can rnams ma gtogs/ sor bsam gnyis kyi skabs thams cad lus gnad lta stangs 'di kho nar nges so/ /de ltar lus gnad byas nas/ bya ba gzhan spangs te bzhag pas rtsa rnams g.yo med du gnas pa ni lus mi g.yo ba/ngag gnad dben gsum gyi skabs bzhin byas pas dag mi g.yo ba/ sems kyi gnad kyang phal cher dben gsum dang 'dra ba las/ gang du mig lta sa'i thad nam mkha'i mun pa la sems che re gtad nas 'jog pa yin te/ dri med 'od las/ dang por stong nyid byang chub ni mun pa la ci yang bsam par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ yid mi g.yo ba'o/ /de ltar na/ grub thob shā wa ri pa'i zhal nas/ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis/ /ga zhwang rlung bcu chud gyur pas/ /phyi nang rtog 'gags rtags bcu 'byung / /so sar gcod pa'i yan lag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don tshang bar bya zhing / dpal sa ra has kyang / mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /chos kyi tshad ni 'di yis chog /mig phyed gyen du lta ba na/ /mthong ba brtan pa nyid kyis shes/ /zhes dang / bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus gcig tu ni gal te nges sbyar na/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i yon tan nges par skye/ /'di dag mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes pa dang / lta stangs nges par gyen du blta dgos pa yang / 'grel chen las/ mig mi 'dzum par steng du blta bas mtshan mar 'gyur ba yin te/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na / lus gnad byed bcing dang ldan pas yid mig rlung gsum gtsug tor thad —25—

kyi nam mkha' dang dbyer med du bsres te gang yang yid la mi byed par sgom dgos so/ /sor sdud kyi dmigs pa dngos te/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa dang pho/ /yang paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i man ngag las/ dmigs pa gtong tshul mi 'dra tsam bzhi byung ba'i man ngag ni 'di yin te/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa'i rtsa ba sngar bshad pa de nyid bsam med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dpe lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu zer/ de skabs sems ma gzhur ba'i skyon gyis rtog pa 'phro ba'am/ sgom skyon can thebs te/ shes pa lteng por song nas sgom min gnyid min du 'gro na/ lta stangs kyi lam nas drangs te/ nam mkha'i dbus su sems thim 'gro ba lta bu shes pa drag tu gtad/ rig pa hur phyung ste bsgrims nas sgom pa ni/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ spre'u sgo gcig tu btags pa lta bu'o/ /dmigs bskor gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang / mig rus na ba dang /ye shes phebs pa ma yin par brgyal ba dang / zug gzer skye ba sogs byung na/byed bcing sngar las ma g.yos bzhin du sems gsal rig gi steng du che re bzo bcos med par bzhag cing / 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam par rtogs pa spangs te/da ltar ba'i shes pa so ma la rang ngo shes pa'i dran pa bsten pa ni/ rang grol kyi rnal 'byor te/ dpe sbun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa zhes bya ste/ dmigs bskor gsum pa'o/ /dmigs pa de gnyis kyi skabs su/ sems bsgrims pas yud tsam re —26—

gnas shing / de'i 'phro la ji tsam sgrim gyin 'phro rgod du song na/ ha cang grim drag pa'i skyon yin pas/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa'i bya ra tsam bzhag nas/ gang yang mi sgom par lhod gyis klod do/ /'di ni rtsol bral gyi rnal snel bya ra te/ dpe rnga mo btags grol lta bu'o/ /dmigs bskor bzhi pa'o/ /dmigs pa phyi ma gsum po 'di rnams kyang dang po'i steng du chang bar bya ste/ /res 'ga' sgrim/ res 'ga' klod/ res 'ga' sems gsal rig gi ngo bo la lta/ phal cher rtsol bral bzo med du 'jog pa nyid mthil du byas te sgom mo/ /dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa dang po phog pa'i mtshams sam/skabs 'di gnyis gang 'os shig tu dngos gzhi'i mun 'khrid dam po la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de— la gnas kyi khyad par ni/'byor ldan gyi gnas phyed g.yab kha shar bstan dang nub bstan lta bu yin la/kun spangs kyi gnas ni/ skyo ra'am/ brag dang shing la sogs pas rang gi lus la grib ma 'byung zhing / skye bo g.yin gyis tshur mi mthong ba zhig dgos la/gnyis ka la yang mtshungs par nam mkha' rgya chen po mthong ba'i sar sgom dgos pa yin no/ /mig lam na mar chu 'bab pa dang / mtsho rdzing nyeng ka sogs mthong sar mi sgom zhes bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig bzhed cing / nub byang la mi lta zhes kyang kha cig 'dod la nyi 'od dang / gangs ri sogs 'od 'tsher bas mig la gnod pas/ de dag kyang mig lam du mi 'byung bas sa'o/ /dus ni/ snga dro nyi —27—

mar rgyab phyogs te/ /phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no/ /nyi phyed mig la gnod pas spangs/ /zhes pa ltar/ snga dro kha nub tu phyogs/ phyi dro kha shar du phyogs pas sgom zhing / phyed g.yab byang bstan nam/ brag dang rtsig pa la sogs pa'i grib ma che bar yod na/ nyin gung yang byang du phyogs pas sgom du rung / de dag kyang sprin ser bu la sogs pa med pa'i dus su sgom zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ srod tho rangs nyin gung rnams dang / gzhan yang sprin dang rlung po yod pa'i dus nyin mo'i rnal 'byor mi sgom ste/ mun khang du mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom par byas la/ gnas dus sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom na 'di nyid sgom pa yin no/ /bsgom bya dngos ni gong du bstan pa'i mi g.yo gsum ldan de nyid yin la/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor sogs gnad phyi ma gsum po de'ang gegs sel bogs 'don du dgos pa byung na bsgoms pas/ bsgom bya dngos nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis po gcig pa yin la/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ rgyud las/ nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis lta bar bya ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pas nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bstan te/ lta stangs kyi gnad khro bo'i lta ba sdang mig 'khru tshugs su lta tshul dgos pa yin/ de bzhin du dmigs pa'i yul gyi gnad kyang mun nag gi nam mkha' la lta ba'i tshab tu/ sprin med kyi nam mkha' sngo sang nge ba dang / rang sems gsal jig ge ba dbyer med pa lta bu la 'jog go /dngos gzhi'i dmigs bskor drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'don spogs chog la/ nyin par dang 'brel ba'i spogs chog dang / mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de —28—

la spyir yan lag drug gar gyi spogs chog btsan thabs sbyor ba rnam pa gsum yin par rgyud las gsungs/ de dag rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir dang po'i las can la sor sdu da kho na dang 'brel ba ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa'i spogs pa ni/ /byed bcing drag tu brtsa ma par bya/ /zhes pa dang / byed bcing gang la zer na/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba las/ mtshan mo gseng med khyim du ni/ yen tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos/ /byed pa lnga la bcing pa gnyis/ /bla ma'i zha' las shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas/ 'di yang rgyud las gsungs pa'i spogs chog btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba'i nang du gtogs pa yin no/ /de yang byed pa lnga ni dbang po lnga'i rlung /bcing pa gnyis ni srog dang thur sel bcing pa yin pas/ 'di'i lag len ni nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gang gi skabs yin yang 'dra/ mig gnyis lta sa rgya chen po ma yin pa phra mo gcig la drag tu bsgril/ lte phugs su bzlog mchu dang sna dang rna ba gsum gcud/ bzhin khro bo'i gdong du bya/ lus nya bzhi sgrim zhing rkang sor rnams bkug khu tshur dang skyil krung dam du bya/ dpung pa drag tu rgyangs/des dbang po lnga'i rlud 'ching / lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba dang / phyir 'phel kha bskyed pa gnyis re mos bya/ de yang re mos myur po ma yin par chu tshod re re tsam spel dgos/ des srog thur gnyis bcings par 'gyur/ de lta bu thun gyi gsum cha'am/ bzhi cha tsam re bsgom/ thun gyi lhag ma rnams dkyus bzhin sgom pas/ sor sdud yun ring du bsgoms kyang nyams rtogs ma skyes pa rnams skye/dang po cung zad skyes kyang nyams pa rnams gso thub/ sngar cung zad skyes pa ma —29—

nyams kyang dang po skyes pa de las yar bskyed ma byung na'ang / 'di bsgoms pas gong 'phel du 'gro/ des na spogs pa'i cho ga zhes bya'o/ /thog ma nyid nas 'di bsgoms kyang tshegs che zhing gegs sdang la/ phyis bogs bskyed chung bar yod pas/ gong gi gnas skabs gsum po de byung na sgom gyi gzhan mi dgos so/ /dmigs bskor bdun pa'o/ /yang tsa mi dang / rga lo'i man ngag las/ skar khung la lta ba dang / snod chus gang ba la lta ba'i man ngag re yod kyang stong gzugs kyi spogs chog tu cung zad 'gro mod kyi/ gnad gal chung bar mngon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs sor sdud kyi lus gnad ma 'byongs bar du ni/ rang babs su bzhag pa nyid legs la/ lus gnad lta ltangs 'byongs nas/ tsog pu'am/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal zhing / mig btsum nas mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa'i lta stangs dang / sems kyi gnad lta stangs kyi lam nas drangs te nam mkha' la lta ba nyid yin pas/ de'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /nyin mo'i sgom shugs dang / gnyid du 'gro khar mtshams sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis/ zhag bdun nam/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig la sogs pa nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par 'gyur/ ci ste ma zin na/ rang dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang 'od du zhu/ 'od phung gi mtha' nas rim gyis yal/snying kha'i thad du til 'bru tsam mam sbu shad tsam la ring du sems bzung de yang yal te nam mkha' stong pa la sems gtad/ de lta bu lan bdun tsam —30—

bsgoms nas sngar bzhin byas pas myur du zin par 'gyur rdo /de la gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i tshad mang po yod kyang / re zhig gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su gsal stong gi rig pa rnam rtog gi g.ya' dang bral zhing / rang ngo skyong shes pa la rtags snang sna tshogs pa 'char ba zhig byung na gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i grangs su chud pa yin no/ /dmigs bskor brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis/ nga/ sgo ma don blo la 'god pa ni/ gang zag shin tu blo dman pa bshad kyang mi go ba dang / blo gros chen po'i rigs bshad mi dgos pa dang /mgyogs khrid byed pa'i skabs rnams su ma bshad kyang chog gnas skabs gzhan du ci rigs par 'chad pa bla ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun yin zhing /gal yang che ba yin te 'og ma rnams la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /de yang mdo tsam smos na/ so sor sdud pa'i mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgom pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug go /dang po ni/ legs par sbyar ba sa sgrita'i skad du/pra ti so so/ ā ha ra skabs thobs kyis sdud pa/ spong ba/ za ba/ gcod pa/len pa sogs la 'jug pa las/ skabs 'dir sdud pa ste/ mtshams sbyar bas pra t+yā ha ra so sor sdud pa'o) /tha mal pa'i dbang po lnga dang yul lnga'i 'brel ba gcod cing yul la rnam shes yan pa sdud pa dang / ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi dbang po gzhan lnga 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin gyi yul lnga la longs spyod cing za ba dang len pa'i don yin te/ mdor na tha mal gyi snang ba la sems bsdus nas ye shes kyi snang ba la 'jug pa'i don no/ /de ltar yang / rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa —31—

lus la yul dang yul can bcu po rnams ni rab tu 'jug pa med pa'o /zhes so /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud thog ma rang bsgom pa'i skabs kyi lan gcig po de la/ rlung sna bug g.yon nas g.yas su 'phos ma thag pas rlung 'bab pa'i dus der bsgoms na/ g.yas kyi 'pho ba rnams 'byung pa sdud rim gyi rgyu ba yin pas ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su bsdu ba'i rten 'bre' khyad par can du 'gyur/ gzhan yang las dang po pas gnyid kyi dus ma gtogs 'bad nas sgom pa gal che zhing / lus gnad ga tsho' byangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams ci rigs pa brtan nas nyin gung dang / phyi phred kyi dus thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor tsam gyi sgo nas bskyangs na gegs mi sdang zhing bogs che ba yin no gsungs so / /gsum pa ni/ sor sdud kyi ngo bo ni rnam par mi rtog pa mi g.yo gsum ldan gyis rlung dbu mar sdud pa'i nus pa can zhig ste/ nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten la chags 'jig gnyis/ bcud kyi sems can la skye 'chi gnyis/ lo la bgrod pa 〈lho bgrod dang byang bgrod 〉gnyis/ zla ba la phyogs 〈dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs 〉gnyis/ zhag la nyin mtshan gnyis/ khams 〈dkar dmar 〉'pho ba la g.yas g.yon gnyis/ dus sbyor dang rlung gi 'pho ba la'ang 〈g.yas 〉mnyam pa dang mi 〈g.yon 〉mnyam pa gnyis sogs thabs shes kyi dbye ba'i dag pas nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis nges par dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar yang / rgyud phyi ma las/ 〈mtshan mo ste mun pa'i nam mkhar du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan rtags bzhi mngon sum du mthong ba'i mtshan mos rnal 'byor sgom dgos par —32—
