bstan/〉mtshan mo du ba la sogs rnal 'byo ra slar yang nyin mo nam mkha' la ni 〈'bar ba la sogs pa'i nyin rtags drug rma ngon sum du mthong ba'i nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sbom par bstan〉'bar ba la sogs kyang / /zhes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo las kyang / ko'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 8sna byar du byed pa des nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du bya'o /ko'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa des bla gab med pa la rnal 'khya/ra du bslab par bya'o tsho /zhes gsungs pas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs la nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'dre(ra gnyis tshang ba dgos pa mdo sngags gnyis ka'i dgongs pa yin zhing / 'on kyang lus la gnad du bsnun pa sogs thabs khyad par can gzhan gyi sgo nas gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa yin na/khyad par du yang 'di'i gnad ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyis g.yas kyi dkyil 'kho7ra lnga dang / nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis g.yon gyi lnga rnams dbu mar bsdus pas mtshan rtags nges pa rtags bcu sogs 'char ba yin te/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ so sor sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yul rtags bcu ste/ rgyud las/ stong pa 〈rnal 'byor ba'i rang ngo'i stong seng gi nam mkha' 〉la ni du ba 〈ngang)〉 smig rgyu 〈dang 〉rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid 〈de me khyer dang 〉/dang mar me dang / zhes mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rtags bzhi dang / 'bar ba 〈ste dus me 〉dang ni zla ba 〈dang 〉/ nyi ma 〈dang 〉/ rdo rje 〈ste〉sgra gcan rnams dang mchog gi cha 〈ste glog 〉dang thig le 〈sngon po 〉mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes nyin mo'i —33—

rnal 'byor gyi rtags drug ste/ rtags bcu nges pa'i rtags yin la/ bcu po de dag gang rung re'i khongs su gtogs pa yin yang / rnam pa ma nges pa'i rtags ni mtha' yas pa zhig go /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /de yang chos nyid don dam pa'i ye shes rang la bzhugs shing / lam bsgoms pas de mngon du 'gyur ba la yid ches skye ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir rtags zhes bya yis/kun rdzob 'khrul snang gi rtags tsam ni ma yin no/ /de ltar rtags de rnams mthong ba'i shes pa ni tshad ma ste/ de yang rgyud las/ lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum 〈sgo ma 〉dang ni rjes su dpag pa 〈pa'i 3 ma 〉rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim gyi tshad ma ni rjes dpag yin la/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi tshad ma thams cad mngon sum yin no/ /mngon sum yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rnam pa 〈dbang po mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngon sum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum 〉bzhi yod la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 〈rnal 'byor mngon sum mngon 〉sum gcig yin pas/ yan lag drug po so so'i skabs kyi mngon sum thams cad la mngon sum bzhi char gyi mtshan nyid cha shas re tshang yod kyang / skabs 'dir dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid gtso che ba yin la/ de'i brten dbang po yang spyan lnga 〈sha'i spyan/ lha'i spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ shes rab kyi sbyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan 〉las sha'i mig yin no/ /de ltar yang / dri med 'od las/ 'dir dang por 〈bsam gto mthar ma phyin pa yan chad kyi 〉las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor 〈ba'i rgyud la rme ngon shes ma 'grub 〉pas mngon par shes pa med par —34—

sha'i mig gis sna tshogs mthong ngo / /zhes so/ /mig gi sgra ni/ ak+ṣa zhes bya ba'i sgra las drangs na/ dbang po thams cad la'ang 'jug pas gzugs kyi rnam cha mthong ba'i rten kho na la mi bzung gis/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dzin pa mtha' dag la 'jug go /'og ma rnams la'ang 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /lnga pa ni/ yan lag drug po thams cad kyis dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi ni chos nyid bde gshegs snying po kho na yin pas dbye ba med la/ dag bya la dbye na spyir phung khams sum cu so drug yod pa las/ so sor sdud pa'i ngo skal gyi dag bya ye shes kyi phung po la 〈ye shes kyi khams/ yid dbang / sgra'i skye mched mchog gi dbang po dri chu 'dor ba ste ye shes kyi khams pa drug sogs pa ye shes kyi khams pa drug 〉sogs pa ye shes kyi khams pa drug tshan gcig po de yin la/ dag byed sor sdud la dbye na bcu ste/ rtags bcu rim pas 'char ba'i dbang gis nyams rtogs mtho dman gyi dbye ba bcu yod pas so/ /drug pa ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bden tshig 'grub pa dang /sngags 'bras grub pa ste/ 〈rgyud las〉so sor sdud pas rnal 'byor pa ni 〈gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga dang / de lnga 'dzin pa'i yul can 'jug shes lnga'i 'brel ba 'gyung ba'i rgyud rlung 'gags pa yul dang rnam par bral ba 〉ste bden tshig 〈sngags rnams kun gyis byin gyis bden tshig 'grub pa'i don no〉 brlob/ /ces gsungs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ nam zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i dus na rdo rje sems dpa' la 〈sna tshogs yum/ kun tu bzang po/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gnod mdzes rgyal po/shin tu sngon mo ste lha ye shes khams pa drug 〉sogs pa lha ye shes khams pa drug tshan —35—

gcig gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams 'byung bgo /de ltar sor sdud kyi sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di bsdu na thun gcig la tshang bar bya/ rgyas pa la spro na thun mang por bshad de/ ma tha' chod la nges pa brtan por bya'o/ /des so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid/ tshar ro/ / de tsam gyis chog shes par byed na/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir bshad de/ re zhig 'khrid rdzogs pa'i lugs su byas la/ yang skabs 'di nas bsam gtan gyi 'khrid ston par 'dod na/ sor sdud kyi sgom don blo la 'god pa song ba'i rjes thogs kho nar bas/ma gtan gyi 'khrid rim gyis 'bogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsam sa/tan gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang / sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsam gtan dngos dang / spogs chog bogs 'don dang bcas pa ste gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ mtshan mo 'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas su bsgom pa gtso che zhing / spyir nyin rma tshan gyi rnal 'byor gyi gnas gnyis kar du bsgom ste/ lus gnad ngag gnad gnyis po sngar sor sdud kyi skabs dang 'dra/ sems gnad kyang mi g.yo bar 'jog tshul sogs phal cher 'dra mod kyis/ khyad par cung zad yod pa ni/ sngar sor sdud kyi skabs su ni/ stong gzugs ma mthong na lta ci smos/ mthong ba'i dus na'ang stong gzugs la sems mi 'jog par nam mkha' kho na la sems gtod pa yin la/ 'dir ni nam mkha' la sems 'jog pa'i tshab tu stong gzugs la sems 'jog pa ste/ stong gzugs mthong ba'i dus de nyid du/ rig nga stong gzus/sa la che re gtad cing / 'di yin 'di min sogs kyi dpyad pa —36—

dang / rnam rtog ye mi byed/ lta mkhan gyi rig pa kho rang gis rig ge ba kho rang la lta shes tsam bya'o/ /'di stong gzugs brtan pa thob nas sgom pa yin pas/sgom la bzhag pa'i dus stong gzugs med pa cher mi yong la/ ci ste med pa'i skabs seng cung zad byung na/ sor sdud bzhin sgom/ stong gzugs g.yas g.yon steng 'og sogs su yal yol byed na yang de'i rjes su mig dang sems gnyis kar mi 'brang bar/ lta stangs dang rig pa thog ma'i gtod sa de khar gtod dgos/ de ltar byas pas sems gtod sa de khar rim gyis stong gzugs 'dus 'ong / de g.yo ba'i rjes su lta stangs dang sems 'brangs na/ byed bcing dang dmigs pa'i gnad 'chugs pas stong gzugs rang yang mi brtan par 'gro ba shas che/ ma song yang dmigs pa'i gnad la brtan pa mi thob pas re zhig lta stangs dang / /sems gtod sa g.yo med du byed pa gal che'o/ /dmigs bskor dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ spogs chog dang / bogs 'don gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ bsam gtan stong gzugs dras tu sgom// sgyu/zhes gsungs pas/ sor sdud kyi spogs chog ltar byed bcing drag po btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba de byed cing / dmigs pa yang stong gzugs kyi cha shas phra mo zhig gi dbus su sems zhugs 'gro ba lta bur drag tu gzir ba nyid do/ /dmigs bskor bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes spyan sgrub las/ snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal bzung / /phra ba'i 'od la brten nas ni/ /rags pa'i 'od can ngo —37—

sprad pas/ /rtog med 'od las srid 'das snang / /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ni/ snang ba gsal po dang bcas pa'i phyogs su yang stong gzugs brtan po 'char na/ lta stangs sngar gyi las cung zad smad nas zhag gsum bzhi tsam bsgoms pa na/ sngar gyi las rtags snang cung zad mi gsal du 'gro yin 'dug na / da dung bogs 'don de sgom ma ran pa yin pas/ lta stangs steng de sngar bzhin theg shas 'jur du sgom/ yang sngar bzhin lta stangs smad nas bsgoms pas/ de la stong gzugs brtan por yod/ de bzhin du rim gyis rim gyis lta stangs phab kyin bsgoms pas mi ring bar thad kar lta ba dang / thur du lta ba sogs thams cad la stong bzugs brtan por 'gro ste/ de nas rdo nag po'am/bong ba la sogs pa mig la mi gnod pa'i dngos po ha cang che ba ma yin pa zhig rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ lta stangs kyi lam nas rim pas stong gzugs te dngos po de'i steng du phab la/ dngos po de yang mthong bzhi pa'i ngang nas stong gzugs la sems gzhur te sgom mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pas stong gzugs dang las snang gi dngos po gnyis kar cha mnyam du mthong gin 'dug na 'char tshul tha ma yin te/ bogs che rgyu med na'ang yun ring goms na gnad du 'gro/ 'ga' zhig de ma thag las snang gi dngos po de mi mthong bar/ 'od gsal gyi rtags de mthong ba zhig yong ste/ 'char tshul bzang bzang 'dra ste 'bring yin pas/ bskyed ha cang che ba mi yong / yang rtags snang dang las snang gnyis kar dus gcig tu yal te/ re zhig gang yang snang ba med pa zhig byung na myur du las snang 'gag cing / 'od gsal gyi snang ba rab 'byams 'char bar 'gyur/ 'di'i rigs —38—

bogs che zhing 'char sgo bzang ba yin no/ /rtags snang yal nas las snang 'dug pa'am/ rtags snang mi gsal du song zhing las snang gsal du song na/bogs 'don bsgom ma ran pa yin pas/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de la goms nas dngos po rgya je che je che la bslabs pas/ mthar ri chen po sogs stong gzugs su 'char bas mtshon te snang ba thams cad la sbyar ro/ /dmigs bskor bcu gcig pa'o/ /ga ti'i nang du 'od gsal gzung ba dang / srog rtsol gyi sgor 'od gsal bzung ba ༄gnyis ni/ srog rtsol gyi gdams ngag dang 'brel ba yin zhing / bsam gtan la shin tu brtan pa thob pa yin na ma gtogs/ las dang po pas 'grub dka' bas skabs 'dir ma bshad do/ /stong pa'i sgra thos pa brtan po yod na/las snang gi sgra dang bsres te/ 'bab chu'i sgra lta bu dang / stong pa'i sgra gnyis ka tshor bar byas te/ de gnyis mnyam po la sems gtad/ des 'bab chu'i sgra 'gags te stong pa'i sgra 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ de nas skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i sgra lta bu la sbyang / de nas gtam smra ba thams cad la sbyang / de nas rang gzhan gyi sgra thams cad la sbyangs pas/ sgra phal cher stong pa'i sgrar 'gyur/ 'dis dri ro reg bya gsum la'ang rigs 'gre mod/ re zhig ma smos so/ /dmigs bstor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud kyi skabs dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ nyal ba'i tshe stong gzugs nyid la sems gtad cing/ rnam rtog gis bar ma chod par gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal myur du zin yod la/ stong 7 —39—

gzugs rang lus kyi nang du 'char thub kyi yod na/ stong gzugs snying gar drangs nas/ de la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar byas na/ dus de nyid du gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par the tshom med do/ /dmigs bskor bcu gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ bsam gtan gyi mtshan don/sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgom pa'i rtags tshad/dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgom pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ sgyu na zhes pa dmigs pa la sems g.yo ba med pa'i don te/ de yang sgo gtan legs po btsud na/ sgo gleg khyar khyor du mi g.yo bar/ sgo 'byed gcod la rang dbang thob pa ltar/ dmigs pa la dbang bar byed pa'i don te/ dri med 'od las/ 〈yul stong gzugs lnga dang yul can stong gzugs mthong ba'i ye shes lnga bsam gtan gyi skabs 'dir gcig tu bsten par snang ba'i sgo nas yul sna tshogs pa'i stong gzugs la bsam gtan pa ste rtse gcig tu gnas so〉/ yul dang yul can bcu po rnams gcig nyid du sna tshogs gzugs la bsam gtan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs 'od gsal de la sems rtse gcig tu byed cing /gnas pa dang 'gyu ba la rang ci 'dod du dbang thob par byed pa'i don te/ theg pa spyi ldog nas kyang bsam gtan gyi don dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud mthar phyin na rab yin la/ min na'ang 'od gsal gyi rtags snang brtan por shar ba'i dus so/ /—40—

gsum pa ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ 〈blo bcos nas btags pa lta bu ma yin par 〉chi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /rtag tu gzugs de bsgom par bya/ /zhes bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ 'od gsal rtags snang la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de'i yan lag ni/ bsdus rgyud las/ bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse gcig sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang 'od gsal rtags bcu la rtse gcig pa'i sems ni shes rab yin la/ ji skad du/ rtog pa zhes pa ni dngos po 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i dngos po'i ming can stong gzugs kyi mtshan nyid shes pa ni rtog pa yin la/ mtshan nyid shes tshul yang rang sems tsam yin par nyams su myong ba'o/ /sems nyid stong gzugs su shar ba de la gzung 'dzin nam/ yul yul can gyi rnam rtog dang spros pa'i mtshan ma gang gis kyang ma gos par myong zhing nges pa ni dpyod pa'i yan lag yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i sems kyi bde ba phyi la dmigs pa dang / nang la dmigs pa gnyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i phyi la dmigs pa ni sngar med kyi nom pa chen po rnyed pa ltar dga' zhing skyid snang shar ba ste bde ba'i yan lag yin la/ nang la dmigs pa ni ting nge 'dzin de nyid bde bar shar ba myong ba yin te g.yo med bde ba'i yan lag yin/ des rkyen byas nas lus la shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can gyis khyab pa ni g.yo med bde ba'i yang phan yon no/ /de yang dang por shes rab rkyang pa skye/ de nas rtog pa dang gnyis ldan du 'byung / de bzhin du dpyod pa dang gsum ldan/ dga' ba dang bzhi ldan/ g.yo med bde ba dang lnga ldan du 'byung ste/—41—

de tsam na bsam gtan gyi yan lag rdzogs par rgyud la skyes pa yin pas/ de nyid rgyun bsrings te bsgoms na mthar phyin pa'i yon to rnams myur du skye bar tsor ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud las/ de'i dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par 〈rtog btags lta bu'i yul dang bral ba ste yul ma yin par sna tshogs pa'i stong gzugs dwangs shing gsal ba'i bdag nyid du mthong ba'i don no〉 bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bsam gtan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags bstan pa yin te/ rtags bcus/ bsdus pa srid pa gsum mtha' dag gi gzugs brnyan sngar song sdud skabs su mthong ba las ches lhag pa/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sna tshogs pa'i snang brnyan kha dog sna tshogs pa de dag kyang / 'od zer 'phro ba/ cha phra ba/ 'tsher ba/ 'dar ba/ gzhig par dka' ba/ zhes pa chos lnga ldan rnams thig le du mas mtshan pa mthong zhing / thig le'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan du ma 'char ba yin la/ de yang sems nyid dag pa'i snang bar rtogs pas/ kun rdzob las snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rang 'char ba yin te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ de la sems ni brtan pa'i bsam gtan gyis kyang phyi rol kyi ni dngos po rnam par spong bar byed/ /ces so/ /tshad ma ni sor sdud dang mtshungs pa las de'i rten dbang po ni lha'i spyan te/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan kyis mngon shes lnga 'grub pa'ang yin no/ /lnga pa la/ dag gzhi ni sngar sor sdud kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin yin la / dag bya la dbye na/ rnam shes kyi phung po 〈nam mkha'i khams/ rna ba'i dbang po/—42—

chos kyi skye mched/ gsang ba'i dbang po/ khu ba 'dor ba ste nam mkha'i khams pa drug 〉sogs phung khams nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig tu dbye/ dag byed bsam gtan gyi yan 'a ga nyid la dbye na'ang yul can bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga dang / de'i yul stong gzugs lnga ste bcu'o/ /drug pa ni/ rgyud las/ mngon par shes pa lnga ni thob par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po bsam gtan sbyor bas dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsam gtan mthar phyin pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu mngon shes 〈rdzu snyul gyi mngon shes/lha'i mig dang / rna ba dang / gzhan sems shes pa'i de sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang / zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i mngon shes so〉lnga rang shar du 'byung ba yin zhing / mthar thug gi 'bras bu rgyal ba mi bskyod pa la 〈rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ chos khams rdo rje ma/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ drag spyan ma ste lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug〉sogs pa lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dir 'phros don gyi man ngag cung zad tsam brjod na/ shes rab kyi yan lag rgyud la skyes pas/ sems gang du gtad sar stong gzugs 'char ba zhig 'byung la/ de nas snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag bsgoms pas/ phyi rol kyi snang ba gang la sems bzhag pa der skad cig la las snang 'gags te 'od gsal gyi snang bar 'gyur ba zhig yod na/ des snga dro phyi dro'i dus su rang gcer bur phyung ba'i grib gzugs kyi snying ga la lta ba'am/ nyin gung ljon shing gi grib ma la lta bas kyang drang ste/ mig sprid sprid du g.yo ba med par lha/ de nas nam mkha' la bltas pas/ grib gzugs kyi rnam pa'i dbus su rtags —43—

snang dpag tu med par 'char/ zla ba drug tu 'di yang yang bsgoms nga sa sa 'og gi gter sogs kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du khang pa'i skar khung sogs la sbyangs pas/ khyim nang gi dngos po lkog gyur yang mthong pa yod cing / de bzhin du las snang gi sgra stong pa'i sgrar thim 'gro na/ stong pa'i sgra dang / 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'i skad bsres pa la mnyam par gzhag pa zla ba drug bsgoms pas rna ba'i mngon shes ci rigs par thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying ga chos 'khor gyi rtsa chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang du stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtad na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ de nyid gzhan la spos na/ gzhan gyi sems shes te/nyi ma la ni rgyab kyis phyogs nas/ zhes sogs dang / sgra ni gang zhig snying gi phyogs na zhes sogs rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar grib gzugs/ shing grib/ sgra skad/ rang dang gzhan gyi snying ga'i rtsa la dmigs pa ste/ lnga po 'di rnams dmigs phran yin pas dkyus kyi dmigs bskor la mi 'dren no/ /sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /des bsam gtan gyi 'khrid tshar ro/ /re zhig srog rtsol man chad mi 'bogs shing / de tsam gyis chog shes par byed na/ rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bar du dge ba'i 'khrid la/ las rlung a wa ga ting 'gag par byed pa dang / dbu ma'i nang du mi shigs pa'i thig le la thim rber byed pa'i dbye ba gnyis te/ srog rtsol gyi 'khrid dang / 'dzin pa'i 'khrid do/ /dang po srog rtsol gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang / sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /—44—

dang po la/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag dngos mtshan nyid tshang ba dang / srog rtsol rjes mthun pa las dang pos sgrub par bya ba gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /re zhig phyi ma'i dbang du byas nas bshad par bya ste/ de la paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang / paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i man ngag 'bro lugs su grags pa dang / jo bo sa man+ta shrī'i man ngag rwa lugs su gras sa pa ste/ gsum po 'di gzhung shing du bya la/ lugs gzhan thor bu pa rnams kyang phal cher de dag dang mthun zhing / cung zad khyad par yod pa rnams 'chad par yang 'gyur ro/ /de las paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag 'di la/ sngon 'gro rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba/ 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar gzhug pa/ zhugs nas rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu mar 'ching ba/ ma chud cing ma 'chings na btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag cing / bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng gi sbyor bas dgrol ba/ lte gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor bas nang gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ba/gtum mo sbar ba'i sbyor bas srog thur bsre zhing 'chi med sgrub pa ste rdo rje'i tshig drug ces bya ba yin pa— las/ dang po bzhi po srog rtsol gyi man ngag dang / phyi ma gnyis 'dzin pa'i man ngag tu mdzad do/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar bya ste/ srog stsol gyi man ngag dngos dang / bogs 'don gegs sel dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la/ lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor gyi yi ge logs su bkod pa ltar/ sngon 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor dang bcas bzhin du 'di rnams sgom ste/ de yang paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ sngar bshad pa'i rlung spyor dang po gsum ste/ de —45—

la dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ lta stangs kyi khyad par ni/bgegs mthar byed dam bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lta stangs zhes bya ba/ thad ka las cung zad gyen du phyogs pa/ smin mtshams su hrig ger lta ba yin/ dmigs bsal can rnams ma gtogs srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi lta stangs thams cad 'di kho nar nges te/ rgyud las/ bgegs mthar byed pa'i lha ba bdud rtsi'i lam du son pa yis kyang nye bar sgrub pa yan lag drug /ces gsungs pas so/ /lus gnad g.yin rnams sngar dang 'dra/ rlud ro lan gsum bsal la/ dang por rlud phyi 'gro nang 'gro gnas pa gsum la sems ma 'khrul bar gtod de/ rdor bzlas kyi dmigs pa dang po'o/ /de nas rtsa gsum gsal gdab ste/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma sngon po sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring bo tsam yar sna gtsug tor tu zug mar sna nye bar gnas pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po ste/de gnyis dbu ma las ldab 'gyur gyis phra ba/ dbu ma dang gsum gzhibs su 'dug par mos/ rlung phyir 'gro dus lte ba nas brtsams te dbu ma dang ro ma gnyis nas song / mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i bar gyi rtsa gnyis po'i cha thams cad nas thon/ sna bug nas phyir 'gro bar bsam/ nang du yong dus sna bug nas zhugs/ gtsug tor nas mgrin pa'i bar gyi dbu ma dang rkyang ma'i bar gyi cha thams cad nas thogs med du song ste/ rtsa gnyis po'i lam rgyud lte bar phyin/gnas pa'i tshe dbu ma kho na'i nang gang bar bsam/ thog mar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum mnyam pa tsam byas pas/ rim gyi gnas pa je ring la 'gro'o/ /de —46—

yang sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i skabs yin na/ rlung rnams 'od dmar po dang /g.yon nas rgyu na dkar po dang / mnyam rgyur 'dug na ljang khu'am sngon po 'gro 'ong gnas gsum byed par sgom pa ste/ rdor bzlas kyi gnyis pa'o/ /'bud pa'i tshe sna bug g.yon 'gegs pa dang / rngus pa'i tshe g.yas 'gegs pa lag len kha cig la 'dug kyang / rdor bzlas kyi skabs de ltar mi dgos so/ /de nas sngar dang 'dra ba las phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od zer u'i sgra dang bcas pa/ 'od zer gyi sne la u yig dang bcas te 'gro ba dang / de nyid nang du 'ong ba'i tshe oṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pa/ tshur 'ong ba'i sne la oṃ yig dang bcas te 'ong bar bsam/ yi ge de gnyis kyang ro rkyang nas 'gro 'ong mi byed de dbu ma kho na nas 'gro bar bsam/ gnas pa'i skabs dbu ma'i nang na hu gi sgra dang bcas shing lte bar hū yig la sems gtad do/ /yi ge'i kha dog kyang rlung dang 'dra bar/g.yas g.yon mnyam rgyu'i dbye bas dmar dkar sngo ba'o/ /de dag ni dmigs bcas kyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ rdor bzlas kyi gsum pa dang dngos gzhi yin la/de gsum kar bsdoms pa dmigs chen gcig yin pas// dngos gzhi'i dmigs bskor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /da lta las dang po pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ 'di lta bu las 'os med la/don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rma gi 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dbyer med du shes pa na ming tshig brjod pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ming ngo / /gnyis pa 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar gzhug pa —47—

ni/ rlung gang nas rgyu brtags te/ sna bug g.yon nas rgyu na/ lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mos mchan khung g.yon nu ma dang bcas te bsdams pa'i steng nas/ bar lhu g.yon pas mnan/ rlud ro bsal/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa bkag sna bug g.yon nas rlung shugs che la ring bar rngubs te lte bar mnan/cung zhig bsdams nas mi bde ba 'byung tshad pa nas/ sna bug g.yon mdzum mo g.yon pas bkag nas/ gdong g.yas su phyogs pas sna g.yas nas rlung drag tu 'bud/ yang sna bug g.yas pa bkag g.yon nas rngubs pa sogs gong bzhin bskyar gyin sbyang / 'di skabs rkang pa brkyang bskum gyi 'dug stangs bshad na'ang skyil krung nyid kyis chog la/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bcings dgos shing /des rlung sna bug g.yas su 'pho ba'am/ mnyam rgyur 'gyur ba dang / yang sna bug g.yas nas rgyun phyag rgya de nyid go bzlog pas g.yon rgyu'am mnyam rgyur 'gyur ba dang / g.yas g.yon phan tshun du lan 'ga' re spos na nges par mnyam rgyur 'gyur la/ mnyam rgyur song nas lugs 'di la rdor bzlas byed cing / yang g.yas g.yon du yo na/ snga ma'i sbyor bas yon po srong ngo / /zhes bzhed la/ 'on kyang mnyam rgyur nam song ba'i tshe/ dgang ba'i rnal 'byor ram/ bum can bsgoms na bzang bas/ bar 'dir dgang ba'i rlung sbyor zhig bcug na legs par mthong ngo / /'di tshe ring po sgrub pa la lhag par bsngags so/ /dmigs bskor bco lnga pa'o/ /gsum pa rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog rlung dbu mar 'ching ba ni/ thog ma nas mnyam rgyur 'dug na legs/ yon por 'dug na gong gi sbyor —48—

bas mnyam rgyur btang ste/ rkang pa zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang / lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol bar bshad na'ang / rkang pa skyil krung gi steng nas byas pas chogagayas g.yon dbus gsum nas/ rlud ro dal ba dang / drag po dang / shin tu drag po'i tshul gyis lan gsum gsum ste/ dgu phrugs su bus/ 'di skabs thur sel gyi rlung 'then gyis bya/ de nas steng rlung cung zad myur bar sas te lte bar bskyur stabs su mnan pa dang lhan cig mchil ma mid/ de rjes thur sel g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas drangs te/ kha sbyor lte bar thub tshad bzung / mi thub pa 'dra na phyir ma shor bar rngubs chung lan gsum byas te mnan/ de nas kyang mi thub pa 'dug na dal bus phyir btang la mthar sangs te 'bud do/ /'dir lag len bzhin pus mo la bskor te se gol gtogs pa so drug khegs na tha ma/ don gnyis khegs na 'bring / brgya brgyad khegs na chen po'o zhes grags so/ /'di dag la dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ lus nang du 'od gsal rtags snang 'char na lte bar stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtod pa yin/ de bzhin ma yin na/ sems stong gzugs gang du shar sa der gtod cing / ma shar ba'i bar bar la blos bcos te sgom pa'i dmigs rten ni mi dgos/ lus kyi dbus lte ba'i thad tsam du sems kyi gtad so tsam bya'o/ /dmigs bskor bcu drug pa'o/ /paṇa chen zla mgon gyi man ngag 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / dgug pa dang / dgang ba dang / rengs pa dang / rdul mtha' can te lnga yod pa las/ phyi ma spogs chog yin pas man ngag —49—

dngos gzhi snga ma bzhi'o/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ ro rkyang nas 'gro ba'i dmigs pa mi mdzad/ g.yas g.yon mnyam rgyu gang yin yang 'dra ste/ phyir 'gro ba dmar po/ nang du 'jug pa dkar po/ gnas pa nag por sgom pa dang / rdor bzlas kyi sngon 'gro gnyis po mi dgos pa'o/ /'di snga ma dang don gcig pas dmigs bskor logs par mi 'dren no/ /rdor bzlas 'di grub chen yu mo'i dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi sbyor drug na gsal bar yod/ spyir 'bro ba gong ma rnams bum pa can nyid la rdor bzlas tshang bar bzhed de rgyud don dang shin tu 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa dgug pa ni/ sna bug g.yas nas rlud rgyu ba'i skabs lta stangs cung zad g.yas phyogs su bsgyur zhing / rlung nang du dal bus drangs nas gsang gnas su mnan la thub tshad du bsdams/ mi thub na sud tsam sud tsam bar bcad kyin bcad kyin mthar sangs kyis btang ngo / /dmigs bskor bcu bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa dgang ba ni/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu ba'i tshe/ lta stangs cung zad g.yon du bsgyur/ nang du cung zad mgyogs par shar te sas la/gsus pa ldir gyis dgang / gtong ba sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs bskor bco brgyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa rengs pa ni/ sngar gyi 'jam rlung dgang gtong dang phyogs mtshungs shing / lugs 'di'i bum pa can yang 'dis 'grub par bzhed la/ don la'ang 'jam rlung gi bum can yin no/ /de yang rlung ro bsal la sna bug g.yon nas rgyu na lta stangs g.yas su bsgyur/ 'og sgo bsdams g.yas nas dal la ring —50—

bar rngubs te/ gsang gnas su bzung la/ mthar g.yas nas btang / g.yas nas rgyu na lta stangs g.yon du bsgyur/ g.yon nas dal bus rngubs/ 'og sgo bsdams/ lto ba ldir gyis bya/ mthar g.yon nas btang ngo / /de ltar re mos su spel gyin sgom/ mnyam rgyur 'dug na lta stangs thad kar byas la myur bar rngubs/ lte bar kha sbyor drag po'i ngang nas lto ba cung zad tshigs pa la gcer/phyir dal bus gtong / de ltar na bum pa can te dmigs bskor bcu dgu pa'o /lugs 'di yang srog rtsol kyi man ngag cha tshang ba gcig go /grub chen man lung ba'i bzhed pa yin gsungs/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal dang bu ston sogs gong mas bskyar bzlos mdzad pa de yang phal cher 'di dang 'dra'o/ /rwa lugs kyi man ngag ni/ dang po srog rlud dngos gzhug pa ni/ lus gnad sogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ dang por sna bug g.yas lta bu zhig mdzub mos bkag nas rlung bus shing rngubs/ 'og rlung bag tsam bsdams pa'i bum pa can bzung /yang sna bug g.yon bkag g.yas nas 'bud cing bzung ba sogs bum can 'dzin pa g.yas g.yon spel gyin sgom/ dmigs bskor nyi shu pa'o/ /thur sel gyi rlung dngos su gzhug pa ni/ steng rlung snga ma bzhin du byas la/'og sgo 'byed 'dzum drag po'i sbyor bas oṃ udang lhan cig drag tu 'then pa de steng rlung dang lhan cig gsang gnas su gzir bar bya'o/ /'di'i man ngag gi yi ge las/ srog dang thur sel gyi bum can ste 'khor lo gzhan rnams su'ang drag tu 'dren par bshad de/ lte bar brtan pa thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de —51—

bzhin du srog rlung gi bum can bco brgyad 'gyur thur sel gyi bum can la byed pa sogs kyang rlung la dbang thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ de dag re zhig las dang po pa la mi dgos shing / 'ga' zhig rang shugs kyis 'grub la/'ga' zhig zhar la 'og tu ston par yang 'gyur ro/ /dmigs bskor nyer gcig pa'o/ /'dir yang de tsam kyis skabs 'di'i srog rtsol gyi man ngag cha tshang bar 'gyur la/ sngar gyi 'phros las mnyam gnas kyi rlud gzhug pa ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las sna bug gnyis kar nas 'bud rngub bya/ gtsug tor ma gtogs pa'i 'khor lo lnga dang / yan lag nying lag gi rlung rnams thams cad gcig tu 'dus par bsam zhing / oṃ zhes 'og sgo drag tu bsdams la steng du drangs/u zhes 'og sgo dbye bas thur du bsdigs pa dang / gyen rgyu gzhug pa de dang 'dra ba las/ mgrin pa dang ro stod drag tu gcud/ khyab byed gzhug pa yang de dang 'dra ba las sor mo rnams bskum/ nya bzhi sgrim mo zhes bshad na'ang / de gsum po yan lag gi dmigs pa yin pa dang / deng sang nyams khrid mi skyong bas dmigs bskor logs par mi 'dren no/ /man lung ba'i mtshan brjod sbyor drug gi lugs ni/ dal bus rngub pa na oṃ kyi yid bzlas dang / kha sbyor bum can rngub chung dang bcas te 'dzin pa na hu gi yid bzlas dang / dal bus rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam du 'bud pa na u'i yid bzlas bya bar bzhed de/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyang don gyis 'di nyid bzhed do/ /'di ni rlung sbyor gcig la rdor bzlas bum can gnyis ka tshang ba'i lugs te/ shin tu legs par —52—

mngon no/ /de bzhin du/ gyi co/ khrom lo/ tsa mi/ rga lo sogs lugs gzhan gyi dgang ba dang / dbyung ba dang / bum pa can rnams kyang de rnams la don tshang bar shes pas logs su bshad mi dgos so/ /'di thams cad la thun mong du man ngag sbyar ba ni/ rlung phyir 'gro dus rtags snang la drag tu sems gtad/nang du 'jug dus sems nyid dang bsre/ gnas pa'i dus su sems dang stong gzugs bsres pa'i myong ba dang 'dzin pa de bshig par bya ste/ shin tu zab pa'i nyams len ting nge 'dzin sems kyi gnad rna ba nas rna ba dang / zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa rgyud gzhung tshad ldan kun gyi dgongs pa rma med pa'o/ /dmigs bskor nyer gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa la spogs chog bogs 'don dang / srog rtsol nyid kyi sgo nas gegs bsal ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ ma chud cing ma 'chings na/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag pa ni spogs chog yin te/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i bzhed pas/ lus gnad lta stangs spyi dang mthun par bcas/ rlung ro bsal rjes rlung rang sor bzhag rtsa bzang na lag pa gnyis gang rung gcig gi mtheb mdzub kyis mgrin pa'i 'phar rtsa mnan/ rtsa ngan na g.yas kyi mthe bos g.yas kyi 'phar rtsa dang / g.yon gyi mthe bos g.yon gyi 'phar rtsa mnan/ sor mo lhag ma rnams kyis ltag pa nas rten te/ ran par gtsir bas/ rab la bde stong gi nyams dang 'od gsal gyi nyams khyad par can skye/ 'bring la rnam rtog 'gag cing rtags snang gsar pa cung zad 'char/ tha ma la'ang rnam rtog cung zad 'gag go /dang por shugs chung ba mi 'gyel tsam du mnan zhing / phyis shugs je —53—

drag je drag tu mnan pas nyams je bzang je bzang du 'gyur ro/ /'bro lugs kyi man ngag las ni/ 'di la rdul mtha' can zer zhing / rting pa g.yas pas bshang lam dgag brla dang byin pa'i bar du gsang rtsa ltem pa'am/ rting pa g.yon pas gsang rtsa ltem/ lag pa phyogs gcig gdan la brten/ cig shos kyis gnyid log mnan/ rlung yongs rdzogs bzung ba'am/ cung zad cig phyir btang ba'i lhag ma bzung ba gang bde bya/ zhes bshad do/ /'di las 'phros pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni 'og tu bstan par bya'o/ /dmigs bskor nyer gsum pa'o/ /bogs 'don ni/ ye shes spyan sgrub las 'byung ba'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dh+ra ti'i nang du 'od gsal bzung / /rtogs med sems kyi de nyid shes/ /rdo rje'i ༄lus kyi de nyid mthong / /gsang sngags chos la mkhas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bum pa can dang stong gzugs la mnyam par bzhag pa yang yang goms pas lus kyi nang du stong gzugs 'char/ de'i rgyun goms pas lus kyi nang gang 'dod du 'char thub/ de skabs nas/ lte ba sprul 'khor gyi dbus dbu ma gang du yod pa'i thad de tsam du stong gzugs shar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pas drod tsha 'ur ba sogs bde drod kyi nyams 'phral du shar byung na gnad du song ba yin/ bde drod mi skye ba dang / stong gzugs mi gsal du song na gnad 'phyugs pa yin pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i gnas tshul nges par byas te bsgoms pas/ de'i nang du stong gzugs shar ba na sngar bzhin sgom/ de nas nyams kyi tshul gyis rtsa dbu ma dang rtsa 'khor sogs ci rigs pa mthong ba 'byung /—54—

—de bzhin du snying ga la sogs pa rtsa gnas gzhan la'ang sbyar gyin sgom/ des rtsa gnas rags pa phal che ba'i rnam pa nyams kyi tshul du 'char la/ de nas yun bsrings te bsgoms pas rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dmigs bskor nyer bzhi pa'o/ /yang ji skad du/ srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal bzung / /rgyu ba rlung gi de nyid shes/ /rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhi rgyas la sogs dbang du 'du/ /zhes gsungs te/ sna bug nas sor bcu drug gi steng gi nam mkhar stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtod/ de la brtan na rim gyis je nye je nye la btang ste/ mthar sna'i nang du stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtod pa'i bar du bya/ de ni nam mkha'i rlung gi lam la sgom pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'byung ba gzhan gyi rlung la'ang sbyar te sgom/ mthar thams cad du 'byongs pa na sna'i bar ga'i thad du stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtad do/ /dbugs dang 'grogs te stong gzugs yal yol byed kyang de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar thog ma sems bzhag pa de kar sgrim/ 'di bsgoms pas sna sgor stong gzugs rtag tu gnas pa 'byung /de la rtse gcig tu goms pa las/ rim pas rlung rnams kyi kha dog dang dbyibs dang / tshad dang rgyu ba'i grangs kyi rnam pa nges pa 'byung / de byung nas kyang bum pa can dang lhan cig bsgoms na zla ba drug la sogs pas brtan pa thob par 'gyur/ de nas rlung rgyu ba dang bstun te 'dun pa bsgyur ba tsam gyis kyang zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las chen brgyad thogs med du 'grub pa yin no/ /'di ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ gzhan yang gtum mo dang / las rgya dang / btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba —55—

mang po zhig srog rtsol gyi bogs 'don du 'byung ngo / /dmigs bskor nyer lnga pa'o/ /skabs 'dir srog rtsol nyid kyi sgo nas gegs bsal ba dang / paṇa chen gyi rdo rje'i tshig lnga pa'i 'phros la bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng gi sbyor ba la brten te dgrol ba yang shes dgos la/ gzhan yang srog rtsol bsgoms pas thod pa 'gogs pa snyam byed pa dang / mgo dang snying ga na ba dang /lte ba gzer zhing spyi gtsug gi pags pa la khab btsugs pa lta bu byung ba dang /khog par shing bcug pa lta bu 'od zer gyi 'khor lo lus nang du drag tu 'khor na/sbyor bas dbu mar 'dzud dgos pa yin yang de mi 'grub na/ re zhig srog rtsol sgom pa'i rtsol ba klod nas/ sku mnye dang kha zas bzang du bsten/ 'bebs kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / ha 'phrab dang / rlung phyir 'don pa mang du byas pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir gegs bsal ba la/ gegs chung ngu la sel byed kyang zhi ba dang / bar pa la bar pa dang / chen po la shugs drag po rnams gal che/ de las bzlog na chung ngu chen por 'gyur ba dang / chen po bcos dka' ba rnams su 'gyur ro/ /nyin dang nyin la ye shes kyi nyams phebs par 'gyur na de nyid byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs phal cher sel bar 'gyur la/ gzhan du gegs sel gyi gdams ngag la yang mkhas pa dang / lus sbyongs la brtson par byed dgos te/ de dag gi yi ge logs su yod pa ltar nyams myong can gyi lag khrid dang bcas te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ srog rtsol gyi mashaṃ don/ sgom —56—

pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag /bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pa'i thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/rgya gar gyi skad du pra ṇa zhes pa srog ā ya ma zhes pa 'gog pa'am/ rtsol ba'am/ring du byed pa la 'jug pas/ de mtshams sbyar bas/ pra ṇa ya ma ni/ srog rtsol lam/ srog 'gog pa zhes bya'o/ /de la srog ni rlung gi ming yin la/ de 'gog pa'am rtsol ba ni 'jug par byed pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa la/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag dngos ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga pa rgyud la skyes nas sgom pa yin la/ rjes mthun pa ni las dang po pas kyang sgom du rung zhing / khyad par dzu yang thog mar dge ba'i sor bsam gang rigs la nyams myong cung zad rnyed nas bsgoms na shin tu legs so/ /gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag la don tshan lnga'i dang po srog rtsol gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ spyir rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le mtha' dag yin la/ de'i gtso bo lte ba yan chad na ro rkyang dbu ma gsum/ lte ba'i 'og tu bshang gci khu ba'i rtsa gsum ste drug /rlung srog dang thur sel gnyis rnams te/ spro na skabs 'dir rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul rgyas par bshad na legs so/ /don tshan gnyis pa srog rtsol bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/〈mi 'gyur bde chen sgrub phyir rlung sems dbu mar bcing pa las byung ba'i stong gzugs phyag chen gyi lus kyi 〉de phyir lus kyi don gyi rgyur ni nyin zhag so so'i dus su rtsa yi sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / dus zhabs pa'i man ngag las kyang / mi 'gyur bde ba skye ba'i phyir/ /srog rtsol yan lag bsgom par bya/ / zhes pa ltar/—57—

'gyur med bde ba'i rgyu tshogs kyi phyogs gcig stong gzugs phyag chen yin pa sor bsam gyi dus nas kyang bsgrubs pa yin la/ /phyogs gcig shos rlud las rnam par rgyal ba thob cing / a wa ga tir bcings pas rdo rje'i lus rnam par dag par gyur nas 'chi ba med pa dnge / thig le la dbang 'byor bar byed pa ni srog rtsol gyi dgos pa'o/ /don tshan gsum pa srog rtsol dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshe rlung rnams dbu ma 'ba' zhig nas 'bab par 'gyur gyi bar du ste/ des byang chub kyi sems rags pa bzung bzlog la dbang thob par 'gyur zhing / dbang po rnon pos zla ba drug gis de 'grub pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/rgyud las/ zla ba drug gis 〈dbang rnon sdom brtson dang ldan pa rnams la 'jig rten pa'i 'khrig bde'i reg byas dman pa ste de 'dra dang bral ba'i byang sems rags pa bzung bzlog la dbang thob pas bde ba kun nas 'phel bas mi mnyam pa med pa de nyid bde stong zung 'jug gi lam gyi 〉sdom brtson rnams la reg byas dman pa'i bde ba mnyam pa lam gyi sems su 'khyu/ra/ /zhes gab/ngas/don tshan bzhi pa srog rtsol gyi ngo bo ni/ 〈rgyud las/〉srog rtsol dag kyang lam ni gnyis po bsgyel zhing dbu mar srog ni rab tu zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar dgag cing 'og tu bshang gci'i rtsar rgyu ba'i rlung yang dung can mar dgag pa yin la/ de bzhin du dbu mar rgyu ba'i srog dang / dung can mar rgyu ba'i thur sel yang gcig tu bsdu bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /—58—

don tshan lnga pa srog rtsol ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/rgyud las/ 〈zla ba nyi ma a sogs ka sogs rnams kyis/ zhes pas/ khams dkar dmar 'babs pa'i rtsa ro rkyang gnyis bstan rnam gsum bgrod gnas zhes pas/ khu rdul sems gsum bgrod gnas dbu ma bstan zhing / sku rdo rje sogs kyis rdor bzlas dngos bstan to/〉 zla ba nyi ma a sogs ka sogs rnams kyis rnam gsum bgrod gnas sku yi rdo rje sogs bzlas pa/ /zhes pas bstan zhing / 'jam rlud dgang ga rtang gis dbugs yo ba bsrang ba ni/ ji skad du/ mchan khung g.yas dang g.yas min dag las nu ma dag kyang stobs ldan mnan te srog ni bkag pa las/ /g.yas nas g.yon pa'i rtsar ni 'phral la rab 'bab g.yon pa'i mchan khung las kyang g.yas su'o/ /zla ba phyed kyis kyang ni 'chi ster 'chi ltas 'phrog ste rnal 'byor ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis so/ /zhes pas bstan/ dgang ba dang bum pa can ni/ kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis po dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa/ /srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas te/ /zhes pas bstan zhing / de'i phan yon yang / lus la zas la sogs pa dang ni bkres dang skom pa 'phrog cing 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ste/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang dri med 'od las/ dbyung ba dang / dgang ba dang / bum pa can gyi sbyor bas ni rtag tu bsnyen pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ srog rtsol gyi man ngag tha dad pa thams cad kyang bstan pa yin no/ /'dir bum pa can gtso bo yin pas nges par dgos la/ gzhan dag ni ji ltar rigs par yang sbyar ro/ /gnas skabs su srog gegs mi 'byung ba'i don du/ rlung stobs rgyas pa dbu mar —59—

'dzud pa'am/ gegs sel gzhan yang rung ste/ de'i dus bstan pa ni/ srog rtsol rab tu bya ste snying ga de bzhin mgo bo dag ni ji srid me yis gdung gyur pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi rtags thams cad g.yas g.yon gyi rlung bcu dbu mar 'gags pa'i mthu las byung ba'i lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams/ mthong nyams/ rmi nyams te rnam pa lnga/ra 'dus pa yin no/ /tshad ma ni/rnam rtog gi rgyu rlung rnams dbu mar 'gags pa'i ye shes yin pas yid kyi mngon sum gtso bor gyur pa'i mngon sum bzhi'o/ /lnga pa ni/ dag bya la dbye na 'du /byed/ shes 〈rlung gi khams sna'i dbang po/ reg bya'i skye mched/ ngag gi dbang po/ bshang ba 'dor ba ste rlung khams pa drug 〉sogs phung khams drug tshan gcig yod la/ dag byed srog rtsol nyid la dbye na/ g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu dbu mar 'dres pa'i dbye bas bcu'o/ /drug pa la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ srog rtsol gyis ni dag pa ri bong can dang nyi ma rnam bral byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i rlung yon po 'gags pa'i phan yon las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 〈mchod pa 'bul ba dang dus 'di tsam nas sangs rgyas thob pa sogs 〉lung ston zhing byin gyis rlobs/ ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pa'i gzugs sogs yul drug gi〈stong gzugs kyi 〉'dod yon la spyod/ dbang po drug gi mngon shes skye/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dbang du 'du ba yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ don yod grub pa 〈sgrol ma nam snying /—60—

reg bya rdo rje ma/ bgegs mthar byed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma ste lha rlud khams pa drug 〉 sogs lha rlung khams pa drug tshan gcig thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /nges srog rtsol gyi 'khrid char ro//gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len da/migs pa'i gnad dang / sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po la 'dzin pa'i man ngag dngos dang / bogs 'don spogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du ji skad bstan pa ltar/ bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu ma'i thig le la thim par byed pa yin te/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi bum can ni bum pa can tsam du 'dra yang srog rtsol gyi bum can ni/ ro rkyang gi lam dgag pa dang / srog thur 4'dre ba'i phyir sgom pa yin la/ 'dir ni srog thur 'dres zin pa'i rlung de nyid dbu ma'i thig ler thim par byed pa'i don yin no/ /de la lte ba'i bum can ni sngar dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang 'dzin pa rjes mthun pa'i sgom pa'i skabs 'dir rlung rnams lte ba'i thig le la thim pa'i mos pa tsam ya nga yang byed pa ni khyad par ro/ /dmigs bskor nyer drug pa'o/ /de bzhin snying kha'i bum can yang phal cher de da nga 'dra ba las/ rnye ba'i bum can bcas zin mtshams nas snying gar 'dren pa dang / lag pa gnyis rgyab tu bsnol/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi mthe bor g.yas g.yon nas 'then pa'i lus gnad sbrags te bya'o/ /dmigs bskor nyer bdun pa'o/ /mgrin pa'i bum can ni rkang pa skyil krung bcas te/ pus mo'i nang khugs su gru mo btsugs/ sor mo bsnol bas ltag pa nas mnan te mgo bsgyur/—61—

rlud kha nas rngub ste/ ltag pa'i thad kar shugs ba spyi la la lkog mas ol mdud mnan/ thur sel mgrin pa'i thad kar phul lo/ /dmigs bskor nyer brgyad pa'o/ /dpral pa'i bum can ni/ phal cher de dang 'dra ba la lag pa gnyis sngar bzhin las spyi bo nas 'then/ rlung yang kha nas rngub pa rkan gyi phugs su yar bsgyil ba ni khyad par ro/ /dmigs bskor nyer dgu pa'o/ /gtsug tor gyi bum can yang dmigs pa gtsug tor tu byed pa'i khyad par ma gtogs de dang 'dra'o/ /dmigs bskor sum cu ba'o/ /man ngag kho na las 'byung ba'i gsang ba'i bum can ni/ rting pa gcig gis bshang sgo brten/ gcig gis gsang ba nas mnan/ lag pa gnyis gzhug chud nas phar 'khyid gang tsam gzhal ba'i sar btsugs/ gdong gyen du phyogs pas rlud drag la ring bar mnan/ bshang sgo dang gsang sgo gnyis ka nas thur sel lan mang du drangs pa de dang steng rlung gnyis kar rgyu zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan te bzhag pa'o/ /dmigs bskor so gcig pa'o/ /'ga' zhig snying ga yan chad kyi bum can las dang po pas sgom du mi rung bar 'dod na'ang / ran tsam sgom pa la skyon med cing / las dang po bas sgom na lag len 'di ltar byed de/ lte ba'i bum can nyi shu tsam song nas snying ga'i bum can lan gcig gnyis tsam byed pa ste/ nye ba'i bum can de snying gar grangs/ slar yang lte bar phab nas rlud gtong / mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams la lte ba'i bum can yar mi 'dren yang / rlung gtong khar bum can lte bar —62—

'bebs dgos so/ /slar yang de rnams kyi mthar gsang ba'i bum can tshar re bya/ rlung ro 'khyams kyi dogs pa yod na snying ga'i bum can gyi mthar ro stod gcud cing ha 'don/ mgrin nga/'i mthar kha btsum nas mgrin pa'i rlung drangs te 'bud/ dpral pa dang gtsug tor gyi mthar sna bkag nas thod pa'i rlung drangs nas 'bud pa sogs kyang lag len bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rlung gi spogs chog ni/ rdo rje'i tshig drug gi gtum mo sbar ba'i sbyor bas srog thur bsre zhing 'chi med sgrub pa ste/ 'dzin pa'i man ngag sngar bstan pa de ltar bsgoms kyang yon tan skye ma 'dod na/ bum can tsam gyis srog thur bsre mi thub pa yin pas/ skyil krung g.yas g.yon gyi rol stabs sam/rdo rje'i skyil krung gis kyang chog la/ lag pa pus mo la bkab/ thog mar 'og sgo steng du 'then/ steng rlung hū ring gi gdangs kyis phyir 'bud/ slar nang du hu thung gis mnan te cung zad song nas gsang rlung hu gi khong sgra dang bcas te yar drangs/ lce rtse skan la sbyar phaṭa ces yid la dran pas kha sbyor drag po de lte bar bzung bzhin pas/ lto ba phyir 'phul ba lan 'ga' bya/ de nas 'bud pa sogs sngar dang 'dra ste/ de nyid yang yang sgom pa yin sgo /'di ni paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag yin la/ grub thob shā bā ri pa'i man ngag /bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i nye brgyud la srog thur bsre ba'i man ngag gsum yod pa ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o /dmigs bskor so gnyis pa'o/ /'khrul 'khor gyi spogs chog ni/ rlung gnad snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe/ rkang sor nas lag pas 'jus te sgur langs su byed/ nang —63—

du rngub ste bzung ba'i skabs su 'phod/ stan gyi steng du bzhag ste tsog pur bya/gsang rlung 'then skabs lus bsgyur/ lto ba phyir 'phul ba'i skabs ltag pa skyed do/ /dmigs bskor so gsum pa'o/ /rtsa'i spogs chog ni/ gong du spund pa'i btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag pa nyid do/ /thig le'i spogs chog gtso bo rni/ dmigs bcas kyi gtum mo yin yang 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir mi/ brjod la/ rdo rje'i tshig drug gi lce gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor bas nang gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ba ni/dmigs med dang dmigs bcas gnyis las/ 'dir dmigs bcas kyi dbang du byas na/ lag gnyis sa gnon bya/ gzhan lus gnad spyi dang 'dra/ dpral par ha dkar po la dbyangs bcu drug dkar pos bskor ba'am/ yi ge gsal mi thebs na thig le dkar po bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /thur sel 'then byas pas rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can khong pa nas yar song / yi ge'am thig le la phog pas bdud rtsi dkar po rlan drod kyi rang bzhin can 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ ya thod khengs/ rlung ro bsal la rlung kha nas shud kyi sgra dang bcas te lce thog tu drangs/ mchil ma dang lha na cig mid/ lce rtse phugs su bzlog nas lce'u chung la reg /rlung stod smad du mnyam par dgang zhing bzung / lce chung las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rtsa'i nang thams cad khengs par mos/ de nyid yang yang bsgoms pas/ rtse chung las rang byung gi bdud rtsi 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang las dang po pas bum can rnams sgom pa'i skabs rlung 'dus pa'i rtags 'gor na/dmigs pa 'di lta bu sgom par bshad de/ rtsa 'khor so so bshad tshod dang mthun —64—

par sgom thub na legs ma thub na/ rtsa 'khor rnams kyi 'khor lo nang ma kho na gsal btab pas chog pas/lte ba sogs 'khor lo lnga la rtsa 'dab bzhi bzhi yin la/ gsang gnas la drug go /de yang nye ba'i bum can sgom na/ lte ba sprul 'khor ser po rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar dbu ma'i nang du zla ba la oX dkar po gsal btab/ der g.yas g.yon srog thur gyi lung rnams thim par mos pa byed/ de bzhin du snying ga'i 'khor lo dkar po dang / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo dmar po dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo nag po dang / gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo ljang khu dang / gsang ba'i 'khor lo sngon po rnams sgom pa'i khyad par ma gtogs/ bum can gzhan rnams la'ang dmigs pa snga mas rigs 'gre'o/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor drug po de rnams dmigs bskor gcig tu bsdus ste/ dmigs bskor so bzhi pa'o/ /spyir nas 'dzin pa'i bogs 'don ni/ srog rtsol gyi bogs 'don dang 'dra zhing / 'di'i spogs chog bogs 'don rnams kyang srog rtsol gyi skabs su 'jug pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/dh+wa ra ṇa zhes pa 'dzin pa dang gzung bya gnyis kar la 'jug pas sna tshogs su bsgyur ba yod kyang / 'dir ni rlung 'gro 'ongs dang bral bar 'dzin pa'i don no/ /—65—

gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin pa'i yan lag dngos kyi dbang du byas na/ rlud dbu mar rtag tu 'bab cing srog dang thur sel 'dres pa'i dus na 'dzin pa sgom mo/ /rjes mthun pa ni srog rtsol dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag la don tshan lnga'i dang po 'dzin pa gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ bde ba'i rlud ste/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang 'dres pa'i rlung ngo / /gnyis pa bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems g.yo med du 'ching ba dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dngos su 'dren pa'i stong gzugs khyad par can 'byung ba'i rtsa ba gtum mo'i 'bar snang sgrub pa'i phyir yin no/ /gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ 'khor lo lnga'am drug tu bum can ji ltar 'dod par dgag nus pa la dbang 'byor ba de srid du'o/ /bzhi pa 'dzin pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud las/ thig ler srog ni rab tu zhugs shing 〈ro rkyang 〉gnyis ka'i 〈hro 'gro 'ong gi 〉bgrod pa bcom ste rtse gcig sems pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyir 'khor lo lnga'am drug gi gnas su dbu ma'i thig le la steng 'og g.yas g.yon gyi rlung rnams thim pa dang / khyad par mthar phyin pa na/ dpral pa'i thig le la srog rab tu zhugs pas thig le 'dzag med dpral par brtan pa la sems zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /lnga pa 'dzin pa ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul la/ las dang po pas 'dzin pa rjes mthun pa sgom tshul ni gong du bshad pa de nyid yin zhing / dngos ni bum pa can gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'khor lo drug tu sngar g.yas g.yon srog thur 'dres —66—

zin pa'i dbu ma'i rlung de nyid thig le la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis stong par thim pas gtum mo 'bar bar byed pa ste/ 'di la rgyud 'grel gyis 'dzin pa ston pa'i skabs phal cher na/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rnam gzhag las ma gsungs pa mang la / dbye ba rnam pa bcu'i skabs na gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor yang 'gro bar bshad pas/ gtsug tor du yang 'dzin pa sgrub dgos pa ni yin la/ des na lte ba snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo gtsug tor te lnga la sngar ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs re dang / sngar thob zin brtan zhing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thabs re ste gnyis gnyis yod do/ /des na dpral pa'i thig le zhes bya ba yang dbu ma'i yal ga zhig gtsug tor nas smin mtshams su 'khyogs pa'i gnas yin nga/ra shes par bya zhing / gsang ba'i bum can ni/ rgyud 'grel nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang don la gnas shing / snga ma rnams kyi gegs sel bogs 'don du 'gyur ba yin pas nges par sgrub ni dgos la/ logs su mi bgrang ba ni gtsug tor gyi bum can gyi cha lag tu spyor bas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ spyir snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par rgyud las/ re 'a nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsal mthong bar gyur gyi bar du'o/ /zhes dbu mar re ji nag po 'char ba dang / gtum mo'i 'bar snang dang / gzhom med kyi sgra'i sgo nas ches lhag pa yin la/ tshad ma ni srog rtsol dang 'dra'o/ /lnga pa ni dag bya la dbye na/ tshor ba'i phung po 〈me'i khams/ mig gi dbang po/ro'i skye mched/ lag pa'i dbang po/ 'gro ba ste me khams pa drug 〉sogs phung khams me khams pa drug tshan gcig yin la/ dag byed 'dzin pa'i lam nyid la dbye na/ ji —67—

skad du/ dri med 'od las/ srog gi 'dzin pa lte ba dang / snying ga dang / mgrin pa dang / dpral ba dang / gtsug tor gyi pad+ma la 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i dbye bas rnam pa/ btsun/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dzin pa la nyams rtogs mtho dman gyi dbye ba bcu yod jo/ /drug pa la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ bdud dang nyon mongs la sogs nyams shing stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur te 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis so/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgas pa dang nad la sogs pa phung po'i sdug bsngal sel/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes pas lam du byed nus/ tshe la cung zad dbang thob/ 'dod yon gyi zhen pas mi 'ching bas bdud bzhi cung zad choms pa yin la/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba'ang yin no/ /rlung bcu thim pa'i mthu las lus ngag sems kyi stobs khyad par can yang grub ste/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju/ /thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba rgyas/ /rgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ /lus yang la sogs mi rtog bde/ /zhes pa dang / tshe ring nad med khams cha snyoms/ /zhes gsungs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ rin chen 'byung ldan 〈gos dkar mo/ sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma/shes rab mthar byed/ smugs byed ma ste lha me khams pa drug 〉sogs lha me khams pa drug tshan gcig mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /des 'dzin pa'i 'khrid tshar ro/ /re zhig rjes dran gyi 'khrid mi 'bogs shing de tsam gyis chog par byed na/ rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir blang bar bya'o/ //—68—

gsum pa tha mar dge ba'i 'khrid la gnyis te/ rjes dran dang / ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po la nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang / sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po la rjes dran dngos ni/ lus sbyor dang rlung gi rtsol ba sogs la ma ltos te/ 'khor lo drug gi rtsa mdud grol/ bde ba'i rlung la dbang thob/ gtum mo'i 'bar snang la ci dgar spyod pa'i skabs yin pas/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan las ji skad bshad pa kho na nyams su blangs pas chog go /'dir rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas te 'khrid pa la/ dngos dang / yan lag go /dang po ni/ sor bsam la myong ba ci rigs par thon pa/ srog 'dzin gyi bum can phal pa yan chad legs par 'byongs pa/ srog thur bsre ba la myong ba thon pa zhig gi dbang du byas nas sgom mo/ de la sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba dang / dngos gzhi ji ltar sgo ma pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ 'dug stangs la bslab pas srog thur bsre ba brtan por byed pa dang / de'i yan lag bzung bzlog sogs kyi rlung sbyang ba dang / byed bcing lus kyi 'khrul 'bor la bslab pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po la/ khro bo seng ge'i 'dug stangs ni/ rkang pa bshang sgor snol/pus mo bsrangs te tsog pu bya/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ lag pa thab 'gal bya/yang na pus btsugs sked pa bsrangs/ lag gnyis brla spom phra'i mtshams su gtad ces kyang gzhan las bshad/ gang ltar mjing pa bstung zhing lta stangs gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'o/ /'di mdun rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa yin/yang de nyid las/ pus mo dang gru mo sa la 'dzugs pa'am yang na skyil krung sked —69—

pa bsrangs/ lag pa gnyis dpyi mgo'i thad kyi sa la 'dzugs/ lus skyed cing mgrin pa dgug 'di rgyab kyi rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa yin/ zhi ma khro glang po che'i 'dug stangs ni/ pus btsugs lag gnyis khu tshur gyis 'gram pa skyor/ gru mo stegs bu la btsugs pa'am yang na rkang pa brkyang ba ste/ 'di ni mnyam pa'i rlung sbyor gyi steng nas thur sel steng du 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /yang skyil krung lus ltag skyed du byed pa las/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis sked pa'i rgyab nas brten pa'am/ yang na gan rkyal rkang pa gnyis cung zad brkyang pa pad+ma'i kha sbyor dang / lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol ba ste/ srog thur du 'dren par byed pa'o/ /'di gnyis la lta stangs ni bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'o/ /zhi ba drang srong gi 'dug stangs la/ seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang 'dra ba las rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol ba dang / yang na tsog pu rting pa bteg lag pa khu tshur bsnol bas rna ba nas bzung ba dang / (〈〈khyu 〉〉rtse yang na pus mo dang gru mo sa la 'dzugs pa'ang / seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol ba'o/ /) zlum po'i rkang stabs la/ rdo rje'i khu tshur brla'i rtsa bar btsugs zhes kyang bshad de/ 'di dag kyang stod smad gnyis kyi rtsa la so sor gnad du bsnun pa yin la/ 'di gnyis la lta stangs ni thur du blta ba'o/ /de ltar na 'dug stangs de dag kyang gnyis sdeb gnyis sdeb kyis chog par bzhed kyang / drug po thams cad byas na legs la/ drug ka la lugs gnyis bris pa'i snga ma rnams ni/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i gsung bzhin yin la/ yang na zhes pa rnams grub chen yu mo'i man ngag thor bu pa dang/ kun —70—

spangs chen po'i thugs sras la stod pa dbang rgyal la sogs pa'i lag len 'ga' zhig la snang ba ltar bkod pa yin pa las/ phyi ma 'di rnams 'chun che che tsam du snang zhing / drug tshan gnyis po 'di gang rung zhig gis chog pas/ gnyis ka phrugs gcig la sbyor mi dgos so/ /'di la thun gsum du byed pa'ang yod la/ mgyogs 'khrid la thun gcig tu byas pas/ dmigs bskor so lnga pa'o/ /de nas dag 'dren ni/ 'og rlung 'then cing hū ring gis steng rlung phyir bsal/ dza : ba ho hi zhes pas 'khor lo lnga la rim pas dmigs shing /steng rlung drag tu mnan/ lī mū grwa sī ā zhes pas khong sgra dang bcas te 'khor lo lnga la rim pas dmigs shing / gsang rlud drag tu steng du drangs/ de ma thag kha sbyor lte bar bzung la phyir bskyed/ 'og sgo bsdams shing shes pa dpral par gtad do/ /sngar kyi lus gnad drug po so so'i steng nas rlung spyor 'di rnams la 'bad dgos te/ lus gnad kyi khyad par ma gtogs/ rlung gnad ni 'dzin pa'i spogs chog dang phal cher 'dra ba yin no/ /dmigs bskor so drug pa'o/ /yang sgom stegs dang pus 'khyud bcug me thab drug chings su grags pa byas la hā ring dang bstun lag pa khu tshur bcing / gru mo pus mo la thug gi bar du lag pa brkyang ste rlung phyir 'bud/ de ltar lan bdun bdun na lag pa thab 'gal byas/ 'jam rlung bzung ste ngal gso lan re bya'o/ /dmigs bskor so bdun pa'o/ /de dag ma mtha' yang zla ba tsam sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ tsog pu 'phong stegs bcug lag pa brla nang nas 'khyud de ngar gdong bzung / rlung kha nas phyir drag tu bus/ 'og sgo glod/ yang sa ste —71—

lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i ngang nas/ slar yang 'og sgo glod de rlung gang thub bzung ngo / /rlung gnad dang po yin zhing 'og la bsre ba dang 'dzin pa ste dbye sdud ces bya'o/ /yang de dang 'dra ba las/ dgang gtong gnyis ka'i skabs lto ba tshigs pa la bcar zhing thur sel drag tu drangs/ ro stod 'then/ ngar gdong mnan pa'o/ /rlung gnad gnyis pa yin/ steng la bsre ba dang bskyil ba ste/ sgo gleg ces bya'o/ /yang lus gnad de'i ngang nas/ thur sel drag tu bsnol rjes phyir bus te/ stong 'dren drag tu bya/ yang rngub ste kha sbyor dgang 'then gyi ngang nas lto ba bskyod/ sked pa skyog ro stod gcu/ lag pa brkyang nas lag sor gcud/mgrin pa gcu zhing mgo sprug nas rlung phyir 'bud/ phyir bzung ka ba btsugs nas mgo dgug bskyod/ mgrin pa/ ro stod/ lte ba'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de dag thams cad la 'dar sprug dang/ mjug tu 'bebs bya/ rlung gnad gsum pa yin/ 'di la kun 'dus zhes bya'o/ /skyil krung lag gnyis khu tshur brla gnon bya cung zad sgur nas hu zhes thur sel 'then/ stong 'dren g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bya/ yang rlung kha sbyor gyen 'then mgo skyed cing sprug pa yang g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bya'o/ /rlung gnad bzhi pa yin no/ /'di la 'dus pa zhes bya ste/ de gnyis 'dren khyab bo/ /de rnams gcig steng la gcig bya zhing /lus sbyong la'ang 'bad par bya'o/ /dmigs bskor so brgyad pa'o/ /'di dag mgyogs 'khrid gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ 'grub na rlung sbyor re la dmigs bskor re byed pa legs shing / de thams cad la yang sems kyi bzhag stangs ni/ mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang nas stong gzugs la dmigs —72—

shing / de'i ngang nas rlung gi gnad gang du gcud pa der sems gtad cing ltod kyis glod pa re byed dgos/ dmigs pa de dang rlung sbyor de dag sbrags nas sgom pa chu tsho de gcig gnyis kyi yun re bya zhing / lhag ma bum pa can gyi rnal 'byor la brtson par byed dgos te/ dmigs bskor so dgu pa'o/ /de dag la yang zla gcig tsam ma mthar sgom mo/ /'di skabs dmigs gsal med pa rnams la lta stangs thad kar lta ba gtso che la/ 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs/ yan lag med pa'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ bde ba gang du skyes pa'i phyogs la lta ba yin pas gcig tu ma nges so gsum pa ni/ de nas 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bya ste/ de yang / sbyor ba drug pa stag mo'i skyug /glang chen 'gying ba wa yi snom/ /seng ge rnam grol khong dkrugs dang / pre ta ka dang yong 'dzin dang / /'dren chung khong 'dren 'dren chen dang / /sbags 'dren 'phar g.yo phur 'don dang / /rab brkyang dang ni seng ge'i rtsal/ /gcu 'then dang ni gsum 'dren dang / /seng ge'i 'gying dang rma bya'i 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gyi/ 'khrul 'khor lag len rim pas bslabs nas/ bum pa can dang sngar gyi rlung sbyor rnams dang bcas pa sgom du gzhug dgos pa las/ sor bsam srog 'dzin rnams la myong ba cung zad thon pa zhig gis/ thun drug tu 'khrul 'khor de dag cher re re nus na zla gcig tsam na dngos gzhi sgom du rung ba'i rtags rnams 'byung ngo / /rtsol ba che chung la ltos te yun ring thung ji ltar bskyang dgos pa'ang 'dis rigs 'gre ste/ dmigs bskor bzhi bcu pa'o/ /—73—

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rjes dran gyi yan lag rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas te/ phyag rgya chen mo gcig sbyor mos pa'i yul du bzhag nas/ 'dir gsum ste/ sgom pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa/ rang lus lag pa'i phyag rgya la bslab pa/ gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus gnad spyi dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ lta stangs thad kar g.yo med du lha ba'o/ /rang nyid dus 'khor lhan skyes yab yum la sogs par gsal gdab/ de'i shul du stong gzugs kyi snang ba legs par drangs/ lha skur snang ba stong gzugs kyis khyab par byas la/ de la yid mi g.yo bar cung zad bzhag stong gzugs kyi snang ba de ltar 'dren mi thub na/ lha sku gsal stong la dmigs te cung zad bzhag /de nas dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ud mar po/ thugs kar hu nag po/ lte bar ho ser po/ gsang bar khyu sngon po/gtsug tor tu ha ljang khu'o/ /yum gyi mkha' u las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hū las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po phra mos mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hu las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nye ba'i nang du u las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad phra mos mtshan pa gsal btab/ de nas 'khyud pa la sogs pa rjes chags kyi spyod pa mdzad pas gtsug tor gyi thig le zhu nas dpral pa'i 'khor lo yan chad gang bar mos stong gzugs dang bsre/ lus gnad de ka'i steng nas gtsug tor dang dpral pa'i bum can yun thung ngu re bya/ dga' ba dang po'i skad cig ma'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar bas sngar gyi thig le'i rgyun de nyid cher rgyas shing zhu ste/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo yan chad —74—

gang bar mos stong gzugs dang bsre/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i bum can tshar re bum can snga ma gnyis las yun ring tsam re bzung / mchog tu dga' ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /dbang po gnyis srub pa'i sbyor ba las/ byang chub kyi sems snga ma'i rgyun las kyang cher rgyas shing zhu bas/ lte ba dang / gsang ba'i 'khor lo yan chad gang bar bsam la lte ba dang gsang ba'i bum can yun ring ba re sgom/khyad par dga' ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /yang drag tu srub pa las/ gsang ba nas rdo rje nor bu'i bar du byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bar mos/ stong gzugs la ring du mnyam par 'jog bzhin pas/ bum pa can gyi sbyor ba gcig dang / sbyor ba drug pa zhes bya ba'i 'khrul 'khor bcas pas rdo rje nor bur byang chub kyi sems phyir 'pho ba 'gags te khyil li li 'khyil bar bsam/ lhan skyes dga' ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /de nas thog mar yongs 'dzin gyi 'khrul snyen ra gyis byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas par mos/ de'i rjes su/ khong 'dren dang / 'dren chen dang / sbags 'dren dang / stag mo dang / glang chen dang / wa snom rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi bar du bzlog par bsam/ de nas pre ta ka dang / rnam grol dang /g.yang sprus/sa dang / 'phar g.yo dang / phur 'don dang / rab brkyang rnams kyis lus thams cad la khyab par byas par bsam/ seng ge'i rtsal dang / gcud 'then dang / gsum 'grems dang / seng ge 'gying dang / rma bya'i 'gyur rnams kyis bzung bzlog 'grems gsum kar byas par bsam/ spyir ni bzung zhing bzlog bzlog cing 'grems/ 'grems shing rlud dang bsre/ bsre zhing ye shes chen por bskyal zhes bya ba yin pas/ gong gi rim pa rnams ni gtso che ba'i —75—

dbang du byas pa yin kyi/ re re la'ang gnad bzhi char tshang ba'i man ngag gis gnad du 'gro bar bya'o/ /ci ste dmigs pa gsal bas dngos su zhu bde bskyed thub na/ sbyor ba drug pos bzung ma thag tu 'khrul 'khor spang pa'i rlung sbyor rnams kyis bzung bzlog khyab pa rnams bstud mar sbyangs la/ de'i rjes su 'khrul 'khor rnams bya zhing / thog mar sbyong ba'i skabs zhu bde bskyed thub rung ma thub rung / de thams cad rdzogs par bya dgos la/ phyis shin tu byang nas bzlog pa dang bgram pa gnad che ba re tsam gyis chog go /gang ltar yang /mthar rlung dang bsre ba'i phyir bum pa can mang du sgom zhing / ye shes chen por skyel pa'i phyir zhu bde'i nyams dang 'od gsal rtags snang la dmigs nas mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang bskyang bar bya'o/ /dmigs bskor zhe gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud las/ bsten pa'i don du lag pa'i phyag rgya rang gi snying gi dbang /po'i / son skyon rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lag pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gnad rnams gong ye rgya dang 'dra la/'di ni ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang las kyi phyag rgya'i mtshams sbyor ba yin yang /phyag rgya gsum gyi nang nas ye shes kyi phyag rgyar gtogs so/ /dmigs bskor zhe gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'grel chen du rtsa rgyud kyi lungs drangs pa las/ bcu drug lo lon rigs can ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa la/ /dang por legs par bslab byas nas/ /dbang bskur nas ni bsgrub par brtsam/ /sku gsung thugs dang chags pa ni/ /dpral ba la sogs rnams su dgod/ /swāhā gsang ba —76—

gtsug tor che/ /zhes sogs dang / de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i snyems/ /'dzin zhing rnal 'byor hu phaṭa bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bkod nas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing / /spyan ma mig la sogs pa yang / /bsregs nas ri bong can ha 'dzag /bdud rtsi khu ba'i chos can ni/ /thig le'i gzugs kyis 'jag par byed / /thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes par grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ sngar ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i skabs su bshad pa yid ngor sgom pa dang / 'dir dngos su sgrub pa'i khyad par de gzhan ni phal cher 'dra'o/ /de ltar na yid kyi phyag rgya dang /lag pa'i phyag rgya dang / las kyi phyag rgya gsum char la stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang / bsre ba yod na ni rjes dran rjes mthun par 'gyur la/ stong gzugs dang bsre ba med na spyir gnad du 'gro ba yod kyang rjes dran gyi phyogs su ni mi gtogs la/ yan lag snga ma rnams kyi bogs 'don spogs chog tu 'gyur ba ni yod do/ /las rgya da lta dngos su mi 'grub kyang / lam gyi 'gang gcig yin pas chos thun gcig ste/ dmigs bskor zhe gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor te/ de yang lus gnad sngar dang mthun pa'am/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pas spyi bo bkagalce rkan la sbyar/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bar 'dod pa yod pa ltar byas kyang rung / rtsa 'khor rnams la dmigs pa gsal na rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul dang mthun par rgyas pa sgom ste/ lhe ba la nang bskor 'dab ma bzhi/ de'i phyi rol —77—

brgyad/ de'i phyi rol bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi skor drug cu'am drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de bzhin du/ snying ga'i nang bskor la bzhi/ phyi bskor la brgyad/ mgrin pa'i nang bskor la bzhi/ bar bskor la brgyad/ phyi bskor la sum cu so gnyis/ spyi bo'i nang bskor la bzhi/ bar bskor la brgyad/ phyi bskor la bcu drug go /gtsug tor la phyi bskor nang bskor gyi dbye ba med de 'dab ma bzhi'o/ /gsang ba'i nang bskor la drug /bar bskor la bcu/ phyi bskor la bcu drug go /'on kyang de tsam gsal 'debs pa dka' bar byung na/ 'khor lo lnga po rnams la rtsa 'dab bzhi bzhi dang / gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab drug pa rnams gsal btab pas chog skabs der bsdus pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/ 'di ltar sgom ste/ rang lus lha skur gsal ba khong stong du gnas pa'i g.yas g.yon gang la yang ma yo ba dbus drang thad/ mdun du rgyab gnyis las rgyab la lhag par nye ba na/ rtsa dbu ma lte ba sprul 'khor yan chad kha dog ljang khu yar sna spyi bor tshangs bug la zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po dbu ma las ldab 'gyu/ra gyis phra ba/ de gsum sum gzhibs su gsal 'debs la/ yas sna nas sor gang tsam gyi 'og tu gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo/ smin mtshams te dpral ba'i gung smad kyi tshad tsam na dpral ba'am spyi bo'i 'khor lo/phrag pa g.yas g.yon skye ba'i mtshams kyi thad du mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar ka'i thad tsam du snying ga'i 'khor lo/ lte ba'i khung bu'i thad tsam du lte ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor lo rnams kyi thad du ro rkyang gi /yal ga/ lag re dbu ma dang sbubs 'brel ba/ phyi rol ro rkyang dbu ma gsum la rtsa'i sked —78—

dkris byas pa lta bu/ sked dkris de las rtsa 'dab rnams yal ga sbubs can lta bu skyes par bsgom la/ de yang gtsug tor dang spyi bo dang / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bzhin du kha thur bstan dang / snying ga dang / lte ba gdugs 'degs bzhin du kha gyen bstan to/ /'khor lo rnams kyi kha dog skabs 'dir gtsug tor gyi ljang khu/ spyi bo'i nag po/ mgrin pa'i dmar po/snying ga'i dkar po/ lte ba'i ser po'o/ /mi'i lus kyi dbang du byas na lte ba nas 'og tu sor brgyad dam bcu tsam gzhal ba/ rgyu zhabs kyi phyogs lus kyi dbus na gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po kha gyen bstan zhig bsgom/de'i bar gyi dbu ma'i mas sna ni dung can ma ste/ kha dog sngon po dang / ro rkyang gnyis po lte ba'i 'khor lo'i 'og mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i bar du g.yas su ro ma'i mas sna nag po dang / g.yon du rkyang ma'i mas sna ser po ste/ rtsa gsum sum gzhibs so/ /de ltar 'khor lo drug la dbu ma yang sbom phra mda' smyug tsam bsam/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i 'og nas dbu ma'am dung can ma'i mas sna cha phra ba g.yas kyi phyogs dang / ro ma'i mas sna g.yon gyi phyogs bzung ste/ nyis gzhibs lta bur byas nas/ cung zad mdun du 'khyogs te gsang bar zug la/ rkyang ma'i mas sna 'khor lo'i ste ba nas dbus kyi snyogs bzung nas cung zad rgyab phyogs su 'khyogs te bshang sgo la zug par sgom/ dbu ma'i nang gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ā sngon po dang / lte bar ho yig ser po yi ge'i mgo lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud tsam/ de'i steng sor gang tsam ma reg pa yi ge '-i ser po/ snying khar u yig dkar po/ mgrin par ra —79—

yig dmar po/ spyi bor i yig nag po/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i 'og mtshams su a yig ljang khu/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i lte bar klad kor chud cing / gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i steng nas yi ge'i gzugs mgo zhabs bzlog pa'i ha yig dkar po rnams gsal btab/ de nas bum pa can bsgoms pas gsang ba'i dbus kyi u las rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can dung can ma nas song /de nas ho yig bskul bas de las gtum mo ye shes kyi me phra ba/ 'tsher ba/mkhrang ba/ rno ba/ tsha ba/ rtsub pa/ gser gyi kha dog can gtso che ba'i kha dog sna drug pa 'bar bas/ 'khor lo lnga la gnas pa'i '-i u ṛ i a rnams phug cing bsregs/ ha la reg pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ste/ a i ra u '-i rnams kyang rim pas gsos la/ de rnams kyi dwangs ma zhu ba'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres te ho yig la khrus gsol zhing rtsa 'khor lo drug gang bar mos/ dmigs bskor zhe bzhi pa'o/ /yang gtum mo bsdus pa ni/ rtsa 'khor lo drug gsal btab/ gtsug tor gyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le dkar po ba'i nu ma lta bu ring thung sor bzhi tsam dang / lte bar gtum mo dbyug pa'i gzugs can kha dog dmar po sor bzhi pa gsal btab la/ bum pa can bzung bas gtum mo'i me 'od rab tu rgyas te/ rtsa 'khor lo drug sogs lus kyi nang thams cad kha dog dmar lam pa dang / drod tsha 'ur byung bar mos/ rim pas spyi bo'i thig le zhu bas mar dbu mar babs pas/ de'i 'od kyis lus nang thams cad dkar lam pa dang / bde chil gyis byung bar bsam/ mthar thig le gtum mo la thim/ mi rtog par cung zad bzhag—80—

gtum mo'i rnam grangs gzhan ni/ snying ga'i 'khor lo nag po dang / lte ba'i 'khor lo ser po kha spyor gyi 'bar 'dzag dang / mgrin pa dmar po dang / spyi bo dkar po kha sbyor gyi 'bar 'dzag dang / gtsug tor ljang khu dang / gsang ba sngon po kha sbyor gyi 'bar 'dzag byed pa'ang yod do/ /gtum mo 'di lta bu la sogs pa dmigs bcas dang mos sgom gyi rdzogs rim du grags pa 'di rnams ngo bo bskyed rim du gtogs kyang / rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyu khyad par can byed pa'i phyir de'i tha snyad brtags pa ste/ las dang po pa rnams la nges par dgos shing / rdzogs rim dngos kyi ye shes skyes nas kyang 'di dag bogs 'don du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ci rigs par sgom par bya ba kho na'o/ /dmigs bskor zhe lnga pa'o//rjes dran dngos rgyud la skyes pa'i dus rdo rje'i lus la gtum mo yongs rdzogs su 'bar zhing / dga' bzhi yongs rdzogs 'dren thub pa yin la/ da lta gtum mo sgom pa ni de lta bu'i rnam pa lam byed dang / de yang stong gzugs dang bsre thub na ni rjes dran rjes mthun pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ rjes dran gyi mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/rgya skad du/ a nu zhes pa rjes su dang / spo ti zhes pa dran par bsgyur la/ a nu'i sgra ni dman pa dang / lhag pa la 'ju ga pa gnyis las/ skabs 'dir lhag pa'i don te/ a nu 'e ti zhes pa rjes su dran pa lhag par dran pa'i don te/ sngar —81—

〈'dzin pa'i skabs su 〉bsgoms pa 〈de nyid 〉slar yang dran zhing shin tu dran pa ste/stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po la yang yang sgom zhing drag tu rtsol ba'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin pa mthar phyin pas rtsa rlung thig le gsum la 'dzin pa mthar phyin pas bum can gyis dus ci tsam gyi bar du rlung dbu ma'i gnas gang du 'ching 'dod pa de srid du 'ching nus pa'i rlung la dbang thob pa dang / de thob pa'i stobs kyis rtsa thams cad kyi nang gi thig le dbab bzlog bkram pa ci 'dod du nus pa ni thig le la dbang thob pa dang / rlung dang thig le de dag dbu ma la sogs pa'i rtsa gang la yang bcug pa sogs ci 'dod du byed rung ba ni rtsa la dbang 'byor ba'o/ /dbang 'byor/ gtum mo'i snang ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi lha sku rab 'byams su shar na nges par rjes dran sgom ran pa'o/ /gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag la/ don tshan lnga las/ 〈dang po 〉rjes dran gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ spyir rtsa rlud thig le thams cad dang / gtso bo gtum mo'i 'bar snang gi stong gzugs dang / rten 'khor lo bzhi'am drug gi thig le/ brten pa zhu bde dang bcas pa'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa dgos pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dngos su sgrub pa'i phyir te/ zhu bde 'dzag med la bslab pa'o/ /don tshan gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 〈bem rdzas kyi thig le cha gcig 'gags pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i cha gcig grub pa'i 〉skad cig ma dang po ma skyes kyi bar du'o/ /mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skyes zin pa'i rjes su yang rjes dran gyi rgyun bor nas/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i lam gsar —82—

pa sgom du med kyi/ rjes dran gyi rgyun nyid ting nge 'dzin du gnas gyur pa yin no/ /don tshan bzhi pa rjes dran rang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud las/ gtum mo'i snang bar gang zhig gyur pa 〈nges pa ste gtum mo 'bar snang gi ngor gang zhig stong gzugs 〉lha yab yum mnyam spyor gyi rnam par gyur pa de dag rtog bral gyi shes pa la nges par lus dang nam mkha' la yang rjes su dran par 〈ste lus dang nam mkhar snang zhing gsal ba la mnyam par 'jog pas zhu bde 'dren par 'gyur/ byed pa'i don no/〉'gyu/ra//zhes gsungs te/ grogs phyag rgya gzhan yod kyang rung / med kyang rung / gtum mo'i 'bar snang gi lha yab yum mnyam sbyor gtso bor gyur pa'i stong gzugs phra rags srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pas/ zhu bde 'dzag med yang yang bskyed pa la rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /don tshan lnga pa rjes dran ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud las/ 〈rjes dran gyi skabs 〉'di dag dman pa la 〈dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum du 〉sogs dbye ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /phyag rgya gsum 〈las ye phyag gsum 〉dang gnas skabs 〈thig le sla ba'i gnas skabs/ cung zad bska ba'i de dang / shin tu bska ba'i de dang 〉gsum ni rnam gsum bgrod pa'i dbang gis las dang kun rtog mchog rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por dbang po brtul zhing thig le sla ba'i gnas skabs na/ las kyi phyag rgya la ma bsten par/ dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren mi thub pa'i skabs na/ las dang ye —83—

shes phyag chen gsum gar gcig tu dril ba'i rjes dran sgom/ de nas dbang po na 'phos te bar skabs der dbang po 'bring du gyur pa/ thig le cung zad bska ba'i gnas skabs su song ba na/ phyag chen kho nas ni bde ba rdzogs par 'dren mi thub la/ las rgya ni med kyang chog pa'i skabs su/ las rgya spangs te/ ye rgya dang phyag chen gcig tu dril ba'i rjes dran sgom/ yang dpong po na 'phar te rnon por song / byang chub kyi sems shin tu bska ba'i gnas skabs su gyur pa na/phyag chen kho nas zhu bde rdzogs par ni 'dren thub/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ma thob pa'i skabs der phyag chen kho na la brten pa'i rjes dran sgom/ de dag kyang mnyam gzhag gtso che ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ rjes thob tu brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang 'brel ba la ni nges pa med do/ /gnas skabs gsum po 'di rnams la phyag rgya 〈gtum mo 'bar ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya dad 〉bzhi sbyor dang / 〈las rgya med pa 〉phyag rgya gsum sbyor dang / 〈las ye gnyis med par 〉phyag rgya gnyis sbyor zhes 'dod pa dang / yang gsum sbyor/ gnyis sbyor/ gcig sbyor zhes rim pas sbyor ba'ang yod do/ /bzhi pa la/ rtags ni dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren thengs de las gtum mo'i 'bar snang mtha' yas pa 'phro tshul gong nas gong du khyad zhugs pa re 'byung la/ kun+da byang chub kyi sems lhung bar rtsol kyang mi lhung ste/ nor bu nas shugs drag pos gyen la rang bzlog tu 'gro ba dang / rang gi lus kyang stong gzugs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ba dang / dag pa dang ma dag pa'i srid pa gsum gyi gzugs brnyan rtag par spro zhing bsdu ba'o/ /tshad ma ni mngon sum —84—

bzhi char tshang yang nang thi bde ba dam pa nyams su myong zhing rig pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rang rig mngon sum gtso che'o/ /lnga pa ni/ dag bya la dbye na 'du shes la 〈chu'i khams/ lce'i dbang po/gzugs kyi skye mched/ rkang pa'i dbang po/ len pa ste chu khams pa drug 〉sogs pa phung khams chu'i khams pa drug tshan gcig tu dbye/ dag byed rjes dran gyi yan lag la dbye na bcu ste/ rgyud las/ 〈chags yul bsam pa'i skabs dang / 'khrig 'dod kyi de dang /chags stobs kyi lus la tsha rim skye ba'i de dang / kha bskams bzhin 'gyur ba'i de dang / zas sogs la mi 'jug pa'i de dang / lus 'dar ba'i de dang / spyon pa ltar gyur pa'i de dang / mi shes pa'i rmongs par gyur pa'i de dang / rkyen gzhan chags yul du snang ba'i 'khrul ba'i de dang / 'khrig spyod skabs sems brgyal ba ltar gyur pa'i de dang 'byu'o/〉 bsam dang 'dod dang lus la rim dang kha mchog pad+ma skams dang zas la rab tu mi 'jug dang / /'dar dang smyo dang rab tu rmongs par 'gyur dang yid ni rnam par 'khrul dang drag tu brgyal ba dag /rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste srog chags lus la 'jig rten du/ /rab tu gsal zhing nges pa de rnams yid srub gnas skabs su zhig rgyal bar 'dod pa de ni su/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rtags bcu'i dbye ba can gyi stong gzugs so sos rim pas bde ba 'dren pa na/bsam pa'i gnas skabs dang mtshungs shing / de rnam par dag pa'i bde ba dang po thob pa la sogs pa/ bde ba mi 'dra ba bcu rim gyis thob pa yi na no/ /drug pa la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ rjes su dran pas legs par dag pa dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag kyang ye shes gzugs las —85—

so/ /zhes pa ltar/ rtsa nang thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas phyi nang thams cad 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis khyab pa dang / rnam smin gyi lus gnas ma 'gyur yang rang sems lha skur dngos su gyur pa dang / gzhan yang mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mtha' yas pa thob cing/ bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun mi 'chad pa yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la 〈mā ma gī 'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed/ khro mo khengs byed ma ste chu khams pa'i lha drug〉sogs pa lha chu khams pa drug tshan gcig gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro/ /sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /des rjes dran gyi stsed tshar ro// //gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang / sgom tshul blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dngos kyi dbang ltar byas na/ phyag chen kho na'i rjes dran dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ spogs chog tu las kyi phyag rgya tha dad pa mang du sgrub par bshad pa yin la/ 'dir ni mos pa lam byed tsam du sgom na/ rjes dran rjes mthun pa dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang / lta stangs sna rtser dbab pa'i tshul gyis lta gsung / dmigs pa'i skabs su yas brtan dga' bzhi ni rjes dran dang 'dra/ mas brtan la rtsa 'khor so sor bum can yun ring du sgom zhing / stong gzugs dang bde ba la mnyam par 'jog ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis thob par mos pa tsam bya'o/ /dmigs bskor zhe drug pa'o/ /dmigs bskor 'di mtha' cig tu ma byas kyang chog mong// bla ma gong ma —86—
