—rnams kyis/ yan lag drug gi dmigs pa'i sa bcad mi stong pa'i phyir mjad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan don/sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dhi zhes pa ting nge 'dzin te/ de yang mnyam par kun tu 'dzin pa'i don yin pas/ gzung 'dzin dang bral zhing / yul yul can dbyer med la sems gnas pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rjes dran gyi yan lag mthar phyin te/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'phral du bskyed nus pa na'o/ /gsum pa la/ don tshan lnga'i dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi yul ni/ stong gzugs dang bde chen gnyis yin la/ don tshan gnyis pa bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i don dang / rnam par smin pa'i lus dbyings su dag ste/ 〈stong gzugs rdo rje'i sku dang mi gnyis pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes thob pa'i don no/〉 /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku thob pa'i phyir ro /don tshan gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi thog ma mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad cig gcig thob pa nas/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yongs su rdzogs par thob kyi bar du'o /don tshan bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ni/ rgyud las/ shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyis ni 'gyur med bde —87—

ba'i dbang gis ye shes gzugs la ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes te/ ye shes gcig nyid la ldog cha'i dbye bas shes rab mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / thabs rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes kyi sku gnyis so sor mthong ba'i gnyis snang gi cha med par zung 'jug tu nyams su myong ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ zhu bde 'dzag med mthar phyin pas rkyen byas nas/ las rlud gcig 'gags/ rtsa gsum dang bcu cha gcig dbu mar thim/ khams dkar dmar gyi bgrod pa re re dbu ma'i nang du g.yo med du brtan zhes bya ste/ de ltar rtsa dang / rlung dang / khams rnams phyin chad 'jig tu med cing rgyun mi 'chad pa'i stong gzugs su gyur pa na/ de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i ye shes ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes bya'o/ /de phyir/ stong gzugs bde bas rig pa la/ /bde ba chen po rang gis rig /ces gsungs so/ /don tshan lnga pa ting nge 'dzin ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud las/ bde ba ma nyams gcig pu zhi ba lhan skyes ye shes rnal 'byor 'dir ni sgrub pa chen po la/ /zhes dang / dus zhabs snyan rgyud las kyang / sgom pa dmigs bcas stong gzugs dang / /dmigs med bde ba ro mnyam la/ /sems ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /dngos po thams cad bde bar 'char/ /zhes pa ltar sngar gnas gyur zin gyi thig le rnams kyi mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / phyis gnas 'gyur rgyu da lta gnas ma 'gyur ba'i thig le dbab bzlog gi zhu bde 'dzag med gnyis tshogs pa gcig tu gyur pas/ sems bde ba thob pa'i ngang nas/ stong gzugs la rab tu chags pas zhu bde 'dzag med yang yang sgrub pa yin la/—88—

rjes thob tu spros bcas kyi spyod pa rtag tu spyod pa'am/ bogs 'don spogs chog gi tshul du ci rigs par spyod dgos pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi mthar thug pa ma mthong ba'i don yang dag par mthong ba na/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i don yang dag par mthong ba'i bar du ste/ tshad ma ni mngon sum bzhi char tshang ba las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi dbang du byas nas/'phags pa'i ye shes rjes mthun pa yin pas rnal 'byor mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ dag bya la dbye na gzugs phung 〈sa'i khams/ lus kyi dbang po/dri'i skye mched/ bshang lam gyi dbang po/ bya ba smra ba ste sa khams pa drug〉sogs phung khams sa khams pa drug tshan gcig yin la/ dag byed ting nge 'dzin la dbye na/ 'khor lo drug tu las rlung 'gags pa'i dbye bas sa bcu gnyis sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa bcu ni rlung bcu po rnams 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pas/ thur sel la sogs pa'i rlung bcu phyin chad mi skye ba'i chos can du rtsa ba nas 'gags pa'i dbye bas rim pa bcu'o/ /drug pa la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis dag pa nyin zhag 'ga' zhig rnams kyi ye shes sku ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin dang po skyes pa nas/ rgyun ma chad par bsgoms na/ lo gsum dang phyogs gsum gyis gnas lugs yang dag pa bden pa'i sa mngon du byed cing rnam par smin pa'i lus dbyings su thim nas/ gnyis —89—

su med pa zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i sku 'grub bo/ /de ni dbang bcu la 〈dbang bcu ni/ tshe la dbang ba/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba/ yo byad la dbang ba/ las la dbang ba/ skye ba la dbang ba/ mos pa la dbang ba/ smon lam la dbang ba/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba/ ye shes la dbang —ba/ chos la dbang ba rnams so/〉 /sogs pa yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad 〈sangs rgyas spyan ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dri rdo rje ma/ gzhan rje'i mthar byed/ khro mo rengs byed ma ste lha sa khams pa drug〉la sogs pa lha sa khams pa drug tshan gcig gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro/ /sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /des ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khrid tshar te/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa rnams bstan zin to/ /gsum pa rjes lam gyi yan lag /sa mtshams/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs pa dang bcas pa la gsum ste/ lam gyi yan lag dang / sa lam 'bras bu nga/nga bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i yan lag go /dang po ni nyer mkho cung zad brjod pa la/ nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang / 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos 'dzin dang / 'da' kha 'pho ba'i gdams ngag dang / bar do 'dun pas 'dzin pa dang / thun sgom gyis mnyam rjes bsre ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/spyir gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la/ gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang / rmi lam gyi gdams ngag gnyis yod/ gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa la/las dang po pas 'od gsal 'dzin tshul ni/ sngar sor bsam pa'i skabs su bstan pa de yin la/ thabs des gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa —90—

la ni/ srog rtsol phan chad du gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag logs pa mi dgos mod/ spyir ni lugs 'di la mgrin snying kha sbyor gyis 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i man ngag dang / lte snying kha sbyor gyis 'od gsal spel ba'i man ngag kyang yod do/ /des na skabs 'dir rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ni/ rang gi mgrin nga/'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ṛ yig dmar po dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su thig le dkar po gsal btab nas/ 'jam rlud bag tsam bzung bas ṛ yig las gtum mo 'bar/ thig le la reg de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ ṛ yig la thim par bsam la/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya'o/ /zhes 'dun pa drag po bcug nas bsgoms pas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro/ /dmigs bskor zhe bdun pa'o/ /rmi lam zin zhing zin pa de yang brtan por song na/ mgrin par stong gzugs drangs te/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de dang bsres nas/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom par bya'o/ /zhes 'dun pa drag po btang bas/ rmi lam du sor bsam la sogs pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i bdun pa skyes te/dmigs pa la sems gtad pa'i tshe stong gzugs mang po bde nyams dang bcas te 'char ba'ang yod/ dang po nyid nas rmi lam dang stong gzugs 'dres mar 'char pa'ang yod/ rtsa bzang zhing dbang po rno ba dang / phyis shin tu goms par gyur na/ dbang po rno rtul thams cad la yang 'char ste/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dran med de ga sad ma thag tu rmi lam gyi dod la stong gzugs 'ba' zhig 'char ba'ang yod do/ /dmigs bskor zhe brgyad pa'o/ /—91—

gnyis pa la/ 'chi ka'i gdams ngag dngos dang / sgom 'phro la shi yang rnal 'byor goms stobs 'jug par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ da lta'i dus nas bdag 'chi ba'i tshe/ sa chu la thim pas du ba zhes pa la sogs pa'i rtags snang mang po dang / bying ba dang / sprid pa dang / 'phar g.yo la sogs pa'i lus nyams du ma dang / dbugs 'dar ba dang / rngam rgod la sogs pa'i ngag nyams du ma dang / gsal ba dang mi gsal ba dang / khro ba dang / chags pa la sogs pa sems nyams du ma 'byung bar 'dug pa la/ de rnams rang ngo shes par byas nas/ sem/sa 'ong/ gsal du 'jug dgos par 'dug snyam du 'dun pas mtshams sbyar la/ rang 'chi ba'i dus su yang sgom tshul 'di lta bu yin snyam pas/yan lag drug po gang skabs su bab pa de sgom la/ lus nyams/ ngag nyams/sems nyams/ mthong nyams gang byung yang 'chi kha'i sgom tshul yang 'di lta bu byed snyam pas/ nyams gang shar de la skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar ngos bzung la mnyam par gzhag khyad par gnyid du 'gro ba dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal la yang 'dun pa de bzhin du sbyong ba gal che/ dmigs bskor zhe dgu pa'o/ /nam zhig 'chi ba mngon du bab pa'i tshe/ mthong snang gang shar yang de la mi g.yo gsum ldan du bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbyings de ngos zin par bya/ de bzhin du lus ngag la bde sdug gi nyams gang byung yang 'dra/ sems la dga' sdug chags sdang ci shar yang 'dra/ rna bar sgra ji ltar thos kyang rung ste/ de dang de la mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rig pa —92—

—gtad de/ rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa ste rig thog tu bskyang ngo / /srog rtsol man chad goms pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin na/ 'chi ltas byung zhing 'chi ba mi bzlog par shes pa tsam na/ bum pa can dang stong gzugs la mnyam par 'jog pa la 'bad rtsol bskyed/ rlung sems drag tu dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs rnams bya/des 'od gsal gyi rtags snang dang bde stong gi nyams rgya cher mched nas rgya 'byam/sa su 'gro/ de'i ngang la dbyings su 'pho thub pa'ang yod/ de skabs ma 'phos kyang rung ste sngar gyi rgyun de ka sgoms/ thim rim rnams shar ba'i 'go brtsams dus nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ des nges par 'chi ba 'od gsal rang ngo 'phrod par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di skabs su spro zhing dgos na//bams thim rim rnams dang / snang ba bzhi'i rnam gzhag zhib mor bshad do/ /dmigs bskor lnga bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor goms stobs 'jug par bstan pa ni/ ches skal ba dman pa'am/ tshe bshugs nas nyams rtogs khyad par can tshe 'di la/ ma skyes kyang / chos 'di dang ma bral bzhin du dus las 'das na/ skye ba phyi ma la nges par grol ba thob ste/ rnal 'byor dbang po rnal 'byor ma thob zhes sogs kyi lung dang sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ chos rje kun spangs chen po'i gsung gi dbu'i nang sa bon rang sems ha ā hū/ /zla nyi nam mkha'i mdog can gtsug gsang snying / /srog rtsol bsu skyel gcig tu bsdus byas nas/ /'dun pa rtse gcig gang 'dod gnas su 'pho/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun/ lus kyi nang du rtsa —93—

dbu ma yang gong du bshad pa bzhi/ dbu ma'i nang spyi bor ha dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ nye bar ud mar po dang / snying gar hu sngon po gnyis mgo gyen bstan/ spyi bo'i steng du bla ma'am yi dam bzhugs par bsam/ rlud kha sbyor zhig bzung / steng rlud mnan pas/ ha hu la thim/ 'og rlud 'then pas u yang hu la thim/ hu de yang 'dar khril li li thig le khra bo zhig tu gyur par bsam yang 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung sangs kyis bus pas thig le de dbu ma'i lam brgyud/spyi gtsug nas rgyangs kyis thon/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ de dang 'od gsal rtags snang 'dres pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de 'dra ba lan 'ga' re song ba na/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas yi ge rnams babs te/ sngar bzhin rang gnas su gnas par bsam/ bla ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas rang la thim spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga yang zum par mos/ de ltar yun ring du sbyangs pas rtags 'byung zhing / ci ste ma byung na yar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dang bstun drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba byas pas 'phral du rtags 'ong / ha cang drags te thal gyis dogs pa'am/ stod mtshang dang / mgo la zug gzer drag po 'phral du skye ba byung na/ dbu ma'i nang nas gser gyi rdo rje ljid dang ldan pa zhig thur du song / bshang sgo nas thon/ sa 'og thag ring por shugs dang los te song nas/dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du gser gyi 'khor lo chen po gcig gi lte bar thams kyis zug par bsam/ de yang yang bsgoms pas sel 'bebs sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de yan chad 'pho ba sbyang ba'i gdams ngag yin/ las la sbyar ba'i skabs ni yar 'pho ba 'ba' zhig las mar 'bebs pa mi byed/ drag —94—

rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba'ang skabs su bab na bya'o /'di'i gdams ngag gi yi ge 'ga' zhig las/ a hū la thim/ hū ha la thim/ de thig le khra bor gyur pa 'dar khril li li 'dug /yang rlung nye bar mnan pas yig 'bru rnams sngar lugs bzhin 'khod/ de nas 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung 'bud pa hi ka dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ yig 'khru rnams mas rim kyis thim/ de thig le khra bor gyur/ spyi gtsug nas bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho zhes bshad de/dmigs pa 'di ngos rnam pa gsal ba tsam snang ngo / /de ltar na 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ste/ dmigs bskor nga gcig pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ci ste 'chi ba 'od gsal ngo 'phrod kyang / goms shugs chung zhing sgom yun thung bas ma grol na/ bar do'i snang ba 'char bar 'gyur bas/der lam bsgoms na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang da lta nas 'dun pas mtshams spyor dgos te/ nam zhig bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i skabs su tha mal gyi zhen pa dang 'grogs na 'khor bar 'khyam pas/ gnas skabs der yang 'di ltar sgom snyam du mtshams sbyar nas/ yan lag drug po gang yang rung ba bdag nyid gang la gtso bor byed pa de sgom/ bar dor 'di ltar sgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang / res 'ga' ni/ 'di thams cad bar do yin par 'dugaskabs 'dir ma 'khrul bar bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bsten zhing / chags sdang la sogs pa'i blo spangs nas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom/res 'ga' ni bar do'i mtshan nyid lus la grib ma med pa dang / nye du la sogs pa'i ngo mi shes pa dang / yang ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi'am —95—

lnga/ ma nges pa'i rnam 'gyur rnam pa drug /'gro ba'i lam bzhi la sogs nga// bar do'i lus dang snang ba'i mtshan nyid 'di dang 'di lta bu dag yin na/ da lta de lta bu re re nas yod dam med/ tshang ngam ma tshang zhes brtag cing / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa dang / bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas chags sdang spangs te/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom mo/ khyad par thun mtshams 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug /zas spyod lam/ gtam smra brjod/ dgra gnyen gyi 'brel ba sogs/snod bcud kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba'i skabs su/ yang yang dran pas zin par byas te/ 'di rnams sgom pa gal che/ de ltar nyin mo sad dus su bsgoms pas/ rmi lam du'ang phal cher 'char gyin 'dug na/ bar dor lam bsgoms pas grol bar the tshom med do/ /dmigs bskor nga gnyis pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ mun khang gsum la rim gyis bslab/ /bde sdug rkyen rnams kun la bsre/ khugs chad la sogs rang sar bskyang / /longs spyod spyod lam kun la bslab/ /ces pa ltar te/ de yang / dang por mun khang dngos su rtags snang rtag tu 'ong zhing brtan por song na/ mun khang 'bring po zhes bya ba/ gos kyis mgo btums te lus gnad sngar dang 'dra ba'i steng nas bslabs/ thog mar rtags snang rnams mun khang las cung mi gsal tsam 'byung / cung zad goms nas mun khang dang khyad med par 'char/ de nas lus gnad gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bcas/ mig btsum ste/ mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pas nang du lta stangs kyi gnad ma 'khrul bar yod/ de ltar bsgoms pas thog mar rtags snang nyung ba tsam 'byung zhing / gsal mi gsal la sngar dang khyad mi 'dug —96—

na/ de kha bsgoms pas zhag 'ga' zhig nas rtags snang shin tu mang ba 'byung /yang sngar las stong gzugs mi gsal tu song ba snyam byed na/ da dung mun khang chung du sgom ma ran pa yin pas/ re zhig snga ma rnams la dmigs pa drag por gtad de sgom/ slar yang mun khang chung ngur bsgoms pas sngar bzhin gsal bar 'ong ngo / /gzhan yang mig la dgab pa'i mun khang chung ngu'i khyad par gzhan 'ga' zhig byed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ de ltar mun khang che 'bring chung gsum 'a goms nas/ dang por snang ba cung zad dang bcas pa'i khang par bslab/ de nas snang ba ches gsal ba'i phyogs su'ang bslab/ de nas thun gyi skabs lta stangs kyi gnad ma 'chugs pa bya zhing / thun mtshams su lta stangs gyen thur thad ka g.yas g.yon la sogs pa ma nges pa dang / de bzhin du mig gdangs pa dang /btsum pa dang / zim mer lta ba sogs lta lugs kyang ma nges pa la bslabs pas/ rim gyis thams cad du stong gzugs kyi gsal snang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang bde sdug mtho dman thams cad la bsre dgos te/ de yang dang por tsher ma zug pa'am/ sna rdo thug pa'am/ rlung dang nyi ma dang kha char la sogs pa'i tsha grang phra mo tsam rang shugs su byung ba'am/ ched kyis kyang de dag gi gnas su song na/ tsha grang gi reg bya cung zad myong ba de la che re bltas te mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang bskyangs/ thog ma sems 'jog stabs mi bde tsam 'byung na'ang /cung zad goms nas tsha grang du snang ba de gsal char song / sems gtad pas de nyid ngos bzung dang bral te/ lus kyi reg bya myong tshul du mi bde yang / de kha'i steng du sems 'jog stabs shin tu bde ba zhig ཿnga / da dung de'i rang ngo —97—

la bltas te bsgoms pas tsha grang du snang ba de snang la ngos bzung med par nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ bkres skom dang ngal dub la sogs pa la yang sbyar bas/ mthar na tsha sdug bsngal chen po thog tu bab kyang lam du longs pa zhig 'ong / de bzhin du/ gtam mi snyan par rang gi yid la mi 'thad pa'i tshig dag thos pas/ sems mi bde kar gyis byung ba'i dus kyang / mi bde ba de dang tshig spyi de la cher gyis bltas te/ btsal na ngos bzung med pa de ngos zin par byas nas mi g.yo gsum ldan bskyang ngo / /de bzhin du/ yid skyo ba dang /dga' ba dang / 'jigs pa dang / spro ba dang / nga rgyal dang / khengs pa dang /chags pa dang / sdang ba dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog sogs gang byung thams cad la de bzhin bskyangs pas rang sangs su 'gro ba yin no/ /gzhan yang /lam du phyin pa'i ngal dub dang / khur chen po 'khur ba dang / bzlas pa dang /mdo 'don dang / gsung sgrog sogs 'jur po byas pa dang / brtsis dang / mno bsam dang / lta rtog 'jur po byed pa'i rjes su'ang / sngar gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya rtsol drag po des rnam rtog gi shugs chad yod pas de dus rig pa lta shes tsam byas nas/ yid mi g.yo bar bzhag pa nyid kyis rig pa gsal stong mtha' dbus med par 'char ro/ /gzhan yang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yid du 'ong ba dang phrad pa'i tshe dga' lhang ste yong ba dang / gzugs sogs mi sdug pa gnod pa can dang phrad pa'i tshe/ zug rngus lhang ste byung ba kun la'ang gang byung de la sems gtad de/ sngar bzhin mi g.yo gsum ldan bskyang / gzhan yang mdo 'don sngags bzlas phyag dang bskor ba snying rje nges 'byung sogs/ lus ngag —98—

yid gsum gyi dge ba rnams dang / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam kun tu/'phral 'phral 'dun pas sleb par byas te/ gang shar de la bzo med du bskyangs pas rang grol du 'gyur ba'i gnad zin par bya'o/ /'di dag shin tu gal che yang / dmigs thun grangs nges su bcad pa med pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /dmigs bskor nga gsum la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa sa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ de ltar sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs/ sor sdud kyis dbu ma'i lam cung zad dag sems gnas pa la rang dbang thob pas/ rnam rtog gi bar chod mi 'byung zhing / 'od gsal rtags bcu thog mar bsgrubs/ bsam gtan gyis dbu ma'i lam shin tu sbyangs shing / rang sems/ stong gzugs/ las snang dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin dbyer med spros bral du shes/ rtags bcu brtan zhing sngar bas kyang ches khyad par du song / bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis yan lag 'di nyid mthar phyin na/ sbyor lam drod kyi dang po la sleb pa yin la/bskyed rim ma brtan par 'di rnams bsgoms nas mthar phyin pa yin na/sngags kyi tshogs lam chen po tsam yin no/ /de nas srog rtsol gyi yan lag gis rlung bcu dbu mar thim pas/ gzung 'dzin tha dad par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mngon 'gyur ba 'gag cing / phyi nang gi 'byung ba la ci rigs par dbang thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon shes sogs nus pa'ang cung zad rnyed pa dang /gtum mo cung zad 'bar bas bde stong gi nyams gsal por shar ba yin te/sngar bskyed rim brtan rung ma brtan rung / drod chung 'bring man chad yan lag —99—

'dis thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dzin pa'i yan lag gis rlud mtha' dag dbu ma'i thig le rna gru/sa la thim pas gtum mo rang 'bar rgyun mi 'chad cing / nus pa dang yon tan sngar bas bcu 'gyur nas brgya 'gyur gyi bar du 'phel/ drod chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes nas rtse mo la mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur/ rjes dran gyis ye shes kyi sku chung ngu thob cing / gtum mo 'bar ba lhag par stobs su gyur pas/zhu bde 'dzag med kyi dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren/ nyon mongs rags pa mngon 'gyur ba spong / rtse mo mthar phyin pa'i bar du'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bzod pa dang / chos mchog ste/ las rlung 'gags shing thig le brtan pa sogs 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dngos su spong bar byed pa'i lam ste/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i phyed mi 'gyur ba'i byang sems kyis gang bas sa dang po/ phyed phyi ma gang bas sa gnyis pa/ zhes sogs 'khore 'e1 gzhan lnga la'ang sbyar bas/gtsug tor gyi phyed phyi ma gang ste/ gtsug tor yang hril gyis brtan pas sa bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de'i skad cig gnyis par gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub ces bya ste/ de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis pa'i skad cig ma tha ma der nga nga dag pa 'phags pa'i mthong lam rgyud la skyes nas/ 'khore ba'i lus ngag yid dang chags rtog rnams spangs zin/ de'i rjes kyi skad cig la gnyis su med pa ste/ zung 'jug gi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs 〈'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dag pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang / sems nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog dang 'dzag bde 'gags pas ye shes rdo rje'o/〉 ye shes rdo rje mngon du byed/ de nas kun tu 'od la 〈sa wu gnyis ni/ kun tu 'od kyi sa dang / bdud rtsi'i 'od/ nam mkha'i 'od/ rdo rje'i 'od/ rin chen 'od/ pad+ma'i —100—

'od/ sangs rgyas kyi las byed pa'i sa/ dpe med pa'i sa/ dpe thams cad pa'i sa/ shes rab 'od kyi sa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa/ so so'i bdag nyid rig pa'i sa'o/〉 sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis thob/ gnas la sogs pa'am rab tu dga' ba la 〈dang po/ rab du dga' ba/dri ma med pa/ 'od byed pa/ 'od 'phro ba/ sbyangs dga' ba/ mngon du gyur pa/ ring du song ba/ mi g.yo bi/ legs pa'i blo gros/ chos kyi sprin/ kun tu 'od/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'o/〉sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gcig rim gyis bgrod par 'gyur te/ mthar gyi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can〈rdul gyi dwangs ma gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar du cha bcu gnyis su ye shes kyi ngo bor brtan par gyur pas bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / byang sems kyi dwangs ma nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar du dga' ba bcu drug gi rim pas brtan par gyur pas de nyid bcu drug mngon du gyur pa'o/〉bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / de nyid rnam pa bcu drug zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo/ yon tan dang / ye shes rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid can rgyun mi 'chad pa thob par 'gyur te/ skal ba dang ldan zhing brtsomyo 'grus can gyis ma nor ba'i lam mchog 'di la 'bad na tshe 'di nyid kyis khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa nyid sgo /'di dag rgyas par gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i yan lag ni/lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyun mi nyams shing bsrung ba gnyis so /dang po ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ gnyis pa la/ bka' rgya bzhi yi rgyus btab pa'i yan lag bar chad spang ba'i yan lag dam tshig —101—

bsrung ba'i yan lag spyod pa skyong ba'i yan lag ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ snod min la gsang bar gdams pa ste/ bka' rgyas gdab bar bya ba bzhi ni/ sngon 'gro'i gdams ngag /dngos gzhi'i gdams ngag rang gi nyams myong / bla mas ji ltar ngo sprad pa ste bzhi'am/ gdams ngag ji ltar phog pa/ nyams myong ji ltar skyes pa/ ngo bo ji ltar sprad pa/ gegs sel bogs 'don ji ltar byed pa ste bzhi yin zhes kyang kha cig 'chad de/ don gcig tu 'bab pa'i phyir gnyis ka'ang mi 'gal lo/ /skabs 'dir bka' rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lam bzang 'phrog pa'i chom rkun spang ba/ lam bzang 'dor ba'i rgyu g.yo can gyi ston pa spang ba/ lam bzang la bar du gcod pa'i bdud ngo shes par bya ba/ lam zab mo bsrung zhing sped par gdams pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dri me 'od las/ lam bzang rin chen 'di ni bag med pa'i/ /sems can gzhan pa rnams la byin pa na/ /rang khyim dgon pa dag tu rab bzhugs te/ /yul ngan chom rkun rnams kyis 'phrog par byed/ /the tshom 'gyod pa dag dang gnyid dang ni/ /le lo rgod pa'i chom rkun rnams kyis kyang / /gnyen 'dun thib po'i nang du rab zhugs te/ /rin po che ni rtag tu 'phrog par byed/ /ces dang / shin tu bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs dang / /longs spyod du ma'i chom rkun de rnams kyis/ /brtson 'grus ldan du zin kyang bag med cing / /brgyal bar gyur pa nyid la 'phrog par byed/ /ces gsungs te/ rang yul dang rang khyim la zhen pa dang / dgra gnyen gyi chags sdang dang / gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga'i dbang du gtong ba dang / longs spyod sna tshogs kyis g.yengs ba dang / yul lnga —102—

la sred pa'i khong skran can rnams la/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang por mi skye zhing /lan cig skyes kyang nyams par 'gyur bas de dag gi dbang du mi gtong /gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid yongs su rtog pa po min phyir/ /rin thang chen por 'gyur ram shes ched du/ /g.yo can gzhan la ston te mi 'gyur zhes/ /de yi tshig gis rin chen 'dor bar byed/ /gang dag rin chen bzang po rig pa rnams/ /rin chen chen po yongs su rtog tu gzhug /de dag rnams kyi rnam dag tshig gis ni/ /rang gi rin chen rnam par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam 'di nyid kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa la ma gtogs/gzhan la rang gi nyams rtogs rnams shin tu gsang zhing dogs gcod mi 'dri ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /pha dang ma dang bu mo sring mo dang / /bu dang skrun zla 'dod pa'i chung ma yi/ /gzugs rnams kyis ni bdud rnams gegs byed do/ /zhes te/ bar chad ngo shes nas de'i dbang du mi gtong ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de phyir bla ma dam pa'i gnang ba yi/ /lam bzang rin po che ni slob ma yis/ /chom rkun rtsa lag yongs su spangs byas te/ /'bad pas shin tu legs par sba bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan lag ni/ rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi bsrung zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gnas pa dang/bza' ba'i dam tshig gsang ste bsten pa dang / lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom —103—

zhing / nyams myong gi mi mthun phyogs rnams spangs/ mthun rkyen rnams sgrub pa ste/ dam tshig gi rnam gzhag rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bshad do/ /bzhi pa spyod pa bskyang ba'i yan lag ni/ mi dge ba bcu spangs/ dge ba bcu la gnas/ chos la dad pa brtan pos las 'bras la blang dor phyin ci ma log par spyod cing / rang gis ji ltar blangs pa'i bslab pa rnams la nan tan snying por sgrub/ gang zag la dad pas sangs rgyas byang sems sogs 'phags pa rnams dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams la mos gus kyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro/ gsung bzhin sgrub/ skyon la mi rtog /yon tan bsam/skyabs yul log pa la yid mi rton/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ chos kyi phan yon bsam pa sogs/ theg pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi spyod pa legs par bskyangs/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can la brten nas/ phar phyin drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa la rang bslab cing / gzhan yang slob tu 'jug /spros bral stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi spyod pa khyad par can la slob pa theg chen thams cad kyi spyod pa rnams kyang skyong / gzhan yang gong du zugad pa'i dam tshig rnams dang / rdzogs rim nges don gyi spyod pa las brtsams te dam tshig bzhi'i spyod pa/ rigs drug gi spyod pa/ phar phyin bcu'i spyod pa la sogs pa gsungs te/ mdor na nges don gyi spyod pa rnams stan thog gcig tu dril nas nyams su len zhing / drang don gyi spyod pa rnams kyang sems can gyi don du sbyor ba la sogs pa thabs la mkhas pas bsgrub par —104—

bya'o/ /'di dag thams cad rgyas pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi 'khrid yig tu lta bar bya'o// //'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam ni rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa ste/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi snying po rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gsang / /zab cing rgya che rtogs par dka' bas bdag lta'i spyod yul ma yin mod/ /skal mnyam gzhan la phan par 'gyur snyam gnas 'dir rtsol la'ang nyes pa ci/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang / /sngon byon grub pa'i ring lugs las brtsams nas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nges don nyams len tshul/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi gsung bzhin bshad/ /zab don yid bzhin nor bu'i phung po dag /mkhas grub gong ma'i thugs mtshor sbas pa las cha cam mngon du phyung nas 'dir spel gyi/ /de yi dge ba 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ /srid pa'i gnas 'dir khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi mgon du bzhugs pa yang / /gzung 'dzin dri ma'i dpung tshogs kun bco me ste/ /rang gnas rtag bde'i rgyal srid spyod par shog /ces zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po jo nang pa yab sras kyi phyag len ji lta ba ste/ grub thob brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi yi ge so so'i gnad kyang tshang bar byas shing / tshig lam mdzes khrigs spangs te/tha mal ba'i skad kyi shin tu go bde bar brjod pa yin la/ de yang gong ma rnams kyi khrid yig so so dag /don bzang la tshig legs pas/ mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs bla na med pa yin yang / man ngag phyag bzhes mang po zhig gab par —105—

mdzad cing / tshig don rgya che bas phal cher gyis rtogs par dka' bas na/ lam zab mo la mi 'jug pa dag mthong bas/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang / chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i khrid yig gi zhabs tog tu dmigs nas smras pa'o/ /de yang snga phyir don gnyer du mas kyang bskul ba dang / khyad par mdo smad pa dbon po yon tan lhun grub la sogs pas 'phral tu bskul ba dang /g.yin du ma la yang phan par mthong nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bzhi bcu pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o//smras pa/ don dam chos sku'i dbyings dang 'dres pa'i thugs la bzhengs pa mi mnga' yang / /'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i thugs rje'i zhags pas dam du 'ching / /'bad med 'dod dgu'i dngos grub gter mdzad yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /mnyam med bu ram shing pas bdag cag dus kun shis pas bskyangs du gsol/ /'dod pa'i 'ching ba kun las grol nywang rtag tu 'dod chags r+ṣa pos gdung / /dngos dang dngos med rnam par bral cu rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /tshig gi brjod pa kun las grol cu sna tshogs skad kyis cig car ston/ /gcig dang du ma rnam par bral cu thabs shes zung 'jug ston la 'dud/ /rgyal bstan dwangs bcud rin chen nor bu'i tshogs/ /dbang lung man ngag gser skud legs par bstar/ /skal ldan ma lus mgrin pa'i rgyan du spras/ /brgyud rim bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin dran/ /'jam dbyangs ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol/ /g.yin stong dbu ma'i rang lugs slar gsal mdzad/ /mdo sngags bye ba'i mnga' bdag sgrol mgon —106—

rjes/ /dus 'khor rdzogs rim mthong ba don ldan mdzad/ /snga na med pa'i gsung rab dam pa 'di/ /rgyal sras dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod sprin bstar/ /'dzad med nyal 'gro'i rgyun la 'gran pa'i thabs/ /gcig las du ma yongs 'phrul chos sbyin mchog /gcig stong dgu brgya go drug zla tshes la/ /sngon bsags las skyes kun dga' chos 'aswol gyis/ /cos mo'i thog drangs 'gro drug pha ma rnams/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho'i g.yang la lhung ba dag /zhi bsil thar pa'i gnas su drangs pa'i thabs/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i snying stobs zla bral gyis/ /bstan 'gro yongs la dmigs nas yon sbyar bas/ /yig tshogs mdzad med spar gyi phyi mo bskrun/ /legs byas 'di dang rgyal kun rab dkar mdzod/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rnam dkar bsod nams kyis/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ /chabs gcig mdo sngags rdzogs ldan dbu ma dar/ /skye 'gro'i bde skyid 'bad med ngang gis 'phel/ /sbyin bdag phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bral/ /bstan 'dzin sde rgyas 'dul khrims gtsang ma'i mdzes/ /thos bsam sgom gsum brtson pa lhod med par/ /byang rgod phra rags kun bral dran shes kyis/ /bya ra lhod med bag yod zhi dul dang / /zhi lhag zung 'brel ting 'dzin brtan po yis/ /bde gshegs snying po myur du mngon par shog /spyin bdag pha rgan tshe ldan phur ba mgon/ /tshe 'das bsam gtan gzhan yang tshe ring 'bum/ /bsam 'phel la sogs bsngo dgos gang yod rnams/ /'di phyir bde ba'i mthar thug gto bde thob/ /rten 'di gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs der/ /nad mug dus 'khrugs rab zhi chab srid brtan/ /dus bzhi snyoms —107—

shing lo phyugs rtags tu 'phel/ /tshe ring bskal bzang bde skyid ldan par shog /'dir 'brel gyis mtshon mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams/ /skye dang skye ba'i phreng ba thams cad du/ /zab chos bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i bskal bzang ldan/ /sgrib gnyis spangs shing 'gro ba'i ded dpon gyur/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin zla bral ltar/ /bdag sogs mdzad pa chen po'i gnas thob nas/ /srid zhi dang bral 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i thabs/ /'gro kun re 'dod 'bad med bskong bar shog /ces skyes thob yon tan gyi che ba yongs su rdzogs shing lam bslab pa gsum dang/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin pas rang don tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs shing / gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / dbang lung gdams ngag ma lus pa la brten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'jums smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho ba dang / khyad par mdo sngags kyi don mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta ba'i rkang byas te/sngags gsar rgyud kyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por bzhugs shing / mtshan brjod par dka' ba don rgya chen po'i slad du mtshan nas smos na jo nang rje btsun kun dga' snying po'am/ rje tā ra nā tha zhes mtshan gyi snyan pa srid 'dir nam mkha'i rnga gsang ltar grags shing / zegs ma'i cha shas tsam 'gro kun gyi rna bar lhung bas kyang ngan 'gro'i lus kyi dpung bsnyil zhing bde skyid ma lus pa ster bas snyigs dus su nges gsang gi rgyal bstan slar yang skyongs bar dgongs te/ bsam bzhin du sku skyes gzhon nu'i tshul du byon pa gang gis mdzad pa'i zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba'i —108—

shing spar kun dga' chos su gyi bzhengs skabs su spar byang smon tshig zab mo'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i nyams myong legs bskrun zhes bya ba 'di yang 'dzin byed dam me pho byi ba'i hor zla bdun pa gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bco lnga gza' lhag pa skar ma byi zhin sa chu 'phrad pa lang tsho sbyor ba rnam dkar gang bsags 'bum 'gyur du 'gro ba'i dus chen nyin mtha' legs grub skabs dbyar gyi dus su dro grang snyoms shing rtsi bcud sna tshogs kyi dri bsrung rnams bser bu dal gyi ldang bas phyogs kun khyab par mdzad pa/ nam mkha'i chu 'dzin stug po phyogs bcur bskyod pa'i dbus nas nam mkha'i rnga gsang lhang lhang sgrogs bzhin 'od dmar zhags pa'i rtsed 'jo dang 'grogs te/ bdud rtsi'i zil char phyogs bcur 'thor nas gser ldan yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa las 'gro kun 'tsho bar byed pas skye ldan sna tshogs kyi 'bras bu rgyas pa/me tog 'khri shing / rkang 'thung / ljon pa sna tshogs pa'i lo 'bras phun sum tshogs pa phyogs bcur g.yo pa'i rtse mor bya khu byug dang / 'jol mo/ mthing ril sogs kyis phan tshun 'gran bzhin snyan pa'i sgra skad rna ba'i bcud du 'khyil ba/ ri thang thams cad kyis rin po che g.yu ljang gi gos gyon pa ltar ljang gsal g.yu yi kha dog tu bsgyur ba/ char sprin stug po'i khur gyi lci ba'i rlabs phreng chu 'dzin sngo bsangs gos can sa la lhung 'dra'i 'dzad med chu mdzod klong nas brdol ba 'di nub zhi bde rgya mtsho la 'gran pa lta bu'i chu bo'i gzhung rab tu rgyas pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo mkha' la 'khyog por bris pas mchog gsum la mchod pas rnam 'gyur ngom pa sogs phyi nang gi mthun rkyen —109—

legs tshogs ma lus pa 'byung pa'i skabs su nyid kyis bskul ba ltar shākya'i dge slong blo bzang chos 'phel rgya mtshos 'dzam thang gtsang chen 'du khang pho brang dmar ldeng ma'i nang du dge 'dun pa brgya phrag gcig dang lnga bcu lhag tsam gyis jo nang phur ba'i sgrub chen 'don zhor du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma ṅga shwa5ma/bdag gis dge ba gang bsags 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde mchog spel ba'i/ /bla na med pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid gyur cig /ces pa'i dge ba bsngo ba 'di ma tis bris/ dge'o/ /—110—

lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/oX snya sti/ gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba grol mdzad pa/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i khrid ston pa la/ thog mar chos khungs dang 'brel ba'i che ba cung zad brjod par spro na/ 'dir bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud ma lus pa phyung ba/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog mthar thug rnal 'byor dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul lam 'jug ngogs/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus dang ldan pa'i gang zag cig tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khrid par byed pa'i nye lam myur lam khyad par can/ rgyud kyi rgyal po g.yin du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gis sbas shing gsang pa'i don/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lor ma sbas gsal bar bstan pa/ phyag rgya chen po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes gsungs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ chos 'di mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud ma lus pa phyung ba yin te/ mdo sngags kyi lam thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying —111—

po can yin/ rgyud las kyang/ gang zhig stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med par smra bo phyogs nyams de ni mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang / spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid zung du 'jug pa ste/ chos 'di nyid kyi snying por rtag tu bzhugs pa yin te/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad kyi skabs su/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byed pa yin/ stong nyid kyi lta ba go yul du 'jog pa'i gnas skabs kyang mang du yod la/'on kyang go yul gyi stong nyid de tsam kho na gnad du mi che ste/ don gyi gtso bo dpyad pa las 'das shing / rjes dpag tsam gyi yul ma yin pa'i spros bral stong nyid ni chos 'di'i dmigs pa'i mthil yin no/ /yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i khyad chos/ g.yin dang thun mong ma yin pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba snying rje chen po dang / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs stong pa nyid de/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin na/ de ni chos tshul 'di la yod pa tsam du ma zad/ zung 'jug gi lam de ni sbyor ba yan lag drug pa 'di kho na yin gyi/ lam gzhan la med ces dam 'cha' ru yang rung ste/ rgya bod du phal cher la grags pa'i man ngag rjes 'brang gi yi ge ris su 'khod cing rgyun yod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ sbyor drug las gzhan pa'i rim lnga/ phyag rgya bzhi pa/ phyag rdzogs zhi gcod/ chos drug lam 'bras sogs gang la yang zung 'jug gi lam yongs su rdzogs par mtshan nyid tshang ba med na/ gzhan blun po mgo skor gyi chos dang / rtog ge bas brtags pa rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang de dang de'i lugs srol 'dzin —112—

par 'dod pa'i rjes 'jug rgya bod rnams kyi 'chad tshul la de ltar yin gyi/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga/ dzñā na pa'i grol thig dril bu rim lnga/ nag po rim bzhi sogs kyi gzhung rtsa ba rnams kyi dgongs brtad ni/ chos 'di dang gcig pas grub thob de dag gis kyang lam 'di kho na thugs su chud pa yin zhing / gzhung de dag chos 'di dang mthun par 'chad shes na dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'gyur ro/ /don gyi gtso bo ni de lta bu yin la/ gzhan yang dad pa dang / nges 'byung dang / blang dor gyi spyod pa dang / zhi gnas/ lhag mthong dang / tshad med bzhi/phar phyin bcu/ bsdu dngos bzhi/ byang phyogs so bdun sogs mdo dang thun mong ba rnams dang / smin grol gyi lam/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor/dbang bzhi'i ye shes/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa rnam grangs mi 'dra ba thams cad/ don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di'i khongs su chud pa'i phyir/ chos 'di mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ sangs rgyas pa yi bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen te/ theg pa gsum du ma 'dus pa'i theg pa bzhi pa med mod kyang/ gsum po'i nang sel gyi dbye ba la brten pa'i rnam grangs kyi theg pa mang du 'byung pa'ang mi 'gal te/lang kar gshe/gas pa las/ theg pa rnam pa mang bar+sha/da pa/ /sems can rnams ni drang ba'i phyir/ /theg pa tha dad ngas bshad de/ /theg pa gcig tu'ang ngas bstan to/ /ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /theg pa dag la thug pa med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /des na dad pa phun sum tshogs pas blang dor phyin ci ma —113—

log par byed pa ni lha'i theg pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom pa ni/ tshangs pa'i theg pa ste/ de gnyis 'jig rten pa'i theg pa yin pas/ theg pa dngos ma yin la/ de las mchog tu gyur nga/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / de bzhin du rang rgyal dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bya rgyud dang / spyod rgyud dang /rnal 'byor rgyud dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa rnams snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma mchog tu gyur pa yin zhing / rnal 'byor bla med gzhan thams cad las kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yi na/ rgyud 'di'i zab don ma thar thug ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na yin pas/ lam dang 'bras bu'i theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse'am mthar thug pa ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa 'bras bur bcas pa dang / gsung rab sde snod kyi theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i yang rtse/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud yin no/ /skabs 'dir dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/ 'dus pa bde dgyes sogs kyang bla na med pa yin na/ de dag las dus 'khor lhag pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bka'i glegs bam dang / tshig la byin rlabs che chung ngam/ phyag mchod kyi yul du bzang ngan gyi khyad par 'byed pa sogs nam du yang mi rung na/rnal 'byor bla med nang tshan du lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta na yang / tshig zin gyi don dang / sgra ji bzhin pa'i don la rgya che chung dang / zab mi zab kyi khyad par yod pas/ don 'di'i dbang du byas te/ bla med gzhan rnams las dus kyi 'khor lo zab cing rgya che ba yin pas/ 'di nyid theg pa'i yang rtser 'jog la/rgyud gzhan thams cad kyi sbas don 'dis gsal bar mdzad cing / de'i tshe bla —114—

med kyi rgyud gzhan rnams kyi dgongs don gyi gnad thams cad 'di dang gcig par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dus pa bde dgyes sogs kyang bla na med pa ma yin par thal ba'i skyon ga la yod/ yang blo dman 'ga' zhig la dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/ 'di theg pa'i yang rtse kho na yin na/ theg pa gzhan thams cad dang thun mong ma yin par gyur pa'i phyir/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin par 'gal/ yang mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin na/ theg dman gyi don yang yin pa'i phyir/ yang rtse yin par 'gal snyam pa 'di 'gyung ngo / /de'i lan ni/ theg pa che chung mdo rgyud thams cad kyi thugs kyi brtad so'i dgongs pa gcig yin zhing / gcig po de yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor kho na'o/ /'on kyang so so'i tshig gi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa la zab don 'di gsal mi gsal dang rgyas mi rgyas kyi khyad par shin tu gal che bas/ mchog dman med pa'ang ma yin no/ /des na nges don shin tu gab pa'i gsung rab rnams la gang zag skal dman dag yid rton pas theg dman gyi mdo zhes grags shing / nges don ci rigs gab cing ji ltar 'os pa gsal bar mdzad pa rnams gang zag dbang po 'bring gi rigs rnams kyis skal par thob pa ni phar phyin theg pa nas yo ga'i theg pa'i bar du grags te bla na yod pa'o/ /zab don mthar thug gsal bar ston pa rnams dbang po mchog rnams kho na'i chos kyi skal bar byon pa la theg pa bla na med pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /des na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad las/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di spyir gsal por bstan pa tsam yin mod kyang / dpal ldan dus 'khor dang bskrun na/ gzhan de rnams rdo rje'i rnal 'byor —115—

gyi rnam gzhag 'ga' zhig tu mi gsal ba dang / kha cig tu bsdus pa dang / la la dag tu ma tshang ba'i tshul du yod la/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dir ni/ zab lam mthar thug 'di shin tu gsal ba dang/ ches rgyas pa dang / yongs su rdzogs shing gab pa dang 'khrugs pa med la/ 'thor thabs ma yin par gsungs pa'i phyir mchog dang rtse mor gyur pa'ang yin no/ /des na dngos su gsal bar bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ da so/ngas pa'i brtad so phugs kyi zhe 'dod kyi dbang du byas na/ theg pa mtha' dag gi dgongs pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar go dgos te nyan thos kyi sde snod nas rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi gzhung na/ spyi ldog nas grub pas khyad par can gyi don yang shugs la 'grub pa mang ste/ dper na mi'i 'gro ba tsam bde 'gro yin par grub na/'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bde 'gro'i mchog yin par shug la grub pa bzhin du/ spyi ldog nas stong nyid sgom pa lam gyis mchog tu gsungs pas/ khyad par can rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong nyid sgom pa lam gyi ches mchog tu shugs la bstan pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom tshul spyi ldog nas nam mkha'i rnal 'byor tsam dang / bla gab med pa'i rnal 'byor tsam yin par dngos su gsungs pas/ de'i shugs la nam mkha' dang bla gab med pa'i rnal 'byor khyad par can sor sdud kyi lam 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pa gsungs par 'gro ba lta bu ste/ des gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon no/ /yang bla med kyi bsdus rgyud gzhan rnams las ni/ khyad par can de rnams spyi khyab kyi khog tu sbas te gsungs pa nyung la/ rgyud tshig bgram po —116—

go dka' ba'i tshul gyis sbas pa dang / dang por nag po rab tu bsgom/ zhes pa lta bu nag po mun pa'i nam mkha' la dgongs pa yin yang / skye bo phal gyis don gzhan la 'khrul 'gro ba'i tshul gyis sbyar ba'i sbas pa dang / bskyed rim gyi zol gyis rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid bshad pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhu bde'i khongs su sbas pa dang / dbang bzhi pa dbang gsum pa'i nang du sbas pa dang / gzhan yang brda thabs sna tshogs pas bstan te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa dang / bla ma'i man ngag dang / rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis rtogs par bya ba'i rim pas go bar bya dgos kyi/ gzhan du ma/khas par rlom pa rnam sa mgo rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud kyi bstan don ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor kho na yin gyi rigs mthun spyi khyab tsam smros pa ma yin no/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba la/ gsang 'dus phyi ma las/ mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'grub sangs rgyas kyis/ /dngos grub mchog ces bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub chung phywa 'dod pa'i lus kyi rigs 'dzin 'bring po/ gzugs kyi rigs 'dzin chen po ste/ de rnams 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ste gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yan chad nas mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /thun mong 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ni bskyed rim gyi rang 'bras su zad pa ma yin/ rdzogs rim pas ma bsgrubs par yang zhor la 'grub —117—

ste/ sa myu ṭi las/ ral gri mig sman rkang byug dang / /ri lu sa 'og gnod sbyin mo/ /dbul chu las kyi rjes 'gro dang / /'jig rten gsum yod dngos grub 'gyur/ /'dod pa lnga dang ldan pa las/ /kun tu bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bsam mi khyab kyi gzhud las kyang / /kun mkhyen gnas kyi sbyor pa 'di/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mi rtog pa/ /kun tu bzang po zhes bya lha/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /sa 'og ral gri ril bu dang / khreng lham bum pa gnod sbyin mo/ /bcud dang mig sman bzang po yang / /rang nyid 'grub ste gzhan du min/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ni rdzogs rim kho nas 'grub pa las rdzogs rim gyi lam yin nges 'khrul med bden pa can rang btags pa tsam ma yin pa'i dngos rang ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na yin pas dngos grub gnyis ka'i sgrub thabs bla na med pa'o/ /zhi sogs las chen rnams ni dngos grub dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa tsam yin pas phra mo zhes grags pa de dag kyang zhor la 'grub pa yin la/ da lta mi nor dar ba tsam dang /zas gos than thun byung ba la dngos grub zer ba dang / the brang gi dngos grub/rgyal 'gong gi dngos grub zer ba sogs ni mi nag pa blun po'i kha skad tsam yin pas chos skad kyi gseb tu smra bar mi bya'o/ /chos 'di las te 'phral gyi 'dod don 'phran bu de kun yang 'bad med du 'byung mod/ de 'dra tsam smos rin yang mi chog go /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zhes pa ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di bsgoms te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'di —118—

—bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ de ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lam 'di bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa kho na yin zhes pa ste/de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang chub sems dpa' thog ma nas sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams la smos ma dgos/ re zhig mdo lam kho na la zhugs pa rnams kyang mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob kar sngags la mi 'jug pa'i thabs gtan nas med/ de lta bu'i sngags lam de yang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam tsam mam/rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam bskyed rim dang / las rab 'byams sogs kyis ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa mthar thug la brten nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub dgos pa la/ de 'dra ba'i rdzogs rim de ni sbyor ba yan lag drug pa kho na las gzhan du med pas/ sangs rgyas ma yin na phar zhog yin na yin tshad kyi lam dngos gzhi nyams len gyi gtso bo rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa 'di kho na yin pas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul du'ang grub mod/ rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas bshad na/ rgya skad du yo ga zhes bya ba dmigs pa'i yul la sems rtse gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir/mnyam bzhag ting nge 'dzin gyi ming la sbyor ba'am rnal 'byor zhes bya/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor de gang gi rgyud la yod pa'i skyes bu de la ni rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /de yang mu stegs la sogs pa 'jig rten pa dang / nyan rang dang / byang chub sems dpa' so so skye bo sogs mang du yod mod kyang / de dag rnal 'byor pa tsam yin gyi/ rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug ni ma yin pas/ rnal 'byor can —119—

gyi dbang phyug ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams yin te/ rnal 'byor can thams cad kyi rgyal po'am gtso bo'am/ 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de ltar yin pa las sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsgom bya yin tshul bshad zin/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas bshad na/ rgyal sras thu bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pas kyang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid bsgom par mdzad pa yin te/ 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta 'dod mdor bstan dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med 'od dang /phyag na rdo rje'i bde mchog gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / rdo rje snying po'i dgyes rdor gyi 'grel pa rnams su lam 'di nyid kho na rgyas shing gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi dgongs don de ltar du grub pas/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi dgongs don du grub ste/ de rnams dgongs pa gcig cing lam bgrod pa gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang grub thob kun gyi spyi mes/ sa ra ha yang lam 'di kho na bzhed de/ des mdzad pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu las/ chos sbyor ba yan lag drug pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i chos skad kyis dbu zhabs thams cad khyab bo/ /dpal o rgyan gyi gnas na grub thob gtso che shos rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis kyang / ye shes grub par lam ngan pa thams cad bkag ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid bstan to/ /slob dpon ār+ya de bas kyang khungs su lung 'dren pa'i dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra thog mas mdzad pa las kyang / yi ge dgod pa dang phyag rgya bzhi'i don —120—

gsungs pa rnams ni chos 'di dang don gcig cing / slob dpon grub thob rta mchog la sogs pa grub thob mang po'i dgongs 'dus/ slob dpon rtog rtse bas yi ger bkod pa phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab kyi gzhung don yang lam 'di kho nar gnas pa dang / gzhan yang grub thob rnams kyi do ha rdo rje'i glu mtha' yas pa zhig kyang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ cha shas cha shas ston pa kho na shas che ba yin zhing / der ma zad slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga dang / 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma las kyang / la la na ming 'dogs tha dad tsam ma gtogs lam 'di nyid bstan pa yin te/ lus dben ni sor bsam/ ngag dben ni srog rtsol/ sems dben ni 'dzin pa/ sgyu lus ni rjes dran/ 'od gsal ni tin nge 'dzin/ zung 'jug ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i rim pa lnga pa las kyang /don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid ston te/ de'i rim pa lnga ni/ bdag byin brlab pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / nor bu 'gengs pa dang / dza lan dha ra dang / bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ste lnga'o/ /de las sa bon med pa'i bdag byin brlab pa ni/sor bsam dang / sa bon dang bcas pa'i bdag byin brlab pa ni srog rtsol dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa ni 'dzin pa dang / nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa dang dza lan dha ra'i rim pa gnyis rjes dran dang / bsam mi khyab ni ting nge 'dzin 'bras bur bcas pa'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa pa'i rim pa bzhi pa las kyang / rgyud kyi rim pa sor bsam/ sngags kyi rim pa srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i phyed snga ma/ ye shes kyi rim pa 'dzin pa'i phyed phyi ma dang rjes dran/ gsang ba'i —121—

rim pa ni ting nge 'dzin 'bras bur bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin du slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pas mdzad pa'i shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid la sogs pa mang po zhig ni/ 'ga' zhig la rdo rje'i rnal 'byor cha tshang ba dang /'ga' las sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor tsam dang / kha cig las gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor tsam ston pa sogs/ mdor na grub thob ches che ba rnams kyi gsung ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na la gzhol zhing 'bab pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa dang dbyangs gcig pa yin no/ /'o na 'dus pa rim lnga'i man ngag mar 'gos gnyis las brgyud pa dang/ bde mchog rim bzhi rim lnga'i man ngag nā ro pa las brgyud pa sogs lag len du 'debs pa'i man ngag mang po zhig la dmigs pa 'di dang mi 'dra bar 'byung ba ci snyam na/ grub thob chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams kyi phugs kyi dgongs don yin par ma zad/ 'phral gyi tshig don yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i lam rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na bzhin ston pa yin mod kyang /lam 'di sgom mi nus pa dang / mi mos pa dang / re zhig 'di la dngos su 'jug pa'i skal ba med pa rnams la/ gzhung de dang de'i dgongs don rdzogs rim dngos de ma yin yang mos pa'i sgo nas lam du byed pa'i rtog bcas bskyed rim phra thig gi rnal 'byor la rdzogs rim gyi mtshan gsol nas bstan pa yin no/ /de la goms na rim gyis rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ba'i phyir shin tu 'brel chags pa yin mod kyang / rtog bcas kyi man ngag de dag rang rang gi gzhung rtsa ba de dag gi dgongs don bstan bya'i gtso bo ni ma yin par —122—

shes par bya'o/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus dang ldan pa'i gang zag cig ces pa'i don ni/ khams drug ni sa khams chu khams me khams rlung khams nam mkha'i khams ye shes kyi khams te drug go /'dir gzugs med khams zhes pa dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba yin zhing / gzugs ni yod de/ de'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi lus la khams drug gi cha shas tshang tsho ba tsam yin mod kyi shas cher spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas ye shes bzhag pa'i khams lnga po la/ gzugs med khams pa nam mkha'i khams kho na ste gcig ldan dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa la de'i steng du rlung khams te gnyis ldan dang / gzugs khams gzhan bsam gtan gsum pa gnyis pa dang po'i/ lha rnams snga ma'i steng du me khams bsnan pas gsum ldan dang / 'dod khams kyi lha rnams de'i yang steng du chu khams bsnan pas bzhi ldan dang / mi'i 'gro ba rnams de'i yang steng du sa khams bsnan pas khams lnga ldan yin la/ ye shes kyi khams ni kun la khyab pa yin yang /khams gzhan rnams phra ba na ye shes kyang phra la/ gzhan rnams rags pa na/ ye shes kyang rags par 'byung bas mi lus la khyab bya khams lnga stobs chen yod pa bzhin du/ khyab byed ye shes kyang stobs che ba'i phyir/ khams drug ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na 'dir nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ba/ nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /zhes pa lta bu'i nam mkha' dngos med la mi 'jog stong pa'i rdul zhes bya ba reg thogs kyi bya ba cher mi byed kyang rdul gyi khyad par yin zhing /dbang po'i spyod yul las 'das pa zhig go /mdo lugs las kyang / skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa zhes pa dang gnad gcig de ltar na skyes bu'i lus spyi khyab —123—

khams lnga ldan yin pa ltar rten thig le byang chub kyi sems kyang khams lnga ldan yin zhing / lnga po dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i brten pa sems kyi chos 'gyur bde bag chags dang bcas pa ni/ ye shes kyi khams yin la/ de ltar na 'byung ba rnams kyi nang nas rags shos sa khams yin pas/ de'i thig le dang de la brten pa'i 'gyur bde ye shes kyi khams kyang shin tu rags pa'i phyir/ lam sgom pa'i gnas skabs su/ sa khams rags pa/ de 'chang sla zhing / rags pa bcings pas phra ba yang rang shugs kyis 'ching bar 'gyur/ thog mar rags pa ma bcings na/ phra ba kho na 'ching ba'i thabs med/ des/ na tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bsgrub dgos/ de la zhu bde 'gyur med grub dgos/ de gnyis ka byang chub kyi sems 'ching ba la rags las pas/'ching ba'i skabs su rags rim nas 'ching dgos pa'i phyir/ khams drug ldan gyi lus la ye shes kyi sku mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig lus gcig la 'grub pa yod par gsungs kyi/ gzhan rnams la ma gsungs so/ /de yang mi srid pa ma yin mod kyang 'byung ba shin tu dkon no/ /tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khrid par byed pa zhes pa ni/ sngon gyi skye bar gsang sngags la zhugs pa'i las 'phro can tshe 'dir mchog thob pa lta bu ni/ skye ba brgyud nas mchog thob pa yin gyi/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas par mi 'gro la/ der ma zad tshe rabs snga mar mdo lugs la brten nas lam sna zin zhing / thar pa cha mthun rgyud la bskyed pa zhig tshe 'dir gsang sngags bsgoms pas grol ba thob kyang / thar pa'i lam rgyud la bskyed zin pa'i rjes su 'khor bar las nyon gyis skye ba gcig —124—

slar len dgos byung ba'i phyir tshe gcig la mchog grub pa smu/ yin zho /'o na ci snyam na/ skye ba snga mar bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba spyi dang khyad par can cher bskyed cing / smon lam khyad par can btab pa ni dgos te/ gzhan du na tshe 'dir sngags kyi theg pa la mi 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang tshe snga gru/ra tshogs lam chung ngu tsam yang rgyud la ma skyes pa gcig tshe 'di la sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas thar pa cha mthun gsar du bskyed de/ tshe gcig po de la 'chi ba'i srid pa ma byung ba'i snga rol nyid nas mchog 'grub pa'i don te/ rnam par smin pa'i lus 'di bor ba med par ma dag nga/'i lus spangs te ye shes kyi lus su gnas gyur pa de ni tshe gcig la mchog grub nga/'am/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa'am/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'am/ zung 'jug thob pa zhes bya ste/ 'di sangs rgyas chung ja'i gnas thob pa yin pas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes tha snyad thob/ de phyin chad las nyon gyi dbang gis skye 'chi ye med cing / ye shes kyi sku de yang rgyun chad pa med pa'i phyir/ rten de la brten nas mthar thug gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos sam mi slob pa'i zung 'jus/ mngon du byed rga /de lta na dang ngo/ra mi'i lus dang / phyis zung 'jug gi sku ste lus gnyis brgyud pa'i phyir tshe gcig lus gcig tu mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ spyir gong du smos pa ltar zung 'jug thob pa la yang sangs rgyas par 'jog pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub rab mtha' zhig thob pa la yang sangs rgyas par 'jog pa sogs rnam gzhag du ma zhig yod pas/ chos skad phyogs gcig la zhen du mi rung la/ 'on kyang 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas —125—

kyi dbang du byas na yang / dang po thar pa cha mthun bskyed pa nas/ phyis mtharwa thug gi gnas thob kyi bar du 'chi srid kyis bar ma chod pa'i phyir tshe gcig kho na yin pa dang / spyir lus la rnam smin gyi lus snga phyi gnyis su ma zad lus je bzang je bzang du 'gro ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma zhig brgyud yod kyang / rnam smin sha khrag gi lus rigs rgyun ma chad pa'i ngang nas gnas gyur pa yin gyi/ shul du lus pa'i tshul gyis bor ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang / rnam smin gyi lus gnyis pa gsar du blangs pa med pa'i phyir lus gcig kho nar brjod do/ /don dam par na ye shes kyi lus ni/ gnyug ma'i lus yin pa'i phyir/ rnam smin zad pa na de gsal bar mthong ba tsam yin gyi/ gsar du lus blangs pa kho na yang min zhing /ye shes kyi sku de ni lus rang yang min pas/ lus gcig dang du ma'i tha snyad 'jog pa'i gzhi yang ma yin no/ /gang dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon 'gyur ba thob kyang / mi gtsang ba'i lus gnas ma gyur par 'dod pa dang / sha khrag gi lus 'di ka ye shes kyi skur 'dod pa sogs ni/ gti mug gis kun nas bslangs shing rgyud 'grel chen po rnams las bkag mod kyang / dgag sgrub kyi spros pa 'dir mi 'chad do/ /nye lam myur 'a ma khyad par can zhes pa ni/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis skye bo rmongs pa rnams mgu bar bya ba'i phyir/ go ba tsam gyis grol/ thos pa tsam gyis grol zhes sogs zab zab mang po smra ba ni/ tshig gi shugs bskyed pa tsam kho nar zad la/ sems nam mkha' la yas pa dang / da ni thod pa mi 'gel lo zhes skye ba mi len pa tsam la sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du smra ba sogs ni/ blun gtam kho na yin pas mkhas pa'i dpyad gzhir yang mi —126—

rung mo sgyu/ /des na nyan rang gi lam khro nas sangs rgyas mi thob cing / phar phyin theg par bskal pa grangs meng gsum dang / rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la yang bskal pa brgyad dang gsum dang skye ba bcu drug sogs gsungs pa rnams ring 'a ma dang / tshe gcig la sangs rgyas 'a sdo/ba pa yang bla med kyi lam las kyang bskyed rim la 'chad rgyu ma yin pas/ rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na nye lam myur lam yi na no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gis sbas shing gsang ba'i don/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lor ma sbas par gsal bar bstan pa zhes pa ni/ de la rgyud sde so so'i rtsa rgyud ces pa la/ rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rtsa rgyud dang / rtsa rgyud bsdus rgyud gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rtsa rgyud gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgyas pa rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa dang / dgyes rdor 'bum phrag lnga nga/ dang /'khor lo bde mchog mngon brjod 'bum pa la sogs pa rtsa rgyud rgyas pa de rnams su rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ma sbas par rgyas shing gsal por bstan mod kyang / de dag sham+bha la sogs rdo rje'i gnas khyad par can dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'am/ lha klu mthu bo che rnams kyi gnas na bzhugs pa yin gyi/'dzam gling lho phyogs 'dir mi rnams la thun mong du spyod pa'i yul du ma gyur pas/ re zhig bor te bsdus rgyud kyi dbang du byas nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa stong bzhi brgya pa dang / /(gon ra lo bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang / dgyes —127—

rdor brtag pa gnyis pa sogs rgya gar dang bod la sogs pa 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi yul kun du dar ba/ bsdus rgyud 'di dag tu dbang bzhi pa'i don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di/ rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab cing sbas pa yin la/ dus 'khor la ni rtsa rgyud rgyas pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis par gsal la rgyas par bstan pa bzhin du/ dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud du yang ma sbas par sa sa la bar bstan pa'i phyir/ bsdus rgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'am/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba la/ phyag rgya chen po zhes brgyud gzhung rnams las kyang don du ma la bshad cing / rgya bod kyi lugs srol tha dad la/ rang blo'i lam las drangs pa'i 'dod tshul mang zhing / sgrub byed du 'dod pa'i smra ba'ang mang mod kyi/ gzhan rnams skabs kyi don ma yin pas/ 'dir ni theg pa bla na med pa'i lam gyi nang nas kyang / rdzogs rim gyi phyag chen de yin la/ de la'ang 'dod tshul mang po yod pa dag bshad kyi mi lang bas/ skabs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang sems 'grel skor gsum gyi dgongs pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa mtshan ma med pa'i rim pa las/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po sgom pa nyid lam gyi rkangs su byas te/ gzhan phyag rgya gsum ltar na las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis sam/ bzhi ltar na las dang chos dang dam tshig ste/ phyag rgya gsum gyi lam de rnams gang dang gang skabs su bab pa de dang der lam dngos gzhi'i bogs dbyung ba'i bogs 'don nam/ lam gyi sna 'khrid pa'i phyir du sbyor ba yin no/ /skabs 'dir phyag chen gyi rnam gzhag zhib mor go dgos kyang /—128—

gzhan la 'chad mi dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas bzhag go /yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi gzugs/ chos nyid don dam pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i sku rdo rje'i rnam cha mthong ba dang / gsung rdo rje nyams su myong bar byed pa dang / thugs rdo rje dang / ye shes rdo rjer rang nyid zhugs pa'i sgo nas gdod ma'i rdo rje bzhi po de/ sgrub pa pos mngon du byed pa'i thabs yin pas phyir/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya la/ de yang mngon sum lam byed yin gyi mos pa lam byed tsam ma yin rgo /dmigs bcas dang 'brel ba'i sngags kyi lam gzhan rnams kyang ye shes kyi sna 'dren par byed nga/ so gas spyir thabs mi zab pa ta ma yin zhing / theg pa 'og ma rnams las thabs kyi sgo nas shin tu zab par yang grub mod kyang / mngon sum lam byed rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la bltos na de dag mi zab ste/ dang por nyams myong skye ba yang shin tu bul ba dang /phyi nang gi spros pa la brten pa'i phyir dang / yun ring du goms kyang mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sbyor mi nus par/ slar yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la 'jug dgos pa sogs kyi phyir/ lam gzhan rnams mi zab la 'di ches zab par grub pas zab lam zhes bya'o /de la chos zab mo 'di nyid ston par byed pa/ la 'phags yul la rbe1gas par bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ces sam/ zhal gyi gdams pa zhes pa'am/ de kho na nyid spyin pa zhes bya la/ bla ma mchog bi/ zhal lung zhes kyang grags kyi/ 'khrid ces pa'i tha snyad med kyang bong yul 'dir 'khrid ces grags so /de yang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i brda chad yin zhing don dang yang shin tu mthun te/ thar pa'i lam du 'khring/ par byed pa'i —129—

thabs yin pas so/ /de yang don bzhi ste/ gang 'khrid na skabs su bab pa rdo rje slob ma'i sems rgyud 'khrid par byed/ gang du 'khrid par byed na sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid/ gang gis 'khrid par byed na bla ma dam pas 'khrid par byed de/ de yang rgyud rnams las bla ma'i mtshan nyid mtha' yas pa zhig bshad kyang / rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bskyed par gyur pa'i bdag rkyen ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnam pa kun tu dgos pa'i med mi rung yin/ mtshan nyid gzhan rnams tshogs na ni legs la/ ma tshang yang 'di nges par dgos so/ /de'i don yang /sangs rgyas kyi zhal zhes pas sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i sgo ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug gi lam 'di yin la/ de 'dra thugs la 'khrungs pas thugs rgyud la gnas shing / zhal la gnas pa ste chos zab mo 'di slob ma'i sems rgyud la 'god pa'i phyir/ chos ston pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de ltar na yan lag drug gi man ngag rnams la rang byan chud cing / slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i brtse ba khyad par can mnga' ba dang / lam 'di nyid bsgom pa'i nyams rtogs ma 'khrul pa gnyis 'dzoms pa'o/ /nyams rtogs kyang rab tu rim pa drug ka thob na smos ma dgos kyang / da lta rnyed par dka'/ 'bring du na thog mar dge ba'i rtogs pa mthar phyin/ bar dge'i rtogs pa rjes mthun pa mnga' ba zhig dgos/ chung ngu la yang sor sdud phyin ci ma log pa thob cing / bsam gto gyi nyams myong ci rigs pa mnga' na/ lam 'di'i rtsa ba tshugs pa yin pas de tsam phyis kyang rung ngo / /tshul —130—

ji ltar 'khrid pa ni/ yid ches gsum dang ldan pa'i lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'khrid pa yin te/ dpal dri med 'od las/sngags kyi theg pa 'di la yid ches pa rnam pa gsum bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ dang por re zhig rgyud la yid ches pa dang / de nas bla ma la yid ches pa dang / de nas bdag nyid la yid ches pa ste/ yid ches pa 'di gsum gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gzhan du na yid ches pa gsum med par lam gang bla mas slob ma la bstan pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu dwa ba por mi 'gyur te/ slob ma blun pa'i dad pa nyid kyi phyir/ kun rdzob kyi bden pas 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/yid ches gsum ldan gyi lam dang phrad na/ ska'/ ldan gyi gang zag gcig tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin/ de yang rgyud la yid ches tsam yod kyang / bla ma la yid ches med na ma 'ongs pa yun ring po lon pa'i 'og tu skye ba gzhan zhig la sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu tsam yin mod kyang / 'phral du nyams myong mi skye bas tshe 'di la mchog thob par mi nus so/ /rgyud la yid ches nga med na ni/ bla ma la yid tshes pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'ang mi 'byung la/ slob dpon de la yid ches 'dra rung ba 'phral gyi myong bas grub pa than thun yod du chug kyang / yang dag pa'i lam la yid ches pa'i rtags ma yin te/ las tshogs than thun dang rdzogs rim ltar snang gi nyam sa than thun tsam skye srid kyang yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /de la yid —131—

ches0gsum dang bral ba kha cig ni/ blun po rang gtso mkhan gyi zog chos dang /rtog ge ba mkhas 'dod can gyi hre se btags tsam yin pas/ dgos pa thams cad kyis stongs la/ kha cig ni de bas kyang thu ste nag phyogs kyi 'dre gdon 'ga' zhig gis byas pas/ 'phral gyi byin rlabs ltar snang gis mgo bskor te/bsod nam sa dman pa dag de la yid ches skye na/ tshe 'dir bkra mi shis shing /phyi ma ngan song du 'khrid/ gzhan kha cig ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnam dag yin du chug kyang / bar skabs su byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa chad pas/ da lta nyams myong 'phral du skyed mi nus te/ brgyud pa gshun nas med na/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa dmyal ba'i rgyur grags pa dang / tshig bshad dang lag len khrigs bkod cam gyi dbang chog la rgyun yod du chug kyang / nyams len gyi rgyu myo/ chad cing byin rlabs ya pa ba rnams ni gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ yang kha cig spyir chos rnam dag yin zhing byin rlabs kyang ma chad mod kyi/ bskyed rim dngos sam/ phra thig la rdzogs rim du ming du btags pa dang / stong rkyang bsgom pa la rdzo gas rim gyi ming btags pa rnams kyang 'phral du yid ches kyi rtags med cing // dbang po rnon pos bsgoms kyang tshe 'dir mchog mi thob ste/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de dag gi nang na 'jig rten pa'i nga/ngos grub thob pa cam ni srid do/ /yid ches gsum dang ldan par gyur na ni/lam yongs su dag par 'gyur ro zhes sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam cha chang la ma nor ba 'chi ya myo pa'i don no/ /de las rgyud la yid ches pa ni/ chos de sangs rgyas kyis rgyud snyelas gsal bar gsungs pa zhig dgos pa yin na/ rdo rje'i rnal —132—

'byor 'di ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las tshang zhing gsal bar gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa rgyud las/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang / /bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bsam gtan 'dzin pa ting 'dzin te 'bras bu'i yan lag gsum gsal bar gsungs pas/ rgyu'i yan lag gsum shugs la go ba dang / dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud las/ so so'i mtshan nyid brda thabs kyis gsungs nas/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byore pas/ /zhes sogs sbyor drug yin par gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las kyang / so sor sdud dang de bzhin du/ /bsam gtan srog rtsol 'dzin pa dang / rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid rnam drug go /zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang rgyud kyi rgyal po phal cher las/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ci rigs par gsungs pa kho na yin zhing / khyad par du dpa' dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las shin tu rgyas shing gsal ba mtha' gcod dang bcas nga/sa yang nas yang du bstan zhing / rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi snying po 'jam dpal mchan brjod sogs kyang lam 'di kho na ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum gyis kyang rgyas par bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bla ma yid ches pa ni/ brgyud pa'i thugs sangs rgyas nyid nas brtsams te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ byin rlabs ma nyams shing nyams myong rgyun ma chad pa zhig la zer te/ tshig rkyang dang / dam nyams dang / 'dres khyer gyi lhad ma zhugs pa cig dgos so/ /de yang dngos —133—

sam brgyud pa'i bla ma zhig la/ bdud kyi bar chad zhugs pa'am 'dres khyer na/de las brgyud pa'i chos de bsgom pa kun la'ang bar chad tshan che ba re nges par 'ong ba yin/ bla ma'i ming can brgyud pa la dam sel yod pa zhig byung na/ de nas brgyud pa'i chos bsgoms kyang yon tan mi skye/ nyon mongs ldang / 'brel ba can thams cad la bkra mi shis so/ /de dag ma yin yang tshig brgyud rkyang pa la shor na/ de zhus nas bsgoms kyang nyams myong skye dus med/ bsgom ma bsgom med pa 'dra ba 'ong / rdzun chung na bla ma de na re/ dpe cha 'di'i nang na ni de tsug gda'/ nga la ni yod ma myong ngo zer/ 'ga' zhig rdzun po che yin na/ slob ma bslu ba'i phyir/ nyams myong 'dra yod skad byed pa'ang 'ong / 'ga' zhig gnas skabs kyi man ngag lag len phran bu la'ang rdugs te 'di bya 'di byed med pa'i rigs kyang 'ong bas/ de dag ni bla ma la yid ches pa'i mi mthun phyogs yin/de la chos 'di ni da lta'i bar du byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad/ gdams ngag gi lag len ma nub/ nyams myong gi yon tan skye bzhin pa yin te/ da lta'i bar gyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams la'ang / sor sdud kyi nyams myong phyin ci ma log pa dngos dang / srog rtsol dang rjes dran rjes mthun pa thugs la 'khrungs pa mang po dngos su yod/ rgyu'i yan lag gsum gyi lag len dang nyams myong ma nor bar yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i yan lag gsum da lta dngos su ma thob kyang / phyis kyi rten 'bre' bslu med du 'grig pa yin no/ /de lta na chos 'di ni 'phags pa'i yul du nyi zla ltar grags pa'i stobs kyis bod yul 'dir yang lo tsā ba chen po du mas spyan drangs te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud rtsa 'grel la/ lo paṇa —134—

sdeb pa'i 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu drug ni nges par yod la/ shong 'gyur sogs bod yul nyid du 'gyur bcos byas pa'ang mang du yod pas/ spyir 'gyur gyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam yod par grags na/ de thams cad la yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag re yod dgos shing / de dag la ma gtogs pa'i lo paṇa gzhan 'ga' zhig dus 'khor gyi dbang dang rgyud bshad ma mdzad kyang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag ma nor bar yod pa'ang mang du byung bas/ spyir ni sbyor drug gi man ngag la rnam grangs shin tu mang ba zhig byung na'ang / rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chos rje kun spangs chen po zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus kyi zhal snga nas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag bka' yod cing lhad med pa rigs mi 'dra ba bcu bdun gsan zhing / lam gyi ngo bo la khyad med kyang gdams pa so so'i che bar dgongs te/ re re bzhin nyams khrid du nyams su bzhes te gdams ngag dang mthun pa'i nyams myong sku nyams su bstar par mdzad do/ /de la sbyor drug lugs srol bcu bdun ni/ lo tsā ba wo po gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi sbyor drug gi man ngag sbyor drug gi sgos kyi rgyud chung 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / lo tsā ba rma dge ba'i blo gros kyi lugs kyi spyor drug dang / khrom lo tsā ba pad+ma 'od zer gyi spyor drug dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas bla ma nag po mngon shes can la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang / kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mgon po nas brgyud pa'i sbyor drug la 'bro lugs su grags pa'i sbyor drug dang / rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang / tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor 'phreng gi lugs/ se lo dang gnyos ston 'od —135—

ma nas brgyud pa 'di la tsa mi lugs rang du grags pa dang / ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i a mo gha badz+ra la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang / tsa mi nas brgyud pa yin yang sbyor 'phreng lugs dang mi gcig pa dpal chen rga lo nas brgyud pa lugs gsum ste/ rga los dus 'khor rang lugs kyi sbyor drug zhang 'tshal ba sogs la gnang ba dang / ma rgyud kyai'i rdo rje'i sbyor drug bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba dang / pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyor drug dge bshes skyu ra a skyabs la gnang ba dang gsum mo/ rga los tsa mi la gsan pa yin yang / sbyor 'phreng gi lugs dang rga lo lugs gnyis gdams ngag ston tshul mi 'dra ba cher yod pas lugs so sor bgrong ngo / kha che paṇa chen shākya shis dpyal lo chos bzang la gnang ba/ dgyes rdor nā ro 'grel chen gyi man ngag tu mdzad/ dpyal pas nā ro pa'i sgrom lder grags pa'i yi ge yang yod pa dang / paṇa chen gyis chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig drug gis khyad par du byas pa ste/kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa lugs gnyis so/ /grub thob dpe med 'tsho'i lugs kyi sbyor drug slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi ta la paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra sa gsan pa bi bhu ti'i ring brgyud du grags pa dang / phyis bal yul gyi sba bi ha rar grub thob shā bā ri'i zhal mngon sum du bstan dus gnang ba'i sbyor drug nye brgyud de bi bhu ti'i lugs gnyis so/ /chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bla ma bal po'i paṇa chen nyi dbang srung ba dang / 'phags yul gyi skyes mchog ra hu la shrī bha dra la gsan pa'i man ngag kyang yod la/ man lung gu rur grags pa grub chen pu byu shi'am/ rgya gar gyi yul du grub chen dī pa ka rar grags pa 'chi med rdo rje'i sku —136—

brnyes te da lta ri bo po ta la na bzhugs pa des/ dang por 'bro lugs gtso bor gyur pa rwa 'bro gnyis 'dus kyi man ngag bsgom par mdzad pa yin yang / phyis grub pa brnyes pas brgyud pa gzhan la ma ltos mod/ gang ltar yang des mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod sbyor drug ste/ de ltar na lugs srol bcu bdun no/ /sdom ni/gyi jo rma khrom jo bo dang / /'phro rwa tsa mi rdo rje grags/ /rga lo'i gsum dang kha che'i gnyis/ /bi bhu ti gnyis chag man lungs/ /zhes so/ /paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i lugs kyi nye brgyud la/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ lho pa gzhon tshul/ nyeg po chos ldan te dngos slob gsum la rnal 'byor seṅge 'bum gyis zhus/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsan/ yang bi bhu ti'i dngos slob dpyal ston pad+ma can la/kun mkhyen chos sku bas gsan/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsan pa'am/dpyal pad+mo can dngos la'ang gsan no/ /bu ston chen po'i gsung bgros gcig la/ ko brag pa nas brgyud pa ded pas chog pa gcig kyang yod par bshad/ don la'ang yod par 'dug da lta yongs su grags pa bi bhu ti dngos slob bzhi'i lugs gsan par byed/ 'di rnams la'ang nang sel mi 'dra ba phran tshegs yod pas/ lugs tha dad du byas na sbyor drug mi 'dra ba lugs nyi shur 'gro/ skabs 'dir brgyud pa tha dad pa'i rnam thar mtha' dag ni 'chad pa dang 'bri bar dka'/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rags rim tsam bshad thub na legs te yi ge logs su yod/ brgyud pa gzhan rnams kyi rnam thar khrigs chags su mi dgos kyang / gtam rgyud rnam thar ngo mtshar che ba chos 'di nyid dang 'brel ba 'chad rgyu yod na tho re long nge ba bshad par bya'o/ /bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i —137—

lugs kyi lo rgyus cung zad tsam brjod na/ 'di'i ring brgyud rtsa ba thug sa de grub thob dpe med 'tsho yin/ de yang grub thob dpe med 'tsho de rten dge slong /rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyang mkhyen/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyang yi dam du mdzad pa zhig yin/ 'khrungs yul ma ga dha pa/ rigs rje rigs/ sde pa mang pos bkur ba yin no zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung / gang ltar na'ang khong gi rgya gar shar phyogs yul li khar shing 'phel/ kha sarba ṇa rang byung gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du yang dag pa'i gnas lugs bsgoms shing / 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgrubs kyang rtag mtshan cung zad kyang ma byung bas thugs mug ste/nam phyed tsam na mnal du cung zad song / der kha sarba ṇa sa lung bstan pa/ bu bi kra ma pu rir song zhig 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro gsung / de'i nang par rang gi slob ma legs pa'i bu dang lhan cig rim gyis chas te/ nam zhig bi kra ma pu rir phebs pa'i nyin mor sna tshogs pa'i zlos gar dang ltad mo du ma 'dug pa gzigs pas/ de'i rkyen gyis snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/nub mo 'khor gyi 'khyams shig tu bzhugs pas nam phyed tsam na rang gi lhag pa'i lha'am dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nyid/ a wa dha ti'i spyod pa can gyi cha byad du byon nas/ bu de kho na nyid 'di yin no zhes gsungs pa gsan pa tsam gyis skad cig de la nyams rtogs ni yan lag drug gi rim pa rdzogs/ gnas lugs kyi don gzigs/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i grub thob chen por gyur kyang /sems can gyi don du lo mang por 'gro don mdzad cing / mi lus kyi rnam pa de —138—

kas bzhugs/ g.yang sa dang / chu dang / me dang / dug dang / mtsho ni dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa gang gis kyang gnod pas mi tshugs/ rtsig pa dang ri la thogs pa med/ sku lus kyi bkod pa dang / gsung gi snang ba mang po cig car 'byung /stag dang / glang po che dang / kla kle'i dpung rengs par mdzad/ mthar sku lus ma spangs par 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra dang dus mtshungs yin/ des slob dpon dpa la 'dzin sde la bshad/ des 'od byed lha la bshad/ des rgyal po'i bla ma chos 'gyung zhi ba la bshad/ des nyi ma dpal ye shes la bshad/ de la paṇa chen rat+na rak+ṣi tas gsan/ de la bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra sa gsan te/ de thams cad kyang rig pa'i gsan lnga la mkhas shing / gsang sngags kyi rgyud thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud pa/mdzad pa chos las mi 'da' ba/ thun mong gi nus pa'i rtags ci rigs pa mnga' zhing / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs shar ba sha stag go /nye brgyud ni grub thob shā bā ris bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra la dngos su gnang ba yin te/ de la bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra ni rgya gar shar phyogs bha len+t+ra ra tshong dpon zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/ rten dge slong sde pa ni mang pos bkur ba/ bi kra ma shrī la sogs ma ga dha dang / o ṭi bi sha sogs su yang bslab sbyangs ci rigs pa mdzad/ gtso bor shar phyogs bha ga la'i yul na chos 'khor dza gad da la bya ba'i chos grwa bzang la rgya che ba yod pa nge/ra bslab sbyangs mdzad pas sde snod gsum dang / phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī rgya gar du lo gsum dang /bod yul du lo bcu gcig bsten/ sa sde lnga dang/ gsang sngags kyi chos shin tu —139—
