mang ba sogs mdo sngags kyi gsan pa mtha' yas pa mdzad/ kha che paṇa chen rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ drang srong srin po rir bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs/'jim bzo bi bhu ti rang gis mdzad/ rab gnas kha che paṇa chen la zhus/ de nas bal yul du byon te/ bcwa shrī sogs mkhas grub gzhan la'ang sngar ma gsan pa'i gzhung gdams pa ci rigs pa gsan/ khyad par paṇa chen rat+na rak+ṣi ta la dus 'khor bde mchog sogs mang ngo/ zhig mkhas nyan du mdzad/ lhag par dus 'khor gyi rgyud bshad la nan tan chen po mjad cing / ches mkhas pa'i paṇa chen du gyur/ sbyor drug gi nyams khrid bskyar ma la rtsol ba chen po dang ngo sprod mdzad pas/ rtsa rlud dbang du 'dus/ nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/phyis s+thaX bhi ha ra'i mkhan por phebs/ chos kyi sgo rnam grangs mang po gsungs/'phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma sogs la'ang rkang tshugs kyi grwa btsugs shing / lhag par dus 'khor 'a bshad sgrub gnyis ka rtsal 'don du mdzad/ yi dam 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / rdo rje phag mo snga mo nas zhal gzigs/ phyis 'khor lo sdom pa dang dus 'khor yang gzigs/ bde mchog gi dbang mdzad pas/ ye shes dbab pa'i dus bal po kirti shrī bya ba zhig dang / rgya gar tha ru ba'i btsun pa ma no ra ta bya ba skal ldan gnyis la nam mkha'i ye shes phebs te/ dbang gral nas mi snang bar gar song cha med du yal/de sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas du ma mnga'/ yang bod du phebs te 'gro don cher byung / mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang po la rang 'gyur yang mdzad/ yang bal yul du byon te/ dgung lo'ang mang rab song skabs/ rnal 'byor ba gzhon nu —140—

snyan la rwa dung bcug pa gcig byung nas/ sna len cung zad cig mdzad nas grang khang zhig tu bskyal/ der sgra slob pa'i paṇa chung zhig gis bltas pas/ rlung mi rgyu ba dang / lus kyi mdog dbyibs sna tshogs su 'gyur ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags 'ga' re 'dug nas/ bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus pas paṇ+ḍi tas kyang de spyan drangs te yid kyi dri ba byas tshad la thogs med du lan shar shar byung / nyid su yin zhus pas/ grub thob shā bā ri pa yin gsungs/ mchog tu dgyes shing gus nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas sbyor drug gsungs/ yi ger bkod pa da lta'i gzhung chung 'di yin/ spyir zab mo'i gdams pa mtha' yas pas tshims par mdzad cing rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam dngos su bzhugs par yang grags/ de nas gang du bzhud zhus pas/ 'di nas o rgyan du 'gro/skal ldan 'ga'i don byed/ de nas dpal gyi ri la ka 'gro gsung ste mi snang bar gyur/ der slob dpon bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra ni byin sas kyi stobs kyis nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa skad cig la brnyes/ 'dzin pa'i yon tan mthar thug pa'i rtags thob/ mi ring ba zhig na thugs dgongs la bod na skal ldan mang po yang yod/nye brgyud kyi chos zab mo 'di dar na ci ma wo dgongs/ dus de tsa na bod sgom la grub thob ko brag pa las bzang ba dang mtshan grags che ba med/ sngar nas slob ma'ang yin pas rdo sku mdzad brgyad brkos ma gcig ka ra'i glang po che gcig sogs bskur nas/ nga la chos zab mo khyad par can gsar pa yod pas nyan par shog gsung pa'i 'phrin btang / der ko brag pas bdag gcig pu der yongs kyang sems can la phan thogs che rgyu ma mchis/ bla ma nyid bod du phebs —141—

na skal ldan dpag tu med pa'i 'gro don yong bas/ bod du cis kyang phebs par zhu zhes spyan 'dren btang bas zhu ba de la paṇa chen thugs dgyes te/ kyi rong tshun chad la phebs bsu'i mthun rkyen mang po dang bcas phebs/ 'di skabs kyang bod du lo gsum song / drang srong srin po rir yang phebs/ ding ri gla 'khor du lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/ spyir chos zhu ba shin tu mang / sgos su sbyor drug zhu ba mang zhing / nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa mang du byung / nye brgyud la phyis brgyud pa zin zhing 'gro don can gyi slob ma dgu byung bar grags/ de skabs sgom chen mtshan grags che ba rgod tshang bas kyang 'di'i zhabs la gtugs pa yin te/ khong rang gi bka' 'bum du bltas pas gsal/ bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gzhus chung bi bhu ti la zhus/ gzhud chung de dag la khong bas mchan bu dang sa dpyad kyang mdzad gda'/ rnam thar na bgros mi 'dug ste slob ma tshos gsungs pa yin las che/ de nas paṇa chen bal por bzhud de/ de rjes kyang lo mang rab song ba na mi snang ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa la rtsod pa med/ 'dzin pa mthar phyin nas yun ring lon pas zung 'jug brnyes pa yin te mchi/ sku gdung ma byung / gang ltar yang slob dpon de yul shin tu gnyan pa zhig tu 'dugasngon rong pa sher seng dang rdo rje rgyal mawo pa sogs kyis kyang zhal smod mang po mdzad de/ nang gi snye ma'i 'gyur de ma bde ba zhig 'dug pas 'khrul gzhi byung nas don ma dgongs par ma zad/ phyis byung gi sa skya bar 'dod pa rnams brnyes thabs dpa skur 'debs byed de/ lung 'brogs langs pa kho nar zad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan kha che paṇa chen sa skyar phebs dus paṇa chung gzhan rnams kyis rje —142—

btsun grags pa la phyag phul/ bi bhu tis ma phul/ rje sa paṇa gyis de'i sngon du sa sgru shrī la sgra dang / da na shrī la la tshad ma gsan/ de dus paṇa chung gzhan rnams la'ang chos 'brel re tsam zhus/ rdzong pa bzang po mdzad pa la/ bi bhu ti de dus nas paṇa chung dgu'i nang nas mkhas shos yin/ de dus paṇa chen rang du ka yod kyang / chos kyang ma gsan/ rdzong pa yang ma mdzad skad/ bi bhu ti ni de sngon nas 'bri khung pa dang 'brel chags yod/ lan bar pa phebs skabs kyang 'bri khung gling du 'phrin las cher byung / de rjes srin po ri ba'i dge bshes zhig yin nam yang zer/ 'bri khung ba'i phyogs 'dzin zhig yin nam yang zer te/ rje btsun chen po'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi grub mtha' la dgag pa yod pa'i sdom gsum 'od 'phreng zer ba'i gzhung chung de brtsams nas/ bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra sa mdzad do zhes kha 'phangs byas 'dug grub mtha' bi bhu ta'i bzhed pa ni yin yod par yang gda'/ phyis kyi sa skya ba rnams bod rtsom dang rgya rtsom gyi nyams ni med/ dgag pa de mthong bas snying na ba yin te/ 'od 'phreng gi gzhung de bod rtsom sang sang sngon rtags can yin pas/ bi bhu tis ma mdzad par nges/ khong la tshig pa de tsam za mi dgos/ dper na rgyud brdzus ma gcig gi nang na/ lta spyod log pa 'dug kyang / de rdo rje 'chang la khag med pa dang 'dra/ lar sdom gsum 'od 'phreng gi lugs de la'ang lung rig gis gnod byed yod na khyogs shog rje btsun grags rgyal la phyag ma phul ba dang / dgag pa byas pa tsam la snying 'kham pa ni gu dog tsam yin gyi/ mkhas pa'i bya ba ma yin no/ /de na mkhas pa yin du re na mkhas pa la 'os pa zhig byas na dga' 'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa tha dad pa du —143—

ma'i nang nas/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du rtsa ba'i rkang ni 'gro lugs kyi man ngag la gzhung srong bar mdzad de/ gzhan thams cad las man ngag rgyas pa'i phyir dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang rtags mngon gyur gyi grub brnyes 'ba' zhig yin pas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs 'gran zla med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i 'og nas bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i nye brgyud la gtso bor mdzad de/ gdams pa zab cing bka' gsar ma nyid kyi phyir byin rlabs kyi bka' babs kyang che ba yin pas thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu 'phra bkod pa'i tshul ston par mdzad do/ /de las gzhan brgyud pa so rbo'i man ngag thams cad kyang / dpal jo nang pa'i lugs 'di la 'dus te/ nyams len gyi spyi khog ni thams cad 'dra bas zlos pa'i tshul gyis ston mi dgos la/ srog rtsol sogs kyi skabs su mi 'dra ba'i khyad par zab khyad yod tshad rnam grangs su bkod nas 'dus pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar na rgyud dang bla ma la yid ches zhes bya ste/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkral/ grub thob rnams kyis bsgoms/ pa sdi ta rnams kyis bshad/lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur/ tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bu thams cad kyis rtsis su mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa'i mkhas sgrub dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams kyis nyan bshad sgom sgrub mdzad pa'i the tshom dang rtsod pa'i gzhi thams cad dang bral/ srid pa gsum du nyi zla ltar grags pa'i chos yin/mkhas pas ma bcos/ blun pos ma bslad/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa drang thal le ba/ nyams dang / rmi lam dang / zhal gzigs ma dang /—144—

gter ma dang / lung bstan ma yin zer nas khungs med rdzab rdzub rab rib la skyabs 'tshol mi dgos pa/ legs legs bsdus pa ma yin pa/ blo bzo'i ris gcod ma byas pa/ sgom chen 'ga' zhig gis 'tsho ba'i don du brtsams pa dang /bla dpon 'ga' zhig gis rang gi 'khor dang yon bdag mgo rmongs pa'i ched du byas pa'i gyabs skor dang rdzus chos dang / log chos kyi bsre bslad ye ma zhugs pa/ rnam dag legs pa'i lam 'di lta bu la 'ju ga pa skal ba bzang ba yin no/ /bdag nyid la yid ches pa zhes pa ni/ chos de rang gis nyams su blangs pas bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i nyams myong skyes tsa na/ chos de slob ma rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyis nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas chos la yid ches tshad ma rnyed pa ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /nyi ma gcig tu yongs su brtag /gal te rtags ni ma byung na/ /de tshe nga yi rdzun tshig yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / dgyes pa rdo rje las kyang bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /lha yin gzugs su sems pa yis/ /rgyun mi chad par nyin mtshan gcig /bsgom pa yongs su brtag par gyis/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /'khor bar thabs gzhan yon ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pas nyin mo gcig dang mtshan mo gcig goms par byas na/ dus de nyid du lam rtags sngon ma rnams 'char thub pa zhig dgos te/ nyi ma shar na dus de nyid du 'od 'byung dgos pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du na mi rtogs pa dpa/ gtum mo bsgom pa sogs zla drug gam lo'am lo gsum sogs yun ring du goms pa las phyis rtags rnams 'gyung ba dang / de —145—

ltar 'byung ngo zhes bla mas lung ston yang / bdag nyid la yid ches pa rnam dag ma yin zhing / 'thad pa'ang ma yin te/ nyin zhag dang po bsgom pa de ka yang dag pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa yin na/ de nyid du de'i rtags 'byung ba 'thad la/ de ni de kho na nyid bsgom ma yin na/ de dag dmigs rnam la khyad med pas/ phyis bsgom pa rnams kyang yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur la/ de yang 'dod na khyed kyi chos de dngos gnas la de bzhin bden mod/ phyin ci log gi lam yun ring goms pa las/ yang dag pa'i rtags 'byung ba yang mi rigs shing yang rtags de yang log pa'i rtags yin na ni/ phyin ci log kho na yun ring du goms pa la rtsol pa byed pa'i bla ma dang / slob ma de dag ni ngo mtshar can brjod pa las 'das pa zhig go /yang nyin zhag dang po nas bsgoms pa de rnam dag yin yang de'i rtags ni phyis yun ring po nas ཿnga ngo zhe na/ nyi ma de ring shar ba yi/ /'od zer nang par 'byung ba mtshar/ /zhes pa dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bas na rtsa bzang na thun thun mtshams gcig /'bring la nyin mtshan gang drang gcig thams mas kyang nyid zhag phrugs gcig bsgoms pas rtags snang 'char bar the tshom med pa'i lam ni chos 'di kho na yin no/ /'o na da lta 'khrid btab pa rnams la zhag 'ga' shas nas rtags snang 'byung ba mang du mthong ba dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ las dang po pas thun bzhir bsgoms na/ res 'ga' dmigs pa la sems gnas kyang phal cher mi gnas pas gang dmigs pa la sems brtad pa snga phyir byung ba rnams bsdoms pas nyin zhag gcig gi tshad du sleb pa na/ nges par rtags snang 'char zhing / rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom cung zad tsam rtsol med rang —146—

babs su 'byung ste/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i cha shas yin no/ /des na dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i rgyun ma chad pa zhag gcig thub dgos pa gtan nas min yang / thun mtshams spyod lam dang sems yengs pa'i gus te sgom byas pa la mi the bas/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor zhag gcig bsgom pa la rtags med pa mi srid par gsungs pa dang / rnam g.yeng dang bsres kyin bsgoms pas/ zhag gnyis gsum du rtags ma byung ba la 'gal ba sdeb rgyu ga la yod/ spyir deng sang gi mis kyang chos 'di'i sgom la zhugs pa'i nyi ma dang po nyid nas rtags snang dang rdo rje 'bebs pa thob pa mang du 'gyung ba mngon sum du grub pa 'dir snang zhing / zhag shas bsgoms pas mi 'byung ba ni mi srid do/ /de la ma mtha' yang zhag gcig gi mtha' 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni nyin zhag gcig po de'am zhag snga phyi sna tshogs pa bsdoms pa yin yang rung ste/ zhag gcig gi tshad du longs pa na dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis gnad du bsnun par song ba'i rten 'brel las the tshom med pa yin la/ dbang po rno ba la ni dbugs sum brgya drug cu tsam la yang 'byung ba la sogs pa nges pa med do/ /des na chu tshod gcig dang / dus sbyor gcig dang / dus sbyor gnyis nas bcu gnyis kyi bar du ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar shes dgos te/stong rkyang tsam bsgom pa la ni rtags snang mi 'byung ba shas che la/ byung yang rtsis su mi byed do/ /phra thig sogs bsgoms pas du sogs 'char ba ni bem po'i rlung rags pa'i dbu mar thim pa'i nyams tsam yin/ de ni rlung gi mdangs sam rtsa'i mdangs zhes bya/ spyir lam du 'gyur mod kyang 'khrul shes yin zhing rnam pa —147—

thams cad par 'char ba'ang ma yin no/ /chos 'di las byung pa'i rtags snang gi gtso bo rnams ni mi rtog pa'i stobs kyis ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le cung zad thim pas/ de ma thag ye shes kyi rtsa rlung thig le cung zad mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/chos nyid kyi mdangs yin la/ de'i phyir rnam pa phyogs re tsam ma yin par rnam pa mtha' yas par 'char ba yin no/ /des na lam 'bras dang chos drug sogs las 'chad pa'i rtags snang dang / sbyor drug pa la 'gyung ba'i stong gzugs gnyis/ du sogs su mtshungs pa'i 'dra chos tsam yod kyang ngo bo bzang ngan shin tu khyad che ste/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis na/ chos de dag tu stong gzugs kyi tha snyad mi mdzad la/ 'dir stong gzugs dang rdzogs rim gyi lha yin par 'jog pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang rtog bcas de dag tu du sogs 'char ba ni/ rtogs pa de shin tu goms pa las/ 'dod 'jigs mya ngan sogs dang mtshungs par rtog med gsal snang 'khrul pa can zhig skye la/ de la brten nas du sogs 'char te/ mdor na rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ ye shes kyi dbu ma la reg mi thub bo/ lugs 'di'i stong gzugs ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems kyis rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i phyir/ thog mar rags pa'i rtsa dbu ma la brten nas de ma thag tu ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma la reg par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ smom byed/ lam gyi ye shes dang / bsgom bya ye shes kyi rtsa gnyis kar mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mtshungs pa'i phyir des de la gnad du bsnun thub la/ rnam rtog sgoms pas ye shes kyi rtsa la gnad du bsnun mi thub ste/ bcos ma dang bcos min gyi khyad par shin tu che ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' la khu tshur bsnun mi —148—

nus pa bzhin no/ /mdor na rtog pa las byung ba'i rtags snang dang mi rtog pa las byung ba'i rtags snang mi 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /spyir 'di la mu bzhi yod de/ rtog bcas kyi sgom pa yin zhing rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang mi bsnun pa gnyis/ rtog med kyi sgom pa la'ang rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang mi bsnun pa ste bzhi'o/ /gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa lta bu gsang sngags nang pa'i phra thig gi rnal 'byor rnams ni/ rtog bcas yin zhing lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i mu yin la/ bod yul 'dir sems 'khrid du grags pa'i mi rtog pa rnams ni mi rtog pa yin yang lus la gnad du mi bsnun pa'i mu'o/ /dpyad sgom gyi stong nyid sgom pa dang / nges 'byung snying rje phal pa sogs rnam rtog kyang yin la rdo rje lus la gnad du mi bsnun pa'i mu'o/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom pa yang yin la/ rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i mu'o/ /de dag las bod yul 'dir grags pa'i phyag rdzogs zhi gcod la sogs pa phal che ba ni/ rdzogs rim yin par 'dod cing grags mod kyang / rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa med pa'i phyir dang / theg chen mdo lugs dang / nyan thos dang / kha cig 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin kun dang yang thun mong yin pa'i phyir rdzogs rim ma yin la/ yang kha cig rdzogs rim gyi skad dod ni dzin ma bcos pa dang / ma brtags pa la 'jug cing / pa ri ni dzin zhes pa yongs su grub pa la'ang 'jug pas/ sgra bshad de dag tshang ba'i phyir rdzogs rim yin no snyam na/ sgra bshad phyogs re tshang ba tsam gyis de dang de yin par mi 'gyur te/chu las skyes dang chu skyes bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar yin pa dang ha cang thal bar —149—

'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sher mdo dang / rgyud bla dang / zla ba sgron me'i mdo dang / rig tshogs kyi gzhung la sogs pa'i dngos bstan yin par khas len bzhin du/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim yang yin no zhes smra ba ni/ tshes 'gal bar smra ba yin mod kyi/ phyogs 'dzin gyi gdon gyis bslad pas rig pa rnal mar med pa de dag la smras kyang dgos pa mi snang bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /'od zer 'gro 'ong la dmigs pa sogs dang / rags pa'i khams tsam kho na la 'gro 'ong gi bya ba byed nus kyi las rgya ye rgya sogs 'di rnams kyang rdzogs rim dngos ma yin te rnam par rtog pa'i sgom pa yin pa'i phyir dang / kha cig lus ngag gi bya rtsol gtso bor ston pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'di dag rgyud gzhung tshad ldan nas rdzogs rim du bshad pa min nam zhe na/ 'di dag kyang man ngag gi gnad dang ldan na rdzogs rim gyi nye ba'i rgyu byed pa yod cing / rdzogs rim dang rnam pa 'dra ba nyid kyi phyir/ rdzogs rim gyi ming gis btags pa ste/ 'di dag gi rags pa'i rtsa dbu mar bem chos kyi rlung thim pa sogs dang / rdul chos kyi thig le 'ching ba tsam sogs yod pas/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa tsam yin mod/ ye shes kyi rtsa rlung thig le la reg par mi nus pa dang / gnas lugs sgom pa'ang ma yin pa'i phyir dang / /rnam par rtog pa can nyid kyi phyir rdzogs rim dngos ma yin te/bskyed rim dngos dang rdzogs rim btags pa ba yin zhes bya'o/ /de lta na yang gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos tsam ni yin te/ dbang bskur ba dang lha bsgom sngags bzlas la sogs pa bzhin no/ /mi rtog pa ma yin zhing —150—

—lu/sa la gnad du bsnun pa yang ma yin pa'i mu rnams ni/ dngos su rdzogs rim ma yin par ma zad/ de dag rdzogs rim yin zhes smra mkhan yang cher med pa'i dpyad pa mi dgos mod/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na mu gsum po de dag thams cad kyang zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sbyang ba'i thabs dang / sngon 'gror ni 'gyur du rung ba sha stag yin pas/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la brtan pa cung zad thob na/ de dag la 'dis rgyas btab ste bsgoms na/ lam 'di'i bogs 'don du 'gro ba dang / gser 'gyur rtsis lcags gser du 'gyur ba ltar de dag kyang rdzogs rim du gnas 'gyur ba'i skabs ni yod do/ /de lta bas na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas lugs bsgom pa yang yin/ sgom pa de kho nas rdo rje lus la phyin ci ma log par gnad du bsnun pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa zhig byung na/ de ni rdzogs rim dngos yin te/ de yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na las gzhan la med do/ /yang 'di snyam du da lta phyag chen du grags pa 'di lta bu mi rtog pa'i gnas lugs bsgom pa yin la/ de'i steng du gtum mo dang las rgya sogs kyis rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun na bde stong phyag chen du 'gyur ba dang / mi rtog pa dang lus la gnad du bsnun pa gnyis kar tshang bas/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang khyad med par 'gyur snyam na/ nyams myong rnam pa 'dra rung yod du chug kyang / de ni rgyu tha dad gnyis 'dus pa'i bcos ma yin pas/ ye shes kyi rtsa sogs la gnad du bsnun mi nus te/ rtsi brgya mang du sdom na yang / khang pa'i gdung ma bzod par dka'/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas go /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'dir ni thabs gzhan gyis byas pa ma —151—

yin par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig po des rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun par byed pa yin pa'i phyir shin tu khyad che ste skar ma'i tshogs pa dang nyi ma bzhin no//'dir gang la gnad du bsnun rgyu'i rdo rje lus ni steng 'og rtsa drug dang / rtsa 'khor lo drug dang / de dag gi rlung dang thig le sogs yin gyi/ lus tsam po la mi 'jog go /de ltar na lam thams cad las ches khyad par du gyur pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ nyams myong la zhag dus thebs pa/ grub thob la zla dus thebs pa/ sangs rgyas la lo dus thebs pa'i chos gzhan gang dang yang mi mnyam pa yin no/ /'di dag la gong du bshad pa ltar go ba chags dgos la/ 'khrid 'debs pa'i skabs/ spros bshad dang mtha' gcod de dag 'chad mi 'chad skabs dang bstun 'tshal/ de yan chad ni 'khrid dmigs ma tshugs gong thog ma'i 'jug sgo'i skabs kyi gsung bgros yin te/ chos thun gsum bzhi lnga sogs ji ltar 'tsham pa re mdzad do/ / sngon 'gro thun mong ba'i dmigs pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces/ sbyor drug la bod snga rabs pa rnams kyi yig rnying rnams bsdus pa tsam dang / 'thor thabs su yod pa dang / man ngag gab pa'i phyir khrigs chags su bsgrigs pa tsam med/sngon shin tu bka' yang gnyan pa la/ chos rje kun spangs chen pos yun ring du dgongs pa brtad de/ yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba btab pa na/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka'i gnang ba byung ba la brten nas bka' rgya bkrol te 'khrid yig rgyas pa mdzad/ kun spangs chen po'i 'khrid yig 'di sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig khrigs chags ma kun gyi thog ma —152—

yin pa'i phyir dang / brgyud pa khungs ldan gyi sbyor drug phal che ba/ chos rje 'di las brgyud pa'ang yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi blos btags gtso bor byas pa'i yi ge rnams ma gtogs/ sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig phyi ma phal che ba yang / 'di la gzhi brten mdzad pa yin rgo /de yang ci lta bu zhe na/ mkhas mchog bu ston rin po che'i lugs kyang / dang por mkhan chen thar lo la bi bhu ti'i lugs gcig gsan/ rje rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dbang rgyud zhib mor gsan kyang / rwa ba'i sbyor drug la tshig 'khrid ma gtogs don 'khrid mi bzhugs pas/ sbyor drug mtha' rgyas rang de phyis 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho la gsan nga/ yin/ khong gis kun spangs chen po la sbyor drug gi nyams 'khrid dang / rgyud snying gi bshad pa tshar mang du gsan/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la yang gsan te/ bu lugs kyi spyor drug kyang gtso bor kun spangs chen po las brgyud pa yin zhing / khrid yig mdzad pa'ang / kun spangs chen po'i khrid yig la rtsom gdan mdzad par 'dug chos rje bla ma dam —pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas kyang / dang por kun spangs chen po'i dngos slob brag kha ba grags pa seṅge la gsan/ yang kun spangs chen po'i dngos slob sron pa kun rgyal de'i slob ma sron pa chos dpal bzang po dang / sron pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis ka la nyams 'khrid du gsan/ phyis bu ston rin po che la'ang gsan/ khrid yig rtsom par mdzad pa ni sron lugs gtso che bas/ kun spangs chen po'i bka' srol nyid yin rgo /yang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub tu grags pa ni/ kun spangs chen po dang dus mnyam du byung ba yin yang / sbung bkra o rgyan pa rin chen dpal ba rang gis zhal gzigs kyi —153—

chos yin gyi/ lo paṇa sdeb pa rgya gar nas bsgyur ba ma yin/ rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin gyi lugs ni dus phyis byung ba yin/ de min gzhan par skabs dang phyis sbyor drug gi man ngag byung ba thams cad/ kun spangs chen po 'di las ma brgyud pa med pa lta bu ste/ chos 'di'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gcig pu ba yin no/ /des na kun spangs chen po'i gsung la brten par 'dra yang / brgyud pa gzhan 'ga'i lugs kyis/ sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong gru/ yin pa gnyis su mi 'byed par/ sngon 'gro'i 'khrid thung gsum zhes mdor bsdus re mdzad pa'i lugs 'dug kyang / las dang po pa la sngon 'gros rgyud sbyong ba gal che bas/dpal jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro rgyas par mdzad pas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro rang la'ang dmigs skor lnga byed pa lags/ /skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa 'bogs pa la/ chos thun gcig song ba'i mtshams su/ skyabs 'gro'i go don bshad mi dgos na der zad/ dgos na ci rigs pa 'tsham zhing ran par bshad dgos te/ de yang phyogs mtshon na 'di ltar/ spyir skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba skyabs zhu ba la zer/ skyabs su song ba zhes 'das pa'i sgra byung na/ skyabs zhus grub pa'i don yin/ de yang rang la 'jigs skrag gang yang med cing rang dbang thob par yod na/ su la'ang skyabs 'tshol mi dgos pas/ gang skyabs 'tshol ba de ni 'jigs pa yod cing / de las skyob pa'i skyabs don du gnyer ba yin pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu 'jigs pas nyen pa yin/ de la 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis yod/ dang po la tshe 'di kho na'i phyir gyi —154—

skyabs 'gro dang / gto gyi skyabs 'gror rlom pa gnyis yod/ de'i dang po ni/'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' ra ba mchod rten dang / /ljon shing rnams la skyabs su 'gro/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing / /skyabs de la ni brten nas su/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ri rdzong la blo brtad 'cha' ba lta bu sems med la yang skyabs su 'gro/ ri dang lha rten sogs la gnas pa'i mi ma yin dang /gzhan yang lha phran nam yi dwags su gtogs pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad lha ma srin la sogs pe la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / rgyal po la sogs pa mi'i 'gro ba kha drag dbang po che la blo gtod pa rnams yin te/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur ba'i 'jig rten phal pa blun po rnams kyi bsam pa yin/ tshe 'di pa skyabs kho na ste mig rgyang shin tu thung ba yin/gnyis pa ni/ skyabs kyi yul khyab 'jug dang / drag po dang / ser skya dang / lha rgyal pa dam pa sogs 'jig rten gyi lha dang / 'jig rten gyi dge sbyong chen po rnams la dmigs nas/ de dag skyob pa rnam dag ma yin yang / skyob pa mthar thug yin snyam log par gzung ste/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis dang thar pa'i re ltos zhu ba ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa mu stegs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi skyabs 'gro yin/gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa la yang bsam spyor rgya chung ba theg dman nyan rang gnyis kyi skyabs 'gro dang / rgya che ba theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir theg chen yin/ de la yang thun mong ba mdo lugs —155—

dang / thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lugs zhes dbye ba cung zad tsam yod pa las/ 'dir sngags lugs ltar bya/ yang skyabs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa da/kon mchog gsum yin yang / bsam pa tshe 'di'am phyi ma 'khor ba'i bde ba thob 'dod las med na/ 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro las ma 'das mod/ yul mchog la dmigs pa'i phyir/ phugs kyi bag chags khyad par can 'jog cing /gnas skabs kyi phan yon yang gzhan rnams las ches lhag par che'o/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro rnams ni/ skyabs 'gro'i ming can cam las mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka yod do/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i skyabs 'gro zhes pa/ skyabs su 'gro lugs sam ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis ka yod kyang / skyabs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya ste/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid tshang ba thams cad yin/ de la dbye na/ nyan rang theg chen gsum yod kyang thams cad spyir dge ba 'ba' zhig yin zhing / sgos su dad kla dang tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa yin/ de la skyabs su 'gro pa'i yul gang yin la ni/ grub mtha' so so'i 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / de thams cad rigs pas dpyad na song tshod la 'di lta bu zhig las mi 'da' 'o zhes so so'i 'dod pa smra ba yin gyi/ dmigs pa bsgom pa dang lag len du 'debs pa la mi 'dra ba'i 'gal ba cher med cing / theg pa che chung gi dbang gis rgya che chung gi 'dor len cung zad tsam ni yod do/ / des na spyir thun mong du mdo sngags gnyis ka 'dra ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ji lta ba dang ji —156—

snyed pa mkhyen pa'i chos kyi sku yin la/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku skye 'gag dang bral ba de dang / nges pa lnga ldan gyi sku de dang / de nyid kyi gsung sgra skad thams cad pa ste/ gsum po de longs skus bsdus pa dang / bzo dang skye ba dang mchog gi sprul sku sogs sangs rgyas dngos kyi sprul pa thams cad sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa ste/ mdor na mos pa'i yul gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni sku gsum gyis bsdus nga/ thams cad yin la/ /chos dkon mchog ni lung dang rtogs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos gsung rab ming tshig yi ger snang ba dang / ngag tu brjod pa rnams yin la/ rtogs pa'i chos ni mthar thug gi zhi ba myang 'das chos dbyings de bzhin nyid dang / de nyid sgrib pas dag pa'i cha nas zhi ba myang 'das 'gog bden 'bras bu'i chos dang / gnas lugs de rtogs pa yang yin/'bras bu de mngon du byed pa'i skabs kyang yin pas lam gyi ye shes ni lam bden gyi chos zhes bya ste/ ngo bo byang chub kyi phyogs chos rnams yin la/ de yang 'phags rgyud kyi lam rnams lam bden dang chos dkon mchog yin par rtsod rnga/ med/ tshogs sbyor gyis bsdus pa rnams kyang phyogs mthun yin pas/ ji srid tshogs spyor gyi lam ma thob pa de srid du skyabs yul du byed dgos pas/ de ltar lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams so/ /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i phyir mi ldog pa rnams theg chen pa'i skyabs yul gyi dge 'dun dngos yin/ de dang rjes su mthun zhing / nyan rang 'phags pa las kyang bzang ba'i phyir tshogs sbyor gyi phyir mi ldog thob pa rnams kyang skyabs yul gyi khongs su bsdu la/ nyan rang 'phags pa rnams theg chen gyi —157—

skyabs yul du byed mi byed lugs gnyis yod pa don la mi 'gal te/ theg chen pa'i skyabs yul dngos ma yin pa dang / ji srid du 'phags pa de dag dang yon tan mnyam par ma gyur gyi bar du/ skyabs su 'os pa'i yang phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mdun du bzhug pa'i sangs rgyas zhes mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos dang dge 'dun la yang rigs 'gre pas/ mdun bzhag gi sangs rgyas ni sku gzugs dang mchod rten lta bu/ mdun bzhug gi chos ni bka'i glegs bam dang /sngags kyi yi ge'i gzugs sogs dang / mdun bzhag gi dge bdun ni so so skye bo'i dge 'dun tshul khrims dang ldan nges pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang chos yang dag par bsdud pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcu gsungs pa'i skabs na/mkhan po dang slob dpon sogs kyang rnam grangs pa'i sangs rgyas su bshad pa yod pas/ mdo lugs las kyang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi khongs su bla ma bsdu ba zhig bshad cing / sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar mos gus byed mod/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom pa rang ni min par bzhed do/ /yang sku gzugs glegs bam la sogs pa la ni gus pa byed dgos par grub mod kyang /sems med bem po'i bkod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ skyabs yul gyi khongs su mi bsdu'o snyam na/ 'dir rigs pas dpyad nas skyabs 'gro byed pa 'di kun/phugs kyi brtad so gang la skyabs zhug par 'gro zhes dpyad nas/ 'di las mi 'da' zhes grub mtha' rnam par 'jog pa'i skabs kyi skyabs yul yin min gyi go ba tsam ste/ de 'dra nyams len gyi skabs 'dir mi dgos shing / 'dir mos pa'i sgo nas dmigs yul du byed pa nyid gtso che bas/ mdun bzhag gi dkon —158—

mchol gsum dkon mchog gsum dngos yin par mos te skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyir/ bem chos dang so so skye bo la skyabs 'gro byas par mi 'gro'o/ /des na grub mtha'i dbya da pa kha thal nas dad pa dang mos gus la gnod pa shin tu mang la/ dmigs pa bsgom pa'i skabs su dpyad pa med par rgya bkyed nas dad pa mkhul che bar byed dgos go /de dag kyang ji srid snying po la mchis kyi bar du/zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bshad pa ni/de ltar smos pa'i skyabs gnas de gsum gyi thun mong gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni gtan gyi skyabs yul yin pa'i phyir/ de rang ni byang chub ma thob bar zhes pa'i ngos gzung yang med do/ /des na mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ni/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin te/ rgyud bla las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ zhes so/ /mthar thug gi chos dang mthar thug gi dge 'dun yang sangs rgyas nyid yin te/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes so/ /yang ji skad du/ mi zad pa'i skyabs/ rtag pa'i skyabs/ g.yung drung gi skyabs/ dam pa'i skyabs ni gcig nyid de/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so zhes 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs so/ /des na sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i skyabs yul rnams ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa rnams kyi skyabs su mi 'gyur bas/ gnas skabs pa'am re zhig pa'i skyabs yul yin rgo /sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ skyabs su song pa rnams ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi skyabs 'og dang /—159—

des grib mas bskyangs pa'i tshul tsam yin la/ nam sangs rgyas thob nga/ nas 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing / skyabs yul nyid la 'dun pa las ches lhag pa'i 'dres pa nyid du gyur nas/ nam/ du'ang so sor bye ba dang / phan tshun spong ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtag tu skyabs gnas ma spangs pas gtan gyi skyabs zhes bya'o/ / des na byang chub ma thob bar ngu zer ba 'di/ byang chub thob nas re ltos med ces blun po rnams kyi kha nas rgyu ba la yid brtan ci yang med do/ /re ltos te theg chen 'phags pa su la'ang med de/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa la re ba mi 'byung / rang stobs kyis sa lam rtsol med du bgrod pa la gzhan la ltos gzhag med pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas thob nas skyabs gzhan dor ba de'ang rang spangs la song ba yin gyi brnyas chos byas nas bor ba ga la yin/ mthar thug gi skyabs la bltos te nam mkha' ma zhig bar ram 'khor ba ma stongs bar ram/ gtan nas gtan du rtag par skyabs su 'gro'o zhes bya yi/ dus mtshams nges pa can gzung du med do/ /gzhan yang rgyas par na/ rgyan dang rgyud bla sogs las drangs te bshad na rung ngo / /thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyis/ spyi khyab kyi dkon mchog gsum dang / khyad par gyi yul bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la'ang skyabs su 'gro dgos pas/ skyabs 'dir skyabs 'gro drug skor du mdzad do/ /'o na dkon mchog gsum las gzhan pa'i skyabs mi 'thad do snyam na ma yin te/ yi dam lha tshogs ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi nang tshan yin/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi nang tshan yin/ 'jig rten pa la ni skyabs su mi 'gro/ bla ma ni —160—

—dkon mchog gsum ka'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gsum gyis chog pa la drug gi ci bya snyam na/ gsum du ma 'dus pa min yang / dgos pa khyad nga/ra can gzhan yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ gsang sngags 'dir dngos su bka' drin thob pa'i yul de'i byin rlabs 'jug dgos pa dang / bka' drin dran dgos pa'i phyir bla ma la logs su skyabs su 'gro ba dang / mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnams zhu ba'i yul thun mong ma yin pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ yi dam dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs dang / bar chad sel ba dang gnas skabs kyi 'dod don rnams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las 'tshol dgos pa'i phyir/ chos skyong srung ma ste de rnams la gal po che'i tshul gyis sgos su nan chags byed pas skyabs su 'gro ba yin rgo /skyabs 'gro bzhi skor byed pa rnams yi dam chos skyong rtsal du mi 'don pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gzhan 'dra/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo las/ slob dpon dag ni sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa gzhi dag la chos ni de yis bstan pa'o/ /dge 'dun gang zhis nge/ra gnas rab tu dga' ba'i thugs ldan sems can kun la rjes su brtse ba ste/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs/ des na sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang yi dam la skyabs gnas gzhan thams cad las rtsal 'don du byed pa nges par dgos shing / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams ni bka' drin dran pa dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'khor du smos pa tsam yin/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ni sgos su bsten —161—

zhing sgrub na 'dir yang gal che la/ gzhan dge 'dun la bsdus pas kyang chog pas mtha' gcig tu nges pa yang med do/ /spyir gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa sgom tshul la dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi nang du skyabs gnas thams cad bsdu ba dang / bla ma gcig pur bsdu ba sogs rnam grangs ma nges pa sna tshogs yod pas dmigs pa'i rim pa la nges pa med/ go babs sngar bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /don tshan gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgra dang gdon dang nad la sogs pa tshe 'di'i 'jigs pa byung gi dogs pa rnams kyang 'jigs pa de las skyob nus sam sems pa re la 'bad de skyabs 'tshol ba bzhin du/ rang cag rnams 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir tshe 'di phyi bar do thams cad du 'jigs pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa zhig ni 'dug 'jigs pa de rang stobs kyis zlog nus pa'i go skabs ni mi 'dug pas/ de las skyob pa'i skyabs zhig 'tshol dgos par byung / de yang 'jig rten 'di'i pha ma la sogs pa'i nye du dang / yar gyi dpon/ mar gyi g.yog thad kar rang dang mnyam pa'i grogs po sogs sus kyang skyob pa'i nus pa mi 'dug ji skad du/ bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bzhes kun gyis mtha' bskor kyang / /srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba ni/ /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul du de dag gis shi ba phan chad mthong thos tsam yang med na/ phan thogs ta ga la yod/tshe 'dir yang skyob nus pa tsam med/ phan las gnod che ba kho na yin/ der ma zad khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs pa lha dbang che bar grags pa rnams dang /—162—

'khor los bsnyur rgyal la sogs pa mi rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyis kyang / tshe 'di'i gnod pa cung zad las skyob nus pa srid mod/ mi 'khyobs pa yang ches mang zhing / las 'bras kyi blang dor bag tsam bstan nas/ skye ba re gnyis ngan song las skyob pa tsam res 'ga' yod pa ltar yang snang mod/ phal cher blang dor gyi gnas kyang log pas/ gnas skabs su yang ngan song las skyob mi thub/sgos su 'khor ba las 'dren pa'i nus pa nam yang med de/ de rnams nyid kyang 'khor ba las ma thar 'khor bar 'khyams/ nyon mongs kyis sems dkrugs pas rang dbang ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis 'di phyi bar do gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las skyob par nus/ dkon mchog gsum du ma gtogs pa sus kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob nus pa med pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos pa yin no/ /don tshan gsum pa ji ltar skyob pa'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la ston pa zhu ste/ blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pa ston mkhan zhu ba dang / chos la skyabs dngos te/ sangs rgyas kyis blang dor bstan pa de ka chos yin pas/ chos kyi nang nas 'byung ba bzhin du lag len la btab pas/ 'jigs pa kun las thar bde ba thams cad thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dge 'dun la zla grogs te/ rgyus med kyi 'a ma du 'gro ba la lam sna ba 'tshol ba lta bu yin/ dper na lam sna ba gar song la 'gro dgos pa ltar de rnams gang mdzad byed dgos pa'o/ /de ni 'phags pa rnams mngon sum du mjal ba'i dbang du byas pa yin mod kyang / 'phags pa rnams —163—

——— las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i man ngag dang lag len gyi rgyun yod pa'i so so skye bo'i dge 'dun rnam dag yod na de la yang dmigs brtad du rung ste/dus deng sang ni 'di gtso che la/ gsang sngags pa'i ni bla ma nyid ston pa dang /bla ma nyid 'a ma sna bar byed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas ni mkhyen brtse nus gsum mtha' ya sa pa mnga' ba'i phyir/ mkhyen pa'i skyabs su song ba'i sems can thams cad 'jigs pa/ sdug bsngal las nyon rnams las skyob pa'i thabs ma lus pa mkhyen/ brtse bas sems can gyi don la btang snyoms mi mdzad par rtag tu skyob par yang mjad/ nus pas skal ba dang 'tshams par skyob thub pa'ang yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis skyabs thub pa yin/ dge 'dun 'phags pa yang rlabs che chung bi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ de dang phyogs mtshungs te/ ma/byen brtse nus gsum/ khyad par can mnga' bas skyabs su 'os shing skyob par mdzad pa yin/ skyob lugs kya tsho gtso bo ni/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos ltar bsgrubs pas rgyu nyon mongs spangs pa na/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol 'gro ba'i chul 'di yin/ skyob lugs kyi rnam grangs gzhan ni 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu spang pa kho na la ma rag ste/ mtshan gzung ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis kyang 'jigs pa bcu drug la sogs pa nyer 'tshe thar/sa cad las dngos su skyob par mdzad cing / ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba rnga preng gtan nas zlog pa'am/ thag sring bar byed pa sogs sgo thams cad nas skyob par mdzad do/ /—164—

don tshan bzhi pa skyabs su song ba'i tshad ni/ yon tan shes pa/ khyad par shes pa/ khas blangs pa/ skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba ste khyad chos bzhi tshang na/ skyabs 'gro rnam dag tu 'gyur ba'o/ /de la yon tan shes pa ni/dkon mchog gsum po nyid kyi yon tan rags pa rnams shes pa ste/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo lta bu'am/ rgyan rnam gnyis sogs gzhung rnams las bshad pa ji ltar rigs pa go zhing yid ches pa'o/ khyad par shes pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ gzhan gnyis zhor la 'byung ba sogs gsum po phan tshun nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i phyir/ skyabs gcig kho nas chog pa ltar 'dug kyang / ji skad du/ theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ zhes pa ltar/ dgos pa la bltos nas gsum du grangs nges byed pa dang / gnas skabs gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas/ skyabs gnas gsum po nyid kyi so so'i khyad par dang / dgos pa dang / skyob tshul rnams shes pa dang / ston nga/ sa then 'a sa sangs rgyas lhag tshul dang / lam log pa las dam pa'i chos ches khyad par du 'phags tshul dang / mu stegs byed kyi tshogs pa sogs las dge 'dun ches khyad par du 'phags tshul rnams legs par shes shing yid ches rnyed pa'o/ khas len pa ni/ yon tan shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar dam bcas pa'o/ /skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba ni/ khyad par shes pa la brten nas/ dkon mchog gsum las gzhan gcig yin na che ba che bar grags pa gang la'ang yid mi brton na/ 'dre bkren sogs la skyabs su —165—

'gro ba lta ga la zhig skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba 'di med na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan mthong bas skyabs su khas blangs pa tsam kyis skyabs 'gro rnam dag tu mi 'gyur te/ blo rtse gnyis dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /yon to shes pa dang / khyad par shes pa med na ni/ khas blangs pa dang skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol ba tsam yod du chug kyang / blun dad kho nas zhugs pa tsam yin pas lam du 'gyur ba shin tu dka'o/ /des na khyad par bzhi char tshang ba dgos so/ /don tshan lnga pa skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ skyabs su song ma thag rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grar chud pa'o/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rten du 'gyur ba ste/ skyabs su ma song ba la cho gas blangs pa'i sdom pa gsum skye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sngar byas kyi sdig pa zad pa dang bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ba ni/ skyabs su song ba la brten nas phyis sdig sbyong dang dge ba gsar ba sgrub pa sogs dpag tu med par 'phel ba rnams phar bzhag /skyabs 'gro byas pa nyid kyis sdig pa mang po byang ba dang / sbyin sogs phal pa las ches lhag pa'i phan yon yod pa'o/ /bzhi po de skyabs su song ma thag nas 'byung ste/ skyes bu dam pa'i grangs su chud/ sngar rgyud ngan pa yin pa las bzang por gyur pa'i don yin no/ /tshe 'dir ཿnga ba'i phan yon ni 'jigs pa bcu drug dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba brgyad sogs phyi nang gi bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa dang / bsam pa'i don chos dang mi 'gal ba rnams yid bzhin du 'grub pa gnyis so/ /tshe phyi ma'i 'bras bu ni/ ngan song du mi lhung ba'am skyes kyang myur du thon —166—

pa dang / mtho ris su yang bde ba thob pa dang / der yang dkon mchog gsum skyabs su 'dzin pa ste gsum mo/ /mthar thug gi phan yon ni sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur ba ste/ phan yon rnam pa bcu po de dag ji ltar 'os pa brjod do/ /sgos su theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro la ni/ mdo rgyan las/ skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don che ste/ /des ni tshad med yon tan tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'di la snying rje'i bsam pas khyab/ /mtshungs med 'phags chen chos kyang rgyas par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dang / theg dman las skyabs te/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas nyid myur du thob par 'gyur ba'i nges pa thob pa yin no/ /don tshan drug pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos sgrub pa ste bzhi tshan dang po dang / dbang po mi rgod pa dang sdom pa ci nus su len pa dang / sems can la snying rje che ba dang / dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa la bslab ces bzhi tshan phyi ma ste brgyad 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs pa ltar bshad kyang rung / mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas rtag tu dad pa sgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bka' drin dran pas rtag tu mchod pa dang / snying rje dran pas skye bo gzhan rnams skyabs 'gro la 'god pa dang /skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dran pas nyin mtshan dus drug tu skyabs 'gro bsgom pa dang / skyabs su ma song ba'am skyabs 'gro btang ba'i nyes dmigs dran pas srog dang bdos kyang skyabs yul mi spong ba dang / yid ches dran pas bde sdug mtho dman gnas skabs ci byung yang dkon mchog la mi 'khang zhing gzhan la blo —167—

mi gtong pa ste/ don tshan drug gi sgo nas bshad kyang rung la/ yang mdor bsdus na dang po nyid nas nye bar mkho zhing gal che ba'i bslab bya ni/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa sgom/ skur 'debs sogs sdig mi gsog /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa sogs gus pa'i spyod lam la bslab/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la dkon mchog dngos su 'du shes pa'i sgo nas mchod pa ci 'grub byed/ 'khor rnam bzhi la gus pa bskyed/ rten gsum sa rjen la 'jog pa dang / 'o brgyal ba'i gnas su 'jog pa dang / 'gom yugs gtong ba dang / btsongs te sku blud za ba dang / gted par 'jog pa sogs rnam pa kun tu spong ba gal che/ yang mdo sde myang 'das las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du'ang lha gzhan dag la ni/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs song bas 'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang grags che ba ltar bslab dgos mod/ 'di'i thog mtha' gnyis po cung zad sla yang bar ba ni shin tu dka' ste 'di la kha dang lag len mthun par byung na ni ngo mtshar che/ don thog tu ma khel na kha bshad chal chol tsam re rang ta kun gyis shes te mdo tsam mi gda'o/ /don tshan bdun pa theg pa che chung gi skyabs 'gro'i khyad par ni/ thun mong pa theg dman pa'i lugs la dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar dang / khyad par can theg chen gyi lugs la ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar ro/ /bsam pa'i khyad par yang /—168—

theg dman ni gtso bor rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar 'dod tsam dang theg chen ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam gyi khyad par yang / so so'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /skyabs yul dang / cho ga dang byed las sogs la ni rgya che chung gi khyad par tsam yod kyang / gong ma'i nang du 'og ma 'dus pa'i phyir 'gal ba ni ma yin no/khyad par gsang sngags kyi lugs la/ dus kyi khyad par mtha' med pa dang bsam pa'i khyad par sems can rnams myur du skyob par 'dod pa dang / smon lam gyi khyad par lam 'jug pa bde bas 'bras bu lhan skyes kyi sku thob par 'dod pa rnams/ lhag por bsnan pas don 'grub pa yin no/ /sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa phog pa'i rjes su/ don cung zad 'chad par spro na gnyis te/ byang chub kyi sems bshad pa dang / tshad med bzhi bshad pa'o/ /dang po la don tshan thog ma byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/spyir byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba/ don dam dbyings de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa yang yod/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes la yang 'jug ste/ don dam sems bskyed ces pa'ang de rgyud la skyes pa'i ming yin/ de lta na yang kun rdzob don dam gyi dbye ba ma byas par/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes ma skyes dang / byang chub kyi sems kyis zin ma zin sogs byang chub sems kyi tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi/ grags che ba gtso che shos ni brtse ba snying rje chen po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su grags pa 'di yin no/ /theg chen 'dir snying rje dang snying rje chen po'i khyad par cung zad yod de/ snying rje ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi —169—

bzod cing 'bral bar 'dod pa tsam yin la de ni tshad med bzhi'i nang gi snying rje yin/ snying rje chen po ni byang chub kyi sems kyi ming ste/ de yang de'i rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyu byams snying rje rlabs po che las byung ba/grogs sems can gyi don gyi khur chen po bdag nyid kyis 'khyer ba'i snying stobs lhag bsam can/ ngo bo gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod de/de'i skabs kyi gzhan don du zhes pa ni/ sems can thams cad rdzogs byang la 'god pa'i ched du zhes pa'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis su dbye ba'am/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /de la smon pa byang sems ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod tsam yin la/ 'jug pa byang sems ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du/ phyin drug dang bsdu dngos sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'phral du sbyor bar 'dod pa'o/ /'di la 'jug pa dang bral ba'i smon pa rkyang pa'ang yod la/ 'jug pa rkyang pa med/ 'jug sems rgyud la yod pa'i gang zag de la/ smon sems kyang yod pas khyab mod/ blo'i sbu ris mi gcig go /bdag gzhan mnyam brje gnyis ni/ mnyam pa gtso bo yin la/ brje ba ni de'i gegs sel bogs 'don yin no/ /de la mnyam pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rang bzhin med par yang mnyam/ chos nyid ye shes gcig tu yang mnyam/ sems can gyi don nyid bdag gi 'dod don yin pas 'dod pa'i don yang mnyam/bdag dang sems can bde ba 'dod par mnyam/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod par —170—

mnyam/ bde ba sgrub dgos dang sdug bsngal sel dgos su'ang mnyam/ gal che chung gi dbye ba med pa dang gces mi gces kyi dbye ba med par/ gnyis ka gces par mnyam ste/ de'i phyir bdag sangs rgyas thob nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god par 'dod pa'o/ /'dir gal che bar mnyam pa ni/sems can gzhan thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas pa dang / bdag gcig pu mnyam pa'i don ma yin/ sems can gang yang rung ba zhig dang bdag nyid mnyam pa na/ sems can ni shin tu mang por gyur na bdag las lhag pa kho na yin no/ /de lta na yang sems can rnams byang chub thob 'dod bdag gis byed pa bzhin du/ bdag kyang byang chub de thob 'dod yin pas/ 'bras bu gcig la sbyor 'dod mnyam pa'i phyir bdag gzhan mnyam pa'o/ /bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ 'khor ba pa rnams bdag nyid bde ba dang bzang bar 'dod pa tsam gzhan su la'ang mi 'byung ste/ 'gro ba gzhan kha cig sdug bsngal bar 'dod/ 'ga' zhig btang snyoms su 'jog nye du sogs nyung zad cig la bde bar 'dod pa srid kyang / bdag rang las mi gces shing gal chung ba kho nar sems pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gzhi bdag gzhan gnyis kyi steng du/ gal che chung brjes te/ bdag mi gces shing / sems can gang ci yang rung ba gcig kyang bdag las ches shin tu gces par 'dzin pa yin te/ gzhan bde ba'i phyir bdag nyid sdug bsngal la yang 'jug par spro ba dang / rang nyid ma grol na sems can zhig thog mar grol bar 'gyur la/bdag grol ba'i thabs byas na/ sems can de re zhig mi grol ba'i rigs shig —171

'dug na/ bdag 'khor bar gnas nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba la mi 'dod pa med cing / sems can de thog mar grol bar 'dod pas/ de'i thabs la brtson par byed pa'o/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa la rang don yid byed cung zad 'dre ba srid pas/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgoms na de dag par 'gyur bas bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i gegs sel ba yin no/ /bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du ma gyur pa la/ 'di yi sa la dor bas mnyam par 'dre ba'i phyir bogs 'byin pa'ang yin no/ /rtsa ba bdag gzhan mnyam pa yin brje ba 'di yan lag yin yang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba phal cher/ bdag gzhan brje ba 'dis byed cing / thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mchog gcig yin pas 'di med du mi rung ba'i gal po che yin te/ rgyal po'i bya ba blon pos byed pa bzhin no/ /don tshan gsum pa sgra don ni don dam de bzhin nyid la byang chub sems zhes zer ba/ de bzhin nyid ni byang chub kyi ngo bo yin la/ sems nyid kyang yin pa'i phyir / kyi zhes pa drug pa'i sgra ni gzhi mthun bsdu ba yin no/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i lam gyi ye shes ni/ byang chub kyi rang bzhin dngos su mthong zhing / de la dmigs pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/ byang chub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dmigs nas rang gzhan rnams de thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i sems pa yin pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ste/ 'di kun rdzob byang sems su 'jog /snga ma gnyis po don dam byang sems yin no/ /de lta na yang chos dbyings la don dam —172—

byang sems zhes brjod kyi/ sems bskyed kyi tha snyad mi 'jug gzhan gnyis la don dam sems bskyed dang / kun rdzob sems skye bad ces 'jog pa'i skabs mang ngo / /de yang sems dang sems bskyed kyi khyad par ci snyam na/ ngo bo dang rdzas kyi sgo nas khyad med/ gnas skabs kyi khyad par las ming 'dogs byed pa yin te/ sems bskyed pa zhes pa la 'jog mtshams gnyis las/ gcig ni smon sems mi 'dor bar dam bcas pa dang / 'jug sdom cho gas blangs pa la smon pa sems bskyed pa dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed pa zhes/ smon 'jug gi byang sems gnyis po de/ tshul khrims kyi ngo bor skyes pas shin tu brtan zhing stobs che la/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur nga/'o/ /des na sems bskyed 'di dam bca' 'am/ cho gas blangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khyad par dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i byang chub sems kyi ming yin/ 'di'i ltar na sems bskyed yin pa la byang sems yin pas khyab kyang / byang sems tsam la sems bskyed kyis ma khyab bo/ /yang sems bskyed kyi 'jog tshul gnyis pa/ byang chub kyi sems rtsol bas rgyud la skyes shing blo la shar ba la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zer ba ni/ sems de rtsol bas bskyed pa'i phyir sems bskyed de/ 'jog tshul 'di la kun rdzob byang sems yin tshad de'i sems bskyed kyang yin no/ /khrid rim kun tu skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ces pa'i sems bskyed ni phyi ma 'di yin te/ byang chub kyi sems dran par byed pa la zer go /don tshan bzhi pa khrid dmigs kyi sems bskyed gnyis ngos 'dzin pa ni/skabs 'dir sems bskyed gnyis kyi cho ga dang / byang sdom gyi rnam gzhag rgyas —173—

par bshad kyis mi lang zhing / skabs kyi don ma yin pas mi 'chad do/ /'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po'i ye shes le'u las/ dus kun tu ni byang chub sems kyang 'gro ba dang ni 'gro bar 'dod pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /thar par 'jug pas dman zhing smon pa rnam par spangs pa dag ni thams cad dus su bdud kyi sems/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes bsgom pa ni/ dpe 'gro bar 'dod pa dang mtshungs pa'i don smon pa byang sems yin la/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom par bgyi'o snyam pa ni/ dpe lam du 'gro ba dang mtshungs pa'i don 'jug pa byang sems yin no/ /bdag ma 'ongs pa dus gzhan zhig na spyin sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya'o snyam pa tsam spyod pa la slob 'dod rgya yan pa yin gyi 'jug sems su mi 'gro la/ 'dir ngo bo ni/ da lta nyid slob 'dod yin zhing / sems 'di nyid kyis bskul nas/byang chub kyi rgyu'i dge ba gcig la 'phral du 'jug pa zhig kyang dgos so/ /des na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mchog yin pa'i phyir/ de bsgom par 'dod cing bsam pa de dang 'bral bar lag len la 'phral du spyor bas sgom yang sgom pa ni 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ spyir 'jug sems dang 'jug sems kyi sdom pa'i khyad par phyed par bya'o/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes —174—

pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes bshad pa'ang gong du drangs pa ltar/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bshad pa yin no zhes kho bo smra'o/ /rgyu mtshan 'dis kyang dus 'khor gyi chos ci rigs pa 'phags yul du snga mo nas byon par yang grub bo/ /don tshan lnga pa phan yon ni/ gang zag de theg chen par 'gro mi 'gro byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes ma skyes la rag dge ba gang yang rung ba byas pa de sangs rgyas sgrub byed du 'gro mi 'gro yang / byang chub kyi sems kyis zin ma zin la rag ste/ de'i phyir byang chub kyi sems skyes ma thag theg pa chen po bar chud ba dang / tshul khrims rnam pa gsum sogs bslab pa gsum dang yon tan thams cad kyi rten thob pa dang / nam zhig na rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nges par 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa dang / ji skad du/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / des na dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sngar byas kyi sdig pa mang po zhig 'bras bu gtan nas 'byin par mi nus pa'i tshul gyis dag par 'gyur la/ kha cig da lta rnam smin thag srings pa'i tshul gyis 'bras bu phyi 'gyangs su gyur pa'i bar der/ gnyen po dge ba gzhan gyis 'joms par byed do/ /de ltar na sems bskyed pa tsam gyis sdig pa'i tshogs dpag tu med par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /dpa' spyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/—175—

byang chub sems kyi bsod nams/ gang / /gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan yon tshad med par gsungs shing / dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel par 'gyur/ /zhes nga shad pa ltar dge ba zad pa med pa dang / sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i sbyin sogs dge ba bskal par bsgrubs pa las kyang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed tsam nyid kyang phan yon che ste/ sems bskyed pa tsam kho na'i rnam par smin pas kyang / brgya byin dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi go 'phang lan brgya stong 'bum phrag tu 'gyur ba'ang yod/ sems bskyed nyid la brten nas phyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i phan yon ni/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'grub na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos so/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i mchog kyang 'di yin te/ mdo las/ ga d+ma'i bye ma grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen dag gis kun bkang nas/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed na/ mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /zhes gsungs/ zang zing gi mchod pa ci tsam che yang sgrub pa'i mchod pa gcig gis zil gyi gnon pa yin la/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang bla na med pa ches mchog yin pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rigs rgyun mi 'chad pa/ra byas pa'i phyir —176—

mchod pa'i mchog go /gzhan yang ngan 'gro las ni bzlog bgyid cing / mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'dis ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bde mang brgya phrag spyod par 'dod pas kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu btang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / 'jug pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni/ sems de bskyed ma thag pa nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ bde bas tshim par byed/ gti mug la sogs pa nyon mongs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sems can gyi don phyogs med ris med la zhugs pa yin te/ gang zhig bde bas 'phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim byed cing / /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed la/ /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bzhes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra'ang ga la yod/ /phan btags lan lon gang yin pa/ /de yang re zhig bsngags 'os na/ /ma bcol legs par byed pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs/don tshan drug pa spangs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed nyams na/ so so thar pa'i phas pham bzhi phog pa las kyang lci ba lta ci smos/ mtshams med lnga las kyang ches nyes dmigs che bas/ dmyal ba —177—

mnar med dam ngan song gi sdug bsngal dos drag la yun ring ba yang nas yang du myong ba dang / gzhan yang rang dang gzhan gyi don nyams lugs mang po dang /mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa dag 'byung bar bshad do/ /don tshan bdun pa bslab bya ni/ spyir nyams su blang bya'i chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi bslab byar 'gro ba yin/ khyad par du 'jug sdom la rtsa ba bzhi dang sbom po zhe drug spong ba sogs dang nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las rtsa lhung bcu bzhi gsungs pa spong ba sogs/ 'phral gyi 'jug ldog la nye bar mkho ba spang bya ldog pa'i tshul khrims kyi bcas pa rnams dang / phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos sogs blang bya sgrub pa'i bslab par bya ba rnams yin mod kyi/ de dag re zhig 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom phyin chad 'di gal che/ sems can blos spangs pa dang / mi mthun pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis kyis sems bskyed gtong ste cho gas blangs pa'i sdom pa yin na 'jig pa lta ci smos/ dam bcas pa tsam gyis sems rgyun yang 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sems can blos spangs pa ni/ sems can gcig gam mang po yin yang rung / gnas skabs re zhig blos spangs skyang / phugs blos ma btang na spangs pa dngos su mi 'gyur la/ yul sems can gcig kho na yin yang / 'phral phugs thams cad du blos spangs na nyes pa 'dir 'gyur ro/ /mi mthun pa'i sems ni/ log lta skyes pa'am rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod ldog pa dang / byang chub kyi sems la phan yon med snyam skur 'debs kyis log par gzung pas byang chub kyi sems spong bar byed dam skur 'debs med kyang byang sdom gyi bslab pa phul ba la —178—

sogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems can la rtag tu phan 'dogs pa /bo na yin pa'i phyir/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems can blos mi spang ba la thugayang dag par theg chen la zhugs pa de gnod byed tshun la bde bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa yod phyin/ gzhan nyes byas grangs med pas kyang byang chub kyi sems rin po che rtsa ba nas gzhom par mi nus so/ /gnas skabs su skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyu/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab/ brjed pa'i rgyu nag po'i chos bzhi spong / de yang nag po re'i gnyen por dkar po re 'byung ste/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi bslab bya zer/ dkar chos bzhi la bslabs na/nag po bzhi spong ba de'i khongs su 'dus pas logs na med/ de yang mchod 'os bslu ba nag po'i chos kyi gnyen por/ shes bzhin gyi brdzun mi smra ba dkar po'i chos te zung gcig byang chub sems dpa' la mi bsngags pa brjod pa nag po'i gnyen por/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstod pa byed pa dkar po'i chos te zung gnyis/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa nag po'i chos kyi gnyen por/ rang gis ci nus ci lcogs kyis sems can 'brel yod thams cad theg pa gsum gyi dge ba la 'god pa dkar po'i chos te zung gsum/ sems can la g.yo sgyus spyod pa nag po'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la lhag pas bsam pas gnas pa dkar po'i chos te zung bzhi'o/ /de la g.yo sgyus gnas pa ni/ g.yo skyus kun nas blangs pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa yin la lhag pa'i bsam pa ni/ gzhan gyi don la rang gis 'khur 'khyer ba/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul ba lta bu'am/ yang na —179—

phyi nang dang bag 'dzoms kyis sgrubs pa med par pha bu'am phu nu lta bur gsong por smra zhing nang ma brton pa'i don yang yin gsung ngo / /gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bshad pa la/ tshad med bzhi po 'di ni byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skye ba'i rgyu dang / skyes pa brtan par byed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin pas/ gang theg pa chen po la rnal 'byor du byed pa de thams cad/ tshad med bzhi'i sgrub pa nyams len la brtson par bya'o/ /de la don tshan dang po tshad med bzhi dang bral ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ /nyon mongs du mas dkrugs par 'gyur te/ gnod sems dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / gzhan bde ba la mi dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags rnams gnyen po med pas rang gar spyod pa na/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes spyod mang po 'phel ba dang / 'dod 'dun dang / gnod sems la brten nas nyon mongs gzhan mang po'ang 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ 'di dang phyi ma'i nyes dmigs mtha' med du skyed par byed do/ /de skad du yang mdo rgyan las/byang chub sems dpa' gnod sems dang / /rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang / /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg /ces gsungs shing / nyes dmigs kyang 'di ltar/ nyon mongs rnams kyis bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms/ /nyams bcas rnyed pas dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas smad/ /rtsod bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khoms rnams su skye/ /thob dang ma thob nyams pas yid la sdug —180—

bsngal chen po thob/ /zhes gsungs te nyes dmigs 'di rnams nyon mongs thams cad dang / nyes par spyad pa spyi'i nyes dmigs kyang yin mod/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gtso bo ni 'dod 'dun gnod sems mi dga' ba rnams yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi nyes dmigs su smos so/ /don tshan sa/nyis pa tshad med sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la/ /legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste/ /nyon mongs can min sems can gyi/ /don du 'khor ba yongs mi gtong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byams pas gnod sems kyi gnyen po byed/ snying rjes rnam par 'tshe ba'i gnyen po byed/ dga' bas mi dga' ba'i gnyen po byed/ btang snyoms kyis nye ring dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems gnyis kar gyi gnyen po byed/ de ltar na tshad med bzhis nyon mongs de rnams spongs par byed de/ de dag spangs pas nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs de dag phyis mi 'gyung ngo / /spong tshul bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs la brten nas spong pa sogs/ mngon pa las mang du bshad kyang / re zhig mi mkho bas bzhag go /byams sogs nyon mongs kyi sa bon spong byed ma yin par bshad pa rnams ni/ 'jig rten pa dang nyan thos kyi dbang du byas te spyi ldog nas bshad pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang rtul thabs la mi mkhas pa'ang de 'drar 'gyur mod/ de dag la ni nyon mongs de rnams mngon 'gyur ba 'gog cing mgo gnon gyi gnyen po tsam yin mod kyang /byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas can gyi tshad med bzhi ni/ chos kyi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs rnams kyi sa bon dang bag —181—

chags 'joms pa'i gnyen po yang shin tu byed do/ /des na byams pa yin pa'i ldog cha tsam nas sa bon 'joms pa'i gnyen por mi 'gro ba dang / byams pa tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sa bon 'joms nus pa'i dbye ba phyed dgos pas/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ /nyes pa shin tu tshar gcod min/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkyang gi kha skad rags pa sbom yor tsam khyar ba'i 'ol chod la mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod yin par rlom pa ni/ mi mkhas pa'i rnam thar ro/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams khams gsum du skye ba'i nyon mongs spangs kyang / smon lam dang ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'khor bar skye ba blangs te/sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong pa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba thams cad kyang / tshad med pa bzhi'i mthu yin te/ de ltar na nyon mongs nyes dmigs dang bcas pa spong ba dang / 'phags mchog rnams sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/phan yon gyi gtso bo smos pa yin no/ /gzhan yang tshad med kyi byed las 'bras bu lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa yang phan yon nyid de/ ji skad du/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa'i gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye/ /des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing / /sems can rnams yongs smin par byed/ /kun tu myongs dang mi 'bral la/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs dang 'bral/ /bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen/ /mi zad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /phan yon ci rigs pa 'og tu'ang 'chad do/ /don tshan gsum pa ngo bo ni/ sems can rnams sngar med kyi bde ba gsar pa dang phrad par 'dod pa ni byams pa dang / da ltar yod pa'i sdug bsngal —182—

—— —dang 'bral zhing phyin chad kyang sdug bsngal 'byung pa'i sgo 'gog par 'dod pa ni snying rje dang / sems can gzhan rnams da ltar bde ba la dmigs nas dga' zhing yi rang bas drangs pa'i yid bde ni dga' ba dang / de gsum gyi drangs pa'i zhe sdang med pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma chags pa'i sems kyi/ khyad par ni/btang snyoms yin par bshad de/ de ltar na btang snyoms nyid dge ba'i sems sogs pa rkang tshugs shig yin te/ ma chags pa dang mi sdang ba'i rgyu las byung ba nye ring med par sems snyoms pa yin la/ byams sogs dang po gsum la rjes su chags pa'i cha shas 'dre ba srid la de ni nyon mongs yin pas skyon rjes su 'brangs pa ste/ btang snyoms kyis skyon de sel ba'i phyir btang snyoms la ma chags pa dang / nyon mongs med pa dang ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid can zhes gsungs so/ /snying rje ni gzhan bde ba la bar chad sel ba'i rnam pa can dang /byams pa dang dga' ba gnyis sems can bde ba 'dod pa dngos yin pas/ de gsum char bde ba'i bsam pa tsam yin la/ btang snyoms ni/ zhe sdang med pa'i phyogs nas bde ba bsam pa'i mtshan nyid kyang yod la/ bdag nyid ma chags shing sems can rnams ma chags mi sdang ba la 'god pa'i bsam pa nyid kyi phyir phan pa'i bsam pa nyid yin pas/ btang snyoms ni phan bde gnyis car gyi bsam pa'o/ /byams sogs bzhi'i ngo bo ni de ltar yin la/ tshad med par 'gyur ba la yul sems can dpag tu med pa la dmigs shing / rnam pa bde ba dpag tu med pa la 'god pa dang / sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'bral bar 'dod pa sogs dang / (〈〈dza〉〉rtse yul sems can dpag med kyi bde ba —183—

dpag med la dmigs nas dga' zhing yid rangs pas drangs pa'i yid bde dang ) ngo bo dgra gnyen bar ma'i bye brag med pa thams cad mnyam snyoms par bde ba 'dod pa sogs dgos so/ /de ltar na byams pa tshad med sogs kyi mtshan nyid de 'dra yin la/ dmigs rnam de 'dra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sems rtse gcig par gnas pa ni tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /tshad med 'di rnams mos pa yid byed tsam yin yang / dge ba bla na med pa yin te sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /don tshan bzhi pa dbye ba ni/ brtan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang //sdug bsngal gyi nyam thag dang bde ba dang / /nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos dang / /de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /zhes gsungs te/ tshad med bzhi po re re yang sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa dang /dmigs pa med pa gsum gsum du dbye'o/ /nyon mongs can dang zhes pa yan chad sems can la dmigs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ bdag dang sems can dang gang zag tu 'dzin pa ched du bkag pa ma yin par/ sems can rnams bde bar 'dod pa nas/ sems can chags sdang gi nyon mongs can rnams nyon mongs med pa la 'god par 'dod pa'i bar/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams sogs bzhi ste/ 'di la kha cig sems can bden par 'dzin pa dgos par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad do/ /da lta sems can du snang ba rnams kyi shul na sems can rjes su med par/ phung khams skye mched tsam zhig ste phung sogs kyi tshogs pa la sems can du btags pa tsam du shes nas/ dmigs yul phung —184—

sogs la dmigs te/ gang zag btags yod tsam du chos sde snod las gsungs pa yid ches pa'i rgyu mtshan dmigs brtad du byas nas/ phung sogs kyi rgyun la bde ba dang / nyon mongs med pa'i bar du 'god pa'i bsam pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o/ /'dir yang chos la dmigs par 'jog pa la/ phung sogs chos su bden par 'dzin pa dgos so zer ba'ang 'khrul te/ gang zag bden med kyi rnam par ma shar ba tsam dang / gang zag bden yod du 'dzin pa gnyis khyad che zhing / phung sogs chos stong nyid kyi rnam pa can du ma shar ba tsam dang /chos bden dngos su 'dzin pa gnyis kyang shin tu mi 'dra ba'i khyad mi phyed ba'i smra ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang snying rje gsum kar yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul gyis 'phags mchog rnams la'ang yod par/ rgyud sde mchog nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang zag dang chos su zhen pa'i mtshan nyid can du mi 'thad do/ /yang so so skye bo rnams sems can dang chos su zhen pa ma spangs pa yin mod/'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyud la de dang der zhen pa med kyang / de'i rgyud kyi shes pa yin tshad de dang de bden med du rtogs pa'i rnam pa can du 'char dgos pa ma yin no/ /yang chos phung sogs la dmigs pa dang / chos sde snod la dmigs pa gnyis chos la dmigs pa'i 'jog mtshams so sor 'dod pa yang gzhung don go ba ma yin no/ /des na bstan bcos dang bcas pas chos la dmigs pa bstan/ sems can dang phung sogs chos rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong nas/ sems can dang chos su snang ba tsam gyis 'khrul pa rnams de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su zad par bzhed pa tsam ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i byams —185—

sogs tshad med bzhi yin no/ /de yang dmigs med byams sogs bzhi po rim pas yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa dang / 'khrul pa zad pa dang / mtha' la gnas pa dang / 'phel zad gnyis bral gyi dgongs pa sems can rnams la shar ba'o/ /tshad med 'di dag bsam gtan la brten dgos par 'dod pa/nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i rnam rtog yin/ mdo sde pa yan chad 'dod khams na'ang yod par 'dod pa ltar/ 'di yang smra mod/ spyir byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas kyi khyad par la/ tshad gzung mi nus pa nyid bsam par bya ba yin no/ /don tshan lnga pa theg chen lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshad med bzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji skad du rgyan las/ brtan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces gsungs te/ mi ma/thun phyogs gnod sems la sogs pa spangs pa dang / 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i lta bas zin pa dang / sems can dang chos dang de bzhin nyid de dmigs pa'i yul rnam pa gsum la 'jug pa dang / bde 'dod dang sdug bsngal spong 'dod tsam gyi bsam pa kho na la mi 'jog par/ sems can mang po yongs su smin par byed pa'i las can te khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis zin pas/ dmigs pa gsum la 'jug pa gzhi gcig la 'du bar bshad pa yang go dgos te/ des na sems can dang chos la dmigs pa yang stong nyid kyis zin pa yod do/ /da ni 'phros don gal che la nye bar mkho ba cung zad bshad na/ gzhan —186—

yang rin chen phreng ba las/ /rdzi'u btsos gsum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re dus su sbyin pa bas/ /byams pa yud tsam thengs gcig gi /bsod nams dag ni char mi phod/ /lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang / /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang / /dug dang mtshon gyi gnod med dang / /'thab pa med par don 'thob dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang / /byams chos yon tan brgyad thob bo/ /zhes byams pa'i phan yon brgyad bshad pa ni/ snying rje sogs gzhan gsum po'i yang phan yon yin 'ing / de bzhin du bzhes spring las/ byams dang snying rje bdag dang dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms rtag tu yang dag goms mdzod cig /gong ma brnyes par ma gyur de lta na'ang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshad med bzhi rab tu goms par byas pas/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan dang por skye ba yang yang gsungs shing / de nyid kyi phyir tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi zhes gsung rab kun tu grags so/ /'dir mtha' cung zad dpyad na/ byams sogs sgoms pa tsam gyis 'dod pa la chags bral mi nus pas/ tshangs par skye ba mi 'thad gzhung rnams las der skye bar gsungs pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nye bsdogs zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyis 'dod pa la chags bral byas pa'i 'og tu nyer bsdogs nyid la brten pa'am bsam gtan dngos gzhi bsgrubs te de la brten nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu tshangs par skye ba'o snyam na/ de 'dra gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin te/ tshad med bzhi med kyang nyer bsdogs rdzogs par thob la —187—

ma nyams pa yod na tshangs par skye nges pa'i phyir/ tshad med bzhi smos pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod yon ma spangs bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la ma skyes par tshangs gnas su skye ba min yang / 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas/ 'dod nyon srabs te/ tshad med bzhi po nyid nyer bsdogs su 'gyur te de las dngos gzhi skye la/'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir/ dngos gzhi yang tshad med dang mtshungs par ldan pa kho na 'byung ngo / /byams sogs gsum gyis khong khro dang/btang snyoms kyis 'dod pa'i 'dod chags spangs pas gtso bo bcom pa na 'khor bros pa ltar 'dod nyon gzhan rnams shugs la spangs te/ 'dod pa la chags bral du 'gyur ba yin pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis chags bral byed phyi na zhi rags kyi rnam pa can kho na bsgom dgos kyi gzhan med do snyam du sems pa ni/ phyogs gcig las gzhan ma rtogs mi mthong ba'o/ /des na/gang gi 'phags dang lha dang tshangs pa yi/ /gnas pa dpe med rgya chen rtag tu gnas/ /zhes 'phags pa'i gnas pa/ lha'i gnas pa/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa/zhes rnam grangs mi 'dra ba gsum du gsungs pa'ang / lha'i gnas pa la ma brten pa'i tshangs pa'i gnas pa zhig yod pa'i dbang gis yin te/ gzhan du na lha'i gnas pa las tshangs pa'i gnas pa gzhan du med par thal bas/ gsum gyi rnam gzhag nyams par 'gyur ro/ /des na mngon pa las zhi rags kyi dmigs rnam can gtso bor bshad kyang / der khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min la/mdo sde rnams las tshad med bzhi gtso bor gsungs te/ sems sbyong ba la gal —188—

che bar dgongs te/ dgos don 'grub pa mnyam po la/ zhi rags las 'di bsod nams rgya che ba'i phyir ro/ /'khrid kyi skabs su mtha' dpyod 'di rigs 'chad mi dgos kyang / 'di na mjodi gzhung sogs la phran tshegs sbyangs par rlom pa rnams/ ches khyad par du 'phags nga/ nges don theg pa chen po'i lugs srol la nor ba'o snyam log par rtog pa 'byung srid pas/ de dag gi blo mun bsal ba'i phyir snga phyir cung zad tsam brjod do/ /de ltar tshad med bzhi'i nang nas kyang / ches gtso bor gyur pa ni snying rje ste/ snying rje yod na pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'byung la/ snying rje med na byang chub sems dang/'i spyod pa rnams mi 'byung ngo / /dang po'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse/ /kun 'khru/gas la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang / /log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o/ /zhes bkren zhing 'phongs pa la snying rje yod na nges par sbyin pa gtong ba sogs rang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'ju ga pa dang / gzhan phar phyin la 'ju ga pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /phyi ma'i rgyu mtshan yang / rgyan las/ snying rje nga/nga ni bzod dang sems pa dang / /smon lam skye ba sems can yongs smin byed/ /ngang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan/ /'di ni snying rje'i ljong shing chen po yin/ /rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na/ /dka' spyod bzod pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /blo ldan sdug bsngal mi bzod na/ /sems can don sems nyid mi 'gyur/ /sems pa dang ni bral ba'i blo/ /skye ba dkar po rnam dag tu/ /smon lam 'debs par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bzang po ma thob na/ /sems can yongs smin byed mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i 'chu ba byams pa —189—

ste/ /de sdug bsngal ni bde ba yi/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin yid byed pas/ /yal ga bde chen 'phel ba dang / /smon lam rgyun ni ma chad pas/ /lo ma 'dor len rkyen rnam gnyis/ grub pa de phyir me tog dang / /'bras bu don yod shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ byams pa la sogs pa ni snying rje 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu yin la/ snying rje yod na sems can gyi don du dka' spyad bzod par nus/ bzod pa de yod na sems can thams cad kyi don bdag nyid kyis khur du khyer ba'i gzhan don sems pa khyad par can 'byung / des gzhan don gyi smon lam khyad par can btang pa ni/ bsam bzhin du srid pa len pa'i skye ba khyad par can 'byung ste/ de las 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas par spyod do/ /rgyu de rnams kyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin na/ gal te snying rje spangs par gyur na/ de dag thams cad mi 'byung bas/ byang chub 'dod pa rnams kyis snying rje la nan tan du bsgrub par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid dmigs phog tshar mtshams sdig bshags la sogs pa'i go don cung zad brjod na/ spyir shes ldan rnams kyis blang dor du byed dgos pa'i las ni/ dge sdig gnyis su nges pa'o/ /de yang las ni/ rgyu'i dus su chung yang 'bras bu'i dus su 'phel che ba dang / dkar nag gi 'bras bu bde sdug so sor nges pa dang / rang gis ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang / byas pa rnams gnyen pos bcom na ma gtogs chud mi 'dza' ba ste/ khyad chos bzhi po rnams kyi don go bde bar bshad/ khyad par du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las la ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des /bskyed / bskyang las ni mi dge ba/ /zhes gsungs —190—

pa lta ra/ zhe sdang gi rigs su gyur tshad dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags dang / las 'bras la rmongs pa'i gti mug gis dngos su kun nas bslangs pa'i las thams/ cad sdig pa mi dge ba'i las yin no/ /de la las kyi ngo bo dngos ni/ sems pa yin zhing / de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i shes pa 'du byed du gyur pa gzhan rnams kyang / lus ngag gi bya ba dang ma 'brel na/ yid kyi las sam sems pa'i las su 'gyur/ sbyor ba lus ngag tu thon thub pa'i nus pa can/ 'du byed sems pa de nyid kyis bskul ba'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dang 'brel ba de ni/ bsam pa'i las sam lus ngag gi las yin no/ /lus ngag gi las thams cad la yid las/ sngon du 'gro ba yin pas/ yid kyi las rkyang pa dang lus ngag gi las zhes dbye'o/ /de la skabs 'dir srog gcod sogs mi dge ba bcu rags rim tsam bshad cing / ji skad du/ de las che long bsdus phyos ni/ dge dang mi dge ci rigs pa/ las kyi lam ni bcu gsungs sgo /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ skye bo phal cher la 'gyung nye ba'i sdig pa'i las rags rim ni mi dge ba bcur 'dus la/ gzhan la brnyes pa dang log 'tsho la sogs pa/ spyir gzhan yang sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas mod kyi/ de dag rnams rnam smin ngan song gsum gyi skye ba 'phen pa ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/chags pa'i yi dwags 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen/ /rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gro /zhes gsungs pa ltar ram sdig pa cher spyad pa dmyal ba dang / 'bring du spyad pas yi dwags dang / chung ngur spyad pas dud 'gror 'phen pa shas che/ de dag tu skyes pas sdug bsngal ngos drag la yun —191—

ring ba dpag tu med/ rgyu mthun ba'i 'bras bu ni/ lha mir skyes pa'i tshe sngar gyi las kyi 'bras bu'i lhag ma/ tshe thung ba dang / nad mang ba sogs sdug bsngal dang gnod pa dpag tu med pa 'byung / bdag po'i 'bras bu yang / phyi ro'/ yul phyogs la lo nyes dang dus log sogs sdug bsngal gyi rkyen ci snyed cig 'gyung ba yin no/ /rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i las la ni/ sdig las kyi 'bras bu de dag phyin ci log pa'i nga de ba dang / gzhan yang phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed pa 'byung ngo / /de skad du/ zhi ba lhas kyang / dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba mos par thub pas gsungs/ /de yi rtsa ba rtag tu ni/ /rnam smin 'bras bu sboms pas so/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba dang / /'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'dod pa rnams dang bral ba ni/ /sdig pa spyod las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yid la bsam pa'i dge byas pas/ /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni bsod nams des/ /'bras bu'i yon gyis mngon mchod 'gyur/ /sdig pa byed pa bde 'dod kyang / /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni sdig pa des/ /sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam par 'joms/ /rgya che dri bzang bsil pa'i pad+mo'i snying por gnas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung snyan zas kyis gzi brjid bskyed byas la/ /thub 'od kyis rgyas pad+ma las byung lus mchog can/ /rgyal pa'i mdun gnas bde gshegs sras su dge bas 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus pags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing / /rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zangs zhun lus la blugs gyur la/ /'bar pa'i ral gri mdung thung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar lhag shing / khren tu 'bar ba'i —192—
