lcags kyi sa gzhir lhung ba mi dge mang pos 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar go /skabs 'dir mi dge ba bcu'i rang bzhin dang / de dag gi rnam smin ngan song gi sdug bsngal ci rigs pa dang / rgyu mthun pa dang bdag 'bras kyi dbye ba rnams ji ltar 'tsham pa bshad/ 'khor ba la skyo ba skyed cing / mi dge ba'i las la blo ldog tu gzhug go /skabs 'dir thun mtshams kun tu sdig bshags gal che/ de la bshags bya'i nyes nga/ ni/ mtshams med lnga/ nye ba lnga/ mi dge ba bcu/sdom/ pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung rnams gtso bor smos pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rang gis bgyis pa dang / gzhan byed du bcug pa dang / byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang / sdig las byas pa la bstod pa brjod pa sogs mdor na nag po phyogs mthun dang bcas pa thams cad bshags par bya ba yin te sbyong bar byed pa'i mthol bshags zhes bya ba la/ nyes pa byas pa gsangs shing sbas na/ sdig pa'i sa bon btab pa la g.yo rgyu'i chu drangs pa lta bu yin pas/ sdig pa rje 'phel du 'gyur/ ma sbas shing skyon du shes pa'i sgo nas bsgrags na/ bden pas mtha' bsdoms pa yin pas/ cung zad stobs chung du 'gro tsho ba dang / nam yang 'phel bar mi 'gyur des na bdag gis nyes nga 'di rta/ bu bgyis so zhes bshags pa'i yul gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs su sgrog pa ni mthol ba yin la/ bdag gis 'di ltar bgyis pa ni shin tu nyes shing blun zhes 'gyod pa drag pos sems gdung ba dang bcas te las de skyon du khas len nga/ ni bshags pa ste/ rang nyid nyes pa dang bcas pas zhum zhing dma' ba'i gnas su zhugs/ gzhan nyes pa de dang mi ldan pa rnams mngon par mtho zhing / mchog —193—

dang ngo mtshar can du shes pas gus pas gtsug tu 'khur ba'i blos kun nas blangs te/ nyes spyod bgyis pa la ngo tsha yang / gsong por smra ba'i sgo nas khyed rnams kyis brtse bas rjes su gzung du gsol/ las 'di dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod pa ni bshags pa'i don gyi snying po'o/ /de lta bu'i mthol bshags de yang khyad chos stobs bzhi tshang ba zhig dgos te/chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/ byams pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa byas shing bsags pa zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rnam par sun 'byin pa kun tu spyod pa dang / gnyen po kun tu spyod pa dang / nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang / rten gyi stobs so/ /zhes gsungs/ de la mthol bshags dngos kyi skabs su sngar byas kyi sdig pa la/ dug 'thung ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid pa'i sdom sems drag po slar ldog pa'i stobs rnams dgos so/ /skabs der 'gyod sems dang sdom sems gnyis ka med mi rung du dgos par mnyam yang / ldog sems med na ni 'gyod sems kyang rnam dag ma yin pas/ bshags pa kha tsam tshig tsam du 'gro ba shes che bas/ phyin chad sdom sems kho na gal che'o/ /rten gyi stobs ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ste/ sngar skyabs 'gro ma blangs na/ skyabs 'gro blang bar bya la/ skyabs 'gro ma blangs bar bshags pa lan brgya stong phul ba bas/skyabs 'gro blangs pa'i bshags pa lan 'ga' zung phul ba yang sdig pa byang stobs che bas/ sngar skyabs 'gro blangs zin pa yin na skabs der skyabs 'gro —194—

gsar pa len mi dgos kyang / yang yang gsal btab pas/ blangs pa dang 'dra ba'i don 'grub cing / yang sngar skyabs 'gro cho gas blangs pa ye med kyang /skabs der skyabs 'gro snying nas dran par byas na yang snga ma dang rjes su mthun pa'i sdig pa 'dag stobs 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du sems bskyed pa la'ang rigs 'gre mod/ spyir sems bskyed cho gas blangs phyin/ skyabs 'gro'ang sngon du 'gro bas khyab ste/ rten gyi stobs sems bskyed blangs pa yin na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis kar tshang ba yin la/ skyabs 'gro blangs shing sems bskyed med par/ bshags pa lan 'bum phrag byas pa las kyang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas bshags pa 'ga' zung byas pa yang sdig pa 'dag stobs che'o/ /sems bskyed cho gas blangs pa med na nam dgos pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi sems dran par byas pa rnams la skyabs 'gro gsal thebs par ma nges pas/cho gas ma blangs pa'i dad pa tsam gyi skyabs 'gro dang / byang chub kyi sems dran pa tsam rten du byas na/ skyabs 'gro rkyang pa rten chung ngu dang / sems bskyed rkyang pa rten chen po dang / gnyis kar 'dzom na rab tu gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /cho gas blangs pa ni/ skyabs 'gro yod pa tsam la sems bskyed yod par ma nges kyang /sems bskyed yod phyin skyabs 'gro med pa mi srid pas/ mu gsum ma gtogs bzhi'i dbye ba mi rung ngo / /cho gas sdom pa len pa'i rigs la/ skyabs sems gnyis rten gyi stobs su bshad pa ni/ khyim pa dang rab byung thun mong gi dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan sdom pa'i khyad par gang blangs kyang rten gyi stobs su 'gyur bas/ skabs 'dir dbang bskur zhus te dam tshig gsar du len pa'am —195—

gso bar byed pa nyid gnad du che'o/ /de'i phyir skyabs sems thob cing dbang bskur ma thob pas lo mang por sdig pa bshags pa bas/ dbang bskur thob pas/ bshags pa nyin gcig byas pa ya nga sdig pa 'dag tshab che'o/ /yang rten gyi stobs zhes bya ba bshags pa 'bul ba'i yul la ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod de/bshags yul ji tsam bzang ba de tsam/ sdig pa 'dag stobs che bar nges pas/de ltar yang rung ba'i phyir/ rten gyi stobs la dbye na/ rang rgyud kyi rten dang bshags yul gyi rten gnyis su dbye bar bya'o/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ spyir dge ba byas pa thams cad sdig pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ skabs 'dir gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa de dang de'i gnyen por/ched du dmigs nas sgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams la/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa zhes bya/ de yang sdig sbyong la dmigs nas dge ba gang bsgrubs kyang der 'gyur ba yin mod/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i sgo drug ces grags pa ni 'grub sla zhing phan yon che ba 'ga' zhig nye bar mkho bas bsdus pa'o/ /de la dang po mtshan bzung ba la brten pa ni/ mdo rnams las sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rma nga po zhig la 'di'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis las sgrib byang bar 'gyur zhes dmigs bsal gsungs pa rnams/ rang nyid brjod cing gzhan la'ang sgrog pa ste/ mtshan de yang brjen par mi bzung che ba 'dogs dang bcas pas bzung bar bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dang 'a sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mdo rgyan las/ sangs —196—

rgyas mtshan mi grags par sangs rgyas mtshan/ /yang dag sgrags pas de dag khams gzhan 'gyed/ ces pa ltar phan yon che ste/ bod las gzhan pa chos dar ba'i yul gzhan rnams na srol ka yang shin tu dar ro/ /gnyis pa sku gzugs bzhengs pa yang / spyir sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa thams cad yin yang / sdig sbyong la dmigs bsal du gsungs pa rnams gtso che ste/ sku gzugs kho nar ma zad sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten nam/ bka'i glegs bam bzhengs pa rnams kyang ngo / /gsum pa mchod pa la brten pa ni/ rten gsum mchod pa dang / dge 'dun mchod pa dang / maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang / gsang sngags la zhugs pas ni/dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang / 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / mchod pa tham/sa cad kyi mchog bla ma mnyes par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa mdo sde zab mo la brten pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mnyam/ po la khyad cher med kyang / gtso bor sdig sbyong la bsngags par gsu ngas rnga/'i mdo rgyud zab mo klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa bzlas pa la brten nga ni ched du bsngags par gsungs pa'i gzungs sngags zab mo rnams bzla ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa stong pa nyid la mos pa ni bdag med pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i don bsgom zhing / gal te sgom par mi nus na yang / mos pa yang yang bskyed pa ste/ khyad par du sdig pa'i las nyid dang / byed pa po gang zag —197—

dang / sdig pa'i sa bon 'dzin pa'i rnam shes dang / 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang bcas pa thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang mos pa sbyong ba'ang yin no/ /de ltar na stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par byed pa la/ dang por sun 'byin pa 'gyod pa drag po gal che na/ las 'bras la yid tshes brtan po yod pa zhig yin na shugs la 'gyod pa skye yang / deng sang phal cher la de med pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi tshig phyir 'brangs pa'i g.yam la rgyugs tsam las/'gyod sems shugs drag mi yong bas/ rgyu mtshan bsam gyin 'gyod pa bskyed dgos so/ /de yang sdig pa byas pas tshe 'dir skye bo thams cad kyis smod/ skye bo ngan pa'i gral chud/ lha dang grung ma rnams khrel/ 'byung po rnams kyis glags blta/ byur chags mang po 'phral du ldang / gnyen tshan dang grogs dang 'khor g.yog sogs rang dang 'brel can thams cad la grib mas non pa sogs bkra mi shis/ rang yang ma nong bkur bas blo mi bde/ rmi lam thams cad kyang mi 'tshams pa kho na rmi/ ya rabs blo ldan thams cad khrel bar 'gyur/ 'chi khar nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ldang / sems la 'gyod pa du ma 'byung / 'chi ba rang gi tshe 'jigs pa dang gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal g.yin pas che/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ dus gzhan zhig na las gzhan gyis mtho ris su skyes kyang / las kyi lhag ma'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa 'byung / sdig pa byas pas bag chags ngan pa sos thebs te/ skye ba gzhan du yang nyon mongs shugs drag cing / sdig pa la dga' bar 'gyur bas/sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad du 'phel bar 'gyur/ bdag 'di lta bu'i bya ba ma ci—198—

——spoyin pa byed pa shin tu rang glen zhing gti mug pa ang / 'byung pos zin nam ci/smyo ba yin nam ci/ las 'di la khye bogs ye mi 'dug pa la de tsam du dga' ba skye ba ang / nyes dmigs 'di tsam cig 'dug pa la/ sna cig kyang ma dran/ ma shes pa/ skyob pa'i lha zhig kyang med dam/ sha tsha ba'i gros 'debs pa cig kyang med pa a/ a tsam las ngan 'di lta bu byas zin pa a snyam du 'dun pa drag po sbyangs/ de ltar sdig pa nyes dmigs che yang gal po che'i don gzhan sgrub dgos mang po yod pas/ mi byed ka med pa yin snyam na/ de yang shin tu blun te/sdig pa byed pa ni/ yang na rang gi lus srog 'tsho ba'i phyir yin/ yang na nor dang longs spyod kyi phyir yin/ yang na kha drag dang gtam grags pa'i phyir yin/yang na dgra 'dul ba'i phyir yin/ yang na gnyen skyong ba'i phyir yin na/ kha drag pa ni gzhan la gnod pa tsam yin/ gtam ni brag cha dang 'dra/ dgra gnyen ni 'phral 'phral 'gyur zhing 'jig nor rdzas longs spyod ni/ phugs lta ci smos/yad yud re yang rtag mi thub/ lus srog kyang nas 'jig cha med cing 'dor bas/ dgos don med pa'i bya ba de dag gi phyir du/ rtag tu sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i las ngan kham po che 'di lta bu gsog tu ga la rung snyam du bsgom/dpa' byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ pha ma sbun zla bu dang chung ma dang / /bran dang nor dang rtsa lag tshogs rnams kyang / khre ba'i rjes phyir de dag 'gro ba med/ /las rnams rjes su 'brang zhing de dag 'gro/ khren tu sdug bsngal gyur pa de dus su/ /bu dang chung ma skyabs su 'gyur ma yin/ /bdag nyid gcig pus sdug bsnga la myong bar 'ong / /de dag de tshe bdag gi skal mi len/ /zhes —199—

gsungs/ gang gi don du bsams bsams te 'bad pa du mas sdig pa byas pa'i dgra gnyen nor rdzas sogs de dag ni/ rang ngan song du 'byams phan 'dogs dgos pa'i dus su/ tho phyir yang sleb mi 'ong / sdig pa byas pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rang kho nas myong dgos pas sdig pa byas pa de bdag rang gcig pu la sdug gyong kho na yin snyam du'ang bsams/ de ltar sdig pa byas pa de don med ma legs pa chen po zhig byung 'dug kyang / da bcos thabs med snyam na ma yin te/ mdo las/ gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge bas 'gebs par byed pa ste/ /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun tu gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyin chad sdig pa spangs pa'i sgo nas/ bsam pa dag pas dge ba la 'bad na/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa bsal ba ltar/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ stobs bzhi la 'bad dgos so/ /'o na sbyong thabs yod pa'i phyir/rim pas go le sbyangs pas chog snyam na ma yin/ tshe thung zhing tshe la nges pa med pas 'phral du sbyong thabs la 'bad dgos/ ji skad du/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du 'chi/ /ji ltar 'di las nges thar par//myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir/sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid ces pa'i sdig sgrib ni/ dngos gzhi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams myong 'phral du skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib rags pa 'ga' zhig yin la/ de yang sdig sgrib nyes ltung zhes pa ltar/ tshe 'dir bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dus nye bas nyams myong skye ba la sgrib tshabs che/ sdig pa gzhan pas kyang sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes lhung sgrib —200—

tshabs che/ khyad par du dam tshig 'gal 'khrul dang / dkor sku glud zos pa sogs lhag par nyams myong skye ba la gegs che bas/ de rnams sbyong ba la rdor sems yig brgya'i sgom bzlas dang bcas pa 'di bsngags/ spyir sgrib sbyong gi yi ge brgya pa la/ rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba gnyis yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'o/ /dang po ni dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud las 'byung / gnyis pa la lha so so'i mtshan sngags spos na/ rgyud sde rab 'byams nas 'byung ba'i 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha ji tsam pa de tsam gyi yig brgya mtha' yas par 'gyur la/ de yang sngags rigs gcig pas yig brgya zhes smos kyi/ yi ge'i grangs brgyar ma nges te/ lha'i mtshan ring thung gi dbang gis sna tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i 'gres sbyar ba ma yin par rtsa ba'i dbye ba ni gnyis te/ rdor sems zhi ba'i yi ge brgya pa dang / rdor sems khro bo he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'o/ /dang po ni deng sang rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya par grags pa 'di yin la/ de la'ang yo ga dang mthun par 'khor los bsgyur ba byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom pa dang /gsang sngags nang pa'i lugs de bzhin gshegs pa kha sbyor lhan skyes su byed pa gnyis yod de sngags ni 'dra'o/ /he ru ka'i yig brgya 'di ni/ sngags kyi rnam pa phal cher snga ma dang 'dra yang / 'gres sbyar ba ma yin te/ dpal mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs so/ /skabs 'di'i lha rdo rje sems dpa' la gzhan lugs pa kha cig dus 'khor gyi rang lugs yin par rlom nas sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par byed pa'ang byung ste/ de ni gsar du blos bcos pa'i —201—

rang bzo kho nar zad do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha de dus 'khor las gsungs kyang /sdig sgrib sbyong ba la gzhan las lhag pa'i phyir du yang ma gsungs la/ de'i sngags kyang yi ge brgya pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yig brgya 'di yang sgrib sbyongs dang / nyams chags bskang ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags yin gyi/ rdor sems yin tshad kyi sngags su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lha de lta bu bsgoms nas sngags yig brgya bzla ba ni/ rdor sems kyi ldog par gcig pa tsam la bsams par 'dug kyang / dper na/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam snang zhal gsum phyag drug pa bsgoms nas/ sngags ngan song sbyong rgyud las byung ba'i du rgya bzlas pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma 'ga' res/ yab rdor sems zhi ba dkar po la yum dmar mos 'byud pa/ sngags zhi ba'i yig brgya bzla ba sogs mdzad 'dug pa spyir mi legs pa ma yin mod/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa man chad kyi phyag bzhes la/ rdor sems he ru ka spyi dang mthun par mdzad pa nyid khungs bzang zhing ches legs pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang spyir sbyor drug rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas dus 'khor kho na'i bskyed rim dang sbrel dgos pa'i nye tshe ba min la/ ci ste bskyed rim dus 'khor kho na dang sbrel du chug kyang / yan lag phra mo dmigs bsal med pa rnams la/ gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos yod mi dgos te/ dper na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzhin no/ /des na dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel las/ yig brgya'i man ngag logs pa ma gsungs shing da lta'i 'di rgyud kyi gsungs pa mngon brjod bla ma yin yang / bla med kyi gsang ba spyi la 'jug pa —2()2—

yin pas skabs 'dir sbyor ba shin tu legs so/ /dpal dus 'khor nyid kyi dbang du byas na yang / dus 'khor sna tshogs gtso bo 'di lha rigs rdo rje sems dpa' dang mi bskyod pa zung du 'jug pa las rdor sems gtso che ba tsam yin mod kyang / sku'i rnam 'gyur khro nyams can du yod pa'i phyir/ he ru ka'i cha shas su yang 'gyur ba dang / dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed ni he ru ka dngos kyang yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir yang rdor sems zhi ba las he ru ka'i lugs su byas na 'brel chags shing / dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'khor lo sdom pa lha rigs mtshungs pa dang / rdo rje bzhi dang rigs drug ston par mtshungs pa sogs/ phan tshun kha 'gengs byed na 'brel chags che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod mod/ rgyas par ma smos so/ /skabs 'di'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdag bskyed kyi tshul ma yin/ mdun bskyed kyi rigs su gtogs te/ rang las g.yin pa'i tshul gyis lha sgrub pa la/ phal cher du mdun bskyed kyi tha snyad 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /spyi bor bsgom pa ni/ rigs bdag gam rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa'i don dang / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis sdig sgrib bkru ba sogs la dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di la yang cho ga rgyas par na gdan pad zla ba sa bon dang / hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas pa las dam tshig pa bskyed/ rdo rje bzhi'am rigs drug byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs mchod/ dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod de rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ slar yang mchod bstod byed pa'o/ /cung zad rgyas pa ni/ dbu rgyan rang chas bsgoms nas/ dbang bskur gyi rna203—

skor rnams bor ba yin/ dkyus su bshad pa ni 'bring po'am bsdus pa yin te/thog ma nyid nas sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgoms pas/ dam ye dbyer med yin pa'i phyir ye shes dgug gzhug mi dgos la/ rang rigs mtshon byed rdor sems kyi dbu rgyan tsam byas kyang rung mod/ ngo bo nyid kyi rigs la rgyas btab med pas dbang bskur lta ci smos rigs bdag kyang nges bzung du mi dgos rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dgod pa yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje bzhi 'dus pa mtshon byed tsam yin gyi byin rlabs kho na'i don ma yin no/ /shin tu bsdu na rdor sems yab yum gdan dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed pa kho na ste/ spyir skyed chog rgyas bsdus bzhi po gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /'dir rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dus 'khor nyid la gtso bor grags pa yin mod/mngon brjod bla ma las kyang lte bar ye shes rdo rje 'god par bshad do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan 'dren pa 'di ni/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi rigs ma yin/ 'og tu sdig sgrib bkru ba'i dmigs pa dgos pa la/de'i don du byin brlabs bsdu ba yin no/ /yig brgya bzla ba'i skabs/ sngags don dang mthun par gsol ba 'debs pa yin yang / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis bkru ba'i dmigs pa 'di yang dmigs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo nas sdig sgrib sbyong ba la bsngags pa lta ci smos/ 'phral du'ang nad gdon sogs phan yon phra mo kha thag nye ba yang du ma yod do/ /yab kyi thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang / de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam nas pad+ma ra brgyud de yum gyi sku yang gang / yab yum gnyis kar gyi sku'i cha thams cad las —2slo—

bdud rtsi 'bab par bsgom pa yang yod/ dmigs pa de'i steng du/ yum gyi thugs kar yang sa bon sngags 'phreng bsgoms nas/ de las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kar gyi sku las bdud rtsi 'bebs pa yang yod/ sku'i sbyor mtshams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs pa yang yod/ yab rkyang ba'i sku las 'babs pa'ang yod de/ skabs 'dir de dag 'dam kha tsam spyir yin yang / dkyus su bshad pa nyid lag len gyi rgyun yin/lar rdor sems yab rkyang sems dpa'i skyil krung can la zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'bebs pa sogs yod pas gcig tu nges pa med de/ rang rang gi man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du dpyad pa med par bzung ngo / /bdag ni mi shes sogs tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug pa'i bshags pa ste/ sgom thengs 'di la stobs bzhi yang tshang ste/ rten gyi stobs las bshags yul ni ches mchog tu gyur pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs thams cad yin la/ rang rgyud kyi rten skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa ni/ thun gyi 'gor yang byed cing / sngags don bsam pa dang / bdag dang sems can thams cad ces sogs la'ang tshang / gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni lha bsgom sngags bzlas nyid yin/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /zhes pa mthol ba dang / bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /ces pa bshags pa yin te/ 'thol bshags de gnyis la/ sun 'byin pa dang / slar ldog pa gnyis tshang ste/ dam tshig 'gal nyams zhes pas ltung ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa dang / mi shes rmongs zhes pas sngar byas la 'gyod pa —205—

dngos bstan la/ de byung tsa na da ni nyes dmigs shes pas slar ldog ces pa'ang shugs la 'byung / skyobs mdzod cig zhes pa'ang da phyin chad mi bgyid pas rjes su gzung du gsol zhes par 'gro bas/ slar ldog pa'i stobs so/ /gsol 'debs gong ma 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshul yin/ phyi ma bshags pa dang 'brel bas bzod gsol yin no/ /jo bo rje a ti sha'i gsung gis/ gsang sngags kyi nyes lhung phra mo 'di rtag tu 'byung nye/ dper na sa phyogs rdul chen po gcig tu maṇ+ḍal phyis te bzhag na/ de ma thag rdul gyis thib thib 'gengs pa dang 'dra gsung pa la/ 'o na lam rgyud la skye ba'i dus tsam mi yong ngam zhus pas/ 'on kyang gsang sngags thabs la mkhas pa mang bas/ nyes lhung phra mo shin tu mang po yang / thabs sna res skad cig gis dag par 'gyur gsung nas rdor sems dang yig brgya'i sgom bzlas zab cing rgyas pa zhig gnang bar gda'/ 'di la brtson par byas na nyes lhung phra mo dang 'bring po rnams rtsa ba nas 'dag chen po rnams kyang mi 'phel zhing / mgo mnan te rim gyis byang bar 'gyur gsung / de sngon bod na gsang sngags pa so so la yig brgya'i gdams ngag mang du yod kyang /rang rang gi slob ma nyung shas re ma gtogs spyi la ma khyab/ jo bo'i gsung des rkyen byas nas/ sngags par gtogs so cog gsar rnying thams cad la chos 'di'i tso langs pa yin skad do/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i skabs su maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshul gyis lag len dang ngag 'don rnams byang ba'i rjes su/ go babs cung zad brjod dgos te/ go ba rags rim tsam med na dmigs pa bsgom mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de la chos 'di —206—

rgyud thams cad kyi thun mong pa yin zhing / 'dus pa la sogs pa bsdus rgyud shas che ba zhig la/ 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag logs pa med pas/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad mngon pa'i lugs ji bzhin byed/ bla med mang rab cig la me'i dkyil 'khor lhag por 'dod/ spyi rags pa mngon pa dang 'dra/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs nas 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag logs su rgyas par gsungs pa med kyang / dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dang /las tshogs kyi zhor la tshig zur gsungs pa rnams dus 'khor dang mthun no/ /des na 'jig rten khams mngon pa'i lugs dang 'dra bar bsgoms kyang /'gal ba med mod kyi/ gtso bo bla ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun dang / smin grol rgyud bshad brgyud pa gcig pa'i 'brel chags dang / gsung rab thams cad kyi mthar thug theg pa mtho ba'i dbang las/ dus 'khor gyi lugs su bsgom pa nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /des na maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi rten du/ rlung me chu'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsgom nus na'ang legs/ ma bsgoms kyang mi 'gal te/maṇ+ḍal gyi sa gzhi la chu me rlung gi bgros med par dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi zhes pa kho na 'don pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi char bsgom pa la'ang /zlum po phyed gshags kyi rnam pa byed pa/ dus 'khor rang lugs yin pas gtso che yang / dmigs pa'i skabs rnam pa gsal ba'i ched du/ mchod rten bang rim zlum po bzhi pa lta bu sgoms kyang mi 'gal te/ 'dir rgyas par ma spros/ des na sa'i dkyil 'khor gser gyi rang bzhin zlum po thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig de'i dbus su ri rab dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum/ rtsa ba'i rgya la ri'i —207—

snying po dpag tshad bcu drug dang / 'gram stegs khor yug la zheng dang dpangs su stong phrag gcig pa yin pas/ de'i rgya la thad kar brtsis na stong phrag bco brgyad yod/ ri rab ni mtshams de nas steng du cung zad je sbom du song zhing /dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum yod pa las/ phyed gong ma dpag tshad lnga bcu'i steng nas/ gdengs kha phyi la 'phyar ba/ rwa rnams skye ba'i gzhi snying po'i phyogs su srab 'thug la stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dbyibs zlum po phyir 'phags pa'i rtse khor yug je srab tu song ba'i dbus nas thad kar gzhal na dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa/ de'i steng du dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga'i dpangs gyen du 'phags pa'i ri'i rtse mo lnga dbus dang phyogs bzhi yod pa/ dper na rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa 'dra zer yang / me long gi steng du bshos bu lnga bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /ri rab de'i rtsa ba nas rwa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi kha dog ni/ shar in+d+ra ni la te kha dog sngon po/ lho pad+ma rā ga ste dmar po/ byang zla ba chu shel te dkar po/ /nub karka ta na ste ser po/dbus ma rka ta ste ljang khur gsal btab/ dmigs pa gsal zhing go nus na ri rab de la gling drug mtsho drug ri drug gis bskor ba sgom dgos pas/ de dag gi rnam gzhag 'chad dgos la/ blo 'khobs chung na re zhig de'i dmigs pa dor te yod par mos pa tsam bya/ gser gyi sa gzhi de la/ pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis lta bur mtshams bcad pa'i re kha gyen du 'phags pa/ dngos gnas la ri yin zhing / rnam pa gyang gis bcad pa 'dra ba zhig yod pa/ de lta bu'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yang chus khyab pa las/ dbus su gyen du 'phags pa'i gling rnams ni/ rgyud las/ sa'i steng du dpag tshad stong phrag rnams ni ri dang klu dang —208—

gza' dang phyogs rnams dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar lus 'phags po dbyibs zla gam rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bdun/ bcad kha nang du bstan pa/ lho 'dzam bu gling gru gsum rtse mo phyir bstan rgyar stong phrag brgyad/byang sgra mi snyan dbyibs zlum po rgyar stong phrag dgu/ nub ba glang spyod rgyar stong phrag bcu dbyibs gru bzhi'o/ /lus dang lus 'phags la sogs pa'i gling phran rnams la rgya tshad nges can ma gsungs kyang / dmigs pas bsgoms pa'i tshe/rang rang gi gling dbus ma las cung zad chung ba re bsgom dbyibs dbus ma dang 'dra/ 'dir sa'i khor yug dum bu bcu gnyis la so so'i dbus su ri bo ltar steng du 'phags pa'i mtshan ma zla gam la sogs par gsungs pa yod pa ste/ /da lta mi rnams spyod pa'i gling bcu gnyis yin la/ gling bcu gnyis zhes mi gsung bar dum bu bcu gnyis zhes gsungs pa'i skabs mang ba ni/ mtshan ma bcu gnyis po ma yin pa'i gling phran gzhan du ma yod pa yang 'du dgos pa'i phyir dang / de dag thams cad sdom pa gling chen po bdun gyi nang tshan gyi 'dzam gling chen po zhes bya ba'i gling gcig tu go dgos pa'i phyir yin te/ shar lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling chung ngur grags pa'i lto 'dzam bu gling dang byang sgra mi snyan sogs ni gling bdun pa 'dzam gling chen po'i nang sel yin gyi/ re re nas gling rang rkang tshugs pa ma yin pa la dgongs so/ /gling rnams la dngos po la kha dog nges pa can med kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i khams mtshon pa'i phyir/ shar gling gsum rlud ste nag go lho'i gsum me ste dmar go /byang gi gsum chu ste dkar go nub kyi gsum sa ste ser por sgom/ phyi lcags ri ni 'dir rdo rje'i ri —209—

zhes gsungs te/ sa'i khor yug gi mtha' la skor ba yin/ sngar 'og gzhi la chu me rlung gsum ma sgom na/ skabs 'dir yang de tshun chad ka gsal btab pas chog chu me rlung gi khor yug sgom mi dgos so/ /'dir cung zad rgyas par sgom na ri mtsho gling gi rnam gzhag ni 'di lta bu zhig ste/ rgyud las/ lan tshwa chang dang chu dang 'o ma zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho bdun te ri bo ni/ /'od sngon man+ta ra ri ni ṣa ṭa dang nor bu'i 'od dang dro ṇa bsil ri rdo rje'o/ /gling ni zla ba 'od dkar dag dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang / /drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun pa 'dzam bu mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ shar du rlung ni shin tu zlum por 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lto ru me ni gru gsum mo/ /byang du chu ni phyed kyi zla ba dag dang nub ni gser mchog sa ni chu yi gter gyi zur/ /zhes pa dang / chu gter drug po thams cad dag kyang zla ba zla ba gcig gis dman pa'i stong phrag re re ste/ /gling rnams dang ni ri rgyud mchog rnams dag kyang de lta'i stong phrag stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /'dzam bu gling gi yangs pa dag dang lan tshwa'i chu yi gter ni 'bum phrag phyed kyi tshad yin te/ /zhes gsungs te dbus kyi lhun po'i rtsa ba 'gram stegs zlum po de'i 'khor yug tu dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu nga bzhi/ dbus kyi thad kar gzhal na stong phrag bco brgyad pa de'i 'og gzhi ri rab kyi 'gram stegs la 'brel ba'i tshul gyi khor yug tu bskor ba'i sa gzhi/zheng du dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu pa zhig yod pa ni zla ba'i gling zhes bya/gling de'i phyi khor yug la 'obs kyi tshul gyis bskor ba/ kha zheng dpag tshad —210—

brgyad brgya dgu bcu pa ni/ sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya/ de'i phyi rol khor yug tu lcags ri zlum pos bskor ba lta bur/ 'od sngon zhes bya ba'i ris bskor ba ste/ri de'i sa mtshams kyi rtsa ba'i zheng srab 'thug la yang / dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu'o/ /des rigs 'gre ste/ ri de'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar 'od dkar gyi gling gi khor yug tu bskor ba dang / de'i phyi la mar gyi rgya mtshos khor yug tu bskor ba dang / de'i phyi nas man+ta ra zhes bya ba'i ris bskor ba sogs go bar bya ste/ ku sha'i gling dang / zho'i rgya mtsho dang / ri bo ni ṣa ṭa dang / mi'am ci'i gling dang / 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang / ri nor bu'i 'od dang / khrung khrung gi gling dang / chu'i rgya mtsho dang / ri bo dro ṇa zhes bya ba dang / drag po'i gling dang / chang gi mtsho dang /bsil ba'i ri'am/ kha ba'i ri ste de ltar na/ ri rab ma gtogs pa'i ri drugagling drug mtsho drug ste bco brgyad de dag ni zheng du dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu rer mnyam la/ dpangs kyi tshad gsal bar gsungs pa med/ bsil ri'i phyi rol ri'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar/ 'dzam gling chen pos khor yug tu bskor ba yin zhing/ 'on kyang gling chung bcu gnyis sogs gling chung mang po yod pa rnams ma gtogs/ bar lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i chu lag gis khyab pa yin/ 'on kyang sa dum bu bcu gnyis po re re la/ nang mtha'i rgya la dpag tshad khri nyis stong lnga brgya dang / phyi mtha'i zheng la nyi khri lnga stong re yod do/ /de phan chad lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho chu'i khor yug ni/ zheng dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed kyi tshad can no/ /bar gyi ri mtsho gling drug po ni/ yongs su bsdoms pa la phyogs rer dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug re'i zheng yod/ de dag ri rab kyi gdengs ka'i 'og tu chud pa/—211—

gdengs ka'i mtha' dang / bsil ba'i ri'i phyi logs steng 'og tu thad kar 'bab pa tsam bya'o/ /de la spyir maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa rnams la sa bon dang sngags sogs mang du 'byung yang / nyin re bzhin lan re tsam ma gtogs maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid kyi skabs maṇ+ḍal brgya stong mang po bsnyen pa'i tshul du byed pa la/ de lta bu mi 'grub pas/ deng sang maṇ+ḍal tshig tsam gyis 'bul ba 'di la thams cad phyag len mdzad/ de la tshom bu so bdun dang nyer lnga dang / nyer gsum ma dang bdun ma sogs rnam grangs mang po 'dug kyang / tshom bu mang nyung dang de dang mthun pa'i ngag gi brjod tshul mang nyung tsam ma gtogs/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'i phyir cho ga bsdus pa yin par 'dra zhing / tshom bu lhag po rnams dmigs pa gsal bar byed pa'i khyad tsam ma gtogs/ dmigs yul rgya che chung yang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na yang dpal ldan gsang 'dus las/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang nas/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lag len gyi dbang du byas nas rgyal srid rin po chen sna bdun/ dbang sngon sogs rin po che bdun gyi gter te/ brgyad po de sa bon las skyed cing sngags kyis 'bul bar maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga chen mo rnams las kyang bshad 'dug gang ltar yang skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' na thun gyi 'go 'jug gnyis su/ tshom bu so bdun ma lta bu tshig cung zad rgyas pa yang 'ga' shas 'bul na ni legs/ nges par dgos pa rang yang min/ dkyus ma grangs su bcad pa rnams gzhan kun la grags pa'i tshom bu bdun ma'i steng du/ sgra gcan dus me bsnan pa'i tshom bu dgu —212—

pa nyid la mdzad/ de la maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs phyin/ maṇ+ḍal rgyu rin po che las grub pa yin na chung yang mi to/ rdza dang shing sogs rgyu ngan na/ rgya che ba dgos zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung / de yang 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i dbang du byas/ ye ma 'byor na g.yam leb sogs kyis kyang rung gsung / tshom bu'i 'bru ni 'byor ldan yin na/ bskyar ldab mi byed par tshar re re bzhin gyis 'bru de zur du sbungs nas/ tshom bu'i 'bru gsar ba 'ba' zhig 'bul/ de lhar rim pas bsags pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod 'khru rnams bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul gyis rang gis longs mi spyod/ 'byor pa med na gcig po de bskyar gyin 'bul ba las 'os med/ dri bzang gi chus kyang byug ste 'byor pa dang bstun rgyu gang 'byor yin/ sngon bod 'dir bka' gdams pa'i maṇ+ḍal skam po dang / sngags pa'i maṇ+ḍal rlon pa zhes grags shing / mdo sngags kyi khyad yin tshul byed kyang /mdo sngags la skam rlon la khyad med/ brgyud pa so so'i phyag len gyis khyad cig yin par 'dug /'dir ni maṇ+ḍal legs par phyis pa sems kyi rang bzhin dri ma med pa dang / dri bzang gi chus byugs pa sems la byang chub kyi sems kyi rlan gyis khyab pa mar+sā/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi dang / dri bzang rgya mtshor yang bsgom mo/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe zhes pa'i skabs su/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i mtha' la rdo rje'i ri'am lcags ris bskor ba bsgom/ de rjes dbus su hu zhes pa maṇ+ḍal gyi bgegs bsal ba yin gyi/ sa bon hū las ri rab bskyed pa ma yin/'dir bsdus pa yin skad cig gis bskyed pa yin pas sa bon mi dgos/ sa bon rang byed na ha las ri rab bskyed pa yin gyi hu ma yin no/ /de'i tshe na ya —213—

las lus 'phags sogs tshom bu thams cad la sa bon byed do/ /'dir de ltar min/ dbus su ri rab kyi i bu bkod pa na/ dmigs pas gsal thebs shing spros pa la mos pas ri rab kyi rjes 'brangs sgom na mngon pa sogs kyi lugs ltar na/ gser gyi ri dang / rol mtsho rnams sam/ dus 'khor rang lugs ltar na gling drug /mtsho drug ri drug rnams kyang sgom/ de rnams mi shes pa dang / mi gsal ba dang / sgom par mi spro na ri rab kho nas chog go /tshom bu dgu ma'i dbang du byas na/ shar lus 'phags po zhes brjod pa dang shar du tshom bu gcig kho na 'god kyang / dmigs pas shar gyi gling gsum ga bsgom dbos/des gzhan gsum la'ang rigs 'gre/ de rnams kyi nang du tshom bu chung ba re re 'god/ dmigs pas ni gling gi nang du mi byed/ gling rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la zla nyi sgra dus bzhi 'god par bsam pa ni/ lhor nyi ma dang byang du zla ba spyi dang mthun/ shar du sgra gcan kha dog mthing nag nub tu dus me kha dog ser po/ de gnyis kar yang dwangs shing 'tsher la 'od zer 'phro ba/ /dbyibs zlum po'o/ /bzhi po de grub pa dang mnyam du gza' skar gyi tshogs mtha' dag kyang bsgom/ skor phyogs kyi rim pa g.yas skor du byas kyang chog mod kyi/ gtso cher rlung me chu sa'i dbye bas shar lho byang nub ces pa'i rim pa'o/ /dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa zhes pa'i skabs/ 'jig rten gyi khams ste mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon to nyer spyod rim gro pa sogs dgos 'dod thams cad kyis byur bur bkang ste 'bul bar mos pa ni nges par byed dgos la/ dmigs pa rgya che zhing gsal na 'jig rten gyi khams mang po zhig —214—

(spru don dgus bkang ste phul bar bsgoms nas/ nam mkhas gar khyab mchod pas bkang ste phul yod snyam pa'i mos pa tsam byed/ dmigs pa rgya chung na dngos su zhing khams gcig po de kha dmigs nas mkha' khyab tu phul snyam pa bya/maṇ+ḍal tshigs bcad ma/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum zhes sogs 'di bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud na med kyang spyir rgyud tshig yin/ slob dpon tsā ri ta dang / rnyog med dpal gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sogs na yod/ bdag gi zhes pa bdag gzhan dang / thub pa'i skyes mchog ces pa bla ma yi dam zhes par 'don par spos/tshig rkang snyoms pa'i phyir bzang po zhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bcug pa yin/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa'i lag len yin pa'i phyir gal che/ sa gzhi spos kyi sogs spyi 'gro de mi spro na ma byas kyang chog go /de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di snga ma la kha gso tsam mi byed par/ re re bzhin tshom bu snga ma bsal nas rting ma 'god/ dri chab kyang skam ras kyis byug ste rlon thag ma chad par 'byug pa sogs bla chos ma byas par sgrub pas lus kyi las dang / tshig dag nas brjod pa ngag gi las dang / re re bzhin dmigs pa dang bcas te 'bul ba'i bsam pa yid kyi las te/ sgo gsum gyi dge ba khyad par can cha tshang ba dang / dngos po chung yang dmigs pa dang bsam pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod pas/ dka' tshegs chung bus tshogs rgya chen po gsog thub pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can du snang zhing / maṇ+ḍal gyi mdo las/ ba lci chur bcas sgyin pa ste/ /byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /srog chags bsal ba bzod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson/ /bsam gtan der sems —215—

—skad cig ma/ /ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs byas pa'i/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang / /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag cing / /zla ba lta bur gzi brjid ldan/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ dkon mchog gi drung du maṇ+ḍal cha chang gcig byas pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kar gyi cha shas tshang bas/ ji skad du/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang / /rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang / /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi phan yon rnams kyang thob par 'gyur ba dang / gnas skabs su rigs phun sum tshogs pa skye/ gzugs mdzes nad med longs spyod che/ lhar skyes na lha gzhan las lhag pa dang / mir skyes na mi gzhan las lhag par 'gyur/ zla ba dang 'dra'i gzi brjid can zhes pa la/ gzi brjid che ba'i don stobs dang dbang thang dang shugs che ba yin/ yang nyi ma gzi brjid che yang tsha bas gdung bar byed pas stobs chen po gzhan la gnod pa'i dper 'gyur la/ zla ba ni yid du 'ong zhing tsha gdung sel ba'i phyir/ stobs r+ṣa po de gzhan la 'jigs skrag dang gzhan la gnod pa mi skyed cing shin tu phan 'dogs pa'i dpe'o/ /de ltar na bla ma bsten tshul lnga bcu pa las/ mchog tu gus pas dus gsum du/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas thal mos/ /bla ma ston pa bsnyen bkur zhing / /zhabs la spyi bos phyag dag bya/ zhes bshad pa dang / dpal don dam —216—

bsnyen pa las/ thun mtshams gsum du shin tu rnam par dag pa yis/ kha dang lag pa rkang pa dag ni bkrus byas nas/ /me tog yang dag blangs te bla ma'i spyan sngar ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu zlum po bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal la brtson par bya'o/ /thun bzhi'am/ gsum la sogs par maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu pa tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad dang sbrags pa de/ ci nus ci lcogs su 'bul/ ma tha yang thun re la brgya rtsa re 'bul bar bya'o/ /spyir sgom 'khrid pa gang la yang thun yun ring zhing / thun mtshams ni zas g.yo skol sogs mi dgos ka med rnams ma gtogs/ sos dal du 'dug pa dang / long gtam dang / don med rnam g.yeng gi bya ba mi byed de/ thun mtshams yun ring na ma bsgoms pa kho na yin pas/ ji ltar yun ring yang gnyid kyi bya ba phar bzhag la/ nyin mo'i thun gyi bzhi cha bas lhag pa'i thun mtshams mi bya'o/ /'on kyang dmigs bsal la/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i khrid kyi skabs bla ma'i bka' lung nos nas/ mchod rten bzhengs pa la sogs pa lus thog tu ci gal 'bab pa/ rnam g.yengs bzhad gad/ snyoms las le lor mi 'gyu ba'i dge las la dka' ba spyod pa'i rigs yin na/ de kha rang sdig pa sbyangs thabs yin pas/ de 'dra'i thun mtshams la yun ring du song yang skyon med pa yin/ 'dir yang de dang mtshungs pas/ thun mtshams su tshogs gyi sgo du ma nas gsog pa'i dbang du byas nas phyag 'bul ba dang / mchod pa bshams pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang byi dor gyi las sogs dang / rang gi longs spyod nas ma chags par dad pas gtong ba dang / lus thog tu ngal dub 'bab pa'i dge las sems rnam g.yeng —217—

gi dbang du mi gtong bar sgrub na/ tshogs gsog gi skabs 'dir thun mtshams yun ring yang skyon med do/ /bsags sbyang gi skabs 'di ma gtogs/ /sgom sgrub byed pa la dge las yin yang rnam g.yeng gi rigs rnams spong dgos na/gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gang zhig ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la zhugs nas/don du gnyer ba'i ting nge 'dzin che chung gang rung cig rgyud la skyes nges pa dang /de yang tshe 'di la rkyen gyis nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng ma thob kyi bar du bya ba gzhan bskyungs te sgom kho na la 'bad dgos la/ dmigs pa la brtan pa thob nas ni/ sgom des zin pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i rnam grangs rgya chen po la slob pa nyid/ spyi btang nas mchog yin mod/ gang zag gi blo'i rigs dang dgag dgos kyi dbang las/ sgom la brtan pa thob kyang spros pa lhur mi byed par mnyam bzhag nyid la sgril na chod che ba ka shin tu mang ngo / /shin tu ches skal pa dman pa 'bad pa chen pos yun ring bsgoms kyang / ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa 'ga' zhig tshe 'dir sgom skye ba'i re thag chad na ni/ re zhig bsags sbyangs kyi don du lus ngag gi tshogs bsag la 'bad pa nyid gnad che mod/ gang zag gi rigs 'ga' zhig sgom la brtson pas lo zla mang po song yang / re zhig nyams myong sna re yang mi skye ba la/ dus lan gcig nam zla'i drod phebs pa ltar nyams myong rlabs chen thog babs su yod pa yang yod pas/ da ni sgom mi skye'o zhes re thag gcod pa snga bar yang mi bya'o/ ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'dod pa'i bsags sbyang gi skabs 'dir/ bsags sbyang gi sgom pa nyid spyir bzang mod kyang / rnam g.yeng dang long gtam dang kyal ka sogs don med kyi las dang 'dres pa'i —218—

mchod pa skor bas las khur skyed sogs dge las su rlom/ kha yengs mig yengs la snying po med pas/ de bas thun gyi nyams len rang la sgril ba gal che'o/ /'dir tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ces bya ba la/ tshogs gsog thabs dngos ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi rnams yin mod kyang / 'dir ni skye ba snga ma'i las 'phro bsags khyab khyad par can yod na des chog kyang / de ni dkon la/ rang rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba dngos su bsags pa'i gzhi rten zhig med na ni/ dge ba'i bag chags tsam yod kyang 'phral du smin pa dang sad par mi nus/ de ma nus pas lam dngos gzhi'i nyams myong 'phral du skye ba dka' zhing bul la rlabs chung ba dang 'phel skyed mi 'byung ngo / /dge rtsa khyad par can gsar du skyed na ni sngar gyi bag chags kyang sad de/ nyams rtogs skye ba myur zhing stobs che ba yin no/ /tshogs gsog rgyu'i tshogs dngos ni/ ji skad du rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed/ /gzhan gyis nyon mongs med par 'khor/ /spyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes rdzos/ /rgyun du sgoms pa thob nas ni/ dge ba yang dang yang du sgrub/ /bstan pa'i tshogs gang yin nga/ ste/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa'ang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs ni gnyis te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /bsod nams kyi sgos kyi 'bras bu ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor bar sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshe/ gzhan —219—

don spyod pa la mthu dang ldan par 'gro ba'i lus dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa mngon par mtho ba rnams thob pa dang / mthar thug gzugs sku gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can kyi don byed pa yin la/ ye shes kyi rang 'bras ni/gnas skabs su sems can gyi don du 'khor bar spyod pa na/ nyon mongs med cing thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes kyis 'jug pa dang / mthar thug tu rang don chos kyi sku 'grub par byed do/ /de las bsod nams kyi tshogs su nges pa ni/sbyin pa dang tshul khrims gnyis yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs su nges pa ni shes rab yin zhing / phar phyin gzhan gsum la gnyis ka'i cha shas yod de/ bzod pa la gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang sdug bsngal dang len ni bsod nams/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ni ye shes gtso che/ brtson 'grus la yang bsod nams la rtsol ba dang ye shes la rtsol ba gnyis yod/ bsam gtan yang kun rdzob la dmigs pa bsod nams dang / don dam la dmigs pa ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /de ni gnas skabs ldog chas phye na tshogs gnyis tha dad pa'i rnam ga / zhag yin la/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas zin pa de'i tshe/ sher phyin tu ma zad sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga yang ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas/ thams cad ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs shig kyang yod/ gzhan lnga char la bsod nams kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhin du/ sher phyin las kyang bsod nams kyi 'bras bu 'phel ba'i phyir/ thams cad bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs kyang yod pas/ des na phyin drug thams cad bsod nams kyang yin la ye shes kyang yin zhes bya ste/ spyod pa dngos sam ngo bo'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis —220—

gcig tu rnam par bzhag pa zhes bya'o/ /spyir byang chub spyod pa la srid tshad kyi dbang du byas na/ so so rkyang pa ba gnyis dang gnyis ka yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa ste/ mu gsum yod byang chub kyi sems gyi zin zhing mi rtog ye shes kyis ma zin pa'i sbyin pa lta bu bsod nam/sa rkyang pa dang / so so skye bo'i dus na lus ngag gi spyod pa spangs shing stong nyid gcig pu la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lta bu ye shes kyi tshogs rkyang pa yin la/ so skye'i dus na mi rtog ye shes rjes mthun pas zin pa'i spyin sogs dang / stong pa'i nyams las shar ba'i snying rje sogs spros pa'i rnam pa can dang / stong nyid sgyu ma lta bu sogs tshogs gnyis zung 'jug rjes mthun pa'am/ zung 'jug gi sgrub pa'am/ rgyu'am zung 'brel yin no/ /'phags pa rnams kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / spyin sogs spyod pa thams cad ro mnyam du gyur pa ni/ tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dngos dang tshogs gnyis gzhi mthun pa yin no/ /dper na byang chub sems dpa'i gtong sems de/ sems can bde zhing smin par byed pas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang yin/ gtong sems de kho nas gdong thug gi dngos po rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i chos dang gang zag stong par rtogs pa'i phyir/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyang yin no/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon/ de'i tshe spyin pa'i ldog cha bsod nams dang / de kho na nyid rig pa'i ldog cha nas ye shes yin gyi/gtong sems dang de kho na nyid de gnyis rig pa rdzas tha dad med de ngo bo gcig yin/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /de lha bu'i bsod nams dang ye shes gang yin pa de yang / yang nas yang du sgrub cing rgyun du goms par byed pa dang /—221—

'dod don thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i phyir tshogs zhes bya ste/ sa khyu ta'i skad kyi sgra bshad las drangs pa'ang yin/ bod skad la yang don de gnas pa yin no/ /tshogs ni tshogs pa ste mang po gsog par 'os shing bsags na legs pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs zi byed dgos rgyu la tshogs pa'i ming gis btags pa'o/ /skye ba sngon du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang du bsags pa'i 'bras bu la spyod pa'i dge ba rlabs chen 'grub pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrubs kyang sla ba yin mod/ de ltar ma yin pa rnams kyis dge ba phra mo nas sgrub pa la 'bad dgos so/ /de dag ni tshogs gnyis spyi'i go don yin la/ dpal dus 'khor dang sems 'grel rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa khyad par gyi bzhed pas tshogs gsum zhes kyang gsungs te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / tshul khrims kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /bsod nams ni gtso bor snying rje chen pos gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa yin na/ spyod pa sbyin sogs spyi dang 'dra/ yang shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ bskyed rim dang las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams sngags lugs kyi khyad chos lhag po'o/ /tshul khrims kyi tshogs ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar du 'byung ba'i zhu bde 'gyur med thabs dang bcas pa de yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni spyir 'dra ba las/ mthar thug gi khyad chos rnam kun mchog ldan dang mi 'gyur ba zung du 'jug pa'o/ /de nyid pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yang yin te/ sbyin pa dang / thabs dang / smon lam rnams bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus gsum tshul khrims kyi tshogs/ bsam gtan shes rab stobs dang ye shes rnams ye shes kyi —222—

tshogs te/ tshogs gsum dang / phyin bcu rdzogs pa las bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus ga kum 'jug /ces gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang skabs 'dir 'phros don cung zad bshad na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims la/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims bya ba/ rang nyid dge chos kyi sgo thams cad spru bslabs ji sa/ rang rgyud yongs su smin pa zhig 'ong / sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims bya ba/ g.yin rnams kyang gang la gang 'tshams kyi dge ba sne ma 'gags pa la bkod pas/ sems can smin par byed pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gnyis po de 'grub tu rung bzhin du mi byed na/ byang chub sems dpa'i nyes pa yin tshul khrims la gnod pas/ skabs su bab na nges par sgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang dge ba sgo du ma nas bsgrubs pas tshogs bsag dgos te/bsam pa dag pa dang / yul mchog dang / dge ba'i las gtsang ma'i khyad par 'ga' las bya ba chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu rgya chen po 'byung ste/ dper na 'phags pa khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byed na de byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling gi dbang phyug gi bdag por 'gyur zhing / lus zhig nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar nga smra'o zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor zlum po la/ ba glang spyod kyi bdag po dang 'thab bral gyi lhar skye ba dang / zla gam la lus 'phags gling gi bdag po dang dga' ldan du skye ba dang / shing rta'i 223—

dbyibs byed na 'dzam gling gi bdag po dang 'phrul dgar skye bar gsungs/'dir dkyil 'khor zhes pa maṇ+ḍal yin zhing / mdo tshig 'di dag gis zhor la 'phang pa'i don mang po zhig ston te/ maṇ+ḍal gyi zhal zhal tsam byas pa dang / me tog tsam phul bas kyang / khams kyi rgyal phran nam/ rgyal chen ba'i rigs kyi lhar skye ba dang / maṇ+ḍal de dag gnyis ldan gsum ldan bzhi ldan du phul bas gling gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi'i bdag por 'gyur zhing / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skye ba yang don gyi go nus la/ der ma zad chos mngon par ma grags pa'i gling gzhan gsum du skyes pa'i 'khor los sgyur rgyal yang yod pa dang / spyir btang la sgra mi snyan pa dbang po rtul ba dang / 'dzam gling chung ngu ba dbang po rno bar grags kyang / gzhan gnyis la gling brjod med pa las/ 'dis ni byang gling nga las nub pa dang / de las shar pa dang / de las lho pa mchog tu gsung pa dbang po rno ba'i sgo nas mchog tu bzhag pa rnams kyang go bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du gtsug lag khang sogs phyags dar byas pa'i phan yon yang rang gi sems dang ba dang / gzhan gyi sems dang ba dang / lha rnams dga' ba dang /dge ba rgya chen po gsogs pa dang / lha'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba ste lnga'o/ /gzhan yang mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci song ba/ /de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis/ /lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid thob/ /su dag 'dir ni rgyal ba'i gzugs byed pa/ /de dag gzugs bzang yid 'ong yon tan ldan/ /dbang po bsdams shing 'od 'bar nyi ma bzhin/ /'jig rten dag na mig tu sdug par —224—

'gyur/ /thub pa'i mchod rten byed pa'i mi rnams ni/ /mya ngan yongs med lus kun brtan pa dang / /longs spyod mchog ldan rin chen mdzod dang ldan/ /dgra yi tshogs rnams kun kyang thub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / dal ba rnyed dka' thob gyur nas/ /skad cig gcig tsam bar du yang / /mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ /mi khom brgyad rnams spong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog la phyag btsal ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ mdog bzang mdzes dang tshig btsun dang / /'khor rnams zil gnon lha mi dga'/ /dam pa dang 'grogs gzi brjid che/ /longs spyod mtho ris thar pa thob/ /ces bya/ dkon mchog la thal mo sbyar ba kho na la yang rgya chen po'i khyim du skye ba len pa dang / gzugs bzang ba dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa snyom sogs pa phan yon bcu gsungs te/ mdo sde las rnam 'byed du blta'o/ /yang mdo las/ dri zhim 'khru mar rnams kyis mchod rten khru/ /spos dang me tog sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul/ /yid du 'ong bas mkhan po slob dpon bsten/ /de lus sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba dang / bla ma dge bdun rten gsum rnams la phyag 'bul ba/ skor ba byed pa/ mchod pas mchod nga// bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa/ re re la yang phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs pa ltar yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las kyang / sems can rnams ni byang chub tu/ /sems bskyed bcug cing brtan byas na/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni rtag tu thob/ /dad pas mi khoms 'gro mi 'gyur/ khrims kyis 'gro ba bzang por 'gro/ /stong pa nyid la goms pa —225—

yis/ /chos rnams kun la chags med thob/ /g.yo med pas ni dran pa thob/ /sems par byed pas blo gros te/ /bkur sti byed pas don rtogs ldan/ /chos srung shes rab can du 'gyur/ /chos nyan pa dang sbyin pa dag /sgrib pa med par byed pa yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'grogs pa nyid/ /'dod pa myur du thob par 'gyur/ /ma chags pas ni don 'grub ste/ /ser sna med pas longs spyod 'phel/ /nga rgyal med pas gtso bor 'gyur/ /chos la bzod pas gzungs thob bo/ /snying po lnga rnams byin pa dang / /'jigs la mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /bdud rnams kun gyis mi tshugs shing / /stobs po che yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /mchod rten mar me'i 'phreng ba dang / /mun pa dag tu sgron me dang / /mar me 'bru mar sbyin pa yis/ /lha yi mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten mchod par rol mo dang / /dril bu dag ni phul ba dang / /dung dang rnga ni rab phul bas/ lha yi rna ba thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'khrul pa mi gling zhing / /yan lag nyams pa rnams mi brjod/ /sems ni rjes su bzung bas na/ /gzhan gyi sems ni shes pa thob/ /lham dang bzhon pa byin pa dang / /nyams chung bkur bar byed pa dang / /bzhene pas bla ma bkur ba yis/ /mkhas pas rdzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur/ /chos kyi ched dang de bzhin du/ /chos gzhung don dag dran pa dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa dri med pas/ /tshe rabs dran pa thob par 'gyur/ /dngos rnams ngo bo nyid med par/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /mngon shes drug pa zag pa kun/ /zad pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid shes mnyam ldan pa/ /snying rjes brlan pa —226—

bsgom pa yis/ /rnam pa mchog ldan rgyal bar 'gyur/ /thub dbang rin chen phul ba yis/ /mtha' yas 'od ni rnam par 'phro/ /zhes gsungs/ btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyings kyis kyang / mi 'tshe ba yis lha dang mi/ /lha min rnams su tshe ring 'gyur/ /'tshe bas thung ngur skye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'tshe ba rnam par spangs/ /gang zhig 'di la zas sbyin pas/ /tshe dang mdog dang stobs ldan zhing / /dpal dang ldan zhing nad spangs pa/ /rtag par bde dang ldan pa 'gyur/ /gang zhig gos ni sbyin byed de/ /'dzes bcas gzugs bzang longs spyod ldan/ /brjid can srog chags rnams la sdug /gos rnams kyang ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di la rab dga' ba'i/ /sems kyi gnas ni spyin par byed/ /lus can de la khang bzang ni/ /'dod pa kun dang ldan pa 'byung / /zhes dang / gang zhig rtag par yid dga' bas/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' bzhin byed/ /phan dang mi phan ston pa'i mi/ /de yi tshig ni btsun par 'gyur/ /gzhan brnyes pa yis smad par 'gyur/ /zlog pa yis ni mthon por 'gyur/ /bde ba chen pos bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal chen pos sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhes dang /gang zhig bdag bde mi 'dod cing / /yongs su bzung pa mi dga' ba/ /de ni gza' rnams dag gi mchog /rgyal chen bzhi pa nyid du 'gyur/ /pha ma pha tshan gtso bo yang / /bkur zhing gtong dang bzod par ldan/ /'thab mo la ni dga' ba gang / /de ni sum cu rtsa gsum skye/ /rtsod par mi dga' 'thab mo la/ /yid ni dga' bar mi byed pa/ /gcig tu dge la brtson pa gang / /de dag 'thab bral nyid du 'gro/ /thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang / khres rab ldan zhing thar pa —227—

'dod/ /yon tan dag la dga' ba'i mi/ /de dag dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /mi gang rang nyid dul ba la/ /zhugs shing tshul khrims 'bogs pa yang / /spro ba che dang ldan pa ste/ /gdon mi za bar 'phrul dgar 'gro/ /sems can gang zhig mi dman mchog /spyin dang dul dang yang dag sdom/ /phul byung yon tan ldan gyur te/ /nges par gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'gro/ /tshul khrims kyis ni mtho ris thob/ /bsam gtan gyis ni khyad par 'gyur/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /mthar ni yang srid med par 'gro/ /chags dang bral dang bsod nams thob sto/de bzhin sdig pa'ang spong bar byed/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed dang / /gzhan la gnod pa spong ba ni/ /bsod nams yin no bzlog pa sdig /bdag nyid chen po de skad gsungs/ /zhes sogs mang du 'byung zhing / 'di tsam gyis mtshon nas mdo dang bstan bcos rnams nas/ tshogs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa dang / dge ba'i phan yo na dpag tu med par gsungs pa rnams rig par bya'o/ /des na dge rtsa sna re la chog shes mi byed par/ tshogs kyi sgo rnam grangs mi 'dra ba du ma nas ci nus su bsags par bya'o zhes brjod/bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa phog zin pa'i rjes su/ chos thun rting ma gzhan la go babs cung zang/ 'chad par spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ de la don tshan dang po slob dpon dang slob ma'i mawo nyid spund pa ni/ ji skad du/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /rang bstod bla ma slob mar ni/ /blo dang ldan pas mi bya'o/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtse —228—

ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /rab tu dang zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes pa 'di bla ma lnga bcu par yang 'byung mod kyi/ dri med 'od du lung drangs 'dug pas rgyud tshig cig yin par gsal lo/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg la lhag par gnas/ /de nyid bsgom zhing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral ba bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs/ /slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o/ /zhes bla ma'i yon tan dang / nga rgyal dang ldan bro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnam 'dral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ /slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog bi bde ba'i gnas la sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang ldan zhing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ /zhes skyon gyi rnam ga theg dang / zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes/ thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus shing g.yo ba min pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin tu sped/ /gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma de nyid bla ma shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdu bya ba/ /shes rab dbang la sogs pa'i rgyur te gzhan zhes bya ba —229—

slar yang 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur/ zhes slob ma'i mtshan nyid rnams gsungs/ de la slob dpon gnyis te/ mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa ni slob dpon mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / skyon spangs yon tan can gyi mtshan nyid thams cad ma rdzogs kyang med mi rung gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis so/ /de bzhin du slob ma'i mtshan nyid rab 'bring tha ma'i dbye bas gsum du 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i yon tan la/ dbang bskur bas dam tshig thob pa dang / de nyid bcu shes pa la sogs pa/ gsang sngags rang gi khyad chos ci rigs pa ma gtogs/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid spyi rnams theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyi dang 'dra bas/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid mdo sngags gnyis la mi 'dra ba chen po ni med do/ /de dag las snying rje med cing zhes sogs skyon bdun po de ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i skyon yin te/ slob dpon skyon de dag shas cher spyod pa yin na bla mar mi bya la/ de dag cha phra mo'ang spangs pa ni mchog yin mod kyang deng sang rnyed par dka'o/ /skyon bdun las lnga'am drug spangs na/ gnyis sam gcig lta bu yod kyang nyes pa mi bskyed pa'ang yod mod/skyon de dag gi nang nas snying rje med pa kho na skyon che bas de spangs pa gal che'o/khro ba dang gdug pa'i khyad par ni 'phral 'phral khro skyen pa khro ba dang / zhe ba rnag cing 'khon 'dzin dam pa ni gdug pa'o/ /g.yin dngos bstan rnams go sla'o/ /de rnams la bshad pa'i rnam grangs cung zad mi 'dra ba ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ brtse med zhing las byed pa gang / khro zhing gnad du bsnun par byed/ /gdug pa dge slong skye bo ldang / khengs pa shes pa ngan pas khengs/ /'dod chen —230—

spyad bya min don gnyer/ khren tu myong 'thungs ma bsdams pa/ /rang la bstod pa 'dir brjod cing / /yon tan can la skyor 'byin byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / 'jam dpal gyi blta 'dod mdor bstan las/ brtse med sha za ba la gsungs/ khro ba dga' bar bsnun byed dang / /gdug pa legs pa'i skye bor sdang / khengs pa ye shes spangs pa'o/ /chags pa lha yi dkor la spyod/ /ma bsdams shin tu chang 'thung ba/ /rang bstod stong pa nyid lam la/ /smod cing smod pa byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de dag la 'ga' zhig de dang de'i ngo bo bshad pa'ang yin la/ phal cher mtshan gzhi gzung bar snang ngo / /slob ma mchog la ni skyon de dag sngar nas spangs pa dgos kyang / spyir slob ma la ma nges te da lta skyon de dag shas cher spyod du zin kyang / slar chos kyi sgor zhugs bla ma la brten nas skyon de dag rim gyis spong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na da ltar snying rje med pa yin yang / slar snying rje skyer rung ba sogs blo bsgyur nus shing rgyud bcos su rung na slob mar sten du rung pa'i phyir ro/ /brtan zhing zhes sogs yon tan drug kyang dpon slob gnyis ka'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'di la'ang slob dpon la ni de rnams tshang ba dgos/ slob ma la ni skyes stobs la yon tan ci rigs pa tshang na/ lhag ma slar glo bcos te phyis yon tan skyer rung ba'i rigs rnams bzung ngo / /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ zhes pa man chad slob dpon kho na'i yon to te/ sngags rgyud kyi sbyor ba ni sngags dang de'i lag len te las tshogs dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi ming ngo / /de nyid bcu ni/dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stangs stabs 'dug stangs bzlas —231—

brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las la sbyor/ /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa ste/ /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma rdo rje bzlas pa dang / /drag shul sgrub pa'i sbyor ba dang / /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed ni rgyud shes pa dang / dang ba'i bdag nyid ni slob dpon rang nyid dad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ chos las bshad pa'i blang dor las mi 'da' ba'o/ /tshig don gzhan rnams go sla/ thun mong gi rdo rje slob dpon 'di dag gi mtshan nyid la/ dad pa dang ldan pa dang / dam tshig ma nyams pa dang /bsnyen pa la sogs pas lha mnyes par byas pa dang / chos gang la brten nas slob ma de rjes su 'dzin rgyu'i chos de la mkhas pa rnams med du mi rung pa'o/ /dang por yang dag bsten bya sogs kyi dbang du byas nas/ dam tshig dang ldan pa ni/ spyir sngags sdom thob la ma nyams pa'i steng du/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig rigs drug gi sdom pa lta bu la/ phyi drang don dang nang nges don gyi dam tshig yang dag par spyod pa ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub man chad kyi don du/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag tsam zhu ba yin na/ phyi'i dam tshig la spyod pa kho nas kyang chog cing /mchog 'dod pas rdzogs rim don du gnyer na ni/ nang gi dam tshig la gnas pa'ang nges par dgos so/ /mu stegs dang theg dman gyis mi phyed pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa ste sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yin la/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni sngags kyi lam stegs yin pas/ sngags kyi nang du 'dus/ lam 'dis gzhan la ma ltos par —232—

rang dbang du sangs rgyas thob nus pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la zer/ de la lhag par gnas pa ni gsang sngags la yid ches pa'i sgo nas lam gzhan mi 'tshol ba'o/ /de kho na nyid ni/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim ste rim gnyis sgom pa dang / dri ma ni nyon mongs te/ nyon mongs dug lnga shes chung ba dang / bzod pa'i ngang tshul ni/ tshe 'di'i bde sdu ga la ma ltos par rang gzhan gyi don du chos spyod pa dang / sngags kyi lam la zhugs shing lam kyi ye shes ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes pa dang / chos ston pa'i nus pa yod cing / snying rje dang phan sems kyis slob ma rnams la lam ste chos sbyin pa'am ster bar byed cing / de nyid kyi dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa yang yin no/ /de kho na nyid rlung dbu mar 'gags pa dang / stong gzugs kyi ye shes la bsten nas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob na rab/ de min na'ang zhu bde 'gyur med kyi tshangs spyod dang ldan pa'o/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa zhes pa'i don/'grel chen gyi dngos bstan las/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa la gsungs te/ de yang yon tan gzhan rnams kyis kyang byed mod kyi/ de kho na nyid las tshangs spyod grub pa ni/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i rim pa grub pa nas 'byung zhing / 'dzin pa thob na bdud dang nyon mongs la sogs nyams zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rang rgyud kyi bdud bzhi cung zad choms pa yin la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob na ni rtsa ba nas 'joms par byed de rang la yon to 'di yod pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas slob ma rnams la lam spyin pas ni/ gzhan rgyud kyis bdud bzhi yang 'joms par byed do/ /dngos bstan yi ge'i don ltar na/ yon to de dag ldan pa'i rdo —233—

rje slob dpon de ni/ bdud rigs kyi 'byung po sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa rnams 'joms shing 'dul bar byed pa la/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang mtshungs zhes pa ste gong gi /lha'i / lta'i bu'i bdud 'joms par 'dus mod kyang / 'chad tshul cung mi 'dra ste snga ma ni rang dang gzhan bdud kyi las 'dod pa tha mal pa'i chags srid las zlog pa'i don yin la/ 'dir ni 'byung po'i gnod pa srung ba dang bzlog pa'i don yin no/ /'grel chen las gzhung gi khog don dbyings che ba de ma go dogs nas bshad par mdzad/ sgra ji bzhin pa ni go sla bas rgyas bshad ma gsungs pa'o/ /slob dpon de ni rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa'i skur sa la rab tu grags pa ste/ sprul pa'i sku dngos kyang yod la de min na'ang phal cher byin gyis rlabs pa'i sprul par nges so/ /de dag ni slob dpon la dgongs pa'i yon tan rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /nga rgyal dang ldan zhes sogs la nor dang / dbang thang dang / thos pas khengs pa dang / de nyid bcu sogs bya ba dang / lam ting nge 'dzin phra mo dang / gzugs dang rigs la sogs pas nga rgyal ba ste/ de yang gong ma la ltos na/ nga rgyal bral bar 'gyur zhing / rang bas dman pa'i skyon la ltas na/ nga rgyal skye ba'i phyir na/ gang nga rgyal shas che ba de ni/ mchog gi yon tan la dad pa mi bsgoms shing / rang dang mtshungs pa'am dma' ba rnams la brnyas shing khyad du gsod pa nyid gyi phyir/ nga rgyal gyi khengs pa de ni dam pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa skyon che bar gsungs so/ /de bzhin du yang yang khro ba'i ngang tshul can gyi 'grogs dka' ba dang / gsang ba'i dam tshig dbral te/ rtsa rlud dang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang lha dang sngags dang —234—

las tshogs la sogs pa skye bo phal pa'i nang du/ dam dum rab rib shod kyin ngom pa dang / bza' bya ma yin pa skye bo'i mngon du bsten pa dang / bgrod bya ma yin pa bsten zhing de dag chos zab pa dang theg pa mtho ba yin par ngo 'phyar ba ni/ dam tshig rnam par dral ba ste gsang sgrogs dang log pa'i lam la spyod pa'o/ /de bzhin du dkon mchog gi rdzas la brkam zhing / gzhan yang nor la shin tu chags pa dang / man ngag mchog ma thos pa dang / rang gi spyod pa dang mthun pa tsam snying la bzhag nas log chos chos su ston pas slob ma bslu ba dang / mchog gi bde ba'i gnas mi 'gyur ba'i thabs mi shes pa dang / dbang skur med par rgyud dang man ngag 'chad pa dang / bza' btung sogs longs spyod la ha cang sred che ba dang / chang 'thung sogs kyi rkyen las bag med pa la dga' ba dang / dbang po gnyis sbyor las 'dzag bde la shin tu chags pa ste/ slob dpon du 'gyur ba la gegs byed pa'i skyon de dag go /zab cing sogs kyi don slob ma'i yon tan te/ zab rgya stong nyid snying rje la sems pa dang/ bla ma'i nges pa dam sdom srung ba la dga' ba dang / rdzas la ma chags pas sbyin pa ga༈nga ba'i ngang tshul can dang / dkon mchog gi yon tan shes shing dad pa che ba dang /'bras bu thar pa kho na la yid brnags pa dang / rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa'i blang dor la gus pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i lam dang man ngag gis sems g.yo bar mi nus pa dang / de kho na nyid man ngag thob pa shin tu gsang zhing sbed pa dang / dge 'dun gyi rdzas za ba la dga' ba dang / mi dge bcu sogs chos dang 'gal ba don du gnyer ba'i grogs ngan dang 'grogs pa la mi dga' ba rnams —235—

so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas med du mi rung ba ni/ dam tshig bsrung nus pa dang sdig pa'i grogs po sbangs pa'o/ /yon tan de dag phal cher dang ldan na rdzogs rim kyi snod yin la/ gtso bo gnyis po kho na dang ldan na yang bskyed rim gyi snod yin/ de tsam yang med pa la bla ma bsten na/ skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi lnga tsam gyi snod dang ldan pa ni yod do/ /de ltar slob ma dang bla ma'i mawo nyid rags pa bstan zin nas/ dus kyi skyon gyis skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs tshang ba'i slob dpon rang yang rnyed dka' ba dang / rnyed du zin kyang rang gi blo ma dag na yon tan dang ldan pa la yon tan yod par mi mthong / skyon med pa la skyon du mthong / skyon yin pa skyon du mi mthong / yon to ma yin pa yon tan du mthong / yon tan med cing skyon dang ldan pa rnams skyes bu mchog tu mthong bar 'gyur te/ skye ba snga mar las ngan bsags shing skal ba dman pa'i dbang gis so/ /de ltar yang / mkhas rnams yon tan la gus kyi/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug sogs la min/ /yon tan med la gang gus pa/ /de blun mi dge'i las las skyes/ /zhes gsungs/ yon tan rdzogs pa ma rnyed na/ gong du smos pa ltar med mi rung gi mtshan nyid tshang ba 'tshol dgos shing / 'khrid zab mo'i skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi zhal thugs dang zhal la gnas pa de dgos so/ /don tshan gnyis pa 'brel ba brtags tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa ste/de yang dpon slob phan tshun 'brel ba brtag pa ni/ chos kyis ma sbrel gong du bya dgos kyi/ sngar brtags sam ma brtags gang yin yang / chos kyi 'brel ba thob nas skyon mi rtog par gus pas bsten dgos te/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam —236—

thos pa la'ang / gal te bla mar mi 'dzin na/ khyi yi skye ba brgyar skyes te/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na phyis kyi skye bo mang po zhig sngags chos la dam tshig yod do skad pa'i kha bshad byed/ srung ni de la'ang mi srung /mtshan nyid pa la dam tshig mi yong zer zhing / mdo chos mang du thos pa'i bla ma la'ang ma gus pa dang brnyas pa dang bskur sti ma yin pa ji tsam byas kyang nyes pa med pa skad smra ba mang du snang ste/ bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa kho na'o/ /des na sngags chos kyis ma sbrel ba la dam tshig gi ming 'dogs mi byed pa tsam yin gyi/ don gyi steng nas phal cher 'dra la/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thos pa'i bla ma dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud thos pa'i bla ma gnyis nang sel du 'doms na/yul gnyan mi gnyan gyi khyad cung zad tsam yod mod kyang / spyir 'gangs la khyad cher med/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis so sor thos pa'i bla ma la'ang des rigs 'gre ste/ mdor na sdug gsog pa po slob ma ngan pa ste/ spyir nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus dam tshig thob pa yin na ni/ des sngags chos zhus pa ma yin la/ mdo lugs theg pa che chung gang yin yang rung ste/ de lta bu zhus pa'i bla ma de la sdig bsags na/ spyir nyes pa che bar ma zad sngags kyi dam tshig kyang nyams pa yin te/ rgyud rnams las kyang / slob dpon mi smad/ bla ma'i thugs mi— dkrug ces gsungs kyi/ rtsa lhung dang po'i yul du rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i nges gzung ma mdzad pa mang pa'i phyir ro/ /slob ma de nyid sngags kyi dbang su la'ang ma zhus dam tshig ma thob na ni/ slob dpon tsam yin yang kho rang gi rdo rje slob dpon du ma song ba'i phyir/ sngags pa'i slob dpon sngags chos kyis —237—

sbrel ba zhig la smad na/ byang chub sems dpa' la smad pa'i sdig pa chen po rtsa ltung dang phyogs 'dra nges 'byung mod kyang / dam tshig nyams pa'i ming rang ni mi thob ste/ kho rang gis dam tshig len ma myong bas nyams rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rtsa lhung gi tha snyad thob par 'gyur ba la lhung ba byed mkhan rang nyid sngags la zhugs pa zhig dgos kyi/ ltung ba gsog pa'i yul sngags chos kyis sbrel ba kho na mi dgos par ma zad sngags pa yin yang mi dgos so/ /gnad 'di ma go bas dam tshig nyams pa ni/ mkhas par rlom pa dang chen por rlom pa la yang shin tu mang ste/ da ster na glo bo mkhan chen bsod lhun lta bu'o/ /de yang khong gi lo rgyus khong rang gis brtsams pa na/ kho bos 'jam dbyangs chen po la mdo chos zla ba dgu'i bar du zhus kyang / sngags chos chen po zhu ma myong / phyis 'jam dbyangs chen po dang nged lugs ma legs kyang dam tshig gi sel yod pa med/ dper na/ rang re rnams kyi bla ma gong mas kyang / rin po che tsong kha pa la bka' gdams lam rim sogs mdo chos mang po zhus kyang / phyis dgag pa dang skyon brjod mang po mdzad 'dug pa zer ba yod 'jam dbyangs chen po zer ba de paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan yin/ bla ma gong ma zer ba de/ rje ngor chen kun bzang la zer bar 'dug khong gi rnam thar 'di shogs chen zhig gda'/ go ba myangs bas dpon slob bla rabs mang po zhig tu dam tshig mi srung ba'i phyag len gyi rgyun yod zer ba zhig byung ngo / /yang rang dang dngos brgyud gang gi sgo nas kyang chos kyi 'brel ba med na rang gi bla mar mi bgrong / brgyud pa'i bla ma yang rtsa lhung gi yul du mi 'jog smad na lar gyis nyes pa ni che mod/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla —238—

ma ma yin yang / spyir skyes bu dam pa smad pa rang la nyes pa dpag tu med/ sgos su byang chub sems dpa' dang / yang sgos su gsang sngags 'dzin pa yul tshes gnyan te 'phros pa'i don no/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ don tshan gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngos gzung ba ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bya ba yod cing / skal ldan rnams tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs gal che shos shig 'di yin no/ /zhes kun la grags pa ni don la gnas nges pa zhig yin par 'dug de yang bla ma dam pa la gus pa byed tshul dang / drin dran pa dang / rnyed bkur rim gro'i bya ba sogs 'phral spyod kyi sgo nas bla ma bsten tshul la mdo sngags theg pa che chung la khyad tsam med/ chos 'dul ba dang /theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams las gzigs pas gsal/ dge ba'i bzhes gnyen bsten pa las yon tan thams cad 'byung tshul yang 'dra/ tha na mu stegs dra ma tshun chad kyang phyogs mtshungs ste/ khong rang rnams kyi las tshogs dngos grub 'gru/ba pa yang bla ma gus par bsten pas byin rlabs zhugs pa las 'byung ba yin pa 'dug /'on kyang khyad par 'di yod de/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bla ma sgom pa'i ming yin/ de yang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa yid la byed cing / de la dmigs nas mos gus rgyun mi 'chad par rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di lam dngos gzhi'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba cig tu 'jog pa ni spyir gsang sngags dang / sgos su rnal 'byor bla med las rtsal du bton pa yin gyi/ theg pa 'og ma rnams la yongs su ma grags pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bla ma'i —239—

byin rlabs lam du byed ces pa yang gtso che ba dang rags bshad kyi dbang du byas na shin tu 'thad do/ /don tshan bzhi pa mos gus ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma ste sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa yin pa yang srid/ ma yin tha mal pa yin du chug kyang / rdo rje slob dpon de'i sku gsung thugs la yi dam gyi lha rnams rjes su zhugs pa'i tshul kyis 'gro don mdzad pa yin pas sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pa lta bu ni yin/ de mnyes na sangs rgyas mnyes/ de la sdig bsags na sangs rgyas la sdig bsags par 'gro /de mchod pas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i phyir slob ma'i sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ ma 'ong rdo rje 'chang ba ste/ /de la brnyas byed sems can gang / /de yis nga la brnyas byed pas/ /ngas ni de kun dus su spong / /zhes dang / 'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /nga ni de yi lus gnas te/ /sgrub po gzhan la mchod pa len/ /de mnyes de yis rang gi rgyud/ /las kyi sgrib pa dag byed do/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang mos gus bsgom pa'i tshul ni rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ dngos po la su gang yin rung so so skye bo'am/ 'phags pa slob pa lta bu dang/ dge ba'i bzhes gnyen phal pa sogs su blta ba ma yin/ sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom dgos don la sangs rgyas gcig dang mang po la khyad med kyang / mos gus 'jug tshul la khyad yod pas sangs rgyas kyang gcig gam gnyis lta bu ma yin/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin/ de'i phyir chos dang dge 'dun kun —240—

yang 'dus/ de bas na bdag gi bla ma 'di dngos gnas la dkon mchog kun 'dus/ bla ma nyid dkon mchog gsum/ dkon mchog gsum nyid bla ma yin/rang re'i snang ngo dang bstun na/ dkon mchog gsum pas kyang bla ma bka' drin che/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyir ta bzang ste/ bdag la zhal mi ston gsung mi 'byon/ sangs rgyas dang / yi dam dang / byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs dngos su byon kyang rung / bdag la dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa las lhag po mdzad rgyu dang ston rgyu med/ de dag dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba med dus 'dir/ de rnams kyi mdzad rgyu thams cad bla mas mdzad pa yin bka' drin rang che'o snyam/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su shes nas yon tan mtha' med pa'i dad pa dang / bka' drin shin tu che bar shes pa gnyis 'dzom na mos gus kyi ngo bo go lugs sgom lugs bzang ba yin/ go yul bzang po de 'dra zhig yod pa'i lugs byas kyang / skabs skabs su min pa bla ma mi dran par brjed/lan re dran pa'i skabs kyang ba sbu g.yo nus pa'i gdung shugs mi 'byung na/ go ba tsam la lus pa yin/ nyams rtogs 'phral mar skyed thub pa de min/ gdung shugs drag po tha mal gyi snang ba gzhan 'gog nus pa/ rig pa bsgyur thub pa zhig byung na/ byin rlabs 'phral du 'jug nyon mongs glo bur du 'gag ye shes skad cig gis 'bebs/ de lta bu yang yang dran pas rtag tu sgoms par 'gro goms pa las skyon thams cad spong zhing yon to thams cad skye ba yin/sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba med na/ phyogs wo dang pho rus dang / yid 'ong gi gdung shugs yod kyang / zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog yin pas grol —241—

mi thub/ dge bzhas phal pa dang grub thob phal par brtse ba'i dad pa yang rnam rtog 'jig rten pa ka yin/ skye bo blun pos bla ma sangs rgyas zer ba zhig yod de/ de yang mi jo bzang gcig gam/ smad bud gcig gam/ zas nor gyis phan 'dogs byed pa zhig la sangs rgyas zer ram/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshig tsam min pa blo rtse brtad 'tshams ci yang med/ de 'dras sems rgyud grol ba la phan pa zhig kyang med des na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shes nas/ de nyid bla ma la tshang ba'i mos gus dgos pa yin/ de ltar bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa ste/dmigs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog sangs rgyas la dmigs pa yin pas lam sgom pa thams cad kyi snying po yin/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug sgos su rang re'i bla ma de la zhus pa'i yi dam rnams kyi byin rlabs 'phral rang la myur du 'jug bka' drin dran pa med na/ spyir byas pa mi gzo zhing / ngo tsha khrel med de byur chags nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/bsod nams dang dpal dang g.yang dang dge legs thams cad phyags ma btab pa bzhin nyams 'gro/ sgos su chos thob pa drin du mi sems pa de/ chos la yang rtsis med dad pa med pa yin pas/ 'bad pa byang tshad don med du 'gyur/yang sgos su rtsa ltung dang po'i yid kyis gos pa yin la/ bka' drin dran pas dge legs thams cad kyi gzhir 'gyur zhing / gus pa chen po rang shugs kyis skye ba yin no/ /de ltar na sangs rgyas su shes pa/ bka' drin dran la/ gdung shugs drag pa/ yang yang ma brjed par dran pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i mos gus yod na mos gus tshad du phyin pa zhes bya/ des na rdo rje slob dpon —242—

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pas mos gus de lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma bsgoms shing gsol ba btab na/ thabs g.yin med kyang /mchog thun mong gi 'dod don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /don tshan lnga pa phan yon lung dang sbyar ba ni/ de yang dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes pa dang / skyu 'phrul drwa ba las kyang / slob dpon ji ltar blta zhe na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de nyid ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan gzung / /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ /yon tan gzung bas dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyis ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma'ang mi 'gom ste/ /mchod rten bzhag dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las kyang / /slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bus/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ dusakyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ston pa po rdo rje slob dpon ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ji lta ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang po'i sangs rgyas ji lta ba bzhin du/thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon klu —243—

sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga las kyang/ ri dbang rtse las 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'dod kyang ni lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'dod kyang ni grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon gyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon kyis ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / dpal sa ra has kyang / bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes dang / in+d+ra bhu ti'i ye shes grub pa las kyang / skya ba 'dzin pa med par ni/ /gru yis pha rol 'gro mi 'gyur/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang / /bla ma med par srid mthar min/ /zhes dang / mthu stobs dbang phyug birnya bas kyang / bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin dge 'dun bla ma ste/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'cha / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /bsten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub bde chen thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ mdor na dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla mar gsungs pa'i lung khungs mtha' yas so/ /da lta mngon sum gyis grub pa yang / rtsa ba'i bla ma la dad pa med pa rnams/ mi 'dod pa du ma thog tu 'bab pa dang / bla ma gus pas bsten pa rnams la/ bde skyid snyan gsum rang shugs kyis 'byung ba mthong ngo / /gzhan yang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung las 'di —2yo—
