skad ces/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'jugabyang chub sems dpar mthong na byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs dang / grub thob tu mthong na grub thob kyi byin rlabs/ so so skye bo'i dge bshes bzang por mthong na/ de dang mthun par byin rlabs 'jug ste/ lar mos gus med na byin rlabs ye mi 'jug go /zhes gsung pa ltar yin no/ /don tshan drug pa lam zab mo zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ bla ma'i mos gus med na dngos grub lta ci smos/ yon tan kun gyi re thag chad dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur tsam gyi mos gus tsam yod du chug kyang / mos gus khyad par can gyis lam 'khrid pa med na/ mchog sgrub par byed pa'i thabs gzhan zhig btsal nas/ de la gegs sel g.yin dang bogs 'don yang gzhan dang gzhan mang po dgos shing / 'dod don gzhan rnams la kha thag nye ba'i thabs kyang mi gcig pa mang po 'tshol dgos te/ tshe sgrub nor sgrub dbang bsdud la sogs pa ji snyed cig byas na yang 'ga' zhig ye mi 'gru/ba/ 'ga' zhig 'grus kyang dka' tshegs chen po dgos pas lam mi zab pa yin/ mos gus khyad par can gyis lam 'khrid pa 'di la ni/ mos gus kho nas mchog kyang 'grub/ lam gyi gegs sel dang / bogs 'don dang / tshe dang longs spyod dbang thang sogs 'dod don thams cad mos gus gcig pus dka' tshegs med par 'grub pa'i phyir/gcig chog yin pas na lam zab mo zhes bya'o/ /don tshan bdun pa lam zab mo'i khrid lugs kyi dbye ba ni mos gus kyi lam 'khrid pa de la yang / spyod pas 'khrid pa dang gsol 'debs kyi 'khrid pa —245—

gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ skal ldan gyi gang zag cig bla ma mchog dang mjal ba tsam ni mos gus lhun gyis grub/ bla ma'i don du dka' ba chen po spyad pas/ sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad nyi ma shar ba ltar cig car tshul du 'gyung ba yin/dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten byung ba'i lo rgyus dang / mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / nā ro mai tri sogs rgya gar gyi grub thob dang / bod yul gyi lo tsā ba mang po dang / rnal 'byor pa a mes byang chub dang / bshes gnyen bya yul ba sogs kyi gtam rgyud sbyar/ gnyis pa ni/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher la mos gus de 'dra'ang dkon dka' spyad kyang phal cher gyis mi nus/ re re tsam gyis byed pa srid na/ mi byed pa tsho'i tshor na ta dga' mor gda'/ lar pho rus dang / zhen dang / khengs dregs dang / 'gran sems dang / phugs rang bzang 'dod dang /yus dang bcas pa yin gyi/ chos ldan gyi mos gus snying thag pa nas med pas/rnam dag legs pa'i lam gyi ye shes skyed mi thub/ des na gsol 'debs kyi sgo nas mos gus la rim gyis slob pa yin/ rim pas bsgoms pas/ mthar mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa na/ lam gyi yon tan rnams kyang rim pas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na mos gus rab la dge spyor rab/ 'bring la 'bring dang tha ma la tha ma 'byung / mos gus med na dge spyor med/ ma gus pa ni ngan song gi rgyu zhes bya'o/ /don tshan brgyad pa mtshan ldan gyi bla ma ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la ni mi rnams thar pa'i ched du skyabs su nye bar 'gro ba ste/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang na gnas —246—

nga 'di yang yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam chos nyid dang / /dge 'dun ngur smrig 'dzin pas mchog gi khyab bdag bde ba skye ba 'bum phrag dag gis ster ba min/ /zhes dang / gang zhig mi yi 'jig rten dag na dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de dag ste/ /de la gnod pa byas pas srog chags rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khros pas me yis khros pa zhes pa chen po'o/ /de nyid sems can rnams la thar pa bde mnyam 'bras ster bu rnams dag gi phyag 'os mchod 'os so/ /sdug can gang yin gang zhig dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad bzang la dus gsum phyag mi byed pa'o/ /mi shes gang yin gang zhig rnam mang me tog rnams kyis dus gsum du ni maṇ+ḍal mi byed pa'o/ /myur du mnar med 'gro ba gang yin gang zhig bde mnyam ster byed bla ma skyo ba skyed pa'o/ khres rab ye shes thob pa gang yin ma nyams gang zhig mchog gi bla ma'i zhabs ni mi spong ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dpal ldan gsang 'dus las kyang / rigs ngan smig ma mkhan la sogs/ /gsod don don gnyer sems pa rnams/ /theg chen bla na med pa yi/ /theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can mtsham med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /rdo rje'i theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di la 'grub/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa dag /sgrubs kyang 'grub par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'di'i thad gyi sgron gsal las/ rang gi bla ma la snying thag pa nas smod mkhan de dang / rang yang snying nye bar byas na/ slob dpon la rang gis dngos su ma smad kyang / slob dpon smad pa dang khyad med par bshad —247—

do/ /yang de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu na ji snyed bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed pa de bas kyang / slob dpon gyi ba sbu'i bu ga gcig gi bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi snying por gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / gsang 'dus rim lnga las kyang / mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /bla med byed pa slob dpon gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas ci/ /dka' thub ma bsten gang zhig yod/ /de nyid mi bzang 'dod pa yis/ khren tu yid 'ong gang dang gang / khren tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /de dang de ni bla mar 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan las kyang / slob dpon gyi ni yon to gzung / /skyon ni nam yang ma yin nyid/ /yon tan gzung bas dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyi ni dngos grub nyams/ /'dir mang smras pas ci zhig bya/ /bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spang pa ni/ /de dang de la 'bad pas spyad/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs phyir/ khres nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba rnams gnad kyi dam pa yin te/ mdor na bla ma bsten tshul yang bsam pa dang spyor ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ bsam pa'i rtsa ba ni gong du bstan pa'i bla ma'i mos gus nyid yin la/ de —248—

yi yan lag tu/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi skyon la mi brtag ste/ skyon gyi rnam pa mthong na/ blo sbyong tshul gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ bla ma 'di lta bu'i skyon dang mdzad spyod ga la mnga'/ 'di ni bdag rang gi sems ma dag pas lan/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba dang 'dra/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma bram ze rgyal ba'i drod dang / grub thob mtsho skyes kyi bla ma phag tshang ba dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dpal khyim btsun du gzigs pa sogs kyis ma zhi te/ de dag gis kyang ma dad pa med par/ gus pa phyir zhing 'phel bas/ dngos grub thob pa dang / ma dad pa'i rnam rtog skad cig re res kyang dngos grub la bar chad byung ba ltar/ bdag kyang bla ma'i mdzad pa ji lta bu mthong yang dad pa 'phel ba zhig byed dgos snyam du bsam/blo sbyangs tshul gnyis pa ni/ bla ma de'i sku gsung thugs kyi skyon mthong ba'am/ mdzad spyod kyi sgo nas mi dge bcu mdzad par mthong yang / bla mas mdzad pa 'di lta bu mdzad pa ni/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang las/sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol du mdzad pa'i 'phrin las yin/ ded dpon snying rje chen po dang / khye'u skar ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags sogs kyi dpe dang mtshungs/ dper na bla ma rdzun gsung par shes na/da lta 'di na skye bo mang po rdzun mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa yod pa yang /dge ba ngo mtshar che ste/ de kun pas bdag gi bla mas dgongs pa can gyi tshig rdzun ltar snang ba gsung pa 'di brgya stong 'bum 'gyur gyi ngo mtshar che/ 'dis sems can dpag tu med pa mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la —249—

'god par mdzad pa zhig yin pa 'dug snyam du bsam pa lta bu ste/ des thams cad la rigs 'gre/ khyad par du rang la bka' bkyon pa dang / mi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad na/ bka' bgyon mi theg dad pa log log lta byed na dngos grub dang sgom gyi ta re ba zad de/ de bas thu ba dam tshig nyams/ rdo rje dmyal ba'i gzhi things pa yin/ bka' bkyen byung na rang gi las ngan sdig sgrib 'dzad/bgegs dang log 'dren ring du bros/ lhag par yang bdag la thugs nye bas gsong por gsungs pa yin te/ phas bu la bya ba bzhin zol 'grog mi mdzad pa bka' drin re ches snyam du bsams/ mi dgyes pa ltar snang na rang gi las sgrib ma dag pa yod pas de mdzub btsugs su brda sprod mdzad par 'dug snyam/ spyir sgrib sbyong dang / slar yang bla ma dgyes par byed pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin/ phyag chen pa 'ga' zhig bla ma'i bka' bkyon theg par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes zer ba yang mos gus kyi gnad dang ldan pa yin/ bod sgom 'ga' zhig gi zhal na re/ mtshan ldan bla ma rin che 'dis/ /gang mdzad thams cad legs pa yin/ /ci mdzad thams cad yon tan yin/ /mi gsod bshan pa mdzad na yang / de khas 'tshengs shing de kha legs/ /sems can thugs rjes 'dzin par nges/ /log g.yem 'chal ba'i tshul ston yang / /yon tan 'phel zhing yon tan 'byung / /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ /rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor ba na/ /brda thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun thar ba'i lam la 'dren/ /rku 'phrog chom po mdzad na yang / /gzhan gyi yo byad tshogs su bsgyur/ /skye bo 'phongs pa zhi ba yin/ /don la 'di 'dra'i bla ma yis/ /bka' —250—

bkyon mdzad na drag sngags yin/ rkyen ngan bar chad sel bar nges/ /brdungs brdegs mdzad na byin rlabs yin/ /dngos grub thams cad de las 'byung / /mos gus can tsho nyams re dga'/ /zhes skad de/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi gnad de lta bu zhig rang yin/ rje grol mchog gis kyang / dngos grub kyi rtsa ba de bla ma skad/ /bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos byon skad/ /ci mdzad de legs par blta dgos skad/ /mdzes mdzes su smra kyang sgra skad lags/ /dngos grub la thob rung ma thob rung / /sangs rgyas dang sems can gang yin yang / /mdzad pa yang legs nyes ci ston rung / /mi nga la snyems khrigs rdul tsam med/ /ces 'byung ba thag chod kyi mos gus de lta bu zhig dgos/ bla ma rang de cung zad ngan pa'i skyon yod pas sangs rgyas su bteg ste yar skyel mi dgos/ bla ma rang gis go chod/ mdzad pa nyes pa de bsgyur nas legs par sgom mi dgos/ gang mdzad de ka don chen yin de kas chog mdzad pa legs nyes la khyad mi gdog /rang la dngos grub re nas mos gus sgom pa min/ bla ma dang ma bral na dmyal bar gnas dgos kyang 'dod thog yin/ bla ma dang bral na dngos grub sangs rgyas sam de yod na'ang nga la dgos ched med do gzhan smos kyang ci dgos snyam pa zhig yin no/ /mdor na mos gus la re dogs spangs pa zhig gal che/ mkhas pa tshig gtso bor byed pa rnams dang / sgom chen pa'i brgyud 'dzin du khas blangs nas/ rtog ge dang sgra snyan ngag sogs tha snyad ngan pa'i g.yang sar lhung ba 'jig rten gyi che 'dod can 'di rnams don phun sum tshogs pa gnang la reg cing /tshig grong mi'i brda chad dang / bstun pa 'di lta bu la mi mos kyang / rgyud las/—251—

'tshe ba rig byed tshad ma can ni bde ba'i 'bras bu mi ster dus kun tu ni sdug bsngal ster/ /dam pa'i byams ldan rmongs pa'i tshig las mchog gi bde ba byed cing sems can bde la rjes su chags/ /de phyir sems can don ni gcig pu nyid la mi bdag yid kyi rang bzhin med pa bsgom par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kho bo cag ni don la brton par byed pa'i phyir 'dir yang de tsam zhig smos so/ /gzhan yang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma dam pa la gnyen bzhan pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten na grogs dang nye du snying nye ba'am/ g.yog bzang po dpon la gus pa zhig gis/ lus kyis bsnyen bkur dang zhabs dog byed/ zhes 'bul/ zhing las dang / tshong dang / pho nya dang / dgra la 'thab pa sogs gang dgos kyi bya ba thams cad sgrub/ ngag gis snyan pa'i tshig dang / bstod ra dang che ba brjod/ kha 'dzin bshag 'debs sogs sgo du ma nas smra/ sems kyis kyang /rang gi rgyal po la sogs pa de mnga' thang mtho na/ nor che na/ tshe ring na/ byus rgyal na/ gzhan dang mi mnyam pa zhig byung na ci ma drang snyam par byed/ las bya thabs kyis kyang / pha rol po g.yin rnams mnga' 'og tu 'jug e nus dang /mtha' na 'brel chags tsam yang 'jug pa'i thabs byed/ rang gis kyang bza' btung nor sogs gya nom pa 'bul khral 'jal tha na lus srog tshun chod kyang de dag gi don du gtong nus kyin 'dug na/ 'jig rten pa de dag lo zla theg po kha shas kyi mdun ma tsam 'grub pa'i phyir du/ gnyen grogs dpon rnams la de tsam du byed nus na/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas ma thob bar du gtan gyi gnyen yin/grogs yin/ dpon yin/ mgon yin/ skyabs yin/ rang gi tshe 'di'i bde skyid —252—

snyan gsum/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod/ mis mthong sogs legs pa gang byung thams cad kyang bla ma'i sku drin dang byin rlabs yin/ gzhan yang rang la thos bsam gyi shes rab bsrung sdom gyi tshul khrims bzlas nus byin rlabs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las gang byung thams cad kyang bla rme 'i drin/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi bar du mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dang / 'di phyi dus rnams thams cad du bde skyid thams cad bla ma la rag las pa yin na/gong du smos pa de lta bu'i lus ngag yid bya byed thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su 'bungs dgos pa'ang yin/ de ltar bya snyam du bsam pa yang dgos so/ /mdor na bla ma'i sku gsung 'phrin 'a/sa mngon par mtho bar smon pa tshun chad byed dgos pa yin/ de ltar na skyon la mi brtag pa dang / ci mdzad yon tan du shes pa dang / re dogs 'gog pa'i thag chod dang / gnyen bshin pa'i bsam pa ste/bla ma bsten tshul gyi bsam pa bzhi po de tshang na/ mos gus lam du 'gro bar the tshom med do/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa thams cad kyis bla ma mnyes pa thams cad byed/ mi dgyes pa thams cad spong bar 'dus/ de yang 'ga' zhig bla ma ni man ngag zhu ba'i sgo tsam yin gyi/ dngos grub dang byin rlabs chen po zhig bla ma las bzang ba'i yi dam mam/ mkha' 'gro sogs la zhu snyam pa byed de/ rten 'brel thams cad rtsa ba nas 'chug dngos grub ta ga la 'ong / des na mos gus drag po rgyun ma chad par bya/ log lta skad cig kyang mi bya/gal te byur chags kyi log lta rang shugs la dbang med du skyes na'ang de ma thag —253—

gnyen pos sleb par byas te/ 'phral du rgyun bcad nas/ lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur du ye ma thon par byas/ ngag gi sgo nas kyang / dngos lkog gang du yang skur 'debs dang gshe ba sogs tshig gcig kyang mi byed/ tshig 'jam pa dang drang po bden pa phyi nang med par smra/ bla ma'i thugs su 'thad pa dang / rang yang yid phebs pa dang / tshig gsal bas gab gsang med par nang yan byas kyin zhu/ sgo thams cad nas snyan pa dang / bstod pa dang / che ba brjod/ bla ma'i ci gsung ba de thams cad tshad mar gzung dgos/ lus kyis kyang phyag 'bul skor ba byed/ nye ba dang ring ba'i phyag g.yog dang las kyi mtha' dang / pho nya rkang 'gro sogs dgos pa'i bya ba thams cad byed de/ tha na chu 'byu thal 'phyag tshun chod kyang ngo / /yo byad kyi sgo nas kyang / shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid ces pa ltar/ dngos po bzang ba dang / dag pa dang / 'phangs pa dang / rang la gces pa rnams 'bul/ cung zad yid 'ong gang dang gang / /zhes pa ltar/ gang bla ma de nyid la mkho ba dang gang la thugs dgyes pa de 'bul te/ dngos gnas la bzang ngan gang yin yang / gang mkho zhing dgyes pa de ka mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur/ thugs su byon pa dang rnam par dag pa'i dngos po 'bul mi nus par/rang la gang mi mkho tshad kyi gyang gyong ngan ngon nor ma nyan dag 'bul/ nas sogs 'bru yin na sad khyer ngan ngon dang / bre tshad gang chung ba nas gzhal ba'i khal grangs byed pa sogs dngos po gang nyung nyung la ming dang / grags gang che che nas byed pa dang / rta phyugs sogs gang rdzud pa dang rgan pa dang nad khyer dang /gos yin na rnying pa sogs nor du ma btub pa rnams nas bag re 'bul zhing /—254—

bzang po thams cad rang gis tshags byed par 'dug ste/ rten 'brel gyi gnad rtsa ba nas 'chugs/ dam tshig gi 'gangs la sel zhugs/ byin rlabs kyi drod yal/ 'dod don dang dngos grub nam yang 'grub pa med/ ngal ba 'bras med dang byas pa don med kyi gsang sngags pa skad chos pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams snying re rje'o/ /yang bla ma bsten tshul 'di rnams/ bla ma'i ngo bzung ba dang / mi gzhan ngor chos brgyad kyi mdzes khrigs dang / rang gi 'dod don 'dra sgrub pa'i phyir byed na/ kha zas bzang po dug gis sbags pa 'dra/ chos su ni mi 'gro /'ga' zhig ni rang gi don yin pa ma go nas bla ma nyid rang la dgos pa'i don gcig yin pa 'dug snyam/ yus dang ngo so kho na lhur byed de/ bla ma mnyes par byas pa ste/ slob ma rang nyid kyi don dang khe chen po thob pa de ma shes nga ra zad do/ /de ltar bla ma bsten chul thams cad kyi 'gag bsdu na bka' ci gsung sgrub pa la 'dus/ dgongs pa la gang yod bzhin byed par 'dus pa lags so/ /de ltar na bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di dang / gong gi skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed de gsum po 'di ni/ chos kyi 'gangs rang yin pas/ dmigs phran re tsam yin pas 'gangs chungs ngo snyam/ du bsam par mi bya ste/ skyabs 'gro ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ sems bskyed ni theg chen thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam / mas cad kyi rtsa ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang bsags sbyangs tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ tshogs bsags dang sgrib spyong du ma gyur pa'i dge ba'i chos cung zad kyang med la/ 'on kyang yig brgya'i —255—

bzlas bsgom dang / maṇ+ḍal ni cho ga'i yan lag sna re tsam yin mod kyi/ 'di gnyis gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la shin tu mkho ba dang / tshegs chung ngus don rgya cher 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi khyad par rer snang bas/ skabs 'dir thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa lnga zhes 'dra mtshungs su sa bcad bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de ltar de yan chad du bshad pa rnams/ chos 'ji gcig pur ma zad skyabs sems bsab/sa sbyangs mos gus kyi khrid gang na yod pa thams cad la sbyor shes par 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir spyir smin byed kyi dbang bskur dgos pa las/ dpal dus kyi 'bor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ thugs dkyil rgyas pa la brten nas/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun tsam mam/ dbang yongs rdzogs sngar thob zin nas/ de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams khrid 'bogs pa thob thang yin la/ de tsam ma nus na/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi da/kyil 'khor gang rung zhig tu/ sbas rgyud rnams kyi lugs kyi dbang yongs rdzogs sam bum dbang thob par bya/ dmigs bsal la skyabs sems maṇ+ḍal gsum la dogs pa med/ yig brgya dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/sngar dbang bskur ye ma thob pa la gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ram snyam na/ 'dir dmigs bsal yin pas mi 'gyur te/ gzhi de las dad pa khyad par can skye ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang bskur snga rol nas ma grub na/thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i skabs 'di rnams gang du bskur kyang 'dra/ gsang sgrogs mi 'byung ba tsam la de dang khyad med kyang / spyir bskyed rim gyi sngon du byis 'jug gam/ dkyil chog phal pa'i bum dbang tsam zhig nges par gal —256—

che'o/ /de ltar thun mong gi dbang bskur ba'i rjes su/ 'khrid kyi 'phros nas skyong ba la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa/ thun mong ma yin pa ni sbyor drug las gzhan pa'i 'khrid mang po zhig dang thun mong ma yin pa ste/ phal che ba'i don yin/ gzhan la gtan nas med ces khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min no/ /'o na sngags kyi 'khrid phal cher la yang / lha sgom pa dang / mi rtog pa dang / stong nyid sgom pa yod pas shas che ba la bsams kyang / thun mong ma yin pa zhes zer du mi rung snam na bden mod kyi/ lha dang mi rtog bsgom pa yod pa'i 'brid rnams phal che ba la de dag dngos gzhir byed pa yin gyi sngon 'gror mi byed pas/'dir lha dang mi rtog pa sngon 'gror byed pa'i sgo nas/ chos gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /de las dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgom thabs bshad zin pa'i rjes sam/ji ltar 'os par go ba cung zad brjod na/ spyir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs 'di nyams len du byed pa la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams byas nas/ de rjes shu rgyu ta sogs la 'jug pa yin/ 'dir thun gcig po de thun mong gi sngon 'gro lnga po rgyas bsdus gang yin yang rung / khrigs chags su bsgoms zin pa'i 'phro 'thud pa yin na shu rgyu ta ma chad nas bsgoms pas chogaskyabs sems gong gi de kas go chod/ yang 'dir skyor mi dgos/ de la rang gzhan snang grangs kyi chos 'di rnams snang yang bden pas stong pa sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ de rjes snang ba thams cad nam ma/spa' la 'ja' ltar yal nas sems snang med la cung zad bzhag de nas shu rgyu ta'i sngags brjod cing / gzung 'dzin —257—

gnyis stong gi ye shes bde gshegs snying po nga yin snyam nga rgyal bskyed/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ bzhugs gdan pad+ma'i 'og tu 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa bsgom thub na legs/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ lhan skyes kyi skabs 'dir gzhal yas khang gi dod thub pa lags/ mdor bsdu na/ma sgoms kyang lhan skyes kyi skabs 'dir cho ga chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /lhan skyes kyi go don gnyis yod de/ gcig ni gdod ma'am rtsa ba'am thog ma nyid la lhan skyes zer ba yin/ lha phyag mang zhal mang yal ga lo 'dab rgyas pa lta bu'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs sa bon lta bu de phyag gnyis pa yin zhes btags pa'i sgo nas bzhag ste/ 'jig rten du rtsa bar 'jog pa phal cher chung ba'am nyung ba dang /'phros shing 'phel ba rnams phal cher mang ba dang che bar 'gyur bas/ skabs 'di lta bur yang lhan skyes kyi sgra zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig la 'jogade'i yang nang nas gsang sngags pa phal la grags che ba ltar na/ gcig gcig pu la lhan cig pa'i sgra mi 'byung bas/ dpa' bo gcig pu dang / dpa' mo gcig pu la phal du lhan skyes mi zer bar/ phyag gnyis pa kha sbyor gyi sku can gcig la lhan skyes su grags so/ /don steng nas zhal phyag mang nyung la rgyu 'bras kyi khyad dang / rtsa ba dang / yan lag gi dbye ba'i nges pa med mod kyang / mtshon don gyi dbang du byas nas/ rgyu'am rtsa ba chos sku spros bral mtshon pa phyag gnyis pa dang /'bras bu'am yan lag gzugs sku spros pa'i rnam pa mtshon byed zhal phyag mang po can yin par 'jog pa mang bas/ rgyu'am rtsa ba'i lha la lhan skyes zhes bya/ de ni bskyed bya rnam pa'i sgo nas lhan skyes su 'jog tshul lo/ /—258—

lhan skyes kyi go don gnyis pa ni/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig 'di skad ces gsung ste/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog rnam pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can du ma grub na phar zhog grub phyin chad sems kyi gnas lugs bde ba dang / lus kyi gnas lugs lha'i skur grub/sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gsum lhan cig tu gdod ma nas yod/ de glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ma shes pa la/ shu rgyu ta'i sngags don bsams pas/ dri ma tha mal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dang / gdod nas grub grub pa'i ye shes lha'i sku gsung thugs de mngon du gyur par mos pa'i tshul gyi sgom pa ni/ lhan skyes sgom pa zhes bya ste/'di ni mos tshul dang bskyed chog gi rim pa'i sgo nas lhan skyes sgom par 'jog pa'o/ /bskyed chog 'di lta bu'i sgo nas/ lha dpa' rkyang nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa'i bar du rgyas bsdus gang bsgoms kyang rung / lhan skyes kyi sgra don tshang mod/ 'khor can dang zhal phyag mang po can la/ lhan skyes kyi tha snyad mi 'jog pa ni/ gsang sngags pa phal cher rnams la rab tu grags pa'i tshad mas grub pa ste/ chu las skyes pa gzhan mang po yod kyang / pad+ma kho na la chu skyes su brjod pa bzhin no/ /des na dpa' bo gcig pa dang / dpa' mo gcig pa dang /—259—

'khor tshogs can la yi dam de dang de lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs su rgya cher sgrog pa ni gsang sngags kyi brda chad la rmongs par zad do/ /'dir 'chad pa'i dus 'khor lhan skyes dang / bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis mdzang/ pa sogs ni/ bskyed bya lha'i rnam pa dang / skyed chog gnyis ka'i sgo nas lhan skyes kyi tshul kho na yin la/ spyir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs su 'jog pa la/ bskyed chog las kyang rnam pa gtso che bas/ lhan skyes la sa bon dang cho ga gsum skyed dang / snying po'i tshig tsam dang / mngon byang lnga skyed sogs sna tshogs pa 'byung ba'ang mi 'gal lo/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba zhes pa ni/ 'dom gang tsam 'khor yug tu 'od zer gyi tshul la/ de phan chad du me lce kha dog sna lnga'am drug pa 'phro ba'o/ kha cig dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi zhabs 'og tu mnan pa'i lha gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang / lha mo gnyis kyang sgom pa ni skabs su bab pa'i dbri bkyed ma shes par mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i gral sgrig bshig ma thub pa'i skyon te/ de lta na gtso bo las gdan gzi brjid ches pa'i skyon 'gyung ste/ dgra bgegs mi thul ba dang / bar chad sdang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas de lhar mi bya la/ drag po dkar po khro nyams dang / stag lpags dang / sprul rgyan can/ mig gsum pa/ 'dod lha dmar po zhi ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mig gnyis pa/ gnyis kar yang phyag gnyis phyag mtshan med pa gan kyal du gnas pa/ dran med du rgyal zhing myos pa'o/ /sku la rdo rje'i rgyan zhes pa rgyu rdo rje pha lam las grub cing rnam pa yang rdo rje'i gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /dus 'khor lhan skyes 'di rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar byed na/ yab yum gnyis kar rdor —260—

sems kyi dbu rgyan can dang / 'bras bur ltar byed na/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can yin/ dus 'khor gyi chos skad la/ rigs bdag ces pa 'khor gyi dbu la bzhugs pa'i lha'i ming yin/ /dus kyi sde bor lo'i dbu rgyan gyi lha ni/ rang rigs mtshon byed yin kyi rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs min te/ dus 'khor la tshur rgyas 'debs kyi lha med de/ dus 'khor nyid lha gzhan thams cad la phar rgyas 'debs pa'i rigs bdag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di go nas gzhan gyi kha rgyugs dang ma 'dres par bya'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i tshul gyi skyed chog 'di/gdod ma rang byung gi lha'i rnam pa lam byed yin/ rang byung gi lha de sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin pas/ thog ma nyid nas dam ye dbyer med du rang grub pa'i phyir/go cha byin rlabs dang / ye shes spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas gdabs sogs mi dgos pas/ skabs 'dir ni de bzhin yin la/ skyed chog gzhan gyi lugs su byas na/ rnam pa lhan skyes yin yang / cho ga de dag byed pa'ang mi 'gal lo/ /skabs 'dir gnas drug tu yi ge drug dgod pa ni/ sgo gsum dang skye mched sogs byin rlabs gyi don ma yin/ rig drug kun 'dus pa'i brda tsam yin/ yi ge bzhi 'god na'ang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje bzhi 'dus pa'i brda yin/ de nas 'od zer spro bsdus snod bcud sbyong ba ni/ mdzad pa 'phrin las lam du byed pa yin pas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren du 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /'khrid kyi skabs su ni bzlas pa cung zad byed du chug kyang /lha sku la dmigs pa ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos la/ spyir 'di la bzlas brjod bsnyen pa sogs byed na/ snying gar zla nyi sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rnam —261—

bcu dbang ldan sngon po zhig bsgom ste/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i bzlas pa spyi dang mthun pa byed/ de dag las/ dang por stong nyid sgom pas ni 'chi ba sbyong / chosasku lam du byed/ skad cig gis bskyed pas ni/ bar do sbyongs/ longs sku lam du byed/ yi ge dgod pa dang / 'od zer spros bsdus/ skye sring dang / las sna tshogs byed pa sbyong sprul sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa lam du byed pa'o/ /mthar 'od gsal du bsdu zhing ldang ba ni/ phyis nying mtshams sbyor ba la ltos pa'i srid pa mtha' dag sbyong zhing / rang bzhin chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa yin no/ /spyir sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te gsum gsungs/ dang po bskyed rim dang / phyi ma gnyis rdzogs rim gyi lha sku yin/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dngos ste ye shes kyi lha sku zhig la zer ba yin na'ang / bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor pas kyang de dang rnam pa mtshungs par bsgom pa la/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sogs mkhas mchog rdo rje 'dzin chen rnams gsung ngo / /de yang skyed chog lhan skyes kyi lugs su yod na/ bskyed rim rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor der 'gyur ba yin gyi/ de min skad cig gis bskyed pa ni dkrod bskyed tsam po'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu 'di ltar yang go bar bya ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ bskyed rim la smad cing rdzogs rim la bsngags pa cher mdzad/'khor lo sdom pa las/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka mang po zhig gsungs kyang /gnyis kar gyi che ba tsam min pa gang la'ang smad pa cher med/ dgyes rdor las/—262—

gnyis ka gsal bar bstan nas bskyed rim la bsngags pa cher mdzad/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud du/ bskyed rim 'khor bcas rgyas shing / rdzogs rim gab pa'i tshul du yod pa shas che/ de ltar tshig dngos bstan la ston lugs mi 'dra ba du mar byung yang / dgongs pa gcig ste/ bskyed rim la bstod pa rnams ni las dang po pa phal che ba la dgos shing / gnas skabs kyi phan yon shin tu mang ba la dgongs/ bskyed rim la smad pa rnams ni rdzogs rim rgyud la skyes zin pa dang sngar ma skyes kyang dbang po rnon po la mi dgos pa dang / nges don ma yin pa/ la dgongs/ de tsam du rgyud thams cad dgongs pa mthun mod kyang / dngos bstan la bstod smad kyi khyad yod pas/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang de la gtso bor byed mi byed kyi khyad cung zad yod de/ gang zag dang bstan bcos mang po zhig tu rang la gang yod pa de bstod/ rang la med pa de smod par 'dug na'ang / 'dir de rigs ye min/ dus 'khor las/ bsgom bya dkyil 'khor gyi rigs mang po dang / skyed tshul cho ga shin tu rgyas pa sogs rgyas bsdus mang po dang / cho ga las tshogs thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub tshul shin tu gsal zhing zhi ba la rgyas te/rgyud gcig nas bskyed rim gyi phyogs dus 'khor nas rgyas par bshad pa tsam gzhan phal cher la med do/ /de la rgyud 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mtha' yas pa gsungs pa las/ gtso che shos ni sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ gzhan yang sdom pa che chung dang / gsang 'dus dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa mang ngo / /dang po la/ ye shes le'ur/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi nang na/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la lha stong dang drug yod pa dang /—263—

sgrub le'i dngos bstan gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor la lha drug brgya so drug yod pa dang / nang ler pad+ma gdan can 'ba' zhig pa lha tshogs brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa yang gsungs/ de las bsdus pa/ thugs dkyil rgyas bsdus gnyis dang / bcu bdun ma dang / bcu gsum ma dang / lha dgu dang / lha lnga'i bar du dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa dang / gtso rkyang la yang phyag mang dang / lhan skyes dang /dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar du yod pa las/ bskyed rim gtso bor byed mkhan yin na/ bsgom bya dkyil 'khor dang / skyed chog bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi byed pa gtso che ba yin yang / skabs 'dir ni/ lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs pa'i don dang / rim pa gnyis cha tshang ba'i don dang / rdzogs rim gyi rgyud sbyangs pa'i phyir du/ bskyed rim cung zad sgom pa ma gtogs/ gtso bor rdzogs rim nyid la sgril ba'i skabs yin pas/ lhan skyes kho na bsngags par ba ched cing / brgyud pa nas brgyud par sgom pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa yang yin no/ /dus 'dir bskyed rim gyi spros pa cher byas kyang / skabs kyi don rdzogs rim la 'phral du 'jug dgos pa las phyir phyogs par 'gyur bas spros pa spang par bya'o/ /da ni spyi ldog nas go ba cung zad bshad na/ gzhan yang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi ngo bo ni/ gzhi sgrib bral du byed pa'i lam khyad par can zhes bya ba ste/ sbyangs gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la/ sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma sbong ba'i sbyong byed lam de yang / gzhi 'khor ba'i las nyon sdug bsngal dbyen gī ༵dhi da rdzo dhi~X gnyi sa dzhai/na rnyi spyu dzhai rnam par rtog ༵/ bskye/ rdo —264—

pa'i rdon dang / rdzogs pa ni rang byung du shar ba'i don no/ /de gnyis kyi tshad ma ni/ rgyud las/ lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mngon sum med na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni brtags pa gang / /de rni ri mo sogs la blta bya yongs su ma smin blo can rnal 'byor rnams kyis bsgom pa'i don/ /zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rim rtog bcas nyid kyi phyir rjes dpag gi rim pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi dmigs nga/'i yul blos gsar du brtags pa la ma rags par mngon sum du snang ba'i tshul la 'jug pa'i phyir mngon sum lam byed do/ /rim pa gnyis po de'i mtshan nyid dang khyad chos ni/ cho ga'i khyad par rgyud las gsungs pa'i skyed chog tshang ba/ rang 'bras kyi khyad par sngags kyi mthu skyed nus pa/ ngo bo'i khyad par sprezhu bde dang stong nyid kyi rang bzhin/ byed las kyi khyad par dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba ste/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i lha sku rnam par rtog pa'i brtags pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor yin la/ rgyu'i khyad par rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa/ byed las kyi khyad par rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar dag byed/ rnam pa'i khyad par bde ba dang stong gzugs lhan cig pa ste/khyad par gsum ldan gyi mi rtog pa'i lam de ni rdzogs rim mo/ /grangs nges pa ni/ dgos pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges te/ skye ba kun rdzob bden pa lam du byed pa la bskyed rim dang / 'jig pa don dam bden pa lam du byed pa la rdzogs —265—

rim dgos pa dang / don dam gnas lugs kyi lam la 'jug pa'i rgyud sbyang ba dang / byang nas gnas lugs sgom pa dngos gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni bskyed rim dang phyi ma ni rdzogs rim yin te/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba la/rgyud sbyang ba'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa zhig sngon du gtong dgos pa shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rnam rtog rgya ru chud pa yi/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam gzigs nas/ /ji lta ji ltar grol gyur pa/ /de dang de yi thabs bstan no/ /rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcings la/ /thog mar rtog pa'i cho ga bstan/ /rnam rtog rang bzhin shes pa na/ /mi rtog pa la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs de kho nas go rim nges pa yang grub ste/ snying 'grel las/ dang por re zhig zhing dag phyir/ khre tshe rnams ni btab par gyur/ /phyi nas dag pa'i zhing la ni/ /sa la'i 'bras ni 'debs pa'o/ /zhes dpe gsungs te/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyes phyin chad dmigs bsal re re tsam ma gtogs/ bskyed rim sgom pa la dgos pa chen po med pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim sgom phyin chad/ dmigs bsal ma gtogs rdzogs rim gyi sngon du sgom dgos par grub bo/ /bskyed rim brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang / brtan pa ma thob rung ci rigs pa bsgoms nas rdzogs rim la 'jug pa dang / thun stod la bskyed rim sgom/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom pa sogs gang byas kyang dgos don 'grub bo/ /rim gnyis kyi dgos pa ni/ las chen bcu gnyis sogs 'phrin las sna tshogs dang /'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa ni bskyed rim dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa ni rdzogs rim gyi dgos pa'o/ /dbang lam 'bras bu —266—

dang bcas pa la sbyar na/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskyed rim gyi smin byed dang / dbang gong ma rdzogs rim gyi smin byed yin/ lam ma dag sa bdun gyi rten 'brel byis 'jug dang bskyed rim gyis sgrib par byed/ dag pa sa gsum gyi rten 'brel rdzogs rim dang dbang gong ma las 'byung ba yin/ 'bras bu gzugs kyi sku bskyed rim dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i sku rdzogs rim dang sbyor ro/ /'dir lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs lta bu bsdus pa 'di rigs rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du spyor na/ lha bsgom pa sor bsam gyi sngon 'gro/ sngags bzlas pa srog 'dzin gyi sngon 'gro/ shu rgyu ta'i sngags don rjes dran gyi smin byed/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa'i rten du 'gyur zhes bya la/ yongs nas chos sbyor ba yan lag drug la 'di rgyud nyi tshe ba re la phyogs su lhung ba ma yin/ rgyud mtha' dag gi nges don nyid yin pa'i phyir/rten bskyed pa'i rim pa yang / lha dus 'khor kho na la brten dgos par ma nges te/ spyir lha sku'i rnam rtog gis tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong ba nyid don gyi gtso bo yin pas/ bskyed rim gyi tha snyad 'jug mi 'ju ga la rag ma lus/ lhag pa'i lha sku gang bsgoms kyang don 'grub ste/ dper na dpe med 'tsho'i lugs 'dzin pa spyi khyab rnams dang / sgos su nags rin gyi rjes 'brang rnams sbyor drug gi sngon 'gror kha sarba ṇa bsgom pa bzhin no/ khyad par du yang / gsang 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ gshi/na rje gshe/da dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/bde dgyes la sogs pa 'khor lo'i gtso bo kha sbyor gyi rnam pa can rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa dang / de bzhin du dpa' bo gcig pa dang / rdo rje phag mo dang /—267—

bdag med ma la sogs pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma/ yum rkyang gi tshul can rnams sam/ tha na bla med las 'byung ba'i las rgyas pa'i lha sa kyang mi rung ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du ye shes mgon po nag po chen po la sogs pa yang / sgrub tshul bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa ma yin par bdag bskyed yi dam ltar sgrub pa la ni rung ste/ rtsod dus las kyang ches rtsod dus kyi tha mar grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sa brnyes pa/ zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs las kyang / bzhi pa lnga pa de rjes su/ /yan lag drug ldan slob dpon 'dod/ /ces nag po chen po bskyed rim la yan lag drug gi rdzogs rim sbyor bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /des na tsar tsi kā la sogs pa gsung gi rnal 'byor ma dang / tshes kyi lha bden bral la sogs pa yang 'jig rten pa rnam par sbyangs pa'i ye shes kyi lha sku yin pa'i phyir/ mgon ngo/ nag po dang 'dra'o/ /g.yin yang 'di ltar go dgos te/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la mchog sgrub/ thun mong sgrub/ las tshogs sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang / bskyed rim dngos dang rjes mthun gang yang mi 'jog pa dang / bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mngon rtogs rim pa rgyas pa rnams/ bskyed rim dngos yin pa la dogs pa med kyang / sgrub thabs phra mo rnams la bskyed rim gyi mtshan nyid ji bzhin ma tshang yang / bskyed rim gyi sder gtogs pa'i phyir/ de dag gi bsam gtan la yang bskyed rim zhes brjod de rjes mthun pa'o/ /'di dag la 'chi bar skye gsum dang / sku gsum sogs sbyang bya sbyong byed cung zad rtsi dgos shing / dmigs pa dang cho ga'i rim pa 'di dag dang 'dra yang / rgyud sde 'og ma —268—

la brten pa rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dag sbyor de 'dra mi rtsi ste/ de gnyis 'dra ba las dag sbyor rtsi na rtsi mnyam dang / mi sbyor na mi sbyor mnyam dgos thang pa la/ bla med nas gsungs pa la sbyor/ cig shos de la mi sbyor ba'i khyad par ci snyam na/ 'di la rig pa'i sgo nas rgyu mtshan bsam par mi nus kyang /bla med kyi bskyed rim la sbyang bya srid pa'i rim pa dang sbyor tshul/ rgyud dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / grub thob rnams kyi gzhung las bshad la/ rgyud/ sde 'og ma'i cho ga rgyas pa la yang / sbyang bya 'khor ba la sbyor ba dang / lam gong ma'i smin byed du bshad pa tshang thub pa'i rgyud gzhung rnying pa gang nas kyang med do/ /rgyu mtshan des cho ga rgyas pa rnams la lung gis grub cing / sgrub thabs phra mo rnams ni de dang de'i sder gtogs pas/ de dag la yang / dag rdzogs smin gsum sbyor mi sbyor gyis khyad 'byung ba yin te/ gtso bo gang la 'jug pa de la 'khor rnams rjes su spyod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs sgom na/ 'chi bar skye gsum sbyong stobs che/rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur tshabs che/ spyod rgyud lugs kyi 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs bsgoms kyang / spyod thabs dang smin tshabs chung ba ni/ rgyud gsungs pa po de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis/ gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par/ dgongs pa ji ltar brtad pa de dang de 'byung ba'i nus mthu las byung ba yin pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa'i bka' yis grub pa'o/ /yang rgyud sde 'og ma'i mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la yang / bskyed rdzogs kyi tha snyad sbyor mkhan mang du byung ba rnams/ tha snyad sbyor tshul de mi 'thad mod kyang /—269—

phyogs mtshungs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ don la brton pa'i dbang du byas na/ skyon chen po'ang med pas/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig nga rgyal dang sdang shugs kyis smra ba mang du byed de/ che thang du 'bad pas 'gog dgos pa'i bya ba ma yin no/ /de ltar na lha'i rnal 'byor rigs mtha' dag skabs 'dir 'jug kyang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhig bsgom na mchog yin zhing / de la lha dpa' bo gcig pas kyang thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon mi nus pa ma yin la/rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa yum rkyang mang po zhig gzhan pas ches zab pa'i gnas skabs kyang mang po 'dug mod kyang / spyir btang la thabs shes kha sbyor du sgom pa zab bo zhes/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsang sngags pa kun la grags pa ltar/re zhig 'dir yang khas blangs te dkyus ltar sgom pa yin no/ /de las kyang skabs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nyid bsngags te/ rgyud sde mthar thug gi lha yin pa dang / rdzogs rim 'di yang / dus 'khor gyi bskyed rim gang du gsungs pa'i rgyud der/ ma sbas shing gsal la rgyas pa rtsal du bton nas gsungs pas/ bskyed rdzogs 'brel chags pa sogs rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig kyang yod mod/ gtso bor rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid tshul 'di dang brgyud pa gcig cing /byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbang dang rgyud bshad ni dus 'khor kho na yin pas bskyed rim kyang dus 'khor bsgoms na/ rgyud pa thun tshags bsdus pa tsam ma yin par/ rkang chen po sel med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / chos 'di nyid kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len dang byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa de yang 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rim gnyis thun mong gi go don —270—

dang / bskyed rim gyi don rgyas pa rnams skabs 'dir bshad mi dgos shing /bshad mi lang bas 'dir mi spro'o/ /rang lugs kyi skyes bu dam pa grub thob dbus pa'i khrid yig na bskyed rim gyi 'khrid med de khong rang gi nyams myong dang dbang po rnon lo dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ khrid yig dkyus su bshad pa kho nas kyang dmigs pa go don dang bcas pa legs par 'grub pa yod cing /dmigs pa 'bogs pa'i sngon rol du'am/ yang na dmigs pa ni phog mun 'khrid lam bcur gong du dmigs pa sbyong ba'i skabs go ba zhib par bskyed pa'i phyir/ spros bshad cung zad byed na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs kyi mchog dbang gong ma bzhi sngar gtan nas ma thob na/ 'khrid kyi dngos gzhi ston du ye mi rung la/ dben gsum tsam rang ston du rung tsam yin mod kyang / phyag len du dben gsum gyi mun 'khrid dang / sor sdud kyi dmigs pa dang po sbrel te sgom pa'i lugs yin pas/ de gnyis kyi bar du spros pa chung ba lag len bde bas/gong ma rnams dkyus kyi phyag len la bskyed rim dang dben gsum gyi bar 'dir mchog dbang gong ma bskur ba nyid gtso bor phyag len du 'debs/ spyir dben gsum dang dngos gzhi'i bar du mchog dbang byas kyang legs mod/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ dben gsum yang sor sdud sogs dngos gzhi rnams kyi sbyor ba thun mong ma yin pa yin pas/ dngos gzhir gtogs su rung ste de'i phyir mchog dbang gong ma skabs 'dir bskur ba nyid thob thang yang yin no/ /sngar lar nas mchog dbang ma thob na bskur dgos pa lta ci smos/ snga rol dus gzhan du lan —271—

mang por thob kyang / slar yang skabs 'dir byin mas sgo 'byed kyi don dang /ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'phral du skyed pa'i don du dbang gong ma slar yang bskur dgos te/ 'di ma smin pa smin byed kho na'i dbang ma yin/ ye shes ma bskyed pa skyed par byed pa'i dbang yang yin pas so/ /mkhas pa kha cig 'khrid kyi dbang 'di la/ khong pa rang tsho dbang gong chen gyi ming can du bzhed pa'i rig ma bcu dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bar bzhed de/ 'di ni rdzogs rim nyan pa dang sgom pa'i don tsam du bskur ba yin gyi 'chad pa sogs kyi don du dgos pa ma yin pa dang / dbang de ni rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa kho na la slob dpon chen po'i gnas thob pa'i phyir/ bskur bar bya rgyu kho na yin par rgyud 'grel nyid las gsal zhing bsnyon du med pa'i phyir skabs 'dir dbang de bskur ba ni skabs su ma bab bo/ /da ni dben gsum gang du bsgom pa'i gnas la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang da/nga / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ zas gos gnas mal sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad chos mthun mang nyung ran pa tsam rnyed sla ba dang / sangs rgyas byang sems skyes bu dam pas bzhugs pa'i gnas sam/ nyams dga' zhing rang gi yid 'thad pa'i gnas bzang ba dang / sa bsil drod dang / chu'i skyon sogs kyis lus la nad kyi gnod pa mi skye bas sa bzang ba dang / shin tu dben pa chom rkun gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa med pa bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gyur ba'i sgra dang / ku co med pa —272—

ni rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa la/ gnod pa med pas bde ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /gang na sa skyong chos ldan sogs la/ yul de'i rgyal po dkar po dge ba'i chos la mi dga' na/ sgrub pa byed pa la gnod pa mang du 'byung zhing / rgyal po rang nyid dkar po'i chos la dga' yang / rgyal khrims kyi chos dang mi ldan na/ 'khor gyi gnod pa 'byung / yul 'khor gyi skye bo rnams mi bde na/ 'tsho ba dkon zhing chom rkun sogs 'phel sa 'dzin te rgyal po phan tshun 'thab rtsod du gyur pa'i phyogs su/ 'jigs pa dang nyer 'tshe du ma 'byung nyen yod cing / dngos su gnod pa ma byung yang / sems mi bde zhing rnam g.yeng mang /ting nge 'dzin mi 'grub pas/ yul phyogs bde zhing 'thab rtsod med la rgyal po dge ba can khrims gtsang ba'i chab 'og tu gnas pa dgos zhes pa yin te/'dis sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i mi dang dus skabs kyi mtshan nyid dang / gong gi blo ldan sogs gnas rang gi mtshan nyid ston pa yin no/ /spyir dge sbyor ma skyes pa thams cad rang gi blo las su ma rung ba dang / grogs po ngan pa dang 'grogs pas lan/ gnas kyi ma btub nas dge sbyor ma byung ba tsam med/ yang zhag shas zla shas tsam sdod pa'i gnas la/ mtshan nyid tsam brtsi mi dgos/brtan pa thob pa la rgyun ring sdod sa la'ang khyad chen po med pas/ las dang po pa rnams gnas gcig tu yun ring sdod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang zhib mor gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir dben gsum bya ba/gsang 'dus rim lnga pa'i dben gsum dang sgrig dgos pa min/ brgyud pa 'di nyid rang gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa'i gsung rgyun la —273—

grags/ rigs ldan sprul sku kun spangs chen pos gsal bar yi ger bkod pa'o/ /dben gsum zhes pa'i sgra bshad tsam la ni rim lnga dang 'di phal cher 'dra ste/ rim lngar yang / lus ngag yid gsum tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas dben pa'i don la 'chad cing / 'dir yang lus bya byed kyis dben pa/ ngag smras brjod kyis dben pa/ sems rnam rtog gis dben pa/ zhes pa'i don 'chad pas so/ /dben gsum zhes pa'i ming gang la 'jug pa'i mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra mod kyang / tha snyad cig kho na don du ma la 'jug pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir mi 'dra ba la 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /spyir 'di rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i skabs/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom gyis rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos kyin yod pa las/ de'i nang tshan mi rtog pa'i cha shas sgos su sgrub pa ste/ thog ma nyid du byed dgos te/ mi rtog pas lus la gnad du bsnun pa la mi rtog pa thog mar 'grub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes rdo rje spyi khyab tu btang nas/ rdzogs rim dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i nyams len du 'dus la/ de'i sngon 'gror yang sems dben pa gcig por ma zad/lus ngag dben pa'ang dgos te/ 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba'i rig pas/dngos gzhi 'bras bu'i tshul de la/ rdo rje gsum gyi dag sbyor yod pas/ sngon 'gro rgyu'i tshul la yang / rdo rje gsum gyi dbye ba dgos so/ /des na gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi lus ngag sems rnams sogs lung drang ba'i don/ sems kyi ngo bo rnam par mi rtog pa de la/ dmigs pa rnam rtog gi spros pa mi dmigs pa dang /—274—

dmigs pa'i yul gang la'ang mi gnas/ ting nge 'dzin mnyam bzhag gi rig don tha dad du byed pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nub pas mnyam pa nyid de ka re zhig rnal 'byor pa rang gi lus ngag sems gsum gyi steng du tshul de ltar bsgom pa ste/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum du 'dzin pa dbyings su 'gags par byas pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnas lugs sgom pa'am/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lam bsgom pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nyid la ltos med bzhi ldan zhes kyang bya ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'grel nyid kyi brda chad dang dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis bsnyen pa ste/ /so sor sdud pa sogs dang rdo rje pad+ma las skyes bdud rtsi yis ni nye ba'i sgrub par 'gyur/ /dga' ba la sogs rnams kyi rdo rje gsum dang chu skyes ro mnyam gyur pa sgom pa sgrub par 'gyur/ khres rab sbyar la gang tshe 'pho med phra mo'i rnal 'byor dag las nges par sgrub pa chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ spyir rdzogs rim dngos gzhi la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dbye ba mdzad pa mang mod kyang skabs 'dir ni rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi sbrags pa la/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshar gcig brtsi dgos pa las/ sngon 'gro ltos med bzhi ldan ni bsnyen pa/dngos gzhi sor bsam srog 'dzin rnams nyer sgrub/ rjes dran sgrub pa dang /ting nge 'dzin sgrub chen du 'jog pas/ sngon 'gro la gcig dang dngos gzhi la gsum du byas pa'o/ /rgyud tshig gsal po 'di yod pas dben gsum mam/ltos med bzhi ldan gyi 'khrid 'di/ logs su mi dgos so gal chung ngo snyam du —275—

sems shing sbong ba ni nyams len gyi skabs su gnad gal po che chad par ma zad yang yang kha nas 'don pa'i rgyud tshig 'di'i don tsam la yang gzhig 'brel ma bcug pa'i hol chod yin no/ /de las skabs 'dir dgos pa ni/ tshig rkang dang po yin la/ 'di'i don 'chad pa ni dri med 'od las/ 'dir las dang po pas dang por sgrub thabs kyi cho gas bsnyen pa bya ste/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas bsnyen pa zhes pa la/ phyi rol tu bdud rtsi lnga ni/ bshad pa la sogs pa dang /sogs pa'i sgras go ku la sogs pa ste lha mnyes pa'i don du de rnams zab bsnyen pa'o/ /nang du bdud rtsi lnga ni/ phung po lnga ste sogs pa'i sgras dbang po lnga ni sgron ma lnga'o/ /de rnams la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste/ lus dang rdzas la sred pa yongs su spangs pa'o/ /bsnyen pa des lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur gyi bshang ba la sogs zos pas ni ma yin no/ /chu gter rdo rje rnams dang zhes pa ni/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / ngag gi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / sems kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / 'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste/ lus dang / ngag dang / sems dang /tshangs par spyod pa'i sdom pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'dis lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur gyi srid pa'i longs spyod la cen pas ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la mkhas pa kha cig ltos med drug ldan gyi tha snyad mdzad cing /sor sdud nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro yin gsung na/ ltos med drug tu mdzad pa ni/ 'grel chen gyi tshig zur dang 'grig pas legs pa'ang yin la/'di las sor sdud kyi yan lag kyang rim pas 'byung bas don la mi 'gal mod/—276—

rnam gzhag 'jog pa'i skabs sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gror bzhed pa ni mi legs pas rang lugs kyi bla ma rnams yan lag drug po thun mong gi sngon 'gror bzhed pa nyid don la gnas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dngos gzhi yan lag drug po rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor yin pas/ de'i gzhi 'dings pa'i sngon 'gro la yang ltos med bzhi po dgos pas chu gter rdo rje zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa sor bsam sku rdo rje rnal 'byor/ de bzhin du ngag la ltos med srog 'dzin gsung dang / sems la ltos med rjes dran thugs dang /'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhi 'dings pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas/ sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gro la sbyor rgyu min no/ /ltos med la yang don gyis rnam grangs drug gsungs 'dug mod kyang /phung po lnga dang / dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa gnyis po ltos med bzhir ma 'dus pa med cing / ltos med bzhi la rdo rje bzhi'i brdas bstan pas/ grangs bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa nyid gtso bo yin par gsal la/ rnam grangs drug so sor gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ dper na yi dam lha cig bskyed rim gyi sgo nas sgrub na/ dngos gzhi rdo rje bzhi lam byed bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi bsgom/ cha lag tu mchod pa dang / gtor ma dang / bza' ston sogs bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrub/ sngags kyi bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i sgo nas bsnyen pa byed dgos pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang rdzogs rim gyi lha'i bsnyen pa dben gsum 'di la/ dngos gzhi nyams len ltos med bzhi dang / mchod gtor dang /bza' ba'i dam tshig gi dod phung dbang gi ltos med gnyis dang / bzlas pa'i —277—

dod tha mal rags pa'i rlung sbyong ba zhig dgos par gsungs so/ /des na rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro'i nyams len la/ bskyed rim gyi de dang de'i dod tshang tshul bshad pas/ ltos med kyi rnam grangs drug byung na'ang / don gyi rnam grangs dbye sgo sde tshan gnyis yar bsdu mar bsdu byas pa las drug byung ba tsam du zad kyi/ dbye sgo gcig dang dkyus thog gcig la drug bgrong rgyu ma yin te/ de ltar yin na bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje zhes mi gsung par/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa drug po zhes gsung dgos par 'gyur ro/ /dper brjod na yang sde tshan gcig la bram rigs rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs zhes mi rigs bzhi bshad/ rnam grangs gzhan du phyug po'i rigs dang dbul po'i rigs zhes mi rigs gnyis bshad na/ de gnyis bsdoms te mi rigs drug gi tha snyad byas kyang ches legs pa ma yin pa bzhin te/ spyir dbye sgo tha dad pa'i dbye ba'i yan lag rnams gcig tu bsres te/ rnam grangs su bgrong ba la yang 'gal ba med pas 'dir yang ltos med drug gi tha snyad rang ta mi 'gog cing /sa bcad drug tshan sgrig pa'i legs cha tsam 'dug kyang ltos med kyi ngo bo mi 'dra ba drug yod do snyam/ bzhir ma 'dus so snyam pa'i 'khrul gzhi skye nyen che bas/re zhig ltos med bzhi ldan kho na'i tha snyad bya'o/ /de ltar na yang skabs 'di dag tu nyams len dmigs pa'i ngo bo dang go rim la/ jo zhal gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med pas rtsod pa mi dgos kyang / ltos med kyi rnal 'byor 'di rdzogs rim spyi dang sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gro gang du 'gro tshul dang / ltos med bzhi drug gi tha snyad 'jog tshul la/ dpal jo nang rnga/'i lugs 'di ka ches brling —278—

——rnga/ /ltos med de dag gi don ni/ rang lugs la gces par mi 'dzin pas gzugs phung dang / 'phral bde sdug gi dbang du mi gtong bar bsgom pas tshor ba dang / rnam rtog spong bas 'du shes dang / sgo gsum las med du 'jog pas 'du byed dang / rnam shes lnga'i rjes su rnam rtog mi 'brang bas rnam shes kyi phung po la ltos pa med pa'o/ /dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa yang rnam shes kyi ltos med 'di las phye ba yin te/ gzugs kyi snang ba ma shar na der zad/ mig shes la dngos su gzugs snang shar yang rung / yid yul du gzus/sa kyi rnam par shar yang drang / mdzes pa la ma chags mi mdzes pa la mi sdang / bar ma la yang dngos por mi 'dzin/ gzugs snang shar ba tsam ma gtogs/ rnam rtog gi blang dor dang 'dzin pa gang yang mi byed pa ni/ mig gi dbang po la ltos pa med pa ste/de bzhin du sgra dri ro reg la sbyar bas/ rna ba sna lce lus kyi dbang po la ltos pa med pa'o/ /lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni/ rnam grangs gcig tu na zas gos sogs lus kyi longs spyod mthun rkyen 'dzom na sgom nus ting nge 'dzin skye/ de dag ma 'dzom na sgom mi nus/ sems kyi tsher ma'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi skye na/ gang zag de'i dge sbyor de/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa can du song / 'di'i rigs la mthun rkyen de 'bad pas bsgrubs na ni/ g.yeng bas khyer te dge sbyor bde skabs mi yong / 'bad med du 'byung ba ni shin tu dkon pas/ kho'i dge sbyor de rkyen khar las pas yong mi yong the tshom zab las phal du mi yong ba shas che/ lan gcig byung kyang rkyen ma 'dzom na sgom 'chor bas/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa can gyi dge sbyor gyis rtag mi thub —279—

—bo/ /des na rkyen bzang ngan la khyad med du bsres te 'byor ba dang ldan yang bza' btung mgron 'bod sogs kyi rnam g.yeng mi byed par blo thag bcad de bsgom/ dbul zhing 'phongs kyang tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad/ zas gos gnas mal ngan ngon gyis chog shes par byas/ dka' ba dang du blangs te bsgoms pas/ gang zag de'i dge sbyor de lus kyi longs spyod bzang ngan dang yod med la ltos pa med pas/ de la sgom skye bar the tshom med/ rkyen la rag ma las pa'i phyir/ sgom skyes nas kyang mi nyams shing mgo thon pa mthar phyin par 'ong bas longs spyod 'dzom ma 'dzom la ltos pa med pa'i don du 'chad pa ltar yin/ des mtshon pa'i ngag gi longs spyod ni/ gtam snyan mi snyan dang /rang la gzhan gyi stod smad dang / rang gi ngag la gzhan gyi nyan mi nyan sogs yin la/ de dag la ltos pa med tshul gong dang 'dra/ yid kyi longs spyod ni/yid dga' ba dang / spro ba dang / skyo shas dang sems gcod dang / re ba dang /dogs pa dang / gnyen la 'dod chags dgra la gnod sems/ rang la nga rgyal la sogs pa'i ro myang zhing / rnam rtog de dag dang du len pa yin la/ de dag gi 'khri ba bcad/ ro mi myong / de dag gi dbang du mi btang bar dge sbyor la 'gril ba ni/ ltos pa med pa'i don te gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang rnam grangs gnyis pa longs spyod la ltos pa med pa'i go don gyi gtso bo ni/ longs spyod bya ba longs spyod bya'i yul dang / longs spyod pa po'i gang zag dang / ji ltar longs spyod pa'i tshul gsum ga la 'jug cing / bltos pa med pa'i don zhen pa med cing 'dzin pa med pa'i don yin pas/ longs spyod pa po dbang po rten dang —280—

bcas pa'i rang gi lus/ longs spyad bya'i yul lus kyi bde sdug dang / bde sdug 'byung ba'i rkyen zas gos khang pa nor rdzas yul zhing / dgra gnyen dug dang / mtshone cha dang / tsha grang gi rkyen la sogs pa sna tshogs pa rnams dang / ji ltar longs spyod pa'i tshul/ 'gro sdod/ nyal ldang / len 'jog brdeg 'tshog sogs lus kyi spyod lam rnams yin te/ de thams cad gnas skabs su mi rtag cing mi brtan la/ g.yas med 'gangs chung 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir/ chags sdang spang blang byed rin yang mi chog don du ni dngos po la cung zad yang ma grub pa'i 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir/ chags rgyu dang / sdang rgyu dang / phan 'dogs rgyu dang / gnod par byed rgyu rang yang ma grub pas thams cad yul stong par shes pas/ blos tsam bzhag tu bsgyur nas bya byed spangs te mnyam par 'jog pa'i don yin/ de bzhin du ngag dang yid la'ang sbyar te/ de'i tshe lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed rang gis kyang mi byed/ gzhan byed pa la blo yang mi 'jug bya ba cig 'ong / de dag bsdoms pas gang la'ang bdag po mi byed/ byar med las med du 'jog bya ba zhig 'ong bas/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang / lus bya byed kyis dben pa'i lus dben gnyis don gcig de bzhin du ngag dang yid la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni/ theg le byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa ni 'pho ba/ zhes bya ba yin pas/dngos su thig le ma nyams par srung dgos/ de'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni mtha' rgya bkyed nas/ re zhig gnyis sbyor gyi 'dod chags la brten pa'i rnam rtog gi rigs gang yang yid la mi byed/ gal te rang shugs su blo la shar —281—

na'ang / dang du mi len par de ma thag 'phro gcod pa'o/ /'di la spyir lus ngag yid gsum char gyi cha shas yod kyang / thig le 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi chags rtog 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas logs su bcad pa yin/ des na ltos med bzhi ru 'jog skabs su thig le 'pho ba'i lus kyi bya ba ma yin pa'i lus kyi longs spyod la 'dzin zhen spangs pa ni/ lus la ltos med yin/ des ngag dang yid la'ang 'gre/ thig le 'pho ba'i bya bar gtogs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi bya ba la 'dzin zhen spong ba ni/ ltos med bzhi pa yin gyi dang po gsum la mi bgrong ste/chos 'di la bzhi pa rtsal du 'don dgos pa'i phyir dang / thig le 'pho ba dang 'brel ma 'brel la lus ngag yid kyi bya ba tsam du mtshungs kyang / ngo bo dang rnam pa yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad che zhing / 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin min dang sgrib pa sbyong dka' sla'i khyad par shin tu che bas nges par logs su bgrangs pa'o/ /dben pa gsum gyi skabs su/ dben pa'i don spangs pa tsam yin pas/ /ltos med bzhi pa 'di yang dben pa'i cha nas snga ma gsum gyi nang du bsdus pa ste/ spyir rdo rje bzhi yang rdo rje gsum gyi nang du 'dus pa dang / de las kyang khyad par du dus 'khor rang las ni/ dben pa gsum dang bzhi'i tha snyad mi gsal/ 'dus pa sogs gzhan las dben pa gsum gyi tha snyad kho na mdzad kyi bzhi pa ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ ltos dben 'di gnyis don gcig kyang rnam gzhag mi 'dra bas/dben pa bzhi dang ltos med gsum kho na'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /des na dben pa'i skabs su gsum du 'dus/ ltos med kyi skabs su bzhir dbye dgos/dbang po dang gzugs phung la ltos med ni lus la ltos med du 'dus shing /—282—

'du shes sems la ltos med du 'dus/ 'du byed dang tshor ba la ltos med bzhi ka'i cha shas yod do/ /'o na rlung sbyong ba rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gror bshad pa de ci snyam na/ skabs 'dir dgang ba dang / dbyung ba dang / bum pa can phal pa rnam sa kyi man ngag la bslab cing / de gnad du 'gro ba'i phyir lus sbyongs kyang mang du byas na/ phyis dngos gzhi sor bsam gyi dus su/ rtags bcu nges pa can rnams myur du 'char ba dang / sor bsam la brtan pa thob nas srog rtsol sgom pa na/ sngar rlung rags pa byang zin pa'i phan yon gyis/ skabs der srog rtsol gyi rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin myur du skye ba yin pas/ gang zag gi rigs gcig la 'khrid tshul de ltar 'jug pa bde ba zhig 'byung bas/ sngon 'gro'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa yin gyi/ sor bsam gyi nyams myong skye ba la med du mi rung ba'i sngon 'gro gru/ yin no/ /sngon byon dpal rga lo'i lugs kyi sbyor drug dang / khrom lo'i sbyor drug dang / phyis dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang brnyes pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa las kyang / sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba lus sbyongs dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /'di rnams kyi lugs ltar na rlung sbyang ba zla drug gam lo sogs bsgoms pas/ pho rlung 'byongs pa tsam 'byung zhing / de'i rgyun ma chad pa la sor bsam dang bsdebs te bsgoms pas/ pho rlung de mo rlung du 'gyur nas sor bsam mthar phyin tsa na mo rlung 'byongs/ nam srog rtsol gyi rim pa la 'jug pa na/ mo rlung thul te ma ning gi rlung du song bas/ ma ning gi rlung nyag gcig la gnad du bsnun chog pas/ srog 'dzin gyi yon tan gegs med myur bar kho nar bde blag tu skye'o zhes gsung ba/ de'i nang nas kyang rga lo'i lugs —283—

la ni sor sdud dang srog rtsol bum can sbrags te bsgom par 'dod pas/ 'khrid tshul de rigs la rlung sbyang ba sngon 'gror dgos nges su 'dug gzhan yang rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa la sogs 'di dag rnams kyis gal te bsngags pa rnams kyi 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da bsgoms pas btsan thabs chu skyes gnas su rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes sor sdud kho na'i rnal 'byor pa la yang / spogs chog thig le'i btsan thabs bsgom pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i rigs la yang sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba nges par dgos so/ /snga phyi'i sbyor drug pa 'ga' zhig gi ngag sgro sa la/ rgyud gzhud gi dngos bstan sor sdud nas 'go rtsom pa 'di/ gzhung lam yin yang bla ma'i man ngag gis srog rtsol nas 'go rtsom pa yang yod zer ba yang sngon du rlung sbyong ba 'di rigs la bsam par 'dug sor sdud dang bum can sbrags pa la sor sdud srog rtsol sbrags pa yin zhes 'chad pa rnams kyang / srog rtsol rjes mthun pa dang / srog rtsol gyi ring rgyu tsam dang / srog rtsol gyi sgrub pa tsam po yin pa la bsam pa'am rlung gi rnal 'byor yin tshad la srog rtsol du ming 'dogs pa tsam yin na/ tha snyad tsam la dpyad pa byar med/ yan lag drug gi nang tshan srog rtsol gyi rim pa la bsam pa yin na ni lam gyi 'gangs ye ma go ba'i cal col te sor sdud dang po'i skabs gyi bum can yang srog rtsol gyi rim pa ma yin te/skabs der rlung dbu mar 'bab pa tsam yin yang 'ching mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /srog rtsol gyi rim pa ta min yang srog rtsol gyi yan lag tsam yin/ sor sdud kyi srog rtsol lo snyam na/ de tsam la bum can sogs med mi rung ma yin/—284—

mi g.yo gsum ldan kho nas kyang 'grub pas sor sdud yin na srog rtsol dang sbrags te sgom par khyab par thal lo/ /sngon 'gro'i rlung sbyang ba ni/ rlung sbyor rang gi sgo nas mu stegs byed tshun chad dang thun mong ba yin la/ srog rtso' gyi rim pa'i bum can sogs ni/ rags pa'i dbu mar rags pa'i rlung bcings pa ste/ ye shes kyi dbu ma'i nang du dgag pa'i thabs yin pa/ bla med sbas rgyud pa'i man ngag rnams la'ang cher med pas khyad shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang man ngag lag len de ltar byed pa la ni 'gal ba med pas/ lag len man ngag gang yin pa de gnad ma 'chugs par bstan na legs kyi/ rgyud gzhung gi lam gyi rim pa la ma sbyangs pa dag go don bshad pa'i rigs mang du smra nga de shin tu mi mjes so/ /de ltar yin mod kyang / deng sang gi sgom byed pa phal che ba zhig la ni/ sems gnas pa cung zad cig ma skyes na/ rlud gi rtsol ba rnams gnad du mi 'gro ba rang mang bar snang zhing / thog ma nas rlung sgom pa de skye bo shas che ba la 'jug pa yang mi bde ba dang / dpe bskyed rim gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs kyang / bskyed rim sgom pa gtso bo dang bzlas pa yan lag yin pas/dbang po rno na bzlas pa med kyang bskyed rim bsgom pa 'ba' zhig gis don 'grub pa ltar/ 'dir yang ltos med gtso bo yin/ rlung sbyang ba yan lag yin/rlung sbyang ba med kyang ltos med 'ba' zhig gis skabs 'dir rdon 'grub pas/sbyor drug lugs srol tha dad pa phal cher la/ skabs 'dir rlung sbyang ba mi mdzad cing / 'bro lugs dang bi bhu ta'i lugs la'ang mi mdzad pas/ dpal jo nang ba'i rang lugs la yang de bzhin no/ /spyir yang ltos med bzhi ldan dang —285—

rlud sbyang ba las dang po pa phal gyis dus gcig la mi 'grub pas/ gnyis kar byed na snga phyi rim can du sbyong dgos la/ gnyis po'i go rim la mtha' gcig tu nges par rang med kyang / ltos med sngon du byas na phal cher la legs so/ /yang sbyor drug gi man ngag rnying pa mang po zhig la/ sor sdud kho na nas 'go rtsom par 'dug pa/ sor sdud la ltos med bzhi tshang ngo snyam par 'dug kyang / rgyud las ltos med bsnyen pa dang / sor sdud nyer sgrub tu gsungs pa'i skabs dang cung zad 'gal bas/ ltos med bzhi ldan logs su byed pa 'di chad na mi rung ngo / /yang don gcig po 'di la dben gsum zhes pa dang / ltos med bzhi ldan zhes pa'i tha snyad ming 'dogs gnyis po gang gtso che zhe na/ dus 'khor nyid las gsungs pas ltos med gtso che ba tsam yin yang / da lta lag len du 'debs pa dang mthun par go bde ba'i phyir/ rang lugs kyi brgyud pa 'di la dben gsum gyi tha snyad grags che'o/ /khrid yig tu/ sngar sgo gsum gyi las byas pa rnams/ don med dang don log tu song zhes pa'i go don ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed byas tshad/ dge sdig lung ma bstan gsum gang rung las ma 'das/ sgo gsum gyi sdig pa byas tshad don med tsam yang ma yin don log ste/rang gi rang nyid sdug bsngal myong ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu song / lung ma bstan byas pa rnams tshe stong zad dang don med kho nar song / dge ba byas pa rnams kyang 'khor ba'i bde ba than thun gyi rgyur song yang / bde ba de rtag mi thub par nyams pas phubs blos brtad thub pa'i 'bras bu ma byung ba'i don chung ngu la dus 'das te/ don chen po med pas don med ces bya/ sngar dus mtha' med pa de —286—

'dra'i bar du/ las de tsam byas kyang 'bras bu ma byung bas/ de yang sngar gyi de 'dra ji tsam byas kyang blo brtad thub pa'i 'bras bu mi yong bas/ da ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed thams cad ci dgar bor la/ bsam med du 'jog bya ba'i don yin rgo /dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ gnas mun khang dang / lta stangs dang byed bcings thun mong ma yin pa rnams mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'i nges pa med pas / sngon dus mun khang ma yin pa'i gnas ji ltar 'os par lus gnad dkyus 'gro tsam 'cha' ba'i srol yang byung mod kyi/ skabs der lus gnad dkyus 'gro de yang 'byongs 'byongs su sbyongs dgos shing / yang dngos gzhi la zhugs dus mun khang la yang ma 'dris pas thog ma nyams mi bde ba 'byung / sngar gyi lus gnad 'byongs ba'i khungs des go mi chod par/ byed bcings kyi lus gnad gsar du sbyongs dgos pas/ snga ma de las nor 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'byung bas na/ kun spangs chen po phyin chad kyi phyag len du dben gsum la gnas dang byed bcings gang gis kyang rung ba'i phyir/ 'di yang rung ba las skabs 'dir mun khang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byed bcings de lus gnad dkyus ma dang lhan cig skabs 'dir 'byongs pas/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su dka' tshegs mi dgos par/ dmigs pa gnad du 'gro ba zhig yong ba thugs myong gis grub nas/ mun khang dang lta stangs sogs dngos gzhi dang khyad med par mdzad rga /des na dben gsum 'di mun khang nga/nga byed bcings drag po'i khyad tsam ma gtogs bod nyid la grags pa'i phyag chen/ zhi byed/ rdzogs chen/ sems sde gcod yul/ bsam mi khyab/ 'khore 'das dbyer med/ ka dag —287—

khregs gcod la sogs par grags pa'i gdams ngag gi gnad ma lus pa 'di kho na la 'dus/ sor sdud yan chad la/ gdams ngag de dag gis snyoms par mi spobs pa'i mngon par mtho ba'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan nga/ yin no/ /gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'phros las/ gdams ngag gzhan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams/ 'dir thun mong gi sngon 'gror byed/ gzhan gyi dngos gzhi rnams 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gror byed/ zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di la dgongs/ 'o na 'dir mi rtog pa nyid la 'jog pa tsam du 'dug gzhan 'ga' zhig tu sems 'tshol dang dran pa'i tsho 'dzin byed pas de lhag snyam na/ dran pa'i so ba ni 'dir yang gtong la/ sems 'tshol du 'dod pa de tshan yang dgos pa'i skabs byung na/ chos 'di'i cha lag la yang yod cing / yod pa tsam du ma zad lhag dang bcas par yang yod mod/ lan gcig rtog dpyod kyi rtsol ba byed phyin/sems 'tshol de la'ang gcig tu 'gangs che rgyu med/ de bas rgyus pa bdag med stong nyid kyi go myong thag chod gol sa gcod pa mtha' yas pa zhig chos 'di la yod pa yin/ 'on kyang lam gyi rkang la ma bcos par 'jog phyin/ sems 'tshol dang dran 'dzin yang dgos rgyu med de de gnyis kar blos byas yin pa'i phyir/ gnas lugs gdod ma la reg par mi nus so/ /bram ze chen pos kyang /chu dang mar me rang gsal zhig tu zhog /ces gsungs te/ dper na chu rnyog ma can de g.yo ba med par bzhag na/ rnyog ma thams cad rang sangs te dngas par gyur pa na/ chu nang na yod tshad gsal bar mthong 'ong / de'i tshe rnyog ma can gyi chu nang na dngos po ci yod 'tshol ba la/ lag nom byed cing chu dkrus mi dgos —288—

par dngos su mthong ba yin/ de bzhin du sems rnam rtog spangs te g.yo med/ du bzhag pas/ shes pa nyag nyog sangs shing dwangs pa na/ rig pa rang gi sdod lugs rang gzugs de gsal bar mthong yong / de tsa na sems dang rnam rtog 'dres pa'i rnyog chu la rtog dpyod sems 'tshol gyi lag pas dkrug mi dgos/sems kyi ngo bo rtsol med du mthong yong / yang da lta phan cher dran 'dzin gyi tsho 'dzin dgos zer yang / nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skyes res kyi ngos gzung nas dbyings su ni gcod/ de la sgom chen pa rnams dran pa zer gyin 'dug pa/ de ni zhor byung thams cad du 'dir yang lag len la ni 'debs/ de tsam la nyams len mthar thug tu ni mi rtsi/ sems rang ngo shes dgos pa yin zhes grags te byar med kyi sgo nas rang rig pa ni/ sems dbye na rnam par mi rtog pa kho na rang yin/ blos byas kyi ngo shes la ha las rgyu tsam med/ de ni sems 'khrid gsha' ma zhig byas na thams cad la shugs 'byung du 'ong ba lags/ mdor na phal cig blos byas kyi chos kyis sangs mi rgya zhes 'gram pa bud bud kha na 'don bzhin du/ rig pa rkyang 'dod dang / dran pa bsten pa dang / rang zhal la blta ba dang /che re blta dgos bya ba sogs slar yang blos byas shig rang la blo ri rtse gtod pa 'di yang ya re che'o/ /sgos su yang ye shes kyi nyams rtsal phyogs med du rgyas nas/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char sgo 'byams klas pa'i skabs shig tu/nyams rang shar byung rgyal du bskyangs dgos pa la/ dran pa'i tsho 'dzin yin par rlom nas mgo bkug dbugs bsngams bsdad pas nyams myong dang yon tan phyogs med du 'char ba la gegs chen po byed pa yin/ dran pa'i so pa spong —289—

dgos pa'i skabs kyang mang ngo / /yang 'ga' zhig rnam rtog sgom gyi rtsal yin bcad du mi btub zer te/ sa ra ltas/ rtog pa nyams pas blo nyams shes/ /blo ngan rjes su rtog byed lo/ /de nyid las ni blo bzang po/ /nam mkha' las lhag ci yang 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas dngos su bkag cing / rgyud las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyu/ra/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam rtog chad pa'i shul na rig pa tsam 'dug pa dang / rnam rtog sdod tshugs ma thub pa tsam la ci yang med pa 'dra zhig myong ba na/ sems nyid rnam rtog rnam rtog nyid sems nyid yin snyam zhing smra ba dang / rnam rtog stong nyid stong nyid chos sku'o snyam du sems shing smra ba ni 'char sgo dang sems kyi mtshan nyid phyogs re rig pa las/go tshul phyogs re ba zhig byung / go tshul de dang mthun pa'i tha snyad re btags par 'dug dper na chu chad pa'i shul sar 'dug pas chu dang sa gcig par 'dzin pa dang / khang pa 'gyel bzhin pa'i dus na bar snang stong pa 'dug pas/bar snang nyid khang pa'o snyam du sems pa dang 'dra'o/ /nyams myong cung zad dang 'brel ba'i go ba rab rib re ta yod de/ rnam par dbye ba 'chad pa'i tshe/ chos las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bya dgos kyi rang re so so skye bo'i nyams myong re dang bstun nas grub mtha' 'jog cing brda chad gsar pa re byed pa ni/bdud kyi dkrugs ma'o/ /gzhan yang rnam rtog dang / rnam rtog gi rang bzhin gnyis dbye ba phyed dgos/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin de ni stong pa yin mi rtog pa yin pas rnam rtog ma yin/ rnam rtog 'char sgo kho rang ni med bzhin du snang ba'i —290—

'khrul ba yin pas/ rnam rtog kho rang gi rang bzhin yang ma yin/ gzhan gang su'i yang rang bzhin yang ma yin/ snang tsam ma gtogs ngo bo med do/ /dper na mig 'khrul mkhan gyis bre la sngags btab/ ltad mo ba rnams kyis mchod rten du mthong ba dang 'dra/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin bre dang 'dra/ snang cha rnam rtog kho rang mchod rten dang 'dra/ bre shing yin kyang sgyu ma'i mchod rten la shing yin rgyu med/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin ye shes yin du chug kyang / rnam rtog nyid ngo bos ma grub pas rnam rtog la ye shes yin rgyu ma byung / gal te rnam rtog ye shes yin na/ ye shes yin pa'i rnam rtog cig grub par thal/ dper na bre shing yin pas sgyu ma'i mchod rten yang shing ka yin na/ sgyu ma'i mchod rten gyi thad na shing gi mchod rten yod par thal ba bzhin no/ /des na rnam rtog gi rnam pa ma yal bzhin du gtad med yal yul zang thal le bar myong ba de ni/ rnam rtog de 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yong ma myong ba'i rtags yin/ nam ngo bo la ltas dus ci yang med pa ltar snang ba de ni/ rjes 'thud med mtshams sbyor ba med/ ma 'brel ba skad cig gis 'jig pa/ mi gnas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gnad rig pa zhig gis bsgom na phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang rang bzhin med pa la 'jug nus kyang / ye shes chos sku yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi 'gyur ro/ / yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gnad la sbyor ma thub na yal yul dang ci yang med pa 'dra ba de lung ma bstan du las 'gro/ yang stong rkyang la chos sku'i ming 'dogs/ snang ba dang rang bzhin gyi dbye ba mi 'byed par bshad pa yin snyam na/ de ltar byed du zad mod/ lung gi brda chad dang rig —291—

nga 'i tshul las ni 'das so/ /gzhan yang rig pa la ltas pas rnam rtog nyid/ mi rtog pa'i rig pa yin pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa ni/ dar la seng gi mig nas nam mkha' mthong ba lta bu yin/ rnam stog shugs drag la bltas pas/ sems stong gsal gyi snang ba rnam rtog tu shar ba zhig 'dug snyam pa ni/ bya 'phur ba'i rjes su bya gdang 'gul ba ltar shugs drag 'gags pa'i rjes kyi sems gsal stong la snga ma'i dri ma chags pa yin pa la / dus myur bas shugs drag de ka gsal stong du 'dug go snyam snga phyi gnyis gcig tu 'khrul ba yin/ des na nyams myong shar tshu' re yod kyang / ngo sprod lugs 'khrul na gol sa 'byung bas/ ngo sprod ma 'khrul ba yang gal che'o/ / ma/thar gtugs na yul gyis rnam pa ma bsgyur ba'i gsal rig tsam rgyun chad rgyu med pa 'di ni ye shes dngos ma yin kun gzhi rnam shes yin/ de dang ye shes rnam pa 'dra rung du yod pas/ ye shes dngos su ma bshad par dpe'i tshu' gyi ye shes su ngo sprad na legs cha tsam yod do/ /kun gzhi rna ma shes de yang ye shes bde gshegs snying po'i sgrib byed yin zhing / de ya/nga dngos su na/ rmi lam snang ba'i skyes bus yod pa'i dngos po mi mthong / med pa'i rmi lam mthong ba dang / sgyu mas bslad pa rnams kyis yod pa'i tshogs pa mi mthong / med pa'i rgyu ma mthong ba ltar yin mod kyang / re zhig so so skye bo dang 'phags pa slob pa rnams kyi blo ngo myo snang ba ltar rnam par bzhag na/ sems can de dang de la lhos nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po don dam pa'i rang rig ye she/sa te/ /sems can de nyid kyi kun gzhi rnam shes kyis g.yogs/ de'i tshe ral gri'i shubs ral gri dang dbyibs rjes mthun du 'byung ba ltar/ kun gzhi —292—

de yang snying po dang rnam pa 'dra rung du yod/ ral gri dngos su ma bstan kyang shubs mthong bas ral gri'i dbyibs rjes su dpog nus pa ltar/ kun gzhi gsal rig tsam nyid las snying po rjes su dpog pa'i ngo sprod byed pa yin/'dir ngo sprod thun mong ba na rgyas par bshad yod pas der gzigs/ kun gzhi snying po'i sgrib g.yogs yin yang / kun gzhi la gnad du bsnun na/ snying po rtogs pa'i lam du 'gyur te/ mi gos can gyi gos nas bzung bas mi yang zin par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ yun ring du sgom mkhan yin na/ bde gshegs snying po ngo sprod tshul de ltar yin la/ bde gshegs snying po dben gsum du ngo sprod na ni/ kun gzhi la brten nas byed/dngos gzhi'i nyams skyes pa la ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes la brten nas rjes su dpog mi dgos te/ bde gshegs snying po'i snang ba dngos 'od gsal rtags bcu mngon du gyur pa la ngo sprod/ 'di 'khrid dngos gzhi'i skabs gtso che/ ngo sprod tshul ni ngo sprod thun mong ma yin par gzigs 'tshal/ dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir bshad pa'i mtha' gcod dang ngo sprod 'di rnams 'khrid 'chad pa po rang gi nyams myong la rags rim shar ba dang rnam gzhag zhib mor blo la nges pa gal che zhing / ngo sprod 'chad skabs dang / shes rab can 'dus par mtha' gcod dgos dus/ rang lugs kyi chos skad rkang tshug pa'i phyir nges par bshad dgos/ go ba chung chung tshogs pa la 'khrid 'chad dus/ mtha' gcod kyi bshad pa mi dgos shing / dben gsum zhag bdun tsam las yun ring mi byed par/dngos gzhi la 'phral du 'jug pa'i lag len byed pa la skabs 'dir ngo sprod kyi —293—

rigs byed mi dgos/ rgyun du sgom mkhan gyi rigs yin na/ rjes su rim pas ngo sprod bya'o/ /de yang gong du zur tsam smos pa ltar dang / ngo sprod phyi nang gi yi ger gsal bar bris pa dang / rgyas par na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo kun mkhyen r+ṣa po dngos slob dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ gsung rab ngo sprod rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ bla ma'i gsung las 'gyung ba ltar ngo sprod dgos kyi/ bod kyi sgom chen par grags pa phal pa byings 'di'i kha rgyug 'ad lud chal chol gyi bsre bslad med pa gal che/ don gyi snying po 'khor 'das snod bcud/ phyi snang ba/ nang rnam rtog /gzhi 'khor ba/ lam sgom pa/ 'bras bu gsar thob/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ mdor na snang grags kyi chos thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du ngo sprod/ de ltar yin yang / rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa ma 'gags par / snang ba sna tshogs sgo thams cad nas 'char sgo mi 'gag ste/ sgyu ma lta bur ngo sprad/ don dam dbyings bde gshegs snying po kun khyab rtag pa srid zhi snang grags kyi chos thams cad las 'das gzhi lam 'bras bu'i khrem gnyer thams cad gdod ma nas sangs pa de/ rnam pa kun ldan du ngo sprad/ de gsum ka la da ltar cha shas dngos su myong ba rnams nyams myong dang bstun nas ngo sprad/ da ltar dngos su ma myong yang rang gi myong ba de la brten nas nges shes 'dren thub pa rnams la/ rjes dpag gi tshul gyis ngo sprod/ lam mthar thug mthon po'i gnas skabs rnams/ rgyud gzhung gi don lung tshad ma la brten nas ngo sprod/mnyam gzhag la la zla ba dang / rjes thob 'khor 'das kyi ru shan 'byed pa gnyis po yang ma 'dres par ngo sprad dgos/ bod sgom snga phyi mang po zhig dang /—294—

da lta yod pa phal cher/ rang gi nyams su ma myong ba de mi 'dod nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas man chad nyams 'og tu chud gyu ba byed cing / rang gis nyams su ma myong ba'i lam mthon po thams cad rang gi nyams myong yin tshul gyi ngo sprad pas/ rang la blo brtad pa'i slob ma thams cad bslus/ nyams myong rbang chung la bdag rkyen che grags/ bsam mno btang ba'i rig gras la nyams myong du kha g.yar bas sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun/ lung rigs dang 'gal ba'i bab col gyi don spyi wal wal la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang 'phags lam du ngo sprad pas 'phags pa thams cad dang chos la skur ba btab/ dper na sprang po mdzes khyer zhig bstan nas/ 'di 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yin zhes byas na/ ngo sprod tshul shin tu tha chad par ma zad/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la smad par yang 'gyur ba rgyal po'i khrims phog pa bzhin no/ /des na dpe don du sbyor dgos rnams dpe las don mtshon pa'i tshul gyis ngo sprod byed na mi 'gal yang / dpe nyid don du ngo sprod pa sogs ngo sprod log pa rdzun gyi phung po mi zad pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig par ma byed cig yang dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ chos thun mang rab byed cing / chos go nus pa la nges shes skye ba'i dgos pa yod na/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu nyes pa lnga/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi dbye ba sogs/ zhi lhag gi bshad pa ji ltar 'os pa yang drangs te/ 'di nyid kyi dmigs pa dang sbyar nas bshad na'ang legs la/ yang blo dman la bshad pa mang pos sems 'khrugs pa de mi legs pa dang / mdor bsdus kyi skabs su de —295—

lta bu'i spros pa mi dgos so/ /de la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang //chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin/ /zhes byings rgod rnam rtog med par sems gsal stong du gnas pa ni zhi gnas/gnas lugs rjen ne gnas pa'i sems rtse gcig pa ni lhag mthong ngo zhi lhag sgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon to thams cad zhi lhag sgom pa las 'byung bas/ phan yon dpag tu med pa de dag thob pa'i phyir dang / gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ zhi gnas stobs kyis g.yo ba med par 'gro/ /lhag mthong gis ni ri dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ skye ba po yis zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong goms par byas na ni/ gnas ngan len gyi 'ching ba dang / /mtshan ma'i 'ching las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ dgos pa de dag gi phyir bsgom mo/ /go rim ni/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ / thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med par mngon dgag 'grub/ /zhes pa ltar yin mod/ theg pa 'dir ni de gnyis so sor 'tshol mi dgos par/ chabs gcig tu bsgrub pa yang yin no/ /zhi gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu zhes bya ba ste/ 'jog par byed/ rgyun du 'jog par byed/ bslan te 'jog par byed/nye bar 'jog par byed/ 'dul bar byed/ zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/—296—
