sems kyi rgyud gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog par byed/ zhes pa ste dgu yin la / dang po ni dmigs pa la sems gtod pa/ gnyis pa ni de'i rgyun yang yang 'thud pa/ gsum pa ni tshur bkug ste dmigs pa la 'jog pa'o/ /'di gsum thog ma'i skabs rang yin/ gnas skabs dang po'o/ /bzhi pa nyer 'jog ni/cung zad dmigs pa la sems ngang gis gnas pa ni/ de nyid yang yang rgyun 'thud cing skyong ba yin/ lnga pa ni cung zad skyo na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon to dran nas/ spro ba bskyed de yang bsgom pa yin/ drug pa ni/ rnam g.yeng dang rnam rtog gi nyes dmigs shes par byas nas chags sdang dang rnam g.yeng skyes pa dang du mi len par 'jog pa yin/ skyo ba dang rnam g.yeng shugs che ba yun ring ring 'dra ba byung na/ gnyen po de gnyis dgos/ bdun pa ni/ chags sdang sdug bsngal gyi rnam rtog shugs chung nge ba thol thol skye na/ rang zhi la gtong ba'am/ dga' mi dga' med par 'phro gcod pa'o/ /de rnams bar skabs gcig gi nyams len yin/ gnas skabs gnyis pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ bsgrims na bying rgod rnam g.yeng dang ma 'dres pa'i sems gnas pa de gang 'dod du skyong thub cing / ma bsgrims na rnam g.yeng gis gnod pa zhig yin te/ gnas skabs gsum pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ de nas ma bsgrims kyang / skyon dang bral ba'i gnas pa ste/ci 'dod 'dod du gnas shing / nam dgos su ldang nus pa ste/ gnas skabs bzhi pa'o/ /'di ci rigs par goms nas/ nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'gro ba la tshegs med do/ /skabs 'di dag tu spong rgyu'i nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo dang ni gdams ngag dag /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /'du mi byed dang 'du —297—

byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes le lo dang dmigs pa la g.yel ba gnyis kyis gnas skabs dang po dang / bying rgod kyis gnas skabs gnyis pa dang / 'du mi byed pas gsum pa dang / 'du byed de rtsol bas bzhi pa la bar du gcod nga sa/ gnas skabs de dang der de rnams spong dge se so/ /de rnams spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad ni/ gnas dang de la gnas pa dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang / /bying dang rgod pa rtogs pa dang / /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang / /zhi tshe rnal du 'dug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dad 'dun brtson 'grus shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ bzhi ni le lo'i gnyen po dang / dran pa ni dmigs pa brjed pa'i gnyen po dang / shes bzhin ni bying rgod kyi gnyen po dang / spong ba mngon par 'du byed pa ni/ mi rtsol ba'i gnyen po dang / rtsol ba klod pa'i btang snyom ni/ ha cang rtsol ba'i gnyen lnga'o/ /sems gnas dgu stobs drug gis 'grub pa yin te/ thos pa'i stobs kyis 'jog pa dang / bsam pa'i stobs kyis rgyun du 'jog pa dang / dran pa'i stobs kyis bslan te 'jog pa dang nye bar 'jog pa gnyis/ shes bzhin gyi stobs kyis 'dul byed zhi byed gnyis/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis nyer zhi dang rgyud gcig gnyis/ 'dres pa'i stobs kyis dgu pa mnyam par 'jog pa 'grub bo/ /gnas skabs bzhi la yid byed bzhi yod de/ dang po ni bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed dang / gnyis pa ni bar chad cing 'jug pa dang / gsum pa ni chad pa med par 'jug pa dang / bzhi pa ni lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /'dir ni de dag ming tsam smos par zad kyi don rgyas par dang nas bshad —298—

par bya la/ dmigs nga/ la yang yang sems 'thud cing / rnam rtog thol thol skye na sbad sbad bcad/ rnam g.yeng lcags thag sbrel du 'gro na rig pa la lcag bcug ste bsgrims/ nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten/ zhum pa dang rig pa shugs chung na spro ba bskyed/ rang shugs la gnas pa'i sgang la bcas bcos mi byed de/gong du bshad pa'i sems gnas thabs thams cad kyang lag len du de la 'dus so/ /de'i tshe sems gsal stong 'dzin med/ ma yengs pa phyogs cha nye ring med pa zhig 'dug pa de ka zhi gnas yin/ deng sang lag tu yang long ba de yin/ shin sbyangs la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gzhan du ma go babs tsam ma gtogs deng sang 'byung ba dkon/ la la 'dra rung byung yang khyad 'don gyi bogs tsam mi yong / lhag mthong la 'jig rten pa dang thar lam gyi dbye ba'am/rtog dpyod yod med dang / dpyad sgom 'jog sgom sogs kyi dbye ba du ma yod kyang / theg pa mthar thug 'dir ni stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya snang ba dang / lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams sna tshogs pa shar ba la/ bzo med du mnyam par 'jog pa 'di kho na lhag mthong yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las kyang / gzugs sogs nang gi chos rnams ni/ /mthong bas lhag mthong zhes brjod rga /zhes gsungs / de ltar na zhi lhag zung 'jug gi lam 'di la mnyam par bzhag na/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i bde ba dang legs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dkyus las/ dge ba'i las kyi spros pa yang phal cher bskyungs nas zhes pa'i don ni/ spyir dge ba'i las kyis sgrib par 'a sdu gyur ba ma yin/ mnyam bzhag mi nus pa'am/ mnyam bzhag la brtan pa —299—

thob na lus ngag gi dge ba la ji tsam brtson pa/ de tsam du bzang mod kyang re zhig ting nge 'dzin ma skyed pa skyed par byed pa'i skabs 'dir/ bya chos mang po de rnam g.yeng dang ngal dub tu song bas ting nge 'dzin mi skye/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin che brtad bsgrub rgyu yin pas/ gnyis ka mi lcogs byin de bor nas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug dgos/ spyod 'jug las/ stobs nyams pa dang rjes 'brel na/ /slar bya'i don du dor bar bya/ /legs par zin nas phyi ma dang / /phyi ma 'dod pas de spang bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi 'grub pa'i gnas mang po la ha cang rtsol grags pa/ brtson 'grub kyi skyon yin pas/ de'i gnyen por dor ba zhes bya ba/ blo sna mang po dor te gcig la bsgril bar gsungs so/ /de ltar zhag 'ga' shas dmigs pa rnams yang yang bskyang zhing / lag len nges por bslabs/ skam bsgrigs kyi sgo nas sgom du yang bcug /de nas bca' 'grig pa na mun khrid dam po la 'jug khar/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du skabs 'gar gtor dbang zhig mdzad pa'i srol yang yod/ gal che re re tsam ma gtogs gzhan la mi mdzad kyang gsung / phyis mi mdzad pa shas che/ med mi rung ni yin yang ma yin mod/ gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun yin pas res 'ga' 'grub na bzang bar ni mngon no/ /de la gtor dbang mi byed na der zad/ byed na de'i rjes su lus phud 'bul bar grags pa 'di byed/ de yang slob ma rnams 'dus/slob dpon stan mtho ba la 'dug yungs kar ram/ me tog gang yang rung ba la/oṃ u hu ho ha k+ṣa mang du bzlas la bzhag /'o pha ri blta 'dod na tshu ri nas ltos bya ba yin/ nged kyi lus gnad 'cha' ba la legs par gzigs shig byas nas —300—

lus gnad re re nas slob ma la ston/ yang 'di skad du/ sngar brjod pa ltar lus bya byed kyis dben pa de yang / nyal ba dang / snyes pa sogs sdod lugs gang byung gis chog pa ma yin/ lus gnad byed bcings phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ chos nas bshad pa gnad dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ las dang po pa ting nge 'dzin skye ba la/ lus gnad 'di gal che shos shig yin/ dam pa gong ma mang po'i rnam thar na yang / dus ga ge mo zhig na lus gnad 'byongs zhes yon tan khyad par can skyes pa'i rnam grangs su mdzad pa yod/ 'ga' zhig dge sbyor yod na sdod lugs la khyad med zer te/ sgom la brtan pa thob na lus gnad ma byas kyang mi gnod pa tsam yin gyi/ de nas kyang yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba la lus gnad mi dgos pa ma yin nyams rtogs te byang chub sems dpa' rgyal bu don grub las mtho ba mi yong ste/ de yang nyal nas ma yin/ 'gyel nas ma yin/snyes nas ma yin/ phar tsam tshur tsam byed kyin ma yin/ kha yengs mig yengs byed kyin ma yin/ lus gnad bcas te dben pa gsum gyi ngang nas sangs rgyas pa lags so/ /da lus gnad la yi rang stabs ma btung/ na ma gtogs/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung rang bcas dgos/ dri med 'od las/ bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gis sgom pa'i dus dang / 'dod pa'i lha la bstod pa'i dus su grangs bzhin du sangs rgyas rnams la rdo rje'i gdan bsngags shing / zhes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan ro rkyang gi rtsa rkang pa'i dbus su 'gro zhing / rtsa'i rtse mo rkang mthil gyi bar du yod pas/ rkang pa gnyis gcig gis gcig gcer zhing 'dud pa na/ rtsa der rgyu ba'i rlung 'gag ste smad kyi rtsa rnams 'ching ba yin/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs —301—

pas/ rtsa dbu ma drang por 'drongs/ rtsa 'khor rnams gcig steng su gcig khel bas/ rlung rnams rang gnas su rgyu/ thig le yang rang gnas su gnas pa yin/lus mdun du gug na dbus kyi rtsa mdun rlung khams kyi rtsa dang thug pas/ snying rlung sogs rlung nang 'jug shes pa 'phyo zhing rnam rtog 'khrug de bzhin du g.yas la yo na/ me'i rtsa dang thug pas sems 'khrug /zhe sdang skye/ khrag mkhris ldang / g.yon du yo na chu khams dang thug pas/ 'dod chags skye/ grang gzhi dang bad kan ldang / rgyab tu dgye na sa khams dang thug pas shes pa bying / 'dus pa'i nad ldang / yo 'khyog med par lus bsrangs pas skyon de dag mi skyed pas gegs phal cher mi 'byung / rlung rang gnas su rgyus/ rtsa thig rang gnas su gnas pas/ ting nge 'dzin skyon dang bral ba skye sla ba dang / rlung dbu mar 'bab sla ba'i dgos pa yod/ mgrin pa dgug bya ba/ ltag pa 'phreng la chag ske mdun la gug pa'i go ba ma yin/ mjing pa drang por bsrings pas lkog mas ol mdud non pa la zer/ 'di dang dpung pa phyir bkyed de mthong kha rgyas par byas pas/ stod kyi rlung rnams dbu mar 'ching / lag pa gnyis la'ang ro rkyang gi rtsa yod cing / rtse mo lag mthil dang lag sor gyi bar du'ang yod pas rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa na/ de dag gi rtse mo nas tshur bsdams te/ de'i 'phrul las lag pa dang stod kyi rlung 'chings thub/ srin lag 'dre rtsa yin te mthe bong gis btsir bas bgegs mi 'jug mnyam bzhag dang khu tshur brla bzhag gnyis ka rgyud 'grel las gsungs mod/ khu tshur brla bzhag byed bcings 'chun che bas 'di kho na gtso bor mdzad/ so mchu rang sar bzhag nas lce rtse rkan la sbyar bas/—3()2—

mgrin pa nas smin mtshams ma/na chad kyi rlung 'ching / lta stangs steng la brtad pas dpral ba dang / gtsug tor gyi rlung 'ching ba ni smos ma dgos/ yan lag dang dbang po thams cad la ro rkyang gi yal ka re yod kyang / gzhan rnams phal pa yin/ gtso bo rgyal po lta bu gsang ba'i dbang po la yod/ des bag chags dang / rnam shes mtha' dag skyed/ las byed blon po lta bu mig la gnas/ phyi yul gyi rnam rtog phal cher des skyed/ gsang ba'i rtsa 'bru chags pa/ lta bu dang /mig gi rtse me tog lta bu yin gsung / lus byed bcings pas gtso bo gsang bar gnas pa de yang g.yo mi thub par rang shugs la 'ching / mig steng du bstad pas ro rkyang mgo nas bzung ste btsir ba lta bu yin/ mgo nas btsir pas de'i shugs kyis mas sna gsang bar rlung rgyugs pa de mtha'i la thug pa na yar ldog ste rtsa dbu mar 'ju ga pa yin/ mig 'bras g.yo ba med par bzhag pas/ ro rkyang gi rtsa 'gul ma thub/ rtsa ma 'gul bas rlung g.yo ba mkhan med par gsar pa mi skye zhing / rnying pa'i rgyun rnams je phra je chung du 'gro/ ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ji tsam zhan du song ba bzhin/ dbu ma'i rgyu ba stobs rgyas pas ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang lus gnad kho nas 'grub pa rang ta ma/ yin mod/ ji skad du/mkha' 'drar byas na rlung ni rnam par 'ching / /zhes sa ra has gsungs pa ltar/lta stangs kyi lam las sems spros pa dang bral bar rtse gcig tu gnas pas/rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa rtsom pa na lus gnad byed bcings de dag re res grogs byas te/ dmigs gnad dang byed bcings de kun 'dus pa las rlung btsan thabs su ldog par 'gyur ba yin no/ /da nged kyi lus gnad ji ltar —3()3—

byas pa bzhin khyed rang rnams kyang chos shig byas la/ de rnams lus gnad byed du bcug zhib mor brtags de yo 'byog sogs skyon rnams bcos/ da lus gnad 'di ka ma gtogs lus bya byed gzhan thams cad dang bral ba la zhog cig sngar lus 'gro 'dug spyod lam sna tshogs dang / ngag gtam sna tshogs smras pas rlung 'khrugs yod/ de'i rgyun la dmigs pa brtad na rtsa log rlung log gi gegs 'byung / dper na snod la mi gtsang ba'am dug sogs kyi dri ma gos par/bcud bzang po blug kyang chud 'dza' ba dang 'dra/ des na 'khrug pa de sel dgos pas/ nged kyis rlung ro bsal ba bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyang sna nas rlung dal la ring ba'i tshul gyis rlung ro lan gsum sangs te phyir bus shig byas la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rlud ro lan gsum bsal/ des rlung 'khrugs pa rnams sangs te rang gnas su rgyu bas gegs mi 'byung / ting nge 'dzin dang gis skye/ rlung 'byongs pa'i bde ba 'byung / snod la bkru bshal dang khang pa la phyag dar byas pa dang 'dra/ da thun gyi 'gor rlung ro bsal ba 'di ma gtogs/ngag gi smra brjod lta ga la zhig rlung yang rang babs kho nar zhog cig da ni sngar yang yang bstan pa bzhin 'gyu byed rnam rtog gang yang ma byed/ ci yang mi mno mi bsam gang yang yid la ma byed par cham me zhog cig byas la/ dpon slob thams cad lus gnad bcas te dar cig bsgom/ bar bar du dmigs pa gsal 'debs dang / rnam rtog gcod lugs yod tsam yod tsam bshad/ nus na chu tshod re tsam bsgom du 'jug de tsam byed mi 'dod na ji ltar 'os tsam bzhag de yang chu tshod re la ma ṇi dal brel ran po ste nyis stong lhag tsam re 'gro/—304—

de'i yun la dpag nas ji ltar 'os pa sgom du gzhug de'i mthar da dung khyed rang rnams lus gnad ma zhig pa sems ma yengs par sgoms shig khyed rnams la nged kyis byin rlabs re byed do byas nas/ slob ma'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug slob dpon gyis bsgoms nas/ o ā hū ho ha k+ṣa dang / o ā ra ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes shub bur brjod cing sngar gyi me tog de nas slob ma'i mgor bzhag go /mthar me tog cung zad gtor la/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i ye shes khyad par can myur du skye bar gyur cig ces brjod/ ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las/ /nya dag myur du lngang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ sgyu 'phru/la drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyu/ra/ /zhes sems bsam med du mnyam par bzhag pas 'u/sa nyams ngag nyams sems nyams mthong nyams rmi nyams sogs ma nges pa ji snyed cig bcos min rang shugs su 'byung ste/ de thams cad byung rgyal du bskyangs pas/ skyon med rang sar grol 'gro ba legs so byas la/ cung zad cig nas lus gnad 'grol du gzhug slob ma rtsa bzang bla ma la nyams myong gi rgyun yod na chos grwa de khar/gnas pa 'thug po dang nyams sna tshogs pa 'char ba'i rgyun yod do/ /de rjes de ma thag nas sgom khang du dam po la bcug na 'dis chu yur mgor chud pa dang 'dra bas/ sgom nyams myong 'phral du skye/ zhag gnyis gsum bdun tshun chad du lus gnad kyang 'byongs/ lta stangs kyang yun ring du mi sdod pa dang mig tsha ba sogs la'ang gang thub thub tu bsgril bas/ zhag gsum tshun chod du 'byongs yong ste/ mchi ma 'byung thengs 'ga' re song ba na/ zug kyang zhi g.yo med du —305—

gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lus gnad byed bcings kyi gtam thar thor thos pa'i rtog ge nga/ 'ga' zhig lus dang mig la sdug bsngal mi zad pa skyed do zhes/ chos 'di la skur ba 'debs pa ni/ de rnams nyid kyis mun 'khrid thun gcig kyang sgom ma myong bas/ dam po'i lag len gyi gtam rna bar thos pa na/ snying 'gas pa tsam du skrag cing dngangs pa'i mu cor kha nas rgyang ter shor ba la dgag sgrub yin par rlom zhing ngo sor byas pa'o/ /gzhan lus gnad lta stangs 'byongs pa la lo zla mang po dgos pa ste/ mun khrid dam po 'di zhag gsum mam lnga'am bdun tshun chad la mi 'byongs pa mi srid pas 'di thabs re mkhas gdams ngag re che'o/ /de nas lus gnad dang lta stangs thams cad bde zhing skyid pa 'ba' zhig yin/ sdug bsngal yul bud pa yin/ mig la sdug bsngal skyed pa ga la zhig mig nad yod pa tsho 'phral du dag 'gro ba mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di ka lags/ lus gnad 'byongs rtags snang mthong nas rtag tu bde ba'i nyi ma bcu gnyis shar ba'o/ /gzhan 'di na kha cig 'chol pa'i spyod par shor/ bcad kham gtsang por rlom pa'i bsam gtan pa rgan po'i ming re btags/ rgyu ma was brus pa bzhin du song / ro stod dang mjing pa sgur re/ mdog ro thal skya zhig byas/chags sdang gi mno bsam la rgya yan pa rnams snying re rje/ chos zab mo 'di kun la bcol rtogs ye med do/ /de ltar na de yan chad kyis sngon 'gro'i 'khrid kyi lhan thabs rgyas par bshad zin/ spyir nyams 'khrid byed pa la sngon 'gros rgyud sbyong ba 'khrid thams cad la gal che/ sgos su chos 'di la sngon 'gro dmigs pa re re bzhin/ zhag shas zhag 'ga' re skyong ba'i phyag srol bzang po yod pas/—306—

de bar la nyin re bzhin go ba skyed pa'i chos thun re byas na legs pa dang / sngar nas chos kyi go don la rang byan tshud pa ni shin tu dkon/ chos spyi'i go rgya la phan pa zhig kyang nges par dgos pas/ cung zad zhib pa tsam bshad pa yin no/ /blo gros chen po rnams bshad pa 'di tsam la bltos pa ga la yin/ 'bring po rnams kyis 'di la ci rigs bsnan pa'am 'di kho na'i steng nas gsung bar zhu/ blo chung na 'di'i nang nas nye bar mkho mkho bsdus te shod cig mchog tu zab pa'i chos tshul 'di/ /skye bo kun la ston pa'i phyir/ /lhan thabs mdo tsam bris pa 'di/'gro don mdzad bzhed rnams la mkho/ /da ni dngos gzhi'i skabs su khrid yig gi dkyus la ji cam yod pa nges par byas nas/ spros pa la mos na go don rnams zung 'jug rab gsal tu zhib par bris yod pas/ de dag las ji ltar 'os pa drangs te bshad pas rung la/ rtags snang rgyas par bshad pa rtags tshad kyi yi ge dang / ngo sprod dgos pa rnams ngo sprod phyi nang gi yi ge las rtogs dgos so/ /de dag tu rgyas par bshad zin pa rnams 'dir mi spro/ /spyir ni tshig gi rgyud la lhad mi 'jug pa dang / grub mtha'i gnad mi 'chug cing / gdams ngag gi rkang grangs rnams mi 'chad pa dang / 'khrugs mi 3gro ba'i phyir yig rigs la thig tshad byed dgos pa yin mod/ gdams ngag bi gnad dang ngo sprod kyi tshul rnams/ nyams su myong zhing blo la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma'i 'char sgo dang mthun par ngo sprod dgos kyi/ dpe ris ded pa tsam gyis gdams ngag gi gnad kyang mi longs shing sems ngo sprod du nams kyang mi btub bo/ /'on kyang de la bsam med kyi rnal 'byor zhes ma bsgrims ma klod dmigs brtad can —307—

gang yang med pa'i don te/ dpe lha khang lder bzo lta bu zhes pa'i skabs/ lha khang nang gi lder bzo de/ /'dug tshul bcas shing zhal 'dzum yang / /mi bsam bsam med tshul du 'dug /ces lab sgron gsung / dpe de bzhin du byed bcings lta stangs bcas kyang / yid byed dang rtsol ba cung zad kyang med pa'i don no/ /bsam med kyi rnal 'byor bya ba ni/ dpal sa ra has kyang / bsam dang bsam bya yongs su spangs nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung tshul du 'dug pa yis/ /bsgrims te bla ma'i lung la gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs te/ grim lhod dang bral ba bu chung btsas ma thag pa lta bu'i shes pa ste/ bsam pa rig pa nang na 'dug pa dang / bsam bya yul phyi rol na 'dug pa gang la'ang mi sems pa'o/ /rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes pa ni/ rnam rtog gi 'dzin zhen ci yang med kyang / nam mkha' la rtse gcig tu bsgrims pa ste/de yang do ha mdzod las/ sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar bzung bya ste/ /nam mkha' rang bzhin nyid du sems nyid bzung / /yid de yid ma yin par byed gyur na/ /des ni bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rig pa nam mkha' la bsres pas/ sems nam mkha' 'dra ba ste/ rnam rtog spros pa'i mtshan ma gang yang med pa zhig 'byung / de goms pas sems nam mkha'i rang bzhin te spros bral du 'gyur/ yid yid ma yin par byed pa zhes pa ni/ sngar 'gyu byed can gyi sems de bsgrims te bzhag pa'i shugs kyis rnam rtog btsan thabs su 'gag pa'i don yin/ dpe spre'u sgo gcig pa zhes pa ni khang pa skar —308—

khung mang po yod pa gcig tu spre'u gcig bzhag na/ spre'u ni 'phyar rgod che bas skar khung thams cad nas nyug tsam nyug tsam yang yang blta bas na/ phyi nas bltas na spre'u mang po yod pa ltar snang / sgo gcig bzhag nas gzhan rnams bkag na/ de kho na nas blta zhing sdod pas/ phyi nas blta ba rnams kyis spre'u gcig tu go bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du sems 'di yang kha yan du bzhag na/dbang po lnga dang 'grogs te dbang shes so so la brten yid rnam rtog mtha' yas pa zhig 'char bas/ sems du ma yod pa ltar snang yang 'phro ba bkag na/sems kyi rgyud gcig la lhan ne 'phral du gnas pa yin no/ /sgom med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ sngar rjes mi bcad sngon mi bsu/ /ltar 'dzin med pa nam mkhar bzhag /dus gsum rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul bcad/ /de ltar rtog med ting 'dzin gnas/ /zhes pa ste/ 'das ma 'ongs yid la mi byed par ma zad/ da lta dngos su snang ba la yang blta rgyu dang bzung rgyu gang yang med pas/ rnam rtog dang 'brel ba'i sgom pa ci yang med pa'i phyir/ sgom med ces bya/ yang do ha las/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sems kyi ngo bo nyid yin zhes/ /rmongs pa mda' bsnun gyis smras rtsen ne shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di nam mkha'i snang ba dang 'dres pa'i sems gsal rig gi cha la blta ba yin pas/ 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa'i 'char sgo thams cad shar tsam nyid nas gsal rig gi ngo bo nyid du rang dag tu byed pa'i phyir/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ram/ 'char sgo thams cad dbyings su ro snyoms par byed pa'i phyir/ro gcig gam ro mnyam gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang zer la/ rtsen ne zhes pas —309—

'dir sems kyi 'jog thabs bstan te/ dus 'das ma 'ongs gnyis dang phyogs phyi nang gnyis la ma reg par/ 'jog tshul grims lhod ran pos bar seng der/ dper 'dab chags sgrin po zhig shing rtser chags pa lta bu'i sems 'jog tshul te/ spyir 'di yang sems bsgrims pa'i phyogs so/ /dpe sbun gsum gyi bar ma nga/nga 'grogs nga/ zhes pa/ byis pa rnams rtsed mo byed pa na/ pha rol po sbun gsum yod pa'i/ rgan pa ni rang bas che/ ga smo pa ni rang bas chung / bar pa rang dang mnyam pa zhig yod na/ rgan gzhon gnyis dang shed mi snyoms pas/gnya' sbre rtse ba sogs mi bde la/ bar ma de dang shed snyoms pas 'grogs bde/rtsed mo rtse spro ba bzhin du 'das pa ni 'das zin pas rjes bcad kyang mi chod/ma 'ongs pa'i 'dod don dang re dogs ni 'byung bar ma nges pas/ re dogs byas kyang mi phan de gnyis la blo brtad kyang sems 'khrugs pa kho nar zad/des na da ltar gyi snang ba gang shar 'di la/ blang dor med par bzhag na bde bas de skad ces pa'o/ /rtsol bral gyi rnal 'byor zhes pa bsgrims 'phro la klod pa de rtsol ba yin yang/ klod zin pa la rtsol bral la gnas pa yin/ de yang bram chen gyi zhal nas/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid de/ /klod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs shing / gcod pa rnams na re/ khrims kyis bsgrims la lhod kyis klod/ /sems kyi bzhag thabs de na gda'/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir 'di la klod pa rang grol gyi gdams ngag ces kyang zer/ spyir ched du bsgrims pa kho na dang / ched du klod pa kho na dang / bsgrims klod spel ma dang / bsgrims kyang ma bsgrims lhod kyang ma klod pa ste gnad bzhi po rnams/—310—

—skabs su gang dang gang bab pa de dang der bogs dbyung ba'i thabs khyad par can byed pa kho na yin/ gnas lugs la ni de dag gang gis kyang ma gos mod/kha cig spang blang dgag sgrub mi byed pa'i 'dzin stangs bzang pos/ mthar spang blang gcig tu ka sleb yod pa ste/ rang tshig 'gal zhing / lha bdud du 'bab/sman dug tu song ngo / /dper na 'bri khung pa chen po'i rnam thar na/ ngas sa ra he'i lugs tsho kyi phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ de yang rig pa klod kyin gdog byas pas/bla ma na re/ phyag rgya chen po la klod don ci yod/ gsungs skad/ de gdams ngag bzang bar byed/ yang 'bab rung ba'i slob ma/ lus gnad bcas nas bsgom pa la/ zhang 'tshal pa na re/ 'di tsug byas kyang phyag rgya chen po zhes yang yang gsung gin stangs stabs sna tshogs mdzad/ de yang gdams ngag gi gnad che zer te/ gang zag de la dus der de skad gsung dgos pa zhig yod pa ni yin te mchis/ spyi khyab kyi nyams len la ni/ gnad che rgyu tsam ma byung / khyad par blang dor dgag sgrub med par zhal gyis bzhes nas/ phugs dgag sgrub kyi steng du ka sleb/ phyag rgya chen po la klod don te med du chug /klod du mi rung ba'i don yang ci yod/ klod pa cher brtad bkag /klod mi dgos pa sgrub pa de ka spang blang dgag sgrub yin mod/ yang lus gnad la gzhur ba bkag /'dug tshul nges med sgrub pa de ka spang blang dgag sgrub yin/ klod don med gsung pa'ang / klod na grol bar the tshom med/ gsung ba dang ni rgyab 'gal lags/ de bzhin du sgom chen pa phal cher blos byas bkag nas/ ma bcos so ma sgrub ste/ dgag sgrub de ka blos byas yin/ bcos par song / dri mas phog yang sgo ma ma tho mtho rna311—

mor 'dod pa 'ga' zhig na re/ ma bcos so mar 'jog pa yang las su 'dug bdag po 'dug nga la ni bcos ma bcos med do/ /so ma dang las song la'ang khyad med do zer kyin wa gog 'thag ste/ ma bcos so ma la zhe brnag pa de kakhyad snga chen po phyung pa'i rtags yin pas kha dang don 'dzol/ go ba dang nyams myong ma mthun pa lags so/ /'phros pas chog go /dper rnga mong btags grol lta bu zhes pa ni/ sngon rnga rdzi gcig gis rnga mong zhig phur bu la brtod nas bzhag pas/ de gu dog nas ldang nyal tsab tsob 'then 'gros kho na byed/ rtsa yang mi za nyal yang mi nyal lo/ /des phur bu bkrol te btang bas/ dar cig rgyugs song ste bkrol bar shes pa na/ sngar gyi gu dog sangs bag phebs te/ khyu re nyal song bas/ rnga rdzi des rgugs mo la smras pa/ btags na phyogs bcur rgyug par brtson/ /bkrol na g.yo med gnas pa yi/ /mdza' mo bdag gis rnga mo mthong / /bdag la phyin ci log tu snang / /zer skad/ don de'i dbang du byas nas mda' bsnun chen pos/ bcings pa dag ni phyogs bcur rgyug par brtson/ /thongs bar gyur na mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /go bzlog rnga mong lta bur bdag gis rtogs/ /bu kye rnams kyang rang la cher re ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ dmigs pa bzhi po de dag re re bzhin nyams myong skyes skyes su bsgom/ de rjes bzhi kar gnad gcig tu dril te sgom tshul dkyus bzhin no/ /yang rgyud dang sems 'grel las nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gyi dbye ba tsam ma gtogos/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa gcig las med/ sbyor drug gi man ngag gzhan phal cher na yang gcig kho na yin/ bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i nye rgyud man —312—

ngag la bzhi po 'di byung / 'o na rgyud gzhung dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/'di'i dmigs pa bzhi kar rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa'i dmigs nga/ gcig po der 'dus shing / 'di'i lugs la yang bzhi po mthar gcig tu bsdus nas sgom pa'i phyir/ rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa mdor bstan dang / man ngag 'di rgyas bshad yin no/ /des na sor sdud kyi man ngag bi bhu ti'i lugs 'di gzhan pas kyang mchog tu gyur pa yin zhing / 'di la kha cig bi bhu tis khong rang gi slob ma mar ston/ gzhon tshul/ nga/pyal ba/ nyeg po bzhi la so so'i blo dang mtshungs par/dmigs pa'i gnad mi 'dra ba so so bstan pa rnams/ kun spangs chen pos bzhi kar gsan nas/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yin yang zer te/ don la de ltar rang yang ma yin/ grub thob shā bā ri pa ni/ bram ze chen po'i do has rgyud grol ba yin zhing / do ha la brten nas shā bā ri ba'i man ngag 'di dag bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra la gdams pa yin pa'i phyir/ nye brgyud 'di la dmigs pa bzhi po 'di gdod nas grub pa yin/ thun tshags bsdus pa min no/ /de yang khungs dang 'brel ba bden par smras pa yin gyi bzang por 'grub tu re nas nged cag rnams kyis mdzes sgrig smras pa ma yin te/ smra dgos med pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi phyir kun spangs chen pos sgrig par mdzad na thun tshags sgrig pa yin yang des go chod de/ de bas lhag pa'i khungs 'tshol rmi dgos pa'i phyir rdo /des na dmigs skor lnga po 'dis/ sor sdud kyi mtshan nyid tshang bar 'gyur bas/ 'di rnams rdzogs par bshad nas/ dngos gzhi mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi mun 'khrid la 'jug pa thob thang yin mod/ dmigs pa bzhi'am lnga po —313—

de/ thun gcig la 'chad pa sla yang / slob ma blo dman rnams kyi blo la nges dka' zhing / zhag shas dmigs pa skyong stabs mi bde bar/ dngos gzhi'i chos thun thog ma rang bshad/ de nub ka mun 'khrid la 'jug pa lag len bde bas/bsam med kyi rnal 'byor gcig pu phog nas/ dam po zhag bdun byed/ de rjes kyang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor de ma thag sgom na/ bsam med kyi rnal 'byor kho na/nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas su byed bcings byed du bcug ste bsgom/ nyin 'khrid dam po zhag ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor sogs dmigs pa phyi ma rnams/ nyin mtshan gnyis ka'i thun mong du da gdod bskyangs kyang chog go /nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi thad na/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/zhes pa'i skabs/ dmigs pa gtod sa la mun nag dang / snang ba dang bcas pa'i nam mkha' sngo sangs kyi khyad byung bas/ mig gi lta stangs kyi byed bcings kyang mi 'dra bar byung ba yin te/ mun khang du blta lugs ji ltar byas kyang nam mkha' mun nag kho na mthong yong / snang ba dang bcas pa'i phyogs su mig phyed bkab byas na/ nam mkha' sngo sangs mi mthong ba'i phyir/ mig gdangs pa dgos so/ /dang por mun 'khrid la chu shing ri brag dud 'gro mi sogs ma nges pa ji snyed 'char yang / nyin mo'i nam mkha' la ni 'od dang thig le sogs yang yang 'char ba las/ gzhan ma nges pa sna tshogs rang mi 'byung ba shas che/ shin tu goms na khyad med par 'byung / mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor la/ rtags snang sna tshogs mang po zhag bdun tshun chod la 'char ba'i rigs can la yang / nyin mo'i rnal 'byor la/ de ltar 'char ba la zla ba gsum bzhi tsam dgos pa shas che —314—

zhing / mtshan mo'i de la brtan mi brtan gnyis yod/ nyin mo'i de lan gcig shar na brtan po rang yong ba 'dug spogs chog gi skabs su/ bla ma tsa mi lo tsā ba'i gsung gis lus grong khyer dang 'dra/ rtsa lam srang dang 'dra/ rlung rta dang 'dra/ sems de la zhon pa'i mi dang 'dra/ byed bcings kyis rtsa sgo dgag thub na/ srang sgo dgag pa dang 'dra bas/ mi rta dang 'dra ba'i rlung sems phyir mi 'chor/ mi khegs na de las ldog pa'o/ /gsung skad/ sbud kra e rgyan pa'i man ngag rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub na/ nam mkha'i dbyings su gza' rnams brtan par bcings/ rgya mtsho'i dbus su rtsa gsum yan lag bsngam/ /zhes sor sdud kyi ska bas su steng 'og bar gsum gyi bum can byed gsung pa yang / khong pa lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba 'di mi/ byed/ gzhan thams cad spogs chog 'di kha bzhin byas nas/ de sor sdud kyi rtsa ba'i dmigs par 'dod pa yin/ rang lugs la de rtsa ba'i dmigs par byas na/ rgyud dang mi mthun/ snga ma nas sbyor ba da/ma grags pa de phyis bogs chung / rnal 'byor gsum snying dang dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/phyis kyi spogs chog tu bshad pa ltar byas na/ rgyud las btsan thabs kyi sbyong sna pe spogs chog tu gsungs/ 'di yang rtsa'i btsan thabs kyi rigs yin pas rgyud dang mthun/ sngar dkyus kyi dmigs pa 'jam po de la lam 'byongs nas skabs skabs su sbyor ba drag po 'di brtsams na/ phyogs mthun la ni goms/ dngos la ni ma 'dris pas bogs skyed che bar yong / de yang phyogs mthun lam goms na/ gzhi rten ma thing ba'i skyon dang / sbyor ba drag po la 'dres grags na/ dper na rgyun du ga bur bsten pa'i mi de/ tshad pas na ba la ga bur gyi sman btang yang —315—

mi phan pa dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong / des na 'di spogs chog kho na yin no/ /de yang mig bsgrims pas mig gi rlud dang / sna bsnyer bas sna dang / kha bgrad lce sgril bas lce dang / sna dang mchu bcud pas rna ba krong 'byung bas rna ba dang / nya bzhi bsgrims pa sogs kyis lus kyi dbang po'i rlung la gzir ba yin/ rlung de rnams kyang srog thur gnyis dang ro gcig tu gnas pas/ lto ba 'phel 'grib gyi sbyor ba 'dis/ srog thur bcings bas de dag kyang 'ching ngo / /sgom don blo la 'god pa'i rtags ched kyi skabs/ sor bsam gyi ting nge 'dzin mngon sum tshad mar rgyud 'grel las gsungs/ dus 'khore gyi rgyud 'grel tshad mar khas len bzhin du/ stong gzugs 'khrul snang du 'dod na/ nang 'gal gyi btson rar chug 'khrul snang mthong ba'i shes pa la ma 'khru/la ba ga la srid/ gzhan yang re zhig 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas na yang / ma dag las snang ma 'khrul ba dang / lam ma nor ba sgom pa'i rtags rnams 'khrul bar 'dod pa/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rnam gzhag go log yin zhing / yang stong gzugs ni rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i snang ba yin zhing / de ltar yin par 'o skol mthun par khas len na / stong gzugs 'khrul snang yin na/ rtsa dbu ma de ye shes skyed byed ma yin/'khrul pa skyed byed kyi rtsa yin par 'gyur te/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'i snang ba de 'khrul snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang stong gzugs log pa'i kun rdzob tu 'dod pa'ang dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsas log snang dang / ro rkyang snyen ra ba'i rtsas yang dag kun rdzob bskyed do zhes par 'gyur bas/ 'di dag ji ltar yin blo rnal du gnas pa rnams kyis rtogs shig rang lugs ni stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri —316—

ro reg bya'i snang ba mngon sum du snang ba'i phyir/ dbang ngo/'i mngon sum/ yid rnam rtog gi bzhon pa rlung 'gags pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir yid kyi mngon sum/ stong gzugs de don dam chos nyid kyi rang gzugs yin pas chos nyid mthong ba'i shes pa rnal 'byor mngon sum/ stong gzugs dang de mthong ba'i rig pa ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir des de mthong bas rang rig mngon sum yin pas/spyir mngon sum bzhi char yin yang / sor bsam gyi skabs 'dir dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid gtso che gsung ngo / /de ltar na stong gzus sa mthong ba ni/ yang dag pa'i tshad ma yin te/ 'di la 'phags mchog grub mchog thams cad dgongs pa mthun no/ /de la re zhig dpa' bo sa ra has/ rmongs pa nam mkha'i tshad ma ni/ /gal te shes na rmongs tshogs gcod/ /dang por rnam dag nam mkha' la/ /lta zhing lta bas mthong ba 'gag /ces phyi nang gi nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gnyis gsungs/ de la mthong ba 'gag pa ni nang gi nam mkha' yin/ des rnam rtog rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams bcad de/ ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ me long phyis pa tsam na gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin no/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang / gang rnams kyi blo rten dang bral/ /yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /zab mo dmigs med de rnams kyis/ /mtshan ma'i don ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes gsungs te/ blo rten dang bral pa ni rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings su bsam med du bzhag pa'i don yin/ yod med las 'das pa ni de'i rnam rtog med pa'am/ ji skad du/ skye ba med pa mthong ba ni/ /gzhon nu ma yi bu ji bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ de ltar na mtshan ma'i don ni stong —317—

gzugs yin la/ dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis stong gzugs de sgom zhes pa'o/ /mtshan ma'i don zhes 'byung bas kyang / 'khrul snang tsam yin don du yod ces par go nus so/ /yang ji skad du/ /sngon med dpyid byung nam mkha'i me tog 'bras/ /lag pas thogs reg byar med sa ra ha/ /mig mi 'dzum par blta dang mi bsam dang / /rlung 'gags pa ste bla ma dam pas gsungs/ /zhes te mi g.yo ba gsum la brten nas/ rlung 'gag shing sems gnas pas bde ba skye ba ni/sngon med pa'i dpyid kyi dus yin la/ skabs der nam mkha' ste sems stong nyid/ kyi ngang las/ me tog dang 'bras bu lta bu'i stong gzugs ji snyed pa shar/ de'i rgyu ni mig steng du mi 'dzum par blta ba'i byed bcings dang / sems bsam du med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rlung 'gags pa las yin zhes pa ste/ 'dir mig dang sems dang rlung ni sna rtse gsum gcig tu bsdu ba'i gdams ngag ces 'chad pa yang / gzhung 'di'i don yin pa shin tu legs so/ /yang bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus gcig tu ni gal te nges sbyar na/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i yon tan nges par skye/ /'di dag mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /sna tshogs rnam rtog bral zhing mi sems par/ /gal te bar snang la ni mig bltas na/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' dag yin nam snyam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtha' dag 'di las thob/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dis kyang sna rtse gsum gcig tu bsdu ba bstan nas/ rnal 'byor 'di kho na las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'gyung / zhes de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' dag gis rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i lam 'di rnams gsungs so/ /'dir/ mtha' dag de —318—

bzhin gshe/gas pa'i 'di dag gsungs/ /zhes bcos na go bde'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji ltar skye na/ sna tshogs pa'i rnam rtog rtog dpyod kyi sgo nas mi sems par/ stong gzugs bsgoms na mthar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' dag gi snang ba can rnam pa kun ldan gyi sku rjes dran du 'gru/ba cing / de las yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas byang sems kyi go 'phang thams cad 'di las thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du zhi ba lha'i rdo rje'i glu las kyang / rmad byung nam/ mkha'i dkyil shar bhu su ku/ /stong nyid gzugs mdzes shar ro bhu su ku/ /dpe med me tog shar ro bhu su ku/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog rin chen long / me tog 'di ni kha dog sna tshogs can/ /me tog 'di ni stong nyid dgon par rgyas/ /zhes 'byung ste/ nyin mtshan gyi nam mkha' la stong nyid kyi gzugs mdzes pa/ sngon khams gsum pa'i sems can sus kyang ma mthong ba rmad du byung ba ste/ sa'i rnam par snang yang sa ma yin/ sa ma yin yang sa dang mtshungs pa'i bya ba byed/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam par snang yang ngo bo bde ba yin/ kun rdzob kyi bya ba byed kyang don dam/ dbyings/ las ma/ 'das pa sogs/dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon pa'i stong gzugs kyi me tog shar ro/ /'di las lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bas/ stong gzugs 'di ni ring thang med pa'i rin po che yin/ 'khor 'das srid gsum thams cad kyi gzugs su 'char bas kha dog sna tshogs pa can/ mi'i rgyun klung med pa'i 'brog dgon pa bzang po na me tog rnams rgyas pa bzhin du/ me tog dang 'dra ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stonge gzugs 'di ni stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnam par mi —319—

rtog pa'i dbyings la mnyam par gzhag na rgyas par 'gyur gyi rnam rtos phal ba'am dge chos yin du chug kyang rtog dpyod kyi mi 'gro 'ong mang po byung na/ rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /dgon par zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi mi rtos/ pa/ 'ba' zhig dgos par bstan te/ lung de dang mthun par myong grub la yang / dpyad sgom/ dang / rnam rtog ngo lta'i sgom la/ yun ring bsgoms kyang stong gzugs yin nges lar mi 'char nyams than thun byung srid na'ang de yang mang po mi yong la/ byed bcings dang ldan pa'i mi rtog pa sgoms na stong gzugs mang po 'phral du 'byung ba/ da lta su'i lag len la btab kyang myong bas grub/ sngon dus byung ngo ba la khag 'jog mi dgos/ bre srang 'khris su bzhes nas bod tshod kyis ci byed/das ga sgrub mtha' bkod mang po'i kha na med go /stong gzugs me tog dang ji ltar 'dra tshul la/ sa la me tog shar ba ltar tho lang de 'char ba'i don du 'chad pa dang / bkrag mdangs gsal ba'i don la 'chad pa dang / brda tshig tsam yin zer ba sogs 'dug kyang / rang lugs ni bde ba skye bas yid du 'ong / yid du 'ong bas me tog dang 'dra zhes kho bo'i bla ma gsung pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du/ lā ma nam mkha'i me tog shar/ /rab tu mi gnas lci ba'o/ /blta zhing lta ba nam langs kyang / shwan ti sgron mes lam 'tshol lko /skya rengs shar ro bhu su ku/ /shun tis smras pa nam langs thun/ /zhes 'byung ste/ lā ma ni dga' ma'am/ rol pa mo zhes phyag rgya'am rtsa dbu mā la bos nas/ thog mar dge ba'i skabs su lus kyi phyi'i nam mkha' la gtso bor snang ba dang / bar dge la rtsa'i nang gi nam mkha' la gtso bor snang ba dang / mtha' dge la mnyam nyid mkha' khyab ste/ nam —320—

mkha' de rnams kyi me tog stong gzugs shar/ 'di rnal 'byor pas lus kyi phyi nang sogs su yod par mthong yang / gnas tshul la gang du yang rab tu mi gnas te/ kun rdzob las snang 'di dag gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ dper na sad dus kyi bum pa de rmi lam gyi khang pa'i phyi nang gang na'ang med pa bzhin no/ /lci ba ni/ yal yul ma yin pa brjid dang ldan pa ste brtan pa'i don yin/de yang sgrub po rang nyid gyis mthong ma mthong gi khyad par ma gtogs/ chos nyid yin pas sngar gdod nas grub grub pa dang / da dung 'pho 'gyur med pa'o/ /des na dngos po shin tu yang ba gcig rten gzhi la mi gnas par/ nam mkha' la phan tshun du 'byer zhing yeng yeng 'dug pa 'thad kyang / dngos po brjid dang ldan pa rten gzhi med par nam mkha' la sdod mi thub pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa las/brjid dang ldan pa la rten gzhi mi dgos par/ nam mkha' la brtan por sdod pa zhig kyang 'dug go zhes/ tshig gi brjod tshul 'gal 'du'i tshul gyis brda thabs mdzad pa'o/ /rtag tu ting nge 'dzin la blta zhing lta bas/ bdag med dang stong rkyang gi phyogs kyis nam langs pa ste/ de tsam gyis/ phyogs nas gnas lugs rtogs su chug kyang / mthar thug tu bgrod pa'i lam da dung ma rnyed pas/ shwan ti da ni stong gzugs kyi sgron me thogs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'tshol zhing yod do/ /yang na dang po rang du stong gzugs mthong ba tsam ni/ skya rengs shar ba dang 'dra/ de rjes rnam pa kun ldan du gyur pa ni/ nam langs pa lta bu'o zhes kyang 'chad do/ /dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel chen don dam bsdus par/lung drangs pa la/ skabs 'dir 'grel ba'i rgya dpe rnying pa zhig la cung zad —321—

'khrul gzhi yod par snang bas/ tshig de'i 'phros chad nas gang tshe zla ba gang ba sogs dang sbrel 'dug na/ zla ba gang ba sogs nag po spyod pa'i do he'i tshig yin pa/ spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod 'grel las gsal zhing / de'i gseb tu/ dga' dang snying rje ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /'phags nga/ lha yi dmigs pa med pa gsal/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di yang / gzhan zhig gi tshig 'phros yin par sna/nga / grub thob rat+na pā las bsgyur ba'i do ha mang po'i nang gi ār+ya de ba'i glu can ta pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung ba'i do ha gcig na/ kye ma snying rje'i ḍā ma mā /sgra sgrog pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /ār+ya de ba dmigs med pa'i/ /rgyal po'i srid la ngoms pa med/ /ces 'byung ba de ka drangs par mngon/ dga' dang zhes pa ngo mtshar dang rgyal po'i srid gsal bar bsgyur ba'i khyad du 'dug 'di ār+ya de ba rang gi do ha yin par 'dug pa la/ nam langs thun sogs dang sbrel nas bris pas/ zhi ba lha'i gsung du 'khru' nas/ zhi lha uru 'a dngos slob yin zhes yid bzang rtse ba gsung pa ni gad mo'i gnas so/ /des na 'grel pa de'i rtsom gdan lta bu phyi mo'i rgya dpe rnying pa bar bar na yi ge zubs pa zhig las bris bshus byas pa'i rgya dpe ma dag pa zhig las bsgyur ba'i skyon no/ /des na snga ma'i tshig nam langs thun zhes pa'i 'gros kyi dbang du byas na/ rnam pa kun ldan nam langs pa 'dra ba'i rjes su gzugs sems ro mnyam pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar gyur pa na nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra'o/ /zhes pa zhig don la yod dgos so/ /de bzhin du 'di skad ces/ rmad du byung ba gang zhig thun las byung / /gang zhig nyi zla bcings shing sgron me sbar/ thun ti rang nyid dpang bzhag rang nyid dgod/ /nam mkha'i —322—

sbrum ma las ni skye ba mthong / /zhes dang / zab mo'i chos thos nas ni lam ngan pa/ /mun pa'i lam las ci yang mthong ba med/ /gal te nam mkha'i rtse mor me tog byung / shwan tis smras pa de tshe 'khru/la pa chad/ /ces 'byung ste/ 'di skabs kyi shwan ti zhes pa yang shwan ta de ba dang shān+ti de ba la khyad yod dam med dpyad dgos la/ sngar drangs pa shwan ti sgron me sogs ni bhu su ku zhes 'byung bas/shwan ti de ba ste zhi ba lha'i gsung yin pa bzhin du/ 'di yang shwan ti de ba'i yi/na zhes bla ma rnams 'chad go /spyir ni spyod 'jug mdzad pa po la phal cher du shun+ta de ba zhes 'byung ba dang / grub thob shurnyi'i mtshan can gzhan mang du yo da pa'ang go dgos so/ /thun las byung zhes pa ni/ thun bzhi ste nyi ma gcig kho na bsgoms pas rtags snang 'byung ba'i don yin/ nyi zla ro rkyang bcings shing / ye shes kyi rlung gi sgron me sbar bas/ nam mkha' stong pa'i bud med sbrum ma las stong gzugs gyi bu skye ba mthong / rang la cha rgyus yo da pas rang nyid dang/nga por bzhag ste/ de 'dra ba mthong bas dga' nas 'god pa ste/ dga' ba'i don bdag nyid la yid ches pa'o tsho /mun par zhugs nga bzhin du zab mo'i chos ma thos shing lam ngan la zhugs pa rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi snang ba mthong ba med la/ zab mo'i chos thos nas gal te ma/nyam par bzhag na/ mnyam gzhag rtog bral gyi nam mkha'i rtse mor/ 'od gsal rtags bcu'i me tog shar ba de'i tshe/ma dag log snang gi 'khrul ba chad do zhes/ 'dis bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor yang zhor la bstan to /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pas kyang spros med las/rnal 'byor 'di las sgrub pa'o /du ba la sogs mngon shes sogs/ /rnam/ rtog —323—

dra ba ma lus gcod/ khren tu spros med go 'phang thob/ /ces rlung dbu mar 'gags pa las/ rtags kyi ye shes skye bar gsungs te/ de yang spros med kyi lugs la/ bidha ra rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba yin/ spros med nyid sor sdud dang gnad gcig rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ spogs chog btsan thabs su 'gyur/ de ltar sgoms pa las/ sor bsam thun mong la du sogs kyi ye shes dang / bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu mngon shes kyi bar du 'byung /zhes pa'i don yin pas/ ming 'dogs kyi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ shin tu spros meng kyi gzhung gi dgongs pa yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la 'bad pa yin la/'di dang de sbyor tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /de bzhin du/ /rang yid mtshan nyid mtha' dag bral pa yis/ /mig phyed gyen du blta ba dang bcas pas/ /gang tshe dbu mar rlung ni bus gyur pa/ /sde tshe rdo rje me dang du ba 'byung / /de yang mtshan nyid dang bral ba ni mtshan ma rnam rtog spangs pa yin/ de dang byed bcings lta stangs dang bcas pa las/ las rlung dbu mar bus pa'i tshul gyis 'jug de las rdo rje ye shes kyi gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang / du sogs khams gsum nga 'i gzugs brnyan 'byung / zhes pa ste/ rgyu mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas 'bras bu srog 'dzin rjes dran sogs skye ba'i don yin no/ /'di la lung khungs ma smos kyang / in+t+ra bhu ti'i do ha nas drangs pa yin gsung / de bzhin du grub thob lwa ba pas kyang / snang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan du rtags ni shes bya ste/ /grub pa'i 'khru/la pa med pa rnams/ /lam nag gis ni du ba bzhin/ /mig dag rengs par byed pa dang / /mgo bo dud pa nyid dang mi/ /—324—

sems dang sems byung mi g.yo dang / /stong nyid mthong ba'i stong pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mig rengs pa ste lta stangs brtan pa dang / des ro rkyang gi rtsa'i mgo bo spyi gtsug nas mig gi gnas su bkug ste/ dud par byas nas 'then pa lta bur 'gyur ba dang / sems sems byung 'gags pa ni/ rnam rtog btsan thabs su bkag pa'i mi rtog pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i stong nyid de yang rnam med tsam ma yin par/ dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa'i stong nyid kyi gzugs mthong / de nyid ye shes kyi snang ba thob pa yin/ de lam dngos yin yang / rnam gzhag 'jog tshul gzhan gcig la lam rtags kyi tha snyad 'jog par shes dgos te/ grub pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob par 'gyur ba'i rtags 'khrul pa med pa ni stong gzugs rnams la mnyam par bzhag pas bde ba skye ba 'di yin te/ lam nag ces pa me'i ming yin pa/ bud shing 'chig bzhin pa'i me yod pa'i rtags/ du ba 'phyur ba mthong ba bzhin/ zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du grub thob dharma pas kyang / dang po thog mtha' las grol zhing / /dbu ma tsam zhig brten par bya/ /der gnas gang zhig 'dod pa ste/ /'di yi snang ba bcu bdag nyid/ ces te/ tshig rkang phyi ma gsum la/ 'gyur gzhan las/ dbu ma tsam la rnam par gnas/ /de la gnas shing de spong gang / /de las mtshan ma bcu 'byung ngo / /zhes 'gyung ba go bde'o/ /dang po thog mtha' zhes pa 'dis ni/sbun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa'ang bstan la/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbu ma nam mkha' stong pa la sems gnas shing / nam mkha' dang rig pa rang nyid la yang / yin min yod med gnyis mnyam gyi 'dzin pa —325—

spong ba'i sgo nas bzhag cing gnas pas/ rtags bcu'i bdag nyid kyi ye shes kyi snang ba 'char bar 'gyur/ grub thob tsarba ṭi pas kyang / dngos min dngos por brten nas su/ /dngos po dngos po min par bya/ /sems ni sems min byas nas su/ /ci yang med par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems sngar rtog bcas de sems min pa rtog med du byed cing / de'i tshe ci med cang med/ rtags med mthong med du mi bya ste/ rdul phra rab kyi dngos po ma yin pa stong gzugs kyi dngos po la sems brtan zhing bzhag pas/ tha mal las snang gi dngos po rnams/ 'ga' zhig snang ba'i dngos po med pa dang / 'ga' zhig snang yang bden dngos min par rig par bya/ zhes pa ste/ 'dis kyang bsam gtan gyi rim/ pa gsal par byed do/ /yang bshad pa/ gang du dri ma med pa'i mkha' la mig phyed sprul pa na/ /'phro ba chen pos thugs rjes bslan pa'i bsam pa'i rten za las/ /yod dang med dang gnyis ka dngos po dngos med 'byed pa bral/ /stong pa 'id kyi rjes 'gro du sogs mtha' dag glo bur 'char/ /zhes 'byung ba/ 'di grub thob chen po dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug gi gzhung na yod mod/ sngon du byon pa zhig gi grub thob kyi lung tshig skabs ngar bcug par ni nges par gsal la/grub thob klu'i byang chub kyi gsung yin no zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo / /nyin mtshan gyi nam mkha' dri ma med pa la/ mig phyed gyen du blta ba'i lta stangs sprul bar byas pa na/ bsam pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i mes yod pa dang med pa dang gnyis kar 'dzin pa sogs kyi rnam rtog bsregs/ sems can kun la 'phro zhing khyab pa'i snying rje dang / mi rtog pa sgom pa las gzhan dngos po dngos med —326—

'byed pa ste dpyad sgom dang bral bar bsgoms na/ sems gdod nas spros pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyi rjes su 'gro ba du sogs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid de/ yun ring dgug mi dgos par glo bur du 'char ro zhes go /grub chen nag po spyod pas kyang / gang tshe zla ba nya ba shar gyur pa/ /de tshe sems kyi rgyal po rab tu nyal/ /dga' dang snying rje ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /zhes pa dang / g.yon dang g.yas su khral pa la/ /kaṇ+ḍa sa smras pa bar lam mo/ /sems rtogs rin chen rab dgas grol/ /grong khyer mi smra rmongs pa rnams/ /me tog lnga byung de ru thim/ /dga' ba'i sems nyid nam mkhas byin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang gi tshe stong gzugs kyi ye shes snang ba'i zla ba shar bar gyur pa na/ sems kyi rgyal po yid rtog bcas nyal zhing thim par 'gyur la/ de'i tshe bsam gtan gyi dga' bde lta bu'i dga' ba dang/ snying rje zhu bde 'gyur med kyi ḍā ma rle'i sgra grags nga/ra 'gyur zhes te skabs 'dir tshig de'i 'phros chad go /spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod 'grel na/ de tshe sem/sa kyi rgyal po rab tu nyal/ /zhes 'byung dga' dang zhes pa 'di mi snang ngo / /g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gnyis kyi lam 'a/ rlung rgyu ba ni/ shog ma sogs khral sdud pa'i lam dang 'dra/ sems mgron po dang 'dra ba rlung de gnyis snyel brten nas song na/ khral sdud pas 'tshe ba byed pa dang 'dra bar/ nyon mongs sna tshogs skye/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /lam de dag gi bar gseng lam khral sdud pas go rig mi 'byung ba zhig la tshong pa rnams song na/ khral sdud pas 'tshe ba med cing bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ byed bcings dang bcas pa'i rmam par mi rtog pa sgoms pas/ gsang lam dang 'dra ba dbu ma'i lam du rnam rtog dang /—327—

nyon mongs dang / sdug bsngal gyis 'tshe ba med par/ bde ba chen po'i dbyings su 'gro ste/ de yang zhu bde 'gyur med kyi thig le ni rin po che ste/ de'i rab tu dga' ba zhu bde lhan skyes kyis 'dzag bde mngon 'gyur gyi sgrib pa las grol bar byed cing / zhu bde 'gyur med kyi lhan skyes de ni/ don dam byang chub kyi sems rjes mthun pa yin pas/ sems rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /rmongs pa rnams zhes bya ba ni bod pa ste/ grong khyer zhes pa kun la grags ba'i ngag tshig gsal po ste/ de ltar mi smra bar brda'i tshig gis nga smra'o/ /'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma'i me tog thig le lnga gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar du byung zhing / nor bur bcings pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam ji ltar 'os pa de nyid du thim par 'gyur la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dga' ba'i sems nyid de ni/ don dam gyi nam mkha' stong gzugs phyag rgya chen pos byin zhes pa'o/ /de yang thig le nor bur son pa stong gzugs kyis bcings pas/ gzugs sems gcig tu 'dres pa na mi 'gyur ba'i don te/'dis yan lag drug kar gsal bar bstan to/ /ār+ya de bas kyang / bcom ldan srog gi lhag pa'i bdag po rje bo bdag nyid la ni thim gyur zhing / /'tsho ba'i rlung gi rgyu ba 'byung dang 'jug pa'i tshogs rab zhi bar gyur pa dang / /gang zhig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyi 'od gsal skar ma'i snang ba rab 'byams 'di/ /rang lus nyid nas nges 'thon mun pa bcom nas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed/ /ces gsungs te/ de yang srog ste rlung thams cad kyi lhag pa'i bdag po'am rje bo na dbu ma'i rlung ste bcom ldan 'das zhes btags pa ste dus kyi 'khor lo'i rlung zhes rgyud las gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gzhi dus kyi dbu —328—

ma'i dbus de lam du byas pas/ ye shes kyi rlung du gyur pa na las rlung rnams ye shes kyi rlung bdag nyid la ni thim par 'gyur zhing / 'tsho ba las kyi rlung 'di'i rgyu ba/ sna sgo nas 'byung 'jug byed pa'i tshogs rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rlung thim pa las/ 'od gsal rtags bcu'i snang ba rab 'byams shar ba ni/ mkha' la skar ma shar ba lta bu'o/ /yang na skar ma'i skad dod/ dzu ti ni 'ja' 'od la'ang 'jug go /stong gzugs kyi gtum mo 'bar ba de ni dbu ma las byung rang lus gang lus las thon nas nam mkha' gang ba'i mun pa bcom nas 'od gsal bar byed/ ma dag pa'i srid gsum gyi snang ba mgo gnon pa'i tshul gyis sbyong bar byed do/ /mun pa bcoms pa ni 'phral du mngon shes skye ba dang / phugs gnas lugs rtogs pa'o/ /'dis gtso bor rjes dran gyi stong gzugs ba༅/da pa yin yang / rnam pa 'dra ba'i sgo nas yan lag drug ka la 'byo ra ro/ /des na 'od gsal rtags bcu la mnyam par gzhag pas ni/ ma dag pa'i srid gsum zil gyis mnan nas ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul du grub cing / grub thob kun gyis du ba la sogs pa'i lam 'di bsgoms pa yin no/ /lung 'dren 'di rnams kyi don gsal bar bshad pa cher mi 'dug cing /mchan bu cung zad bris pa 'dra 'dug pa yang / bsdus grags pa dang / gnad don la 'byor pa ma mthong nas/ 'dir gsal la 'dus par bshad pa yin mod/ rgyas par bla ma'i gsung las shes par bya'o/ /klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa yin tshul ni rgyas par rim lnga'i 'grel par bshad zin pa las shes par bya —329—

zhing / nag po'i dgongs pa'i ji lta ba yin pa yang / rdzogs rim gzhung gsum gyi 'grel par yang bshad zin pa/ spyod pa ba nyid kyi do he'i 'grel pa zhig byas par shes par yang 'gyur ro/ /rtags bcu ni dkyus su bshad pa ltar dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las rdzogs par gsungs/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las gtso bor mtshan rtags rnams gsal bar gsungs te/ 'gog pa'i rdo rjer bgrod sems la/ /mtshan ma nyer 'dzin 'byung 'gyur te/ /mtshan ma de ni rnam pa lnga/ /byang chub rdo rje bshad pa yin/ /dang po smig sgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba'i rnam nga/ yin/ /gsum pa mkha' snang rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa sgron me 'bar ba'o/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes pa 'di dus 'khor phyogs su lung drangs pa'i 'gyur ltar yin la/ rgyud lo chen gyis bsgyur ba las/rnam pa zhes pa rnams 'dra ba zhes par yod de smig sgyu 'dra ba dang po ste zhes sogs so/ /rnam pa zhes brjod na rtags snang kho na la 'byor gyi gzhan la mi 'byor/ 'dra ba zhes brjod na/ rtags snang la'ang 'jug mod/ rtags can gyi shes pa brtan g.yo'i tshad la'ang 'byor bas/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rnams na/ 'chad chul sna tshogs yod pa kun la sbyor ba'i dbang du mdzad par snang /'on kyang skabs 'dir rtags can gyi shes pa la sbyor du mi rung ste/ 'di 'dzin pa'i yan lag gi skabs su bzhed pa'i mtshan rtags yin la/ rtags can gyi shes pa gnas skabs lnga char yan lag snga ma gsum du grub zin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di rtags snang /bo na yin pa las/ 'dir smig sgyu dang por gsungs par dkrugs te bshad pa yin pas/ dung dang por byed dgos par dri med 'od las —33()—

gsungs pas nges pa can yin/ mtshan rtags bzhi yin yang 'dir lnga bshad pa ni/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams mchan rtags bzhi dang / nam mkha' sprin med la rtags can zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad kyang don la lnga pa nam mkha' lta bu 'di/ nyin rtags drug po 'char ba'i gzhi la dgongs pa yin/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba rnams kyang / rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /zhes nam mkha' la dbye ba gsum gyis 'byed par byed de gnad gcig go /des na 'char ba'i gzhi nam mkha' bshad pas nyin rtags drug po sbas pa'i tshul gyis cung zad bshad pa'ang yin no/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ nyin rtags drug po gsal bar gsungs te/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ khres rab ye shes me po che ni ser po 'bar ba ste dus me'o/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba ni dkar po 'bar ba ste zla ba'o/ 'gro ba'i mar me ni dmar po 'bar ba ste nyi ma'o/ ye shes sgron me ni nag po 'bar ba ste sgra gcan no/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba ni mchog gi cha ste glog 'gyu ba'o/ sngags mchog sngags bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /zhes pa ni sngags dang / rig sngags ni thig le tsam dang / mchog dang / bdag po dang /rgyal po'i sgras thig le chen po bstan/ de'i shugs la phal pa dang / mnga' 'og dang / 'khor yang yod dgos pas de ni sna tshogs gzugs brnyan no/ /'bro ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gzugs brnyan la yang rtags can gyi tha snya/da mdzad 'dug 'dir rtags zhes bya ba lam rtags tsam la mi gzung ste/ gnas lugs kyang —331—

yin la rtags kyang yin/ dper na mtshan mo rgyang ring po nas mthong ba'i me de me dngos kyang yin/ der phyin na grang reg sa la nus pa la rtags kyang yin pa bzhin/ stong gzugs chos nyid kyi rang gzugs dngos kyang yin/ chos nyid bde gshegs snying po gdod nas bzhug pa'i rtags dang / sangs rgyas myur du thob pa'i rtags kyang yin par shes par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi phung po sogs zhes pa la/ye shes kyi phung po dang ye shes kyi khams/ yid kyi dbang po sgra'i skye mched/mchog gi dbang po dang dri chu 'dor ba ste drug yin/ lha ye shes khams pa drug tshan gcig zhes pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ sher phyin ma/ kun tu bzang po/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gnod mdzes dang shin tu sngon mo rnams so/ /snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa 'di goms na/ sge'u khung nag dang nge ba lta bu dang / g.yabs sogs la bltas te der stong gzugs drangs nas ring du goms par byas na rims pas khyim gtan la phebs pa'i mngon shes 'byung / stong pa'i sgra la sems gtod pa goms shing / sgra phal cher stong pa'i sgrar 'gro na/ lkog gyur gyi don 'di lta bu zhig rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes 'dun pa btang ste/ stong pa'i sgra la sems brtad pas/ lkog gyur gyi sgra rna bar tshor ba'am/ lung ston pa'i rnam pa 'byung / rna ba'i mngon shes rjes mthun pa yin/ 'di gnyis la dang po thog mar la snang ba shar ba tsam ma gtogs ji bzhin things pa dka'/ 'dzin zhen dang rtsis btab mi byed par yang yang las la sbyar bas/ phyis nges pa can things par 'ong / bsam gto gyi sgom don blo la 'god pa'i skabs rtog dpyod gnyis kyi thad du ngo sprod thun mong bas rgyas par ngo sprad na/ skabs su bab cing shin tu —332—

legs pa yin/ sor sdud kyi 'khrid tsam las mi byed cing / ngo sprod dgos na sor sdud kyi 'jug tu byed dgos mod kyang / thog dge'i 'khrid rgyas par dkyus thog gcig la byed cing ngo sprod dgos na/ bsam gtan yan lag lnga pa'i skabs su byed pa'ang yan lag so so dang bstun kyang rung ngo / /yun ring ma bsgoms pa la ngo sprod mi byed pa nyid thob thang ni yin te/ nyams myong ma skyes pa la ngo sprod par mi 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /yang snying po bsdus na bsam gto gyi rtog pa'i yan lag tsam rgyud la skyes na ni/ bsgoms pa'i nyams myong gi stobs las/stong gzugs rang sems su rtogs pa yin la/ sor sdud kyi nyams myong la de ltar rtog pa rang min yang / stong gzugs mthong ba'i nyams myong las brtsams te/ lung rig gi sgrub byed la ma ltos par/ myong ba'i stobs las stong gzugs rang sems las gzhan du med par nges shes 'dren nus pa yin te/ de tsam na de kho na la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo sprod gnyis ka byar btub bo/ /sngon 'gro bltos med bzhi ldan yun ring du bsgoms na/ dngos gzhi'i 'khrid la ma sleb kyang / sngon 'gro'i nyams myong la stong phyogs kyi ngo sprod rnal ma 'debs thub/ skabs der ma nges pa'i rtags snang ji snyed 'byung bas/ snang phyogs kyi ngo sprod kyang rjes mthun rags pa thub pa zhig 'byung mod/ phyis kyi phyag len la dben gsum yun ring mi skyong bar/ dngos gzhi la 'phral du 'jug pa'i phyir/ skabs der ngo sprod par mi mdzad do/ /de yang da lta'i snang ba rags pa 'di sems snang yin/ bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ gzhi med rtsa bral yin/bde gshegs snying po gdod nas lhun grub yin/ bya ba 'di lung dang rig pa'i —333—

sgo nas nges pa rnyed nus kyang / sgom rnam dag ma skyes kyi bar du myong stobs kyis nges pa 'dren mi thub/ stong gzugs kyi stobs kyis myong stobs ngo sprod na/ snang ba rags pa 'di la'ang de ltar myong stobs kyis nges shes gting nas skye thub pa yin no/ /de yang slob ma gcig la thig le sngon po lu gu brgyud yang yang 'char ba lta bu zhig yod na/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ khyed la thig le'i snang ba shar 'dugade gzugs ma yin/ mig gis mthong ba ma yin/ mig gis blta sar mi yong ba'i ltag pa'i phyogs su yang res 'ga' yong gin 'dug pa/ yang de la thal mos bkab nas kyang ltos shig des sgrib kyang mi thub/ thal mos rgyab skor nas tshur yong ba'ang min/ des na thig le de phyi na 'dug par mthong yang phyi na med/de rang gi lus kyang min/ gzhi gang yang ma yin pas sems kho nar 'dug pa/sems gnas tsam thig le'i gzugs de gsal ba/ mang ba/ brtan pa gcig gda'/ sems mi gnas pa'i skabs de las go log /des na sems ka stong gzugs yin/ stong gzugs ka sems yin pa'i rtags 'di ka yin/ sems mi gnas na sems kyi rang gzugs mi mthong / gnas na rang gzugs mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar byung ba yin/ des na stong gzugs 'di sems la gzhan phyi rol du grub pa med do/ /stong gzugs 'di 'di ltar gsal ba brtan pa zhig la/ phyi rol tu ma grub sems las g.yin du med pa bzhin du/ da lta'i las snang rags pa 'di thams cad kyang / gsal bar snang zhing brtan brtan 'dra mod kyang / sems las gzhan du cung zad kyang ma grub/ phyi na yod par snang ba tsam gyis phyi rol tu grub par mi 'gro ste/ da ltar mthong ba'i stong gzugs thig le —334—

dang 'dra/ yang gsal gsal 'dra/ brtan brtan 'dra bas kyang phyi don yin par mi 'gro ste/ khyed rang gis mthong ba'i thig le'i gzugs bzhan/ yang gnyid 'thug po shwe1ga pa lta bu mig shes 'gags tsa na/ gzugs kyang 8rig gas te mi 'dug yang gnyid sad de mig shes skyes tsa na gzugs 'dug des na da lta'i gzugs snang 'di mig shes las gzhan du med/ don du ma grub shes pa'i snang ba tsam yin/ dpe sems gnas mi gnas la stong gzugs 'char mi ‘sna char dang 'dra ba lags/ yang mi gcig gnyid la song ba na/ kho ras gzugs ma mthong ba yin gyi gzugs 'gags pa ma yin te/ kho gnying la song pa'i skabs mi gzhan gyis mthong nga/'i phyir snyam na/ de gnad ma go ba yin/ dper na khyed rang gnyid la song skabs/ khyed rang gi grogs mched kyis /bang pa dang / yo byad mthong ba de ka grogs mched kho la mig shes yod pas byung ba yin/ yang gnyis kar gnyid du song skabs gzhan zhig gis mthong pa yang de dang 'dra/ de bzhin du thug med du sbyar te/ ji tsam du mig shes yod pa 'a gzugs yo da/ med pa la med pas gzugs snang sems su thag chod/ sgra sogs lnga la'ang de bzhin du sbyar/ de lta ra stong gzugs dang / rig thog gnyis po lhan cig tu ngo sprad do/ /de nas so sor phye ste/ shes rig 'di yang ngo bos grub rgyu mi 'dug ste/ rnam rtog 'di ni yad yud tsam las rtag thub pa mi 'dug snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma skye ba ma gtogs/ mu 'brel 'brel pa rgyun chags chags pa zhig kyang mi 'dugaskye bzhin pa la 'jig bzhin pa ma gtogs gnas rgyu gcig kyang mi 'dugalegs nga/ra brtags dus 'od dam mdangs 'gyur ba 'dra ba zhig ma gtogs/—335—

'di ltar yod ces bya ba gcig kyang mi 'dug ste/ des na rnam rtog 'di 'khrul snang ma gtogs dngos gnas la grub rgyu mi 'dug de bzhin du gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dzin pa'i shes pa thams cad la'ang 'don pa spos te ngo bos grub rgyu mi 'dug go /yang phyi snang ba dang / nang rnam rtog gnyis char la ma reg pa'i rig pa gsal rig tsam 'di yang / rtag tu rgyun ma chad pa ltar snang mod kyi/ legs par brtags na rten dang gnas gang la'ang ma brten par 'dug skad cig gis skye 'jig gnas gsum du snang yang / mdangs 'gyur ba tsam min pa/ skye gnas 'jig gsum la ngos bzung rgyu mi 'dug ngo bo 'di ltar grub cig kyang mi 'dug pas/ ma brtags tsa na sems 'di nga yin snyam/ gsal zhing rig kyang ngos bzung gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ sems de yang gzhi med rtsa bral yin/rang gzhan snod bcud 'khor ba'i rnam pa 'di thams cad/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong ngo / /sgom chen pa byings de chos sku yin lhan skyes yin sems lhan cig skyes pa zer ba de yang 'di kho na yin/ 'di'i 'tshang rig pa na sangs rgyas la nyin khugs btang zhes kha pho 'don/ rang lugs la de tsam gyis mthar thug rang du ma sleb ste/ re zhig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnam grangs gcig tu 'jog kyang 'jog pa lags/ 'di stong phyogs kyi ngo sprod yin/ snang ba thams cad stong par ngo sprad pas/ stong pa'i rtsal snang ba ma 'gags pa'i rten 'brel cir yang 'char ba de shugs la 'byung bas rgyas bshad mi dgos/ de la snang stong zung 'jug dang / stong nyid dang rten 'brel zung 'jug dang snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa sogs sgom chen so so'i ming du ma 'dogs te/ don la sgyu ma —336—

lta bur 'dus/ gnas skabs kyi sgom bzang yang bzang ste/ rang lugs kun rdzob bden pa la bltos pa'i zung 'jug yin/ de rnams thun mong ba yin/ kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel dang / snang ba'i bshad pa mang yang stong phyogs su 'dus te stong pa gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rang re rnams chos la 'bad pa ni gang la dmigs pa yin/ gzhan de dag ni gang yang ma dmigs na/ gnas lugs la su zhig yod snyam na/ yod ngos shes pa mkha' khyab kyi chos sku rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de yin/ de la dmigs nas chos byed pa yin/ chos sku de kho shes bya la srid tshad kyi gnas lugs yin/ yod nges shes pa'i sdod lugs yin/ dper na bum par snang ba na bum pa med bum snang 'khru/la ba yin/ de'i shul na phal bas mi mthong ba'i chos sku yod/ de ka bum pa'i gnas lugs yin/sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ de ka dang 'dra bar khyed rang lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i gang zag gcig tu khyed rang la yang snang /gzhan 'gas kyang mthong gin 'dug ste/ 'khru/la snang yin/ snang lugs yin gyi gnas lugs min/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i gang zag de 'dra yod ma myong gdod nas ma grub/ khyed rang mi gcig tu snang gin 'dug ste snang bzhin pa'i dus na/ gnas lugs la mi med/ 'khru/la lugs la mi yod par snang /mir snang ba de'i thad na/ gzhan phal bas kyang mi mthong / khyed rang gis kyang ma rig pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku mkha' khyab de bzhugs/ de khyed rang gi gnas lugs yin/ sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ dper na shing 'bras kyi khog na tshig gu yod kyang mi mthong bas snying po zer ba dang 'dra —337—

bar/ kun khyab kyi chos nyid de bde gshegs yin/ de yod kyang ma mthong bas snying po yin/ des na khyod la bde gshegs snying po yod/ khyed rang bde gshegs snying po can yin/ de yang ji ltar yin na khyed rang la snang ba'i snod bcud thams cang/ dang / khyed rang gi lus ngag longs spyod thams cad khyed rang gi shes pa'i snang ba yin par 'dug pa/ de thams cad rang gi shes par 'dus/ shes pa las gzhan du med/ shes pa rnam shes dang / rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di yang sems gsal rig tsam 'di'i mdangs las gzhan du med/ chu la gzugs brnyan shar ba dang 'dra/ shes pa gsal rig tsam 'di/ kun gzhi rnam shes yin/ gzhom du med pa'i ma rig pa zhes bla ma snga rabs pa rnams tha snyad 'dogs/ 'dzag bde'i bag chags kyi ngo bor gnas/ kha nang log gis blta shes na/ 'di da lta blun po tshun chod kyis kyang myong bas grub pa yin/ mthong ba yin/ rang rig kun rdzob pa yin/ 'di yang snang tshul yin te gnas tshul ma yin/ rgyun chags pa'i rig pa rjen ne bzhin snang ste/ snang ba ltar ma grub 'khrul snang yin/ 'di gang na yod pa'i sa de ka na/ chos dbyings kun khyab kyi sangs rgyas de yod/ de sems 'di'i gnas lugs yin/ sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ da lta'i sems 'di sems kyi rang bzhin ma yin/ gnas lugs ma yin/ sems 'di'i rang bzhin gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po de yin/'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ji lta ba rang de mkhyen/ byang sems sa bcu pa pas gsal bar mthong / brgyad pa dgu pa gnyis kyi 'ol spyi tsam mthong ma dag sa bdun la gnas pas zur tsam mthong / nyan rang 'phags pa dang /—338—

gsang sngags kyi thabs zab med na byang sems so skye rnams kyis dad pas rtogs bya yin gyi dngos su mthong ba med/ so so skye bo phal pa rnams kyis dad pas kyang mi rtogs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas mkhas po sangs rgyas skyangs dang / legs ldan ku khyed dang / zla ba grags pa dang / ye shes snying po dang / kā ma la shī la la sogs pa la yang / chos 'di dad pas rtogs pa'i bsod nams med na/ bod ston dang bod sgom za thang dang grags pa che tshad yod cing / nag phyogs kyi gdon gyis 'phrin las sgrub pa rnams la/ chos 'dir mos pa skye ba lta ci dgos/ ge bar yang ga la 'gyur zhing / tha na thos pa'i bsod nams kyang yod re rkan/ de bas na khyod rang 'di thos pas legs/ go zhing mos na a cang che/ gsang sngags zab mo thabs kyi che ba yin pas/ so so skye bo las dang po pas kyang phyogs tsam mthong ba yin/ khyed rang gis mthong ba'i thig le lu gu brgyud 'di ka bde gshegs snying po'i rang 'od yin par gdon mi za/ de ma/ zad bde gshegs snying po rang yang yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan snying po de stong phyang phyang cig med/mun thom thom cig med/ ci med cang med zhig mid/ ril ril gong gong du med/spros bral rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba/ /kun la khyab pa phyogs cha nye ring med pa zhig lags/ spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa byas tsa na/ da lta'i sems ngos bzung med pa la/ las snang tha mal ba sna tshogs 'char ba 'di ka yin nam mno ba zhig khyed rang la yang yod srid/ mi gzhan rnams/ kyang e zer ltos/ phal cher zer yang zer/ de skad du zer yang / cal col 'ba' zhig yin/ 'dod chags skyes tsa na zhe sdang med/ zhe sdang skyes tsa na 'dod chags med/ rta mthong tsa —339—

na ba glang med/ ba glang mthong tsa na rta med/ gtam snyan thos tsa na yi mug mi skye/gtam ngan thos tsa na dga' ba mi skye/ bsdad na mi 'gro/ 'gro na mi sdod/ de ka rgyar chad phyogs su lhungs/ rnam pa thams cad pa ga re/ mthong thos bya byed rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs can de la ka spros pa zer ba yin/ spros med ga re/ las snang 'khrul pa 'di la spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa yin du re ba 'di rnams khyi lud la gser du mthong ba a re 'khrul/ 'o spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa bya ba/ ma dag las snang 'khrul pa 'di dag ci yang med pa'i shul na/ rang rig rang gsal don dam gnas lugs shig yod/ de ka la spros bral zer/ de nyid ka 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rnam par gdod nas rtag tu shar shar ba 'gyur med cig la rnam pa thams cad pa zer/ dam tshig gis rang ta mtshon du med de/ de skad smras pas/ sems la 'char lugs ma nor ba zhig yod/ dper na nor bu rin po che sa 'jim gyis gos pa zhig /phyogs gcig nas drad na/ dang por khab rtse'i khyon tsam nor bu mthong yong/ khab rtse tsam 'od tse re mthong ba de ka nor bu yin/ dpe de bzhin du bde gshegs snying po de/ bde stong zung 'jug ces bya ba mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yang yin/ rnam kun mchog ldan yang yin/ de nor bu bi rje r+ya dang 'dra/ sgrib pa'i rtsa ba 'dzag bde'i bag chags dang las rlung yin/nor bu de sa 'dam skam pos g.yogs te ci yang mi mthong ba dang 'dra/ byed bcings kyi sgo nas mi g.yo ba gsum ldan bsgoms/ des las rlung cung zad cig 'gags/ thig le cung zad cig bstan yod/ de phyi g.yogs kyi sa de phyogs gcig nas drad pa dang 'dra/ snying po ste rnam pa thams cad pa yin yang /—340—

rnam pa gzhan rnams ma mthong / thig le lu gu brgyud kyi rnam pa de khyed kyis mthong bar gda'/ dpes 'dam drad pas nor bu khab rtse tsam mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /des na thig le lu gu brgyud mthong ba 'di/ bde gshegs snying po mthong ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de lags/ 'o na sngar stong gzugs rnam shes su gtan la phab pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ spyir rnam shes ye shes gnyis gser dang gser gyi g.ya' lta bu yin pas/ go sa tha dad na med/ gser rnyed na g.ya' rnyed/ gser la reg na g.ya' la reg gser mthong na g.ya' yang mthong ba bzhin yin pas/ bde gshegs snying po'i snang ba yin pa dang / rnam shes kyi snang ba yin pa'ang mi 'gal/ blon po'i g.yog de rgyal po'i g.yog kyang yin pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir gser sa 'og na yod na 'od sa steng zer ba bzhin dang / nyi ma'i 'od me long dang chu la brdar nas 'ong na/ me long gi 'od dang chu'i 'od kyis mun nag bsal zer yang / don la nyi 'od gcig de dag la brdar nas 'ongs pas mun nag bsal ba yin pa dang / mun nas tu mar me sbar/ de la 'od skong ngam sprang skyabs yod la/ 'od skong gi phyi rol tu gzugs sna tshogs mthong ba'i snang ba 'gyung ba de snang ba ste dngos su 'od skong las byung yang / gdod nas mar me'i snang ba yin pas mar me'i snang ba dang /'od skong gi snang ba'i dbye ba med/ dpe de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad las gtan nas ma grol gyi bar du/ ye shes kyi snang ba dang rnam shes 'dre ba yin pas/ da ltar thig le lu gu brgyud kho na ma gtogs gzhan mi snang bas/ khyed rang gi snang ba la rgyar chad phyogs lhungs su snang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba mkha' —341—

khyab yin yang / da lta mnyam bzhag tsam gyi bde ba phra mo zhig las gzhan nyams su ma myong ba la/ bde ba chung ngu dang snang ba phyogs gcig pa'i cha nas rnam shes kyi snang ba yin/ thig ler mthong ba tsam dang/ bde ba cam gyi phyogs nas bde gshegs snying po mthong ba yin/ de yang dar la'am gseng gi mig nas 'od rgyugs pa lta bu yin pas/ bde gshegs snying po'i rang 'od yin par yang 'thad do/ /yang tha mal gyi snang ba 'di las rlung gi nus pa las mthong ba yin/ 'dzag bde'i bag chags sems kun gzhi rnam shes dang 'dren pas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skye ba yin/ byed bcings dang ldan pa'i mi g.yo ba gsum ldan gyis/las rlung cung zad 'gags pas ma dag las snang gi cha shas cung zad dgasnying po'i mdangs kyi cha shas 'od gsal rtags snang cung zad cig shar/ shar bas thig le cung zad cig bstan te/ bde ba cung zad skyes pa de'i 'dzag bde'i bag chags cung zad cig 'joms pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad pa la las rlud gis sgrib/ mi 'gyur bde ba la 'dzag bdes sgrib pa yin/ byed bcings kyi rlud 'gag nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis 'dzag bde 'jom/sa/ de gnyis 'dzom pas snang sems gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i gnyen po byed/ yang las snang sems su gtan la phebs pas las rlung gi gnyen po byed/ sems stong par gtan la phebs pas 'gyur bde'i bag chags kyi gnyen po byed/ byed bcings mi rtog pas snang ba sems dang sems stong par rtogs pa'i thabs byed cing /sgrib pa 'joms byed du 'gyur/ yang dper na gser gyi mchod sdong zhig yod pa las de yol bas bsgribs/ de la sbar 'dzin byas kyang yol ba la lag pa —342—

thebs kyi mchod sdong la mi reg tha mal gyi snang sems la dmigs pa brtad kyang de dang 'dra/ ye shes la reg mi thub/ yol ba dbral ba'i seb nas sbar 'dzin byas na mchod sdong gsal po ma mthong yang / mchod sdong la lag pa thebs yong / dmigs pas tha mal gyi snang sems cung zad cig 'gags pa'i seng la sems brtad pas chos dbyings kyi cha shas shig mthong / mchod sdong la 'ju thub pa dang 'dra/ da khyod kyis chos sku'i sne nas sbar gyis zin wa gru thub pa yin pas/ ma shor bar gyis la stong gzugs 'di ka 'bad par sgoms/ mi gzhan gyi kha skad zer bgros la ye/ ma nyan cig lam bzang rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu thob pa yin no zhes brjod/ 'di snang phyogs sam zung 'jug la ngo sprad pa yin/ thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /snang phyogs bya ba kun rdzob kyi snang ba la byas na de gzhi med rtsa bral yin pas stong par ka 'dus/ ngo sprod logs su med/ bden med du ngo sprod na ni der zad/ ye shes sam gnas lugs su ngo sprod na 'khrul/ 'dir rang lugs la snang phyogs zhes pa/ don dam ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas ngo bo zung 'jug kho na'o/ /thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo sprod rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ 'dir bshad pa de tsam ma nor bar ston shes na'ang don 'grub pa lags so/ /yang bsam gtan yan lag lnga dang sbrel te 'chad na/ thun mong ma yin pa stong gzugs la dmigs pa'i phyogs ni/ shes rab sogs bsam gtan rim pa lnga car la khyad par med/ thun mong gi skabs kyi yul snang dang shes pa 'gro ldog gcig tshul shes rab dang 'brel/ de las snang ba sems su rtogs nga/ rtog —343—

pa dang 'brel/ sems stong par ngo sprod pa dpyod pa dang 'brel/ las snang stong pa'i ngang nas/ stong gzugs la brten nas bde ba skye ba dga' ba dang 'brel/stong gzugs rang bde bar myong bas 'dzin zhen dang bral ba ni/ g.yo med bde ba dang 'brel ba'o/ /des na bsam gtan rim pa lnga dngos su skyes na rab/ ma yin yang sor sdud kyi nyams myong shar ba la/ bsam gtan rjes mthun pa'i ngo sprod byed du btub/ ngo 'phrod na bogs kyang che bar 'ong bas don chen po 'grub bo/ /bsam gtan gyi dag dbye'i skabs su/ sbyangs bya phung khams drug ni/ rnam shes kyi phung po nam mkha'i khams/ rna ba'i dbang po chos kyi skye mched/ gsang ba'i dbang po khu ba 'pho ba rnams so/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig ni/ mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyugs ma/phyag na rdo rje/ chos khams rdo rje ma/ khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ khro mo drag spyan ma rnams so/ /mngon shes lnga rjes mthun pa sgrub tshul rgyud kyi lung ni/ nyi ma la ni rgyab kyis phyogs nas nyi 'od la gnas rang gi grib ma brtan pa'i mig gis blta/ /phyi nas nam mkha' dag la mngon par brtags na ro mnyam skyes bu du ba'i mdog can mthong bar 'gyur/ /zla ba drug tu goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las sa la gnas pa'i gter ni sa'i bu gar mthong / /yang na shing gi grib mar rab tu zhugs te nam mkha'i mthil du thig le'i 'phreng ba bsgor/sa pas so/ /zhes dang / sgra ni gang zhig snying gi phyogs na gnas pa mi mchog rnams kyi rna ba'i bu gas thos gyur pa/ /de la mi yi sems ni gcig tu gyur pa sbyar ba dag kyang ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ste/ /'jig rten kun tu sgra ni gang zhig srid —344—

par skyes pas brjod pa de dang de ni de bzhin thos/ khyab bdag gi ni rnam shes nyid dang ring du thos pa dag kyang rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /zhes te/snying kha'i phyogs na gnas pa zhes pas snying gar rlung sems 'dus pas stong pa'i sgra 'byung ba dang / rang ngam gzhan gyi snying ga'i rtsa chu shing gi me tog lta bu la dmigs pa gtod pa bstan/ rnam shes nyid dang zhes pas gzhan sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'o /skabs 'dir mi gsal yang / snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa goms shing / las snang 'di rnams gang 'dod du 'gog thub pa'i mtshan sa shig nas/ bum can rang tsam khegs par byas/snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas/ rlung ba gang stong dang / stong gzugs bsres te bsgoms na/ rtsig pa la mi thogs pa sogs dang / 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ci rigs pa'ang 'byung gsung ste/ gtso bor bum pa can las 'byung ba yin no/ /rtags kyi dbye ba ni rgyud las/ nam mkha' kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzu ma rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yi/ /stong pa las ni du ba smig sgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang / /'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams cadang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal gar 'byar pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ /re kha nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar gyur gyi bar ye du' /de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bu gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te/ /rnam pa —345—

kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ thig le mthong bar 'gyur zhes pa yan chad rtags bcu ste so/ra sdud nas 'grub/ de'i dbus su sogs nges pa gsum ldan gyi longs sku ste/ bsam gtan mthar phyin pa'i rtags yin/ du ma zhes pas sor bsam/ thun mong du sna tshogs gzugs brnyan de bstan/ re kha nag po ni srog 'dzin gnyis kar gyi rtags kyang yin/ srog rtsol mthar thug pa phan chad la 'byung bas gtso bor srog rtsol gyi rtags su'ang byed/ 'dzin pa mthar thug na de la kun mkhyen gzugs zhes pa de 'byung zhing / rnam/ pa kun ldan zhes sogs kyis dran ting gnyis kyi rtags te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs de yang rnam pa thams cad par shar ba'o/ /rtags kyi dbye ba ston pa'i rgyud tshig 'dis/ yan lag drug kar gyi dbye ba ston chul 'di/ grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal lung / rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta skyes mchog dam pa gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las nan tan du thos pa yin/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yang 'di kho nar gnas par 'dug rigs pas kyang grub ste/ re kha nag po dngos te sor bsam gyi rim pa la mi mthong ste/ 'di ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma la 'char dgos pa las/ sor bsam gyi rim pa bas rtsa de mi mthong ba'i phyir dang / rim pa so so la mi sbyor na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku lan gnyis smos pa zlos par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / sor bsam gyi skabs rnam pa kun ldan rang ma mthong ba'i phyir dang/ yul dang rnam par bral ba zhes pa ni/ gzung ba phyi don du med cing / rnam rtog gis brtags pa'i mthu las byung ba min/ dbang yid kyis shes pa bslad pa'i snang ba —346—

— yang min zhes pa yi/na la/ de yang yul dang rnam par bral ba'i tshig snga mas rtags bcu dang / bsam gtan gyi longs sku chun chod stong gzugs ci la de ltar gsungs zin kyang / kun mkhyen gzugs te rjes dran rnam/ kun mchog ldan gyi sku 'grub nga/ na/ des rna' 'byor ba'i lus dngos kyi bya ba byed cing / lus kyi gtso bo yang de yin pa dang / stong gzugs kyi rig ma dang 'dod yon rnams kyis kyang de dang de'i bya ba rlabs po che dngos su byed nus pas/ de rnams gzus sa can gyi rjes su grub bo snya ma nga/'i dogs pa 'byung bar dgongs nas dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ /gzugs can du lta ga la grub/ rnam shes kyi rnam par yang med de sems nyid chos sku'i snang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don la yul dang rnam bral gyi tshig phyi ma smos so/ /gzhan du na yul dang rnam par bral ba zhes/ lan gnyis smos pa yang zlos par 'gyur zhing / thig le'i dbus kyi sangs rgyas dang bsam gtan gyi yin te/ re kha'i dbus kyi sangs rgyas la gang du sbyor med pa'i zol 'jog gis ci zhig bya/ yang kha cig sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang rnam pa kun ldan gyi gzugs sor sdud kho na nas kyang rdzogs par 'dod pa de dag 'di skad kyang smra ste/ 'di rnams sor sdud la rdzogs dgos te/ gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med pas mthong bar bshad cing / bsam gtan thob na mngon shes 'byung ba'i phyir zer ba ni rtog ge ba'i 'od thogs la/ gsang sngags pa'i khral gal bas bla ma'i man ngag gi zhal rgyun yang med/ don 'gang che sa mthong pa'i blo gros kyang med par/grwa ga sgo tsheg pa ṇa1 na snying la bzhag nas/ ma bo/ bkug ste dpe cha bltas pa'i yig —347—

rig nag 'ded la go ba log par shar ba de/ gzhan gyis ma go ba go tshul gyi mkhas khyad du smras pa'o/ /de'i don ni stong gzugs de dag rang sems yin na yin mnyam dang / min na min mnyam du byed dgos pa las/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ma thob gong du stong gzugs mtha' yas pa mthong ba'i phyir/rang sems kho na yin zhes pa ste/ 'di yang rnam shes ye shes kyi dbye ba ma phye bar/ rnal 'byor ba'i snang ngo dang bstun nas gsungs pa yin no/ /nges par dpyad na/ rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi sems rnam shes ni ma yin/ chos nyid kyi sems kyi dbang du byas na ni/ rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi yin yang / chos nyid de chos su dang sbrel yang rang gi rang bzhin yin gyi gzhan yin par mi 'jog go /chos nyid kyi sems dang sems nyid dang / kun gzhi ye shes dang / de bzhin nyid kyi bdag dang / dam pa'i bdag rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs lags so// //srog rtsol gyi skabs/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud ces pa la/ paṇa chen la chos rje sa paṇa gyis zhus/ sa paṇa yang / pha chos kyi thugs chen mdzad nas/lam 'bras kho na gzhan la ngom zhing bsngags brjod mdzad kyang kho rang ginyams len gyi mthil sbyor drug la mdzad/ sgo dras dpe khang gi 'og na sa paṇa gyi sgom khang yang mun khang du yod/ bum can la brten nas te te 'ching ba dang /bdud rtsi lce sbyor 'grub pa sogs sbyor drug gi rlung phyogs la yon tan kyang 'khrungs pa yin/ de 'dra rjes 'jug rnams kyis nyams mgo e non ni ma shes lags/ rwa lugs kyi sbyor drug la ni man ngag nyung zhing rno ba zhig 'dug kyang —348—
