sgrub grwa bzang ba tsam ma byung ngo / /srog rtsol sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi skabs su rgyud las/ dang por mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni dngos grub rgyu ru sngags pa dag gis yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /lus med na ni dngos/ grub med cing skye ba 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba med/ /sde phyir lus kyi don gyi rgyur ni nyin zhag so so'i 'dus su rtsa yi sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /lus ni grub na gzhan pa'i dngos grub srid pa gsum gyi gnas su sngags zhugs nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang / stong pa las ni du ba sogs 'a/ma bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gi gzugs brnyan 'tshams su bsgom nga/ra bya/ /de nas rtsa yi 'khor lo rnams su srog dang thur sel rlung ni brtan nga/ dag kyang byed pa ste/ /phyi nas zla ba nges par 'gog pa gza' bzhin byed de byang chub sems ni rnal 'byor ba yis so/ /de nas gang zhig cung zad 'dod pa dag ni nyin zhag 'ga' yis skye ba 'di la thob par 'gyu/ra/ /zhes pa dang / kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung rnams ma lus pa/ /srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pa/ /dus kyi goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me yi dbus su ro ni myo/nyam par 'gyur ba ste/ /lus la zas la sogs pa bkres pa dang ni skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster/ /zhes dang / zla ba nyi ma 'gog pa mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa la ste dbu ma me la rab tu zhugs/ /srog dang thur sel gnyis po dag kyang nyin zhag dang po song na dus min 'chi ba bslu ba ste/ /lag pa dang bcas rkang pa'i mthe bo'i tshigs dang sen mo'i mthar ni srog gis kun tu gang byas pa/ /'khor —349—

lo drug la sangs rgyas lha mo/ 'jigs med phyag gi pad+ma rnal 'byor pas ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / nus ma gang zhig lta ba'i dbus gnas gzhan gyi gnas su bcu gnyis mtha' dang bcu drug mthar 'gro ba/ /de ni lte bar 'gog pa dang bcas dri med glog dang mtshungs pa dbyug pa'i gzugs can langs pa yang / /'bor lpo nas ni 'khor lo'i bar du nges par dman zhing rol pa'i bgrod pas dbu ma'i rtsa la skyod/ /ji srid gtsug tor phug par btsan thabs nyid kyi phyi rol kyi ni pags pa dag la khab bzhin reg de yi dus su thur du sel ba mchog gi btsan thabs nyid kyis steng gi lam du bskul bar bya/ /zung gi rlung dag 'gags pa na ni gtsug tor phug nas mchog gi grong khyer dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yid la rdo rje rab tu sad pas yul dang bcas pa mkha' la spyod pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang / srog rtsol rab tu bya ste snying ga de bzhin mgo bo dang ni ji srid me yis gdung gyur pa/ /de las steng dag tu ni bzang po'i pad+ma ra rgyal bar 'gyur te ma bsdams pa'am stobs dag gis/ /gtsug tor phug cing phung po dag dang khams rnams rnam par spangs nas 'chi ba nyid du 'gro 'gyur te/ /phyag rgya 'grogs pa rab nyams skyes bu rnams kyis skye ba 'di nyid la ni bde 'bras ster ba med/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs rnams kyis gal te sngags pa rnams kyis 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da goms pas btsan thabs chu skyes gnas su rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams la/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i lag len gyi gnad thams cad 'dus te/ dmigs pa rnams la khrid yig gi dkyus dang go don rnams gzhan du —350

bshad zin rgo /'di'i dag bya phung khams drug ni/ 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams/ sna'i dbang go reg bya'i skye mched/ ngag gi dbang go bshang ba 'dor ba rnams/ so/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i skabs/ lha rlung khams pa drug ni/ don yo nga grub pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma / nam mkha'i snying po reg bya rdo rje ma/ bgegs mthar phyed/ shin tu brtson 'gru/sa ma rnams so/ /de bzhin du 'dzin nga la yang sbyang bya drug ni/ tshor ba'i phung po/ me'i khams/ mig bi/ dbang po/ re'i skye ma/ched/ lag pa'i dbang po/ bya ba 'gro ba rnams tre du/ /'bras bu lha me khams pa drug ni/ rin chen 'khyu/nga ldan/ gos dkar mo/sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ rmugs byed ma rnams so/ / rjes dran gyi 'khrid kyi skabs su rlung sbyang ba la / dza hu ba hoXhi dang / lī ni/ ṛ/ spyo 65 sbre/ra ba dang / bla ma go/nga ma rnams kyi khrid yig na/ 95 wa ra ya ha 'a dbyangs so so sbyar ba'i ngag 'dren sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams/ ye shes we'u las/ ye shes dgug par byed pa 'di ni slar yang shin tu stobs te de ni gzhug pa rmugs byed kyis / //nge/ bzhin bcings pa rengs byed kyis te nges par mcheg bde'i dbang gis khengs byed kyis ni mnyes pa yang / /ye shes 'khor lo das la 'khor lo ro ni mnyam par byed pa rdo rje shugs kyis byed pa ste/ /de bzhin khro bo'i lha mo rnams ni rab gsal nges par rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi sku la'o/ /zhes dang / waṃ sogs0 dbyangs brgyad gang dag yul dang yon tan du 'gyur dbyangs phyed kyis ni rnam par dman pa rnams/ /phan tshun dbye bas phye ba —35/—

rkang pa dang bcas ro dang mnga' rnams dbu ma'i dbugs ni 'bab pa ste/ /zhes gsungs nga/'i man ngag tu gong ma rnams bzhed de de bzhin du snang ngo / /rjes dran gyi sbyang bya drug ni/ snyu shes kyi phung po/ chu'i khams // lce'i dbang po/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ rkang pa'i dbang po/ bya ba len pa rnams so// /'bras bu lha chu khams pa drug ni/ 'od dpag med/ mā ma ki spyan ras gzigs/gzugs rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma rnams so/ 'dir rgyud las/dbus su srog ni rab tu zhugs pa yul dang rnam par bral ba'i sna tshogs yum la 'khyud pa ste/ /pad+ma ra zhugs kra 'i rang gi rdo rje spro ba dag kyang de bzhin zla nyi'i dbus su rab bzhugs pa'o/ /bde ba'i sa bon ma lhung ba las rab dga'i dga' bar gnas pa rnal 'byor pa yi rnal 'byor 'di/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don slad khyab bdag gi ni dpal ldan gsang ba las kyang mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis rnam/ pa kun ldan gyi ye shes sku de srog ste rlung 'gags pa las/ byung ba'i gtum mo'i snang ba/ rtsa a wa dhū tī nas gzhi bcas pa dang / rtsa ba de lha sku kha sbyor gyi rnam/ pa yin pa'ang gsal bar bstan zhing /'dis rjes dran dang zhor la ting nge 'dzin gyi mchan nyid kyang gsal bar bstan no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i skabs su/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yis/ /dus sbyor rnams ni mi 'bab phyir/ /sa rnams bcu gnyis zhes grags pa/ /gnas la sogs pa don dam mo/ /zhes sa bcu gnyis dang /mchog tu mi 'gyur skad cig ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /drug brgya yongs rdzogs rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpar rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes mi 'gyur —352—

ba'i skad cig ma nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang / bsdus rgyud las/ chags dang chags bral thog mtha' la gnas skad cig ma yang khyab bdag gi ni dbugs kyi grangs 'phel lo/ /zhes mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig ma 'grub pa'i rgyu gsungs/ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang bya drug ni/ gzugs kyi phung po/ sa'i khams/ lus kyi dbang po/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ bshang lam gyi dbang po/ bya ba smra ba ste drug go /'bras bu lhas khams pa drug ni/ rnam snang / sangs rgyas spyan ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dri rdo rje ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma rnams so/ de ltar na/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ de phyir g.yo med bde ba'i skad cig lhan cig skyes pa 'dir ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ster byed de/ /srog gi ro yi 'gro ba rnams la gnas pa thams cad bkug cing nyon mongs bdud rnams bcoms byas nas/ /rdzu 'phrul kun mkhyen sa dang srid gsum bla ma nyid ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi skye ba 'di la ste/ /gal te lam du rab zhugs 'chi bar gyur na de tsho de yi 'dzin pas skye ba gzhan la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam 'di la mos shing dam tshig dang ldan na ji tsam 'gor yang / skye ba bdun tshun chad la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par the tshom med do/ /rjes kyi 'khrid kyi skabs su/ mgrin snying kha sbyor la brten nas 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni/ lus gnad tsog pu bya/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying ga chos kyi snyen ra lo sngon po'am nag po rtsa 'dab brgyad/kha gyen bstan rgya sor gsum tsam/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis pa kha dog dmar po kha thur bstan/ rgya sor drug tsam/ de gnyis kyi bar 'khor lo'i lhe ba gnyis rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po sbom phra gro sog cam gyi sbrel —353—

pa/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte bar thig le sngo skya sran chung tsam/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lte ba na/ ṛ yig mgo bo thur bstan me'i rang bzhin can dmar po/ /de nas rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung shugs che zhing ring bar rngubs/ mgrin pa'i ṛ yig la phog de las 'od zer me'i rang bzhin dmar skya phra mo zhig thur du 'bar te/ dbu ma'i lam nas mdung btsugs pa ltar song ba snying ga'i thig le la reg nga/sa/ de zhu zhing cil li li khol ba la sem/sa brtad/ rlung /ba sbyor drag tu bzung ngo / /snying ga'i bum can thob thang yin yang / lte ba'i bum can byas na gegs mi sdang zhing sad 'byam/sa mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod pas da lta'i lag len 'a/ lte ba'i bum can ka byed yang rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe 'od zer dmar po mgrin pa'i ṛ la thim/ snying ga'i thig le khengs pa'i tshul gyis 'od hril le 'dug /rlung phyir cung zad bzung ba'i skabs thig le de rje phra je phra la yungs 'bru cam/ yang rje sbom je sbom la sngar bzhin sran chung tsam du song bar bsam/ de nyid nyin par yang yang bsgom/ nyal khar rlung thengs nyer gcig dang / dmigs pa nyer gcig sbyar/ de nas lus gnad tsog pu'am seṅge nyal stangs bya/dmi/gas pa ṛ yig gi me 'od snying ga'i thig le la bsnun pa sngar bzhin bsgom/rlung sbyor mi bya/ sems snying gar brtad pa de kha'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /lte snying kha sbyor gyi 'od gsal spel ba ni lus gnad skyil krung sogs spyi dang 'dra/ snying ga chos 'khor sngon po 'dab brgyad tshad sor gsum snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ kha thur bstan/ lte ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par na yongs rdzogs sgom/de mi gas snyel ba'am bsdu na/ nang skor 'dab ma bzhi la sor gnyis/ phyi skor —35kre—

'dab ma brgyad la sor bzhi pa ser po kha gyen bstan zhig bsgom/ de'i bar dbu ma gong bzhin 'dug pas sbrel/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lhe ba thig le dkar po'am sngon po'i me re gang / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na/ thig le phra mo yungs 'khru tsam lnga ste/ rgyab ser g.yon dkar g.yas dmar/ mdu myo nag /dbus ljang pa'o/ de nas bum can kha sbyor drag tu bzung zhing / stod la shugs ma song ba'i ngos nas/ nye ba man chad g.yas skor g.yon skor drag tu bskor pas/ lte ba'i thig le ser po dkar po la thim de dmar po la/ de nag po la/ nge/ ljang /khu la thim/ ljang khu dbu ma'i lam nas rgyangs te 'phar/ snying ga'i thig le 'a/ thim/snying ga'i thig le'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad khra gsal la khyab par bsam/ rlung phyir btang zhing phyir bzung ba'i tshe/ de ka la sems brtad/ de nyid skyar gyin sgom pa yin/ nyal khang rlung thengs nyer gcig sgom pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ snga ma ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa la bsngags/ des gnyid kyi 'od gsal yang yang zin 'ong na/ phyi ma 'di bsgom pas bde nyams dang gsal snang gong 'phel la 'gro/ gsal snang mthar phyin pas/ lkog gyur shes pa'ang 'byung /dmigs pa 'di gnyis dus 'khor rang lugs la ngo bo bskyed rim yin pas srog rtsol gyi rim pa rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag la mi dgos kyang / da lta las dang po pa la shin tu zab pa'i dmigs par 'gyur zhing / srog rtsol gyi gdam ngag dang ni 'brel ba yin no/ khams thim rim dang / snang bzhi'i rnam gzhag zhib mor bshad zhes pa la/ de yang rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sa ni chu la rab tu 'jug cing chu yang 'bar byed la te gtsang bar byed pa rlung la'o/ /rlung ni stong pa —355—

la te stong pa nges par mtshan ma rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur zhing mtshan ma ni/ rnam pa thams cad pa ru 'gyur te mi yi bdag po gzhom du med pa ye shes sku/ /ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul dngos grub tu 'gyur mi bdag skye dgu rnams kyi skye ba 'di nyid la'o/ /zhes te/ 'dis ni gtso bor tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rgyud la skyed tshul gyi dbang du byas nas 'dzin pa rjes dran ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi skabs su 'od gsal du 'jug tshul bstan pa yin yang / ma dag pa'i phung khams thim tshul dang / de las ye shes kyi snang ba spro tshul spyir btang 'dra ba yin pas/ 'chi ba 'ong gsal dang bar do lam du byed tshul yang bstan par 'gyur zhing / gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi rim pa yang ngo / /de bzhin du/ chu yis me ni rnam par nyams pa dang por 'dir ni lus kyi dbus su sdom brtson rnams kyis bya/ /phyi nas 'dzin ma dag ni chu ru 'gyur te lan tsha bzhin du chu yi dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /rlung ni chu bo de dag skam nas nam mkha' la ni snang ba min par myur du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems ni mun pa'i mtha' yi me ste yul dang rnam par bral ba dbus kyi mtha' la bzhag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang pos rags pa thim pa dang / gnyis pas sa chu gnyis thim pa dang / gsum pas me rlung thim pa dang / bzhi pas nam mkha' rnam shes thim tshul lam/ snang ba ba'i po gsal bar ston pa yin te/ me dang mun pa'i mtha' zhes bsgyur ba ltar na a wa ga tī dang / dung can ma'i rlung gcig tu 'dus pa 'od gsal gyi skabs ston par 'gyur zhing / mun pa'i mtha'i me zhes bsgyur ba ltar na yang / snang ba ni zla ba dang / mched pa ni nyi ma zhes kha bskang ste thog mar sbyar nas mun pa ni —356—

thob pa dang / dus me ni thams cad stong pa 'od gsal pa'o/ /de yang rtsa rkyang ma rlung dang thim ler bcas pa dbu mar 'gags pas snang ba dang / ro ma'i de dag 'gags pas mched pa dang / dbu ma'ang dung can mar thim pas thob pa dang /dung can ma la gnas pa ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /dbu mar dung can mar 'gags zhes pa'ang / de gnyis kyi byed pa ro gcig tu 'dres bzhin pa'i don yin gyi/steng nas 'og tu sdib pa lta bu'i don ma yin no/ /bram ze chen po sa ra ltas kyang /rlung dang me dang dbang chen 'gags pa na/ /bdud rtsi rgyu ba'i dus su sems ni rlud la 'jug /nam zhig spyor gzhi gnas gcig tu ni zhugs pa yi/ /bde chen mchog ni nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang / ār+ya de bas bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim par yang / sa yi khams ni chu la thim/ /chu ni me la thim pa ste/ /me ni rlud phra'i khams la'o/ /rlud ni sems la thim par 'gyur/ /sems ni sems byung la thim ste/ /sems las byung ba ma rig pa/ /de yang 'od gsal bar 'gro'o/ /srid pa gsum po 'di ltar 'gags/ /zhes nga/ dang /gzhan yang / sa la sogs pa bzhi po dang / /de bzhin stong pa bzhi po dag /skyed dang 'jig pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /dngos po brgyad po rnam shes bya/ zhes gsungs te/ mdor na 'od gsal nyid dngos po rnams gang du thim pa dang / gang las byung ba'i gzhir byas te/ gzhi dus kyi 'chi ba dang / bar do la gsal zhing rdzogs pa dang / gnyid la 'jug cing rmi lam dang sad dus su ldang ba'i skabs kyang ci rigs pa 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang gnas skabs du mar gsal ba dang / der ma zad shin tu phra ba ni/ rnam rtog re re 'gags cing skye ba la yang —357—

'byung ste/ gang ltar na'ang de thams cad la rags pa phra ba la thim/ de shin tu phra ba la thim pa'i shin tu phra ba mthar thug de 'od gsal yin/ yang de nyid lugs zlog tu rag pa'i bar du skye/ de la rags pa ni/ dbang po lnga/ phung po lnga/yul lnga/ ye shes lnga ste rags pa nyi shur grags pa lta bu yin/ ngos 'dzin rjen pa ni/ sha khrag rags pa'i lus dbang po rten bcas dang / sgo lnga'i dbang shes rnam rtog dang bcas pa rnams so/ /phra ba tsam po ni 'byung bzhi yin/ shin tu phra ba ni/ snang mched thob gsum yang yin la phra ba'i mthar thug 'od gsal lo/ /gzhi 'khor ba'i dus su de ltar 'byung ba de la/ de kho na dang 'dra bar lam bsgoms pas kyang nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ lam gong ma rnams la lta ci smos/ sor sdud gcig po'i gnas skabs na yang de rnams tshang ste/ ltos med bzhi ldan gyi nyams myong skyes pa'i skabs rags pa rnams cung zad thim zhing / mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgom pas/ phra ba dang / shin tu phra ba'i thim rim 'char te/thig le'i skabs su 'od gsal yin la/ de nas thig le chen po'i rim pa dang /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ni bar do dang skye ba lam du byed pa ste/ 'on kyang phra mor na gcig la'ang tshang ste/ ltos med dang mi g.yos rnam rtog 'gags pa ni thim rim 'chi ba 'od gsal lam byed dang / de las rtags snang gcig shar bas ni bar do lam byed/ des tha mal gyi snang ba la rgyas btab pa ni skye ba sprul sku lam du byed do/ /'di ni zur tsam mtshon pa ste gzhan yang chos drug sogs las 'byung ba ltar/ mdor bsdus bshad kyang drang / dag cing zhib pa ni gsang 'dus 'phags skor las 'gyung ba yin pa kho bos rim lnga'i 'grel par bshad —358—

zin pas/ de las rtogs par bya ba'i 'dir yi ge mang par 'gyur bas ma bris go /'pho ba'i dmigs pa snga ma ni/ chos rgyal phyogs pas mdzad pa'i yig chung gi lugs yin/ gdams ngag gi yi ge 'ga' zhig las zhes pa 'di/ kun spangs chen po'i bu chen la stod pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi lugs yin/ bar do'i skabs 'chi ba las bar dor ldang tshul yang 'phags skor na gsal/ yang ba'i g.yang sa gsum ni/ dmyal ba la nag po dang / yi dwags la dmar po dang /dud 'gro la ser po ste g.yang sa phyams chen po rgya khyon tshad med pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba gsum mthong ba'o/ /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ni 'byung bzhi snang log gi sgra yin te spyi skad la grags/ lnga ni de'i steng du nam mkha'i snang log gi sgra bsnan pa ste/ dus 'khor ba'i grub thob rnams kyi bzhed pa yin/ rim nga/ bzhin du ri 'ur ba dang rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa dang / nags tshal mes tshig pa dang / 'jig dus kyi rlung gi sgra dang / 'brug sgra drag po lta bu rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang sbyar rdo /ma nges pa'i rnar/ 'gyur drug ni/ gnas ma nges pa/ gos ma nges nga//zas ma nges pa/ grogs ma nges pa/ spyod pa ma nges pa/ yid kyi 'gyur ba ma nges pa'am/ 'du shes ma nges pa'o/ /'gro ba'i lam bzhi ni/ dus yi 'khor lo'i rgyud nyid las gsal bar gsungs te/ ji skad du/ 'od zer lha rnams mtho ris su ste dkar min bgrod pa de bzhin lha min klu yi 'jig rten du/ /kun tu 'dres rnga/ mi yi 'jig rten dus ni yi/ dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dag gi 'gyur/ /zhes —359—

'od zer dkar po'i lam las lha dang / nag po'i las lha min klu dang dmyal ba dang / dmar po las yi dwags dud 'gro/ 'dres pa las mi ste bzhi'o/ chos gzhan las 'gro ba drug la lam drug tu'ang grags/ mdo lugs las/ dkar po nag po 'dres ma gsum du'ang 'gyung bar bshad do/ /thun sgom gyis mnyam rjes bsre ba ni rkyen dang bsre ba yin/ snga rabs kyi co rma sogs lo tsā ba rnams kyis 'khrid mdzad dus/ sbyor drug gi sgom chen mang rab cig la/ mngon shes sogs kyi yon tan skyes kyang / gdams ngag 'di med pas/ na tsha sogs lam du 'khyer ma thub nas/ gzhan kun na re/ sbyor drug de rkyen mi thub pa zhig yod par 'dug zer 'phya ba byung skad/ des na 'di gal che/ 'bro ba'i man ngag la 'di rgyas par yod pa'ang lags/ kun spangs chen pos rtsal du 'don par mdzad pa'ang yin no/ /rkyen phra mo nas bsre ba 'di/ spyod 'jug las kyang gsungs te/ /goms na sla bar ma gyur pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /de bas gnod pa chung goms pas/ /gnod pa chen po bzod par byos/ /zhes dang / tsha grang char dang rlung sogs la'ang / /bdag gis gze re mi bya ste/ /zhes gsungs shing / snyi sar rkos nas sra sar drod kyi dpe yin no/ khugs chad la sogs pa'i nyams ni/ rnam rtog snga ma 'gags shing phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar stongs yin pas/ skabs der sems rnam par mi rtog pa gsal bar mtshon nus/dmigs pa la mnyam par gzhag pas rnam rtog chad pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i yan lag gi skabs/ gegs sel ni yi ge logs su yod/ dkyus la 'chad mi dgos/ bogs 'don ni bla —360—

ma'i mos gus dang / sems can la snying rje dang / snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang / stong pa nyid dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la nges shes skyed pa dang / gzhan yang dus skabs su bab pa na/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba rnam pa gsum gyis srog dbu ma'i thig ler drag tu gzhug pa dang / gzhan yang thun dbri bkyed dang /spyod lam yangs dog spel ba dang / yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa sogs yin la/ 'dzin pa grub pa yan chad kyis ni/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med de/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnams so/ /de dag la spro na rgyas bshad cung zad bya/ bsdu na ming tsam smos pa de kas chog go /bka' rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa zhes bya ba/ rgyas gdab bya ba'i yul bzhi tshan gnyis 'khrid yig tu bshad pa ltar yin/ de la gnyis yod pa'i snga ma phyogs pa dang / phyi ma dbang rgyal ba'i gsung yin/ snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig phyis 'khrid kyi skabs su bla ma'i bka' rgyas 'debs mod kyang de ni slob ma la go ba bskyed phyir gsal 'debs tsam yin/ de'i rtsa ba dbang gi 'jug pa'i dus kyi dam bzhag nyid yin pas/dam bzhag bzhi la bka' rgya bzhi zer yang gsung / yang kha cig dngos su rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' yin/ de la brgyud pa rnams 'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' rgya dang gcig /snod min la gsang ba mi ston pa rgyud las dam tshig tu gsungs pa'i phyir/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' rgya dang gnyis/ snod min la gsangs/ snod ldan 'ga' zhig la spel/ de yang bla ma dang lha la gnang ba zhu/de ltar byas na gzhan la phan pa ma zad/ rang nyid la yang nyes skyon med cing tshogs rdzogs pas gegs dang bar chad mi 'byung / dpal dang yon tan gong —361—

'phel du 'gro/ snod min la bstan na rang dang slob ma gnyis kar phung / skal ldan don nyer can la ser sna byas na/ byang sdom gyi rtsa ltung phog g.yin don 'grib/ tshogs mi rdzogs pas phan yon nyes dmigs de bzhin yod pa/ dngos po'i gshis lugs yin pas 'da' bar mi nus pa ni/ chos nyid las 'bras kyi bka' rgya ste gsum/ chos 'di dang rang gi nyams myong rnams gsang ba 'dzags shing / srang khar yan na bka' srungs rnams kyis chad pa 'byung ba'i phyir dam tshigs mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya ste bzhi'o/ /zhes 'chad pa dang / yang bka' rgya dang po dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i dus/ bka' rgya gnyis pa dbang rdzas dam tshig dus/ bka' rgya gsum pa gdams ngag 'khrid kyi dus/ bka' rgya bzhi pa ngo sprod 'dzug btsugs dus/ zhes kyang 'chad de/ 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams la bshad khungs mi dgos pas/ don dang mthun na gang ltar bshad kyang 'gal ba med pas/ dgag sgrub ni dgos kyang mi dgos/ thub kyang mi thub/ thams cad la go rgyu bzang po re ni 'dug go /bar chad spang ba'i yan lag gi skabs/ lam bzang rin chen 'di ni bag med pa'i sogs kyi 'bru bsnyer na/ chos zab mo ra zhe ying bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra/ de bsgoms pa las nyams myong che chung gang shar kyang / nyams myong de yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra/ dbang dang stobs yod pa'i mi gcig gi lag tu rin po che de byung na ta/ chom rkun gyis 'phrog pa'i nyen med de/ rin po che de mi phal pa dbang med pa zhig gi lag tu byung na/ chom rkun gyis 'phrog pa'am/ g.yo can gcig gis bslus te 'phrog nyen che bas/ rin po che sus kyang ma tshor bar sbed thub pa'i cag byed dgos/ de —362—

bzhin du nyams myong dang 'brel ba'i gdams ngag zab mo thob pa 'di yang /rang nyid gegs kyis mi yer ba'i gdengs dang brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du/bag med dang g.yo can sogs skye bo skal med rnams la ston du yang mi rung zhing / rang nyid kyang mi gzhan gyis blo bskyur ba'i dbang du mi 'gro ba zhig byed dgos/ rang gi nyams myong la gnod pa thams cad sgom 'jig par 'gyur ba'i chom rkun dang 'dra bas spong dgos/ zhes pa mdor bsdus kyi don blo la bzhag nas 'di ltar/ lam bzang po rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rin po che 'di ni bag med cal col gyi sems can mi gzhan rnams la ston par mi bya/ gal te bstan pa na/ dper na 'brog dgon pa lung stong du chom rkun 'byung ba ltar/ sems can de dag rang gi khyim la shin tu chags shing / blos mi thongs bas rang khyim grong yin yang rung / gnas gzhi yin yang rung ste/ chags sdang 'phel ba'i khyim gyi 'brog dgon par rab tu zhugs shing gnas pa la/ zhing las dang / tshong gi las sogs khyim gyi 'tsho rtsis dang / bza' btung khyim thab/ 'khor dang / rnyed pa dang /zagatam sogs la chags pa yul ngan pa'i chom rkun gyis chos zab mo de chud zos pa'i tshul gyis yon tan mi skye zhing cung zad skyes kyang nyams pa'i tshul gyis 'phrog par byed do/ /de ltar na slob ma des chos chung gsan pas g.yang shor te/ rang gi yang byin rlabs nyams pa'i don yin/ yang gcig tu na chos btsongs nas nor sgrub pa'i sgrib pa des/ rang gi sgom shor pa'i don la'ang spyor yang nags thibs por choms rkun 'byung ba ltar/ sngar bla mas gdams ngag bstan pa'i dus su/ nyams myong gi rin po che ci rigs par thob kyang / gnyen —363—

'dun ni mtshon byed de/ dgra gnyen la brten pa'i chags sdang sna tshogs 'phel ba'i yul phyogs nags thibs por rab tu zhugs shing gnas pa la/ dmigs pa'i yul la the tshom dang / bya byed 'khrul ba phra mo tshun chad la 'gyod pa dang /sgom pa la mi spro ba'i le lo dang / sgom blo byas kyang sems rnam g.yeng gis khyer ba'i rgod pa ste/ mnyam bzhag bsam gtan la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa lnga'i chom rkun 'di rnams kyis mnyam bzhag rtag tu 'phrog cing nyams par byed do/ /ji skad du/ rgod dang 'gyod dang gnod sems rmugs pa dang / /gnyid dang 'dod la 'dun dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag dge ba'i nor/ /'phrog pa'i chom rkun lags par mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ chos mngon pa sogs thams cad las/ rtog rigs bdun bgrangs nas sgrib pa lnga zhes gsungs pa la/ rgod 'gyod gnyis gcig tu sdoms/ gnyid rmugs gnyis gcig tu sdoms/ 'dir bshad pa'i le lo ma bgrangs/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems bsnan no/ /de dag bslab pa gsum la sgrib pa'i rnam gzhag sogs mdzad/ de la rgod pa zhes pa sngon de dag gi chos skad la/ /'dod yon la longs spyod pa da ltar dran pas sems ma zhi ba zhig la rgod par 'jog la/'dir ni dmigs pa la mi gnas pa'i rnam g.yeng spyi la rgod par bzhag pas/rgod pa bkag na 'dod 'dun gnod sems zhor la khegs par dgongs pa yin gyi/ kha cig de gnyis gsang sngags pa la spong mi dgos pa'i skabs yang zer ba mi 'thad cing / skabs kyi don las phyir phyogs so/ /'dir bslab pa gsum gyi sgrib pa la mi sbyor/ sems gnas pa kho na'i sgrub pa mdzad do/ /dpal gsang ba —364—

grub pa las kyang / le lo gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang / /rgod dang the tshom zhes bya ba/ /sgrib pa lnga po sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mi bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di dang gcig pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / gzhan gyi bud med bsten pa sogs log g.yem dang / 'du shes bsgyur te rdzun smra pa dang / dngos su rgol ba'i tshig rtsub dang / mdza' bo 'byed pa'i phra ma dang/ de gsum las gzhan du gyur pa nyon mongs can gyi tshig 'khyal bar gyur pa dang / gzhan gyi longs spyod rang gir 'dod pa'i brnab sems dang / pha rol po'i lus dang longs spyod la gnod sems dang / bden bzhi'i don la med par skur ba 'debs pa'i log lta ste/des mtshon pa'i lta ba ngan pa gzhan rnams kyang ngo / /mi dge ba bcu lta ngan sna tshogs dang bcas pa de dag byas na/ ting nge 'dzin sngar ma skyes pa mi skye zhing /skyes pa nyams par 'gyur bas/ sngar sgom cung zad skyes pa rnams 'phrog pa'i tshom rkun no/ /yang srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod log rdzun tshigachang 'thung ste las ngo bo nyid kyis sdig par gyur pa/ rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho ba yin pa'i phyir/ yod pa'i sdig pa lnga dang bcas pa ste chang 'thung ba rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho bar 'dod pa dge 'dun phal chen pa'i lugs dang 'dra'o/ /cho lo rtse ba dang / mtshan ma can gyi sha dang / bza' ba dang rin gyi don du bsad pa'i sha'i bza' ba la chags pa dang / long gtam sna tshogs la dga' ba dang / mu stegs kyi rig pa dang kla klo'i chos la blo 'jug cing brtson pa ste/ de rnams sdig pa'i las dang / rjes su mthun pa nye ba'i sdig pa lnga dang/ mchod spyin gyi don du —365—

ba lang gsod pa dang / mi bsad mchod sbyin nam/ ma mo mchod pa'i don du/byis pa gsod pa dang / nar son pa'i bud med gsod pa dang/ skyes pa gsod pa dang / lha mi'i bla ma dkon mchog gi rten gsum 'jig par byed pa ste gsod pa lnga'o/ /lnga po 'di rnams sdig pa shin tu che zhing / lhag par dang po bzhi po mu stegs byed mang po zhig chos su 'dod pa dang / lnga pa kla klo rnams chos su 'dod pas/ de dag gi log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir sgos su smos pa yin na/ 'khu ba ni/zhabang zhing khros pa ste/ 'jig rten nam chos kyi grogs po dang / bkur bar 'os pa'i rje bo dang / sangs rgyas dang/ dge 'dun dang / bla ma la khro ba ste lnga dang /dbang po lnga yul lnga la mngon par zhen pa ni chags pa lnga ste/ 'di rnams byas na ting nge 'dzin nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lam bzang rgyud la skyes pa 'phrog pa'i lnga pa lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di rnams rtag tu ste nam byas res kyis lam bzang rin po che 'phrog cing nyams par byed do/ /nyi shu po de rnams byas na sdig pa'i bags kyis non nas sgom nyams par byed cing / dbang shes lnga'i rjes kyi rtog pas yul la chags pa ni/ rnam g.yeng nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin dngos dang 'gal ba'o/ /sdig las spyad pas ting nge 'dzin rnams nyams 'gro bar mdo sngags thams cad nas gsungs pas/ sdig pa'i las mang po byas kyang rdzogs pa chen po dang / phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du ye grol ye dag yin zer zhing /sgom bzang du song ba skad byed pa yin/ rnam pa gnyis te/ yang na rdzun kha thal kyis gzhan mgo bskor ba 'ba' zhig tu zad/ yang na ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgom log thebs pa kho na'o/ /des na rang gi brtson 'grus las —366—

byung ba'i sgom gcig dang / byin rlabs rnam dag las byung pa'i sgom gcig dang /nag phyogs kyi 'gong po'i byed las kyi sgom gcig ste/ sgom thebs tshul gsum yod pa 'di go dgos nges rang zhig yin na'ang / phal cher gcig gis mi go bar 'dug go /gzhan yang bza' ba dang / btung ba sna tshogs dang / gnas khang dang / gos dang / 'khor g.yog dang / khyim thab dang / 'bru dang / phyugs dang / sa gzhi la sogs pa longs spyod du ma la shin tu mngon par chags shing g.yengs pa'i chom rkun de rnams kyis ni/ skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan pa yin du zin kyang / bag med pa'i spyod pa la yin par 'gyur zhing / dran pa nyams pas brgyal par gyur pa ste/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pas/ sngar yod kyi yon tan thams cad nyams shing 'phrog par 'gyur na/ brtson 'grus chung zhing lhod pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos so/ /g.yo can gyi ston pa spang pa'i skabs/ rang la nyams myong 'dra skyes kyang zab mo'i rgyud don la rang byan chub pa ma yin na/ rang gi sgom de bzang ngan rang gi mi shes pas/ gzhan la 'dri dgos na chos 'di ston pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de la zhu rgyu byung na legs/ de min chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la go ba bzang zhing myong ba skyes pa zhig la dris na/dogs pa chod cing legs par 'ong srid/ sgom med pa'i rtog ge ba dang / sgom yod par brdzu ba'i zog po dang / chos gzhan gyi lugs kyi sgom bzang rab yod du chug kyang / chos zab mo/ /'di'i ro ma myong ba rnams la/ sbyor drug gi nyams rtogs sogs rang gi nyams myong dang / phyag len du 'debs pa'i man ngag dang /bla mas ngo sprod tshul sogs dogs gcod ta nam yang mi byed de/ tshig zur tsam —367—

yang mi smra'o/ /gal te dogs gcod byas na/ de dag gis 'di ni lam log pa'o snyam/ kho rang gi lugs dang ma mthun pas smod pa shas che/ kha cig 'di sgom rang dga' tshad yin pa 'dra na'ang / 'di bzang ngo byas na chos 'di dang bla ma de la rtsis che ru song nas ltag shed skye bar 'dug 'di la smad ra btang na kho rang gi sngar gyi chos dang bla ma la dad pa log nas nga'i 'og tu chud 'ong shas che snyam nas g.yo sgyus smod pa yang srid/ de ltar gzhan gyis smad tsa na/ rang yang the tshom skye ba dang / blo log par 'gyur bas/ chos bzang po 'di bor te log pa'i lam la 'gro nyen yod/ dper na nor nyams med pa zhig gi lag tu nor bu yin nges la yin yang zer ba zhig byung / de mi sna tshogs la bstan zhing dris na/'ga' zhig gis/ nor bu'i nyams med nas ngo ma shes te de la smad ra gtong /g.yo can 'ga' zhig gis nor bu yin par shes kyang / 'di 'dra rdo phal pa zhig yin par 'dug pa/ nor bu'i rigs te 'di 'dra ba yod dogs med zer zhing /rin chung ngu zhig sprod pa'am/ kyal ka'i tshul gyis 'phrog par byed/ yang gzhan la ma bstan par nor bu'i nyams shes brdzun dang g.yo sgyu mi byed pa zhig la bstan nas dris na/ des 'di ni nor bu'i nang sno 'di lta bu yin/ de'i rtags 'di dang 'di lta bu yin/ rin thang 'di tsam byed ces sogs drang por mug da pas/ nor bu ma shor bar ma zad phyin chad nyams kyang chug pa zhig 'ong / de bzhin du chos 'di'i nyams myong gis thugs rgyud phyug pa zhig la dris na/ rang gi sgom ma shor bar ma zad/ sngar kyi sgom la dogs pa chod/ phyis nyams myong 'char rgyu rnams ngo shes/ ma bde ba'i 'phrang thams cad las grol ba zhig 'ong —368—

ba yin no/ /de ltar ston pa ni/ rang nyid kyi nor bu'i mtshan nyid mi shes pas/nor bu yongs su rtog pa po ma yin pa'i phyir/ nor bu de rin thang chen po zhig yin par 'gyur ram/ rin thang chen po ma yin zhes/ g.yo can gzhan nor bu'i mtshan nyid shes sam mi shes gang yin yang rung / de la bstan na/ 'di ni nor bu ma yin te rin thang chen por mi 'gyur ro zhes zer ba na/ de'i tshig la yid brtan bcas nas rin po che de rtsi sa med pas 'dor bar byed do/ /skyes bu drang po'i rang bzhin can gang dag /rin po che bzang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid rig pa rnams la/ rin po che chen po de yongs su rtog tu gzhug cing / 'di ci yin zhes dris na/ mkhas pa drang po'i rang bzhin can de rnams kyis rnam par dag pa bden pa'i tshig la brten nas/ rang gi lag gi rin po che de'i ming dang khyad chos dang / rtags mtshan dang / rin thang dang / rnam par dbye ba la sogs pa mtha' dag shes par 'gyur bas/ de la ni bstan par bya ba yin no/ /zhes te 'di don gzhan bkod pa'i tshul gyis gsungs pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bla mas 'di skad brjod de/ de yang bla ma ngan pa de dag gis chos zab 'di la tshul ji lta bas smod par 'gyur snyam na/ bod yul 'di na mu stegs byed dang / nyan thos ste gnyis dang / sems tsam mthar thug tu 'dod pa cher med pas dogs mi dgos/dbu mar rlom pa rkyang pa yin yang / mdo lam la mthar thug tu 'dzin pa la'ang shin tu nyung mod/ gal srid mang po byung yang / sngags la ye ma zhugs pa rnams kyis/ skabs 'dir skyon brjod la sleb mi 'ong zhing / gzhan rnams kyang yid brtan mi 'cha' bas gnod tshab chung ngo / /des na 'dir sngags la zhugs par —369—

rlom pa'i rtog ge tha shal ba 'ga' dang / gsang sngags pa'i ming can gzhung phyogs re tsam las ma mthong ba 'ga' dang / sgom chen gyi ming can mang po zhig gis smad ra gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /dang po sngags la zhugs par rlom pa'i dbu tshad rtog ge pa tha shal dag ni/ stong gzugs 'khrul snang yin/ de mthong ba'i shes pa tshad min gyi blo yin/ sems mi rtog par ba 'ag na gti mug skye/ rig shes kyis dpyad pa'i don ma rtogs na mun sgom du 'gro/ stong gzugs la mi rtog par 'jog pa har sgom yin/ har sgom dbang shes yin/ dbang shes lnga kha phyir lta yin pas ting nge 'dzin man lam mi skye/ zhes sogs smra bar byed do/ /don la ni/ de dag phyin ci log ste/ stong gzugs ma 'khrul ba'i snang ba dang /de mthong ba'i shes pa tshang ma yin tshul bshad zin/ mi rtog pa bsgoms pas las dang po pa la ye shes skye/ grub thob rdo rje dril bu pas/ mgal me skyod pa'i rnam pa can/ /sems ni yul la rab tu rgyug /don de las ni rnam bzlog nas/ /mtshon du med pa mtshon par byed/ /ces dang / stong dang stong min la sogs pa/ /kun rtog rab spangs mkha' mnyam 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rig shes bsgoms pas gnas lugs mi rtogs/ lcam dpal mos/ dbu ma'i 'dod lugs gzhud gi tshul/ /de ni rtsod pa kun la mos/ /bskal pa yal ga ngal bas kyang / /byang chub thob par mi nus so/ /zhes dang / sa ra has/ gal te mngon sum gyur na bsam gtan ci/ /gal te lkog tu gyur na mun pa 'jal/ /zhes so/ /to sgom bya ba'i tha snyad la don ngos bzung rgyu rang med/ to sgom yin yang ci to/ /stong gzugs ni dbang shes kyis mthong ba yang min/ dbang shes —370—

las ting nge 'dzin rnam dag mi skye ba yang ma yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ mig dang gzugs la brten nas ni/ /dri ma med pa'i blo skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci yin zhes log par smra ba de dag sun dbyung bar bya/ lar rang sngags dpe 'dra klog dar byas pa'i mtshan nyid pa skam po la sgom gyi bcol gtogs rang med lags so/ /phyogs re'i mig can sngags par rlom pa ni/ phyis byung gi lam 'bras pa'am/ rim lnga pa sogs thabs gtso bor 'dod pa rnams yin/ de dag ni bskyed rim dang / dbang chog bshar sgom dang / ngag bzlas dang / dmigs bcas kyi gtum mo phra thig dang / las rgya sogs kyis grol bar 'gyur gyi/ de dag ma sgom na stong gzugs bsgoms pas mi grol lo/ /zhes smra'o/ /'di ni drang don sad sud la zhen zhing nges don gyi phyogs tsam yang ma mthong ba yin/ khyed kyi gtum mo las rgya sogs ni kha bshad tsam du zad gda'/ kha bton dang bzlas pa bzang ste sgom 'khrid rang mi zer lags/ spyir rtogs bcas nges don gyi lam du mi 'gyur ba sogs gong du bshad zin pas dgag par bya'o/ /sgom chen gyi ming can ni rang rang gi chos kyi gnad ma go ba'i phyag rdzogs pa mang po zhig ste de dag 'di skad smra ste/ sems rtogs na sangs rgya ba yin gyi/ stong gzugs sogs kyis ci zhig bya/ stong gzugs dang rmi lam 'od gsal la sogs pa 'di dag nyams tsam yin pas gnas lugs la sleb rgyu med/ rtogs pa zhig rang dgos pa yin zer ma myong yang myong skad mang po byed du 'ong / yang byed bcings nges can dang / mun 'khrid sogs gu dog po des ci byed/ nged kyi chos 'di gu yangs cham me yod zer/ yang las 'bras kyi spang blang dang / dam —371—

tshig sdom pa'i khrims dang / dge sbyor gyi thun dang / gtsang sbra/ thos bsam/khrigs bkod byed pa rnams lta ci smos/ lha sgom/ sngags bzlas cho ga dbang bskur/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor/ gtum mo khra thig la sogs pa 'di thams cad theg dman yin zer zhing / gang shar la spang blang dgag sgrub med pa 'di theg chen yin/ mthar thug yin/ khyed lus gnad byed bcings dang / stong gzugs sgom pa'i 'di nyams tsam yin/ theg dman de 'dras cir yang mi btub/ da rang ngo la ltos/ lhod de skyur la zhog spyod pa mno tshad kha thal byas pas chog /de ka chos yin zer du 'ong / de tsa na skya ser pho mo glen blun krog mo krog pho rnams tshig de rna bar snyan grags nas/ chos sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa 'di tsho bor/chos log zos bde la kha lhan gyis 'gro/ de yin ni bsod nams zad pa yin/khyi phag mi gtsang ba la rgyug pa dang 'dra/ ji skad du/ dud 'gro phag la kha zas gtsang mas ci/ /bong bu phyugs la mu tig nor bus ci/ /long ba ri mo 'on pa pi wang dang / /blun po dag la chos kyi ci byar yod/ /ces pa der gda' 'o/ /de skad smra ba de lung rigs kyis dgag sgrub byed thabs med de shin tu blun pa'i phyir/ yang na lung rigs khyad du gsod pa'i kha 'jam mang po 'don/ yang na 'thab mor 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang tshig de rnams shab shob kho na yin pas snying po cung zad kyang med par go dgos/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas bya ba/ sems tsam rtogs pa rang gis kyang min/ sems kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs shing / rtogs pa de yang mthar phyin na sangs rgyas thob pa'i don yin da lta'i rnam rtog 'og 'gyu skyes pa cha rgyus yod pa tsam la sems rtogs pa mi zer/ sems —372—

nyid mthong ba yin min/ 'di skad ces sems rtogs na ta sangs rgyas pa'ang srid de/ khyed rnams kyis sems ni ma rtogs par 'dug /sems rtogs na sangs rgya bas khyed rnams la ga la phan/ zhes bya/ rang lugs la sems rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgrib pa spong / sgrib pa spangs pas sems nyid rtogs/ tshogs bsags pas yon tan skye/ sgrib pa spangs pa dang yon tan mtha' phyin tsa na sems nyid rtogs pa mthar phyin/ de tsa na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin/ grong gseb la yan pa'i rtog ldan brdzus ma la sems nyid kyi gnyer kha med/ sems rang mngon sum du rtogs pa ni/ sa bdun po ni sems yin te bya ba de yin/ sems nyid rtogs pa mthar thug pa ni/ ye shes chos sku yin/ dpe'am rjes mthun pa'am cha shas phra mo tsam la nges pa med de/de 'dra la de tsam du rbad gshod byed rin yang mi chog go /rig pa ngor lta tsam chos kyi ming yang mi shes pa'i phal pa la yang yod/ nad drag pos phog pa bag tsam zhig cig la/ da ga 'dra zhig 'dug byas na/ thom thom pa zhig min pa gang yang mi 'dug zer 'ong / de sems kyi gnas lugs rig pa yin nam ci/ yang nga da lta dga' byung / nga da lta tshig pa za zhig 'dug zer 'ong ste/ khos dga' ba dang / tshig pa zos pa la bltas 'dug /ngo shes 'dug ste/ des rnam rtog rang grol du e 'gro/ chos su e song / sems gnas pa dang 'gyu ba rang ngo shes pas chos su 'gro ba rang zhig byed na snang cha sgyu ma lta bu dang / rang bzhin brjod bral nam mkha' lta bur 'char thub pa zhig dgos pa yin/ rang re la ni sems nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'od gsal rtags bcu sgom pa —373—

'di ka yin/ yin tshul rgyas pa bshad zin/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang rang lugs la ta stong gzugs nyams tsam ma yin/ chos sku'i rang gzugs yin yang / re zhig de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sgom nyams tsam yin pas gnas lugs mi rtogs/ nyams gang yang ma shar ba bzang na/ ngan song dud 'gro la sogs pa bzang bar 'gyur/ nyams len byas na nyams skye ba chos nyid yin mod/ 'o na nyams len mi byed pa de legs sam ci/ legs na kho rang la 'dug go /gu dog pos ci byed bya ba ni/ ri la sdod ma nus/ sgom ma nus pa'i kha skyengs su 'dug /gu mu lto ba rang yangs pa dang 'dra/ theg pa che chung gi dbye ba ni/sems bskyed dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas 'byed pa yin/ spang blang yod med kyis 'byed pa min/ spang blang med pa la med lugs shig dgos/ byung tshad za ba dang / phag tshad du nyal ba dang / rigs ngan dang 'grogs pa la spang blang med pa mi zer/ dge ba thams cad theg dman du lta ba 'di lar nas mi dge ba bcu las log lta thu zer ba de yin pas ngo shes 'tshal/ spang blang med zer gyin dgag sgrub spang blang la mi tshe skyel ba 'di ci yin/ ltogs dad dang chags sred snying khungs su bcug pa'i spang blang med/ dgag sgrub med zer ba 'di bag med tho cho'i rgyab skyor nag po zang thal ma gtogs/ dkar po dge ba'i chos cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa'i ngan 'gro'i lam po che der gda' 'o/ /des na chos byed ma dgos par da lta nas sangs rgyas pa'i khungs la/ 'chi lugs lod cing shi na dmyal ba nas thar dus med pa'i chos log mi gtsang ba'i rgya mtsho la / dka' tshegs chung la ngo mtshar che ba'i zab chos bdud rtsi'i chu mig yin snyam du ma —374—

sems shig des na chos bya ba te/ dang por las 'bras kyi spang blang zhib pa zhig /bar du snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa zhig /mthar 'dzin pa thams cad las rang grol ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa zhig dgos/ gsang sngags la zhugs na de rnams kyi steng du/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa zhig /bla ma la mos gus chug pa zhig /rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa zhig dgos pa yin/ yang sgos su gang la dmigs pa brtad de bsgoms na/ nyon mongs thams cad 'gag yon tan thams cad skye ba'i zung 'jug gi lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di dang mjal nas tsab tsob ma byed cig /lar chags sdang chos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba'i bla ma dge bshes zer ba tsho dang gtad med kyi rang nyams byung rgyal du skyong ba'i mkhas pa ming can dang / zog po mgo skor mkhan gyi sgom chen pa'i ming can gyi kha la ma rgyug par/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gsungs pa'i chos la 'jug dgos pa yin no/ /chos 'di dang mjal nas da blo sna ma mangs shig de khas 'tsheng ba yin no zhes pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ bdud kyi bar chad ngo shes par byed pa'i skabs su/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la rtse gcig tu nyams len byed pa la/ thog mar blo sna gzhen du 'gro ba'i skabs dang / bar du dmigs pa gsal zhing rtags snang rgyas pa'i skabs dang / mthar nyams rtogs gong 'phel gyi skabs rnams su 'di'i sgom la bar chad byed pa byung na/ dge ba rlabs chen gzhan 'grub pa ltar snang yang / bdud kyi bar chad kho na yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba lung ma bstan dang mi dge ba yin na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rgyal khams mi chen gyis gang ba'i slob ma skyangs pa dang / dge slong 'bum phrag —375—

bye ba la chos ston gsol ba las kyang / rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar gyi lam du 'gro nges rang zhig byung na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor so sor sdud pa thun gcig bsgom pa yang / tshogs gsum gang gyi sgo nas lam chod che ba'i phyir ro/ /spyir dge ba la bar gcod thams cad bdud yin/ dge ba la bskul ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin zhes kyang bya mod kyi/ nang sel dge ba chung ngu bor nas rlabs chen la 'phral du 'jug na/ chung ngu bkag pa tsam bdud ma yin/ nges don las bzlog nas drang don la 'jug pa sogs/ dge ba chen po bkag nas chung ngu la 'jug na/ chung ngu la 'byogs pa de dge ba tsam yin mod kyang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /des na rang gzhan gyi chos la bar du gcod pa'i bdud rnams ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang / pha dang / ma dang / bu mo dang / sring mo dang / bu dang / sprun zla dang /'dod cing chags pa'i yul chung ma la sogs pa/ nges pa med pa'i gzugs rnams su gyur nas/ yang dag pa'i lam sgom pa la gegs byed de/ dngos su sprul pa yang srid mod phal cher bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis so/ /de'i phyir na bla ma dam pas gnang ba'i lam bzang rin po che 'di slob ma rnams kyis gces spras su byas nas/ gnyen nye ba rtsa lag tu brdzus pa'i chom rkun lta bu/ rang khyim dang / nye du dang / nyon mongs dang / 'du 'dzi dang / slob dpon ngan pa dang / sdig las dang / bdud kyi las thams cad ngo shes nas yongs su spangs te dran shes bzhin gyi sgo nas 'bad pas bsgrims te/ sgom nyams myong gi ye shes shin tu legs par sba zhing bskyang bar bya'o/ /zhes —376—

pa'o/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ gsang sngags rang gi tha snyad kyi dbang du byas na/ dam tshig dang sdom pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs kyi dbang du byed pa dang / sbang bya bzlog pa'i tshul khrims la dam tshig /mnyams su blang bya sgrub pa'i tshul khrims la sdom pa/ zhes zer ba dang / de gnyis go bzlog pa'ang yod mod kyang / ming 'dogs tha dad byas kyang don steng nas 'gal ba med/ mdo phyogs su tshul khrims la dam tshig gi tha snyad ma grags kyang / dam tshig gi don 'da' bar mi bya ba yin pas/ tshul khrims la dam tshig gi don tshang ngo 'dir rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ni/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i lhung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes sogs rgyud tshig gis gsal bar bstan/ rtsa ltung dang po rdo rje slob dpon thugs mi mnyes par byas pa ste/ dmigs bsal la rang gis dge ba byas pa la ma dgyes na/ rtsa lhung du ni mi 'gyur/ slob dpon ma dgyes pa'i nyes pa ni yod dge ba de rang la phan yon yang yod pas/ dkar nag 'dres ma yin/ 'di la'ang dmigs bsal rtsa lhung du 'gro ba yod de/ sngar dge ba rlabs chen la 'jug par chad pa las/dge ba dman pa chung ngu la zhugs pas/ thugs dkrugs na rtsa ltung ngo / /gnyis pa bla ma'i bka' las 'gongs pa ni/ sdig pa la sbyor ba'i tshig ma yin pa'i bla ma'i bka' gcog pa ste/ de yang lung ma bstan bcag na rtsa lhung yang ba'i rigs dang / dge ba'i gsung bcag na shin tu lci ba'o/ /mi dge ba can gyi gsung bcag na rtsa ltung ni med/ shad kyis sbyang ba'i mi dgyes pa med par ma byas na/bka' 'das kyi nyes pa tsam yod do/ /'di gnyis yul rdo rje slob dpon la —377—

brten pa'i lhung ba yin pas/ sdig pa che la sbyang dka' ba'i rigs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi chos la brten pa'i bla ma gcig pa ni rdo rje sbun te/ de la sdig gsog pa ni/ nang dam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di yang nyes pa lci zhing sbyong dka' ba'i rigs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ byams pa spong ba zhes smos kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems spong ba ste/ gtan du byams pa spangs na sems can gcig la byams pa spangs kyang 'dir 'gyur te/ rtsa ltung gi gzhung gzhan gyi 'chad lugs ltar gyi/ lnga pa bzhi pa gnyis ka lugs 'di'i bzhi par 'dus so/'dir lnga pa ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la ma dad cing zhu bde 'gyur med la dgos pa med par bsams nas/ kun da byang sems ched du nyams par byed pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' yin pa zhig la/ sdang sems kyis smod pa dang / bdun pa ni/ dbang bskur ma thob pa'am mi mos pa la gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba ston pa'o/ / brgyad pa ni/lha'i khyad par sgrub pa sogs kyi dgos pa med par rang gi lus mi gtsang ngo zhes smod pas yan lag gcod pa nas bsnyung ba la sogs pa'i bar du gdung ba rtsom pa dang / dgu pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams gdod nas stongs pa dang / don dam gnas lugs 'gyur med zung 'jug du gdod nas rang grub pa'i don go ba'i rjes su slar mi 'thad do snyam ma dad pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ kha 'jam zhe gdug pas gzhan bslu ba dang / bcu gcig pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mo rmad du byung ba la ma dad pa dang / bcu gnyis pa ni/ dag pa'i sems can zhes bya ba nang du yang dag pa'i lam rgyud la skyes pa la zer/ de 'dra'i gang zag la de 'dra —378—

yin par nges pa'am/ yin min the tshom za bzhin du/ rang 'dod kyi dbang gis skur ba 'debs pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs nas tshogs kyi gral du thabs shes kyi rdzas sogs longs spyod kyi dam tshig rnams mi gtsang ba dang / nyes dmigs che ba'i bsam pas spong pa dang / bcu bzhi pa ni/yul bud med gcig la smad kyang drang / du ma la smad kyang rung ste/ smod lugs rigs 'ded pa'i sgo nas smad na/ bud med thams cad la smad par 'gyur ba ste/bud med kyi rigs 'dis cir yang mi rung zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de dag kyang lhung ba'i rnam gzhag shes bzhin du/ khyad du bsad nas de dag byed la/ da dung chos pa yin tshul gyi bzang rdzu byed pa ni/ g.yo sgyu can te nyon mongs drag po'i rtsa lhung gis sngags kyi dam sdom rtsa ba nas 'jig par byed pa dmyal ba brgyad po rnams su bskal pa ches mang par mnar bar 'gyur bas/ bsgrims te zhe zon gyi sgo nas 'bad de spong ba gal che'o/ /gal te bag med dang nyon mongs mang bas dbang med du gos na'ang de ma thag bshags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dam tshig gso ba'i dbang zhus te/ sdig sbyong la 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gong du smos pa'i yod pa'i sdig pa lnga/ nye ba'i sdig pa lnga/ gsod pa lnga/ 'khu ba lnga/ chags pa lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams spong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga la yang dag par gnas dgos/ de las gzhan bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig ni rigs drug gi dam tshig dang / sdom pa rnams yin te/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni zhes sogs gsungs/ de yang khyab byed rigs gnyis las/ khyab byed dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig ni stong nyid spros bral dang brtse ba snying rje chen po phan —379—

tshun rgyas btab ro mnyam du byed kyin sgom pa thun bzhi'am/ ma tha yang zhag re'i nang du lan re med thabs med/ khyab byed gnyis pa mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig la/rdo rje thugs snying rje dang / dril bu gsung stong nyid sgom pa yin na/ snga ma rdor sems kyi dam tshig 'dir 'dus pas/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi skabs/ snga ma yod na 'di logs su mi dgos kyang / go don gyi dbang du byas na/ 'jog lugs gnyis kyi dang po ni ldog pa mi 'dra ste/ stong nyid snying rje re re ba mi bskyod pa'i rigs dang / gcig tu bsres pa rdor sems kyi dam tshig tu 'jog pa'ang yin no/ /yang 'jog tshul gnyis pa ni/ sems can dang / chos la dmigs pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs ba'i byang sems dang / kun rdzob spros bral gyi stong nyid sgom pa mi bskyod pa dang / dmigs med kyi snying rje dang / don dam rig pa'i ye shes kyi stong nyid gcig tu 'dres pa rdor sems la sbyor te/mdo lugs la dmigs med snying rje dang / don dam rang rig sgom thub pa/ sa mtshams mthon po kho na la sbyor kyang / gsang sngags 'bras bu lam byed yin pas thog ma nas kyang 'byung ngo / /'o na de dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa'o snyam na/rjes mthun pa yin par byas kyang don la 'dra bas 'gal ba med la/ theg pa ga༈ gyi dngos dang / 'di'i rjes mthun pa skyon spong yon to sgrub pa gang la'ang stobs che chung la khyad med pas/ dgos don gyi dbang las rjes mthun pa'i tha snyad mi byed par dngos su 'chad pa'ang yin no/ /'chad tshul gnyis po de yang gnad gcig ste/ dmigs pa gnyis kyi snying rje dang / spros bral rang sgom na phyogs re bar yong zhing / dmigs med snying rje byas na/ zung 'jug kho nar —380—

'ong ste/ 'di'i dmigs med ni rig stong las gzhan du med pa'i phyir ro/ /gyeg rgya sku'i dam tshig ni rang dang snang ba lha skur bsgom pa yin/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ bla ma la mchog tu gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes par byed pa ste/ bzhi po de mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig yin/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dam tshig la/ rin chen lcags zangs ba lang rta/ /glang po bu mo yul 'khor dang / /'dod pa'i chung ma rang gi sha /spyin pa rnam pa bcu ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa mtshone byed de/ zang zing gi spyin pa dus gsum du sbyin par 'dod pa'i sems dang ma bral ba dang / dngos su yang skabs su bab na ci nus spyin pa yin/ 'khor lo'i rigs la bza' btung thams cad sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis rlob pa dang /yod na dam rdzas kyi ril bu brten zhing / dus khyad par gyi dam tshig dpa' bo'i ston mo sogs byed pa'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig ni bla ma dang / yi dam dang / dkon mchog gsum spyi rnams mchod pa yin la/ bla ma mchod pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi skabs na'ang yod mod kyi/ dam tshig 'di dag phan tshun gzhi mthun pa yod du rung bas/ bla ma mchod pa ni rdo rje dang las gnyis kar du gtogs par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ nus pa rnyed na las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgyas thig le 'ching dgos pa yin la/ las dang po pas kyang kun da lta bu ci nus su srung ba'o/ /de ltar na de rnams bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar gyi thun mong pa yin/lugs 'di'i dbang bskur thob tshad kyis srung dgos 'di rnams dngos su kun rdzob gtso che yang / rdzogs rim nges don gyi dam tshig gi gzhi rten du yang med ka med yin no/ /—381—

nges don rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug sgom pa/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / dril bu gsung gi dam tshig dang gzhom med kyi sgra dang / phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig lus stong gzugs su 'char bar byed pa la bslab/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ sgrib pa po'i nyams rtogs kyi khyad par gyis mos gus mchog dman gyi khyad ma gtogs rnam pa 'dra ba yin/ rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ rlud bcu dbu mar bcings pa dang / rnam snang rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ phung po lnga'i dwangs ma dang / dbang po lnga'i dwangs ma 'dzag med du byed pa dang / don yod rigs la drod dang rjes chags kyis gtum mo 'bar bas/ thig le zhu ba dang ldog ste bde ba'i phung khams dbang yul tshims par byed pa dang / 'od dpag med kyi rigs la/—stong gzugs phyag chen la brten nas zhu bde 'gyur med du sgrub pa rnams yin no/ /'o na de dag phal cher las dang po pas sgrub par mi nus pa'i phyir/ ji ltar bzung snyam na/ de tsam du skrag mi dgos spyir rig drug gi sdom pa bzung pa tsam gyis rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig 'di dag sgrub dgos par ni ma nges te/ byis 'jug kho na'i don du sdom pa bzung ba la mi dgos pa'i phyir dang / don 'di rnams sdom bzung gi sbas don yin gyi/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i tshig don ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gong ma dang 'brel ba'i sdom bzung yin na ni/ don 'di rnams khas blangs pa yin te/ rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa thob pa'i phyir nges don gyi dam tshig gi bslab bya 'di dag la/ las dang po pas kyang gnas dgos pas/ lam —382—

mthon por ma sleb bar du sgrub mi dgos pa dang mi nus pa ma yin no/ /de yang stong nyid snying rje rigs gnyis na de'i dmigs pa sgom pa yin/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung bcings pas rlung bcu bcings par 'gyur/ dga' bzhi'i thig le 'ching ba rjes mthun pa sgom na/ rnam snang gi dam tshig 'grub pa dang / mas brtan rjes mthun pa dang / yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pas don yod grub pa'i dam tshig 'grub/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba gsum la bslabs pas/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig 'grub/ stong gzugs bsgoms pas phyag rgya sku dang / rlud bum can sgoms pas dril bu gsung dang / mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig kyang 'grub/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba dang / stong gzugs gnyis rgyas phar 'debs tshur 'debs byed kyin sgom na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig kyang 'grub pas so/ /mdor na nges don de rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu tshogs bsgrubs nas rang rang gi nges don de dag mos pas bzung bas chog pa yin te/ de'i phyir shin tu sgrub dka' ba ma yin no/ /gzhan mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig sogs ni/spyir bskyed rim pa la gal che yang / ma 'byor na bskyed rim pas kyang yid kyis bsam pas chog /rdzogs rim pa la de dag gal che rgyu yang med pas che thang du byed kyang mi dgos/ brnyes par yang mi bya/ dngos su ci rigs par sgrub pa'am/yid kyis bsams pa tsam byas na'ang legs/ gtso bor mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom pa dang / rjes thob spyod lam du de kha'i nyams myong rgyun chags su bskyangs pas/ nyams len sgrub pa'i dam tshig thams cad de —383—

la tshang / 'dir rgyas par bshad mi dgos so/ /spyod pa bskyang pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ theg pa che chung thams cad kyi thun mong kyi spyod pa dang / theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa yin zhing / mdo sngags gnyis po rang gi thun mong rnams la skabs 'dir rgyas bshad byed kyis mi lang / khrid yig gi dngos bstan ltar rkang grangs ming tsam brjod dam/ de las bag tsam spros nas chos thun re tsam 'chad/ skabs su gang bab sbyor/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa ni/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang yin/ khyad par rdzogs rim nges don gyi dam tshig ni/ don rdo rje'i rnal wor sgom khi / kho nge 'dzin gyi bar chad thams cad spangs/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa las gzhan du mi g.yel bar byed/ lus ngag yid gsum po yo byad dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sgo nas/ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig byed pa la 'dus mod/ rgyud las gsungs tshul dang go babs kyi dbang du byas na zur tsam brjod na/ rdo rje bzhi'i spyod pa/ rigs drug gi spyod pa/ phar phyin bcu'i spyod pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ nyin dang mtshan mor thig le dag las dkar po'i rgyun 'bab gang zhig mā ma gī ste chad ma yin/ /go ku la sogs mig la sogs pa nyin zhag so sor spros te sha gzhan res 'ga' dag kyang min/ /rang rigs sa la gnas pa'i lha rnams ngag gi dag pa'i lus la bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsnyen pa ste/ /stong par sems ni rab tu zhugs nas ro mnyam byed pa 'khrig pa de ni skye gnas la ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun rdzob tu nus pa rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor pas myos 'gyur lnga btung /sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga bza'/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bsten pa yin/ nges don du de —384—

dag gi don rim pa bzhin du/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsal sbyong / dbang po lnga'i rlung dang rnam rtog dgag rtsa 'khor rnams su rlung gi spyor bas thig le bcings/stong gzugs la brten par sems mnyam par 'jog pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi pad+ma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bskyang bar bya/ /g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi pad+ma ra smad mi bya/ /sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus ni sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bsrung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyu/ra ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa ste/ drang don du stong nyid snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang ni rgyas/'phrin las thog med du 'grub pa'i nus pa ni rnyed/ thabs gzhan med cing thabs de kho nas 'gro don du 'gyur nges pa yin na/ srog gcod pa dang / brdzun smra ba dang / gzhan nor 'phrog pa dang / pha rol gyi bud med 'phrog pa rnams kyang tshogs chen po'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ /de yang nus mthu'i sgo nas yin gyi/dug mtshon sogs phal pa'i byed pas ma yin no/ /myong dang / sgron ma ste/ sha dang / sangs rgyas te bdud rtsi lnga bsten tshul gong dang 'dra/ gzugs mdzes pa dang / sgra snyan pa sogs yul lnga bsten/ zhu bde 'dzag med du 'ching bar nus na/ g.yung mo la sogs pa'i rigs ma nges pa'i phyag rgya sgrub pa ste/ mdor na —385—

rmad byung 'gal ba'i spyod pas/ sems can gyi don byed pa yang yin la/ nges don du ni de dag rim pas las lung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gog pa dang /gang la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson pa dang / rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa'i thabs la brtson pa ste bzhi dang / sngar bshad pa'i nges don gyi dam tshig bzhi gcig tu bgrangs pa dang / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po nyid kyis dbu mar thig le dgag pa'am/ 'di yod phyin phyag rgya gnyis ldan dang gsum ldan yang ste/ de ltar na rigs drug gi so so'i dam tshig go /lus dang longs spyod sems can la blos btang ba ni/ rigs drug thun mong gi spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nor rnams spangs pas sbyin pa yid dang bud med 'grogs pa las kyang 'pho ba med pa tshul khrims te/ /bzod pa sgra la sogs pa mi 'jug pa ste rlung gis gnyis ka'i bgrod pa 'jig pa brtson 'grus nyid/ /bsam gtan shes rab dag kyang lhan skyes bde la gnas pa'i sems dang kun tu 'gro ba kun gyi skad/ /de las sems can don dang rdzu 'phrul srid pa mthar byed mi skye thob ste gzhan pa bzhi rnams so/ /zhes gsungs te/ ltos med bzhi ldan ni sbyin pa/ rjes dran ni tshul khrims/ sor bsam ni bzod pa/ srog 'dzin ni brtson 'grus/ ting nge 'dzin las lus sems lhan skyes mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni bsam gtan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngag gzhom med kyi sgra dbyangs ni shes rab/ de ltar rang rgyud dag pas chos bstan pa sogs lta ci smos/ mthong thos dran reg sogs thams cad myur du byang chub la 'god pa'i sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni —386—

thabs/ sems can gang la gang 'dul du rdzu 'phru/la sna tshogs pa dmigs pa med pa'i 'dun pa tsam las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin las rang rgyud kyi srid pa ste nyon mongs spong zhing / gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngal mthar byed pa'i stobs/ mi skye mi 'gag pa ste gdod ma'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes ni ye shes kyi phar phyin te de rnams ci nus su sgrub par byed pa'o/ /'di'i nang gi phyin drug dang / sor sdud shes rab nas ting nge 'dzin sgyin pa'i bar du/ yan lag drug phar phyin drug la lugs zlog tu sbyar ba gnyis 'gal lo snyam na/ mi 'gal te/ spyir yang rnam grangs tha dad pa'i bshad pa la/'gal 'du rtsir med cing / khyad par du yang sor sdud sher phyin sogs la sbyar ba ni/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyin drug dngos kyi dbang du byas la/'dir ni phar phyin drug spyi 'gro 'di chos 'di la 'dus pa'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing / sbyor tshul gnyis ka yang yan lag drug tsam la sbyor gyi/ rim pa drug kho na la sbyor bar ma nges so/ /de ltar na pha rol tu phyin pa bcu las/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /gang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu gyur pa ni/ srid zhi thams cad kyi phan pa dang / bde ba dang / dge ba dang / legs pa sgo thams cad nas dus thams cad du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yid bzhin nor bu la/ /legs bshad gtam gyis byi dor bgyis pa 'dis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis tshims pa ster gyur cig /zhes zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan la nye bar mkho ba'i gsal —387—

byed lhan thabs su sbyor rgyu'i yi ge 'od brgya 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'gro don mdzad bzhed du mas snga sor nas bskul ba dang / nye bar yongs kyi dge ba'i bzhas gnyen mkhan chen kun dga' lung rigs rgya mtsho'i gsung gis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas sbyar ba las/ slad nas kyang 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa dpal stag lung pa chen po rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis bkas kyang bskul nas cung zad tshig sna bsrengs pa ste/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa gangs ri'i khrod kyi sham+bha la'i gnas su'o// //zhus dag ma ṅga la//—388—

'khor gye sdoms bzhugs/na mo gu sa bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ /gegs sel lus sbyongs 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /rnam gzhag mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /kun gyi thog ma rtsa khrus ni/ /lus sbyong kun gyi gzhi bcas nas/ /mgo bo lag pa lus stod smad/ /rkang pa rnams la phur mnye bya/ /mgo ni bskor dang mdun rgyab 'phangs/ /gcu zhing sprug pa rnam bzhi'o/ /dpung ba bskor dang zhags pa 'phangs/ khu tshur 'phang dang sor tshigs 'then/ /bzhi po lag pa'i rtsa khrus yin/ /pus 'jus ro stod gcud pa dang / khu tshur brlar bzhag ro stod gcu/ /dpyang phrag rdeb dang nu brdeg bzhi/ /lto ba bskor dang bsrubs shing srub/ /sta zur gcud dang khu tshur brdung / /smad kyi bzhi'o pho ba'i gsum/ /rdo rje bsdams dang lag ngar dang / /gru mo pho bar brdeg par bya/ /rked pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab 'phul/ /sor 'then rkang 'bras langs 'dug gnyis/ /gling bzhi nam mkhar sprug dang 'phags/ /rnam grangs tshul gyis sum cu yod/ /ngo bo 'khrul 'khor gcig yin te/ /yan lag lnga sbyong rgyas pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i lus sbyong nyi shu ni/ /dang po lag khrud lta bu ste/ /gnyis pa lag log brang la gcer/ /gsum pa khu tshur brla steng nyed/ /bzhi pa rdo rje'i skyil krung brdeb/ /lnga pa gzhu sran 'gengs pa 'dra/ /drug pa khu tshur dpyang phrag rdeb/ /bdun pa lag —389—

gnyis rdo bcog 'dra/ /brgyad pa gru mo mgrin brang sgyed/ /dgu pa dkyil krung ri 'phul bya/ /bcu pa khu tshur rgyab brdung bya/ /bcu gcig lag gnyis brla nang 'khyud/ /bcu gnyis 'greng ste lan gsum gnyed/ /bcu gsum brnol mnan lus bag gcu/ /bcu bzhi gru mo phan tshun g.yab/ /bco lnga yan lag bzhi rgyongs bya/ /bcu drug g.yas g.yon rkang pa gshud/ /bcu bdun mdun du 'phra bar bya/ /bco brgyad g.yas g.yon rkang pa gcu/ /bcu dgu gsang ba'i rtse nas 'then/ /nyi shu phyogs bzhir 'phra bar bya/ /de nas yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor la/ gnas sam dbang po sbyang ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ u rgyan go da wa ri gnyis/ /bskor zhing mnyed pa dang po yin/ /de bi ko ṭa bskor nas ni/ /phyogs bzhir 'dren pa gnyis pa yin/ /ko sa la mnyed gsum pa'o/ /rā si 'dren pa bzhi par grags/ /bu lir sprug pa lnga pa ste/ /gcu zhing bskor ba drug pa'o/ /'bar 'dzin brdeg mnye bdun pa'o/ /lag gnyis arbu mnye ba brgyad/ ra smi shwa ra 'phur ba dgu/ /ma la wa bskor bcu pa'o/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis ka ru dang / o tre mnye mnan gcud pa yin/ /tre sha ku ne bskyod bcu gsum/ /ka ling gcu zhing g.yal bcu bzhi/ /la sba ka gcud bco lnga yin/ /kañtsi gcud brjeb bcu drug pa/ /hi ma bgrad nas gcud bcu bdun/ /kṛ ha bsdams brdung bco brgyad pa'o/ /so ra ne mnyed bcu dgu pa/ de bzhin gser gling si rgyu mnyed/ /nyi shu pa dang nyer gcig pa'o/ /ku lu ta nas lag gis bzung / /langs 'dug byas nas rgya mtsho bskyod/ /stag mo'i skyug stangs bya ba ni/ /rtsa gnyis pa dang rtsa gsum —39()—

pa'o/ /rgyab brdung lus po thams cad mnye/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin par bshad/ /yang gnad sbyong bcu gnyis pa'am bcu bzhi pa ni/ skyil krung lag bteg lus gcu dang po yin/ /nang du lag bcug bya rkang 'jugs brdeb gnyis/ /'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rkang mtheb byin bzung langs brdeb gsum pa yin/ /rting 'phrab dpyang phrag khu tshur brkyang pa bzhi/ /lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /logs la rkang brdeb lag brkyang lnga pa'o/ /nyal ba'i 'khrul 'bor ro/ /de dag re re'ang rlung ni kha sbyor dang / /hā ring 'don dang ha thung 'don pa ste/ /rlung gnad gsum gyis dbye ba gsum gsum mo/ /skyil krung mthe bong rgyab 'then drug nga/ ste/ /rkang gnyis ltag bsnol sgal tshigs 'bebs langs bdun/ /pho bskor gru mor lus 'gel brgyad pa yin/ /sgal tshigs sar btsugs zhags pa 'phang ba dgu/ /mkhal 'degs g.yas g.yon gcu ba bcu pa yin/ /ska rags bcing zhing bskor srub bcu gcig ste/ /mnyam 'khyud gcu zhing brkyang bskum bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de steng gling bzhi 'bebs dang gling bzhi gcud/ /bsnan pas lus sbyong bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /sgur te pus 'jus stan la 'phong brdeb dang / /tsog pu rkang lag mthil sprad gnon zhing 'then/ /'di rnams brgyud pa so so'i gdams ngag ni/ /tha dad las byung gcig tu bsdus pa dang / kha cig rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa'ang yin/ /de dag ni srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs su gegs sel dang / bogs 'don dang / rdo rje'i lus dag par byed pa la nye bar mkho ba rnams so/ /na mo gu sa thog mar 'chun bcas spyor ba drug ldan bca' bar —391—

bya/ /bzhi btsugs hag ces brjod pa stag mo'i skyug stangs yin/ /de dang 'dra la hing zhes gcu ba glang po'i 'gying / pus btsugs stong 'then hū zhes wa ya bsnom du bshad/ /sgril dang sna sdems seng ge rnam rol spyi dang 'dra/ /g.yas g.yon dpung bcag sprugs pa g.yang mo'i khong sprugs te/ /hig 'dren langs dang tsog pu yi dwags pre ta ka/ khu tshur brlar bzhag dgang 'then sprugs pa 'dren chung zer/ /gyen bzlog i zhes khong 'dren ha bcas bar ma yin/ khu 'dren drag po rkang gshel ga 'then pa 'dren chen te/ /langs mnan brkyang bskum 'phar zhing brdung ba 'phar g.yor grags/ /gyen bzlog bzhi sprugs g.yas g.yon 'then res phur 'don no/ /phyi gan pus brang re mos brkyang bskum rab brkyang ste/ /pho ba btsugs nas gling bzhi brkyang bskum seng ge'i rtsal/ /rkang dpung bsnol mar 'jus nas gcud par gcud 'then yin/ /thal sbyar mgo mgrin stod smad gcud pa gsum 'grems so/ /rkang btsugs khu tshur dpung sbyar mgo brdung seng ge'i 'gyeng / skyil krung pus 'byud dpung 'then gnon pa rma bya'i 'gyur/ /langs dang 'dug nas dgang gtod 'dren pa sbags 'dren te/ /rlung gnyis dbye bsdud langs dang 'dug tshul yongs 'dzin yin/ /de ltar na nyi shu po de rnams rjes dran gyi yan lag tu dgos pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams so/ lken tu zab cing ngo mtshar ba/ /yan lag drug pa'i gdams ngag las/lus sbyong rnam pa sna tshogs dag /brgyud pa tha dad las byung ba/ /mang po rnams las nyer mkho ni/ /zab bsdus byas pa 'di tsam yin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i/ gdams ngag 'chi med grub pa yang / /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu rgyal —392—

la/ /brten nas mdzad pa yin zhes gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'di dang mthun pa yi/ /gdams ngag rnam pa mang po mthong / /'di bris pa yi dge bas kyang / /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /'gyur ba med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad par shog/ //sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag rnying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdom 'di yang / rgya' bams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //

man ngag gsal byed bzhugs/na mo gu ru we/ zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi sdom tshig sngar sbyar ba de'i don cung zad dgrol bar bya ste/ dang por rlung bum can kha re bzung / sems dpa'i skyil krung bca'/lag gnyis mnyam bzhag gam pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa dang / de las yar drangs te dpyang phrag gam/ khu tshur 'dom 'jal bskor ba sogs ni 'khrul 'khor kun gyi gzhi bca'o/ /dang por rtsa khrus chen mo'am/ rtsa sbyong r+ṣa mo ni/khu tshur 〈bcangs pa 〉dpyangs phrag brdab cing / mgo bo 'phur mnye/ lag pa 'phur mnye/ ro stod 'phur mnye/ ro smad 'phur mnye/ rkang ba g.yas g.yon rim pas brkyang ba la lag pa gnyis kyis phur mnye dang / rkang mgo nas 'jus te 'then bskum bya'o/ /de ltar na 'phur mnye lnga'o/ /〈sems skyil 〉 de nas lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag byas/ mgo bo g.yas su lan gsum dang / g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ mdun rgyab tu lan gsum dang / g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum 'phang / gdong g.yas g.yon tu lan gsum gcu/ kha gdangs lce brkyangs/ nywa bzhi lhod kyis klod nas mgo lan gsum sprugs/ de ltar na bskor 'phang gcu sprug ste mgo bo'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ khu tshur brla dang dpyi'i mtshams su bzhag gru mo 'bur gyis byas nas/ dpung pa g.yas nang du lan —394—

gsum/ phyi ru lan gsum bskor/ de bzhin du g.yon kyang bskor/ de nas gnyis ka dus gcig tu mdun rgyab gnyis la lan gsum gsum bskor/ lag pa g.yas 〈pa khu tshur mdun nas 〉 mgo la 〈g.yas 〉bskor te g.yas phyogs su sor mo brgyangs kyis btang ste sprugs〈3〉de bzhin du g.yon 〈bskor 〉 la'ang sbyar ba ni/ zhags pa 'phen pa dang / 〈3〉 dpung ba'i thad kar khu tshur 〈kha phyir bstan 〉bcas/ phar brgyangs te 'phang dus khu tshur steng phyogs su kha bstan te gcu ba ni/khu tshur 'phang ba dang / 〈3〉 snying ga'i mdun du thal mo brdabs te/ de rjes g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi tshigs gsum la g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bzung nas rtsa ba'i tshigs nas rim pas 'then/ sor rtse nas shor tshul gyis lcon sner brdeg de bzhin du sor mo gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ de nyid go bzlog ste g.yas kyi sor tshigs dag kyang 'then/ de ltar na dpung pa bskore/ zhags pa 'phen/ khu tshur 'phang / sor tshigs 'then pa ste/ lag pa'i 'khra/la snam 'khar bzhi'o/ /lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa pus mo g.yas la 'jus te/ ro stod g.yas 〈bskor 3〉g.yon 〈bskor 3〉du gcud/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang sbyar/ khu tshur brlar bzhag lag ngar bsrang ste/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu ba dang / khu tshur pus mo nas yar bzhar te/ nu steng du sleb pa dang / dpyangs phrag brdeb pa mnyam por byed pa lan gsum/ yang khu tshur brkyang la slar nu steng du khu tshur dang / lag ngar rtsib logs la brdeg pa lan gsum/ de ltar na gcud pa/ gcu ba/ brdeb pa/ brdeg pa ste/ ro stod kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi go /lag pa gnyis pus mo la bzhag sgal tshigs bsrangs pa'i ngang nas cung zad sgur te/ lto ba —395—

g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ yang skyil krung steng nas khu tshur g.yon pas pus mo g.yon pa mnan/ khu tshur g.yas pas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng nas tshur mtho gang tsam brla steng du 'then pa dang / ro smad g.yas su drag tu gcud/ zhor la dpung pa'ang g.yas su 'then/ slar yang 'chun btsal te/ khu tshur pus mo'i steng du skyel ba lan gsum/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin du sbyar te srub pa yin te/ 'di la lag ngar gnyis ma gug pa gnad du che'o/ khu tshur gnyis brla'i rtsa ba dang nye ba'i phyi rol sa la btsugs/ 'phong stan dang ma bral zhing pus mo gnyis po re mos kyis bteg nas sta zur gcud pa lan gsum/〈6〉 de nas khu tshur 'dom 'jal gyi mthar g.yas 〈kyis 〉rgyu zhabs su lan gsum brdeg cing / g.yon bcu (〈dza〉 pas ) drug mdor lan gsum brdegayang de nyid go bzlog go /de ltar bskor srub gcud brdung ba ste smad kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ /lag pa rdo rje brdams pa mgo bo'i steng gi nam mkha' phyar nas phyag rgya 〈kha phyir bstan 〉brkyang ba pho bar lan gsum brdeg de bzhin tu gru mo phan tshun la lag pa g.yas g.yon 'jus te lag ngar gnyis skra mtshams su phyar te pho bar lan gsum brdeg de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis la lag pa gnyis bsnol mar 'jus te/ gru mo gnyis brtsegs/ ro stod cung zad sgur/ gru mo mig gi thad cam du btegs te/ pho bar lan gsum brdeg 'di dag thams cad la pho ba 〈g.yas g.yon du 〉bskor zhing mdun tu 'phul thengs re'i steng du phyi nas brdeg pa re yong ba re byed/ de ltar na rdor brdams dang / lag ngar dang / gru mo brdeg pa'i dbye bas pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor gsum mo/ /〈khu chur brla bzhag 〉 sked pa —396—

g.yas g.yon du 'khyo ga gis byas nas/ phyogs gcig rtsib logs dang sta zur 'byar ba tsam dang / phyogs gcig shos sgang de ( 〈ja〉 gis ) yong ba byas/rlung kha sbyor yang de phyogs su 'phul te/ g.yas g.yon du gsum gsum/ de bzhin du skyed sgur gyis dbye bas mdun rgyab tu lan gsum gsum ste/ rked pa'i 'khru/la 'khor gcig go /lag pa sar bcugs rkang pa gnyis mdun tu shad kyis brkyangs/ 'phong cung zad brdeb/ lag pa khu chur 'dom 'jal gyi ngang nas/rkang sor rnams nas rim gyis 'then/ sor mo 'then pa'i skabs rting pa phyir phul/ sor mo re re bzhin rtse nas shor thabs su song ba'i tshe/ rkang sor bskums shing rkang ga rtse rdzog thur du dgug lcogs na g.yas g.yon mnyam du 'then/ mi lcogs na 〈lag gnyis bzhag ris kyi 〉 thun re mos la g.yas g.yon re mos kyis snga phyi yod pa bya/ de nas lag pa khu tshur 'phong gi g.yas g.yon du bcugs nas lus bteg pa dang / rkang pa bskum pa mnyam por yong ba byas te 〈'phong 〉brdeb/ 〈lag gnyis skyed gzer 〉de ma thag langs te rlung 'khrab 〈 8〉bya/rkang pa brkyang bskum gyis 〈mdun du 〉'phra tshul 〈33〉bya/ yang sgur te/ lag pa gnyis khu chur mdun du bcugs/ kha sbub tu langs te/ rkang pa gnyis re mos kyis 'phra〈33〉'o/ /rkang ba 'phra chul thams cad la brkyang ba'i skabs rting pa drag tu brgyangs/ rkang 〈ma bskum/ nga/'i skabs 〉sor 〈mo 〉bskum dgos/ de ltar na/sor 'then dang / rkang 'phras gnyis te ( 〈ja〉 'phra langs 'dug ste/ ) rkang pa'i 'khru/la 'kho/ra gsum mo/ /〈sems skyil 'beb bya'o〉 de nas sgal tshigs sa la bcugs te/ yan lag bzhi mnyam du brkyang bskum lan gsum byed pa dang /——rte()7—

〈gcig yang 〉rgyab 'phar lan gsum ste/ sug bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis go/de ltar na lnga tshan gcig bzhi tshan gnyis/ gsum tshan gnyis/ gnyis tshan gcig gcig pu gcig ste rnam grangs sum bcu yin la/ lus thams cad kyi rtsa khrus zhes bya ba ngo bo 'khrul 'khor gcig ste/ yan lag lnga sbyong rgyas pa'o/ /srog rtsol gyi skabs su lus sbyong gzhan ma lcogs na/ 'di tsam gyis kyang chog ste/'khrul 'khor 'di ni 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gdams pa'o/ /༈ rtsa ba'i lus sbyong nyi shu pa ni/ dang po bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ lag pa thal mo dang bcas pa mdun du shad kyis brkyangs/ thal mo ma reg tsam gcud/ 〈steng 'og g.yas g.yon 〉de nas rdo rje bsdams pas mnye zhing yang gcu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang 'dra bar bca' gzhi'i ngang nas lag pa brkyangs/thal mo brdabs te rdo rje bsdams pa bya/ kha phyir bstan te brkyang la lag pa 〈g.yas g.yon lan gsum bskor te 〉gcud/ de ma thag 〈'di man 'chad 〉kha nang du bstan brang la gcer zhing lag ngar gyis rtsib logs bsdams pa lan gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ khu tshur 'dom 'jal tshur bsdus nas brla g.yas pa'i steng du khu tshur g.yon gyi steng du g.yas pa bzhag lag ngar ma gug pa'i ngang nas mtho gang tsam gyi rgya la g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ khu tshur g.yas g.yon spos nas kyang de ltar bya/ de bzhin du 〈go bzlog nas 〉 g.yon la'ang bya/bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag 'chun dang bcas pa bya/ de 'phral khu tshur dpyi mgo'i thad kyi sa la btsugs nas/ 'phong dang skyil krung bteg cing / skyil krung gi mdun gyen du phyogs par 'chun —398—

btsal nas/ 'phong dang skyil krung mnyam 'bebs su sa la brten pa lan ga sdo/ma/lnga pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ lag pa mdun du brkyang zhing thal mo brdab/ de nas gzhu 'gengs kyi chul g.yas g.yon tu spel 〈6〉mar byed cing lus gcud pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur pus mo'i steng nas yar bzhar te bzhag 〈brla sha 〉sha drag tu brdab/ 〈dpyangs phrag 〉lag pa thad kar shugs bskyed de brkyangs/lag mthil pus mo la brdab pa lan gsum/bdun pa ni/ pus mo btsugs la/ lag pa g.yas sor mo brkyang ba pus mo nas phrag pa'i bar du yar 'then/ rna ba'i rgyab nas bskor/ 'gram pa g.yas pa'i thad tsam nas shugs bskyed de pus mo'i thad kar 'phangs 〈3〉 'di skabs rkang pa'ang g.yas pas g.yon pa gnon gyin 'dug de bzhin du g.yon la'ang sbyar〈pus mgor langs 〉/ 〈'di man chad 〉lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kar dus gcig tu gong bzhin 'then la/ phrag pa nas brgyud/ spyi bo'i thad du rdor bsdams brkyang la thub tshad du phyar te/ gsang ba'i mdun du brdeg pa lan ga sdo/ma/brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur kyi mdzub nu ma'i steng du bzhag bar lhu thad kar brgyangs/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du gcud pa'i tshul gyis brang dang /mgrin pa dang / gru mo rnams bskyed do/ /dgu pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i steng nas/ snying gar rdo rje khu tshur mdzub sprad —399—

de/ mdun du bzhar nas/ lus kha bub bya zhing / sa gzhi la khu tshur sleb tshad du phul/ yang tshur drangs la lus bsrang ste/ snying khar sleb pa na/ skyil krung sa gzhi dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas lus gan rkyal du byed pa dang / khu tshur yang spyi gtsug gi thad nas phar sa la gang sleb tu brkyangs/ de nas skyil krung bteg cing bsdams nas tsog der 〈pus mgor 〉 langs te/ de ltar g.yas g.yon 〈khu tshi brkyang ba 〉dbus 〈yar 〉gsum du bya'o/ /bcu pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas lag pa khu tshur bcangs te/ g.yas g.yon tu drag tu brkyangs/ la spyan dang bcas te re mos su sked pa'i rgyab nas brdung ba'o〈6〉/ /'di langs pa'i ngang nas byed pa'i lugs yod kyang skabs 'dir skyil krung gi steng nas bya ste/ bcu tshan dang po sa la bsdad pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /'di man chad 〈'ji po 〉thams cad la re re'i mgor langs te rlung 'khrab 〈3〉re bya zhing / re re'i gzhug tu rlud bsgyur 〈lag gnyis 'bol steg la btsugarkang mgo gnyis sar btsug nas lus bsreng ste/ lto ba g.yas bskor gcig g.yon bskor gcig steng 'og gi tshul du lan gcig bsgyur ba'o gsungs 〉re yang bya'o/ /de la bcu gcig pa ni/ langs ma thag lag pa g.yon rgyab dang / g.yas mdun nas btang ste/ brla g.yas pa'i rtsa ba nas 'khyud de/ rkang pa g.yon pa sa la btsugs pa 'khrab cing / g.yas g.yon tu lan re re bskor/ slar yang de nyid g.yon du go bzlog pa'ang bya/ lag pa thung bas ma thub na/ lag pa g.yon pa mdun nas brla g.yas 〈g.yon pa nang gi 〉pa'i phyi'i phyogs dang / g.yon gyi skabs su lag pa g.yon pa brla g.yon pa'i phyi phyogs nas 'byud pas chog go /—400—

bcu gnyis pa ni/ khu tshur dpyi mgo'i steng nas phrag pa'i bar du bzhar zhing / de nas lag pa steng du thub tshad du brkyangs nas/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ g.yas 〈bskor 3〉g.yon 〈bskor 3〉 dbus 〈yar phul 〉gsum du gcud pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ rting pa g.yas pas rkang gsher ga g.yon pa mnan/lag mthil g.yon pa gyen du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'ang gyen du bstan pa sbyar/ gru mo'ang de bzhin du brtsegs/ lag mthil gyi steng du gdong phyogs par byas nas/ sked pa dang / stod sgur te 'chun dang bcas te g.yon phyogs su cung zad gcu'o/ /de bzhin du 〈go bzlog ste 〉g.yas la'ang sbyar/bcu bzhi pa ni/ khu tshur nu steng du bzhag gru mo thad kar bsrang / gru mo'i rtse mo g.yas dang g.yon dang gnyis ka'i rim pas/ mdun dang rgyab tu lan gsum gsum g.yab/ de'i tshe phrag pa gcud cing dpung pa nas 'khrul 'don par bya'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ 'phar zhing rkang pa bgrad/ lag pa sta zur du 〈sor mo 〉bgrad cing brkyangs/ 〈lag pa khu tshur snying ga nas lan gsum mthar 〉de nyid g.yas g.yon dbus 〈yar 〉 gsum du 'chun btsal bas shugs bskyed de gcud/bcu drug pa ni/ 〈khu tshur snying khar bsnol 〉rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthil gyis g.yas kyi brla'i rtse mo nas brtsams te/ bol tshigs kyi bar du rkang ngar lan gsum bshud/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang bya/ 'di la rkang gshor ga nas lag pa —401—

gnyis kyis 'then zhing / brla nas rkang ngar bshud pa'i skabs lag pa gnyis kyis rkang ngar gcig shos bzhud pa'i lag len yang snang /bcu bdun pa ni/ langs te mdun du 〈rkang bas 〉'phra ba lan gsum/bco brgyad pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pas rkang pa g.yon gyi brla'i nang nas gsang ba'i g.yon du 'byud/ g.yon pas phyi nang 'byud de lag sor bsnol 〈ba yar spyod 〉 rkang pa g.yas pa'ang g.yon gyi phyi nas rkang ngar bsnol te g.yon du sa la btsugs/ 〈3〉 lus g.yas su gcud/ de bzhin tu g.yas la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo brdabs te/ thal sbyar shin tu brkyang ba gsang ba'i thad nas la tun dang bcas te sna rtse'i bar du bteg la/yang thur du thal mo kha phye nas shugs dang bcas te lhod kyis btang ngo / /nyi shu pa ni/ lag pa sked gzer byas/ rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du g.yas dang rgyab gsum du 'phra/ g.yon pa'ang mdun dang / g.yon dang / rgyab gsum du 'phra ste/ re re'ang lan gsum gsum mo/ /de ltar nyi shu po de rnams rim pa de nyid kyis tshar gcig dang / lugs la zlog pa'i tshul gyis tshar gcig dang /bcu tshan snga 〈 ma dang 〉phyi 〈ma 〉gnyis spel 〈tshe dang po dang phyi ma'i dang po gnyis spel/ de'i rigs 'gres rlung khug gcig gam mi nus na bca' gzhi bcas rlung gnyis bya'o 〉 nas tshar gcig sogs bya'o/ /༈ yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor gnas kyi sbyang ba'am/ dbang po sbyang ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ rna ba g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mtheb mdzub kyis 'jus —402—
