—'es/ phyi bskor 〈3〉 nang bskor 〈3〉 〈de nas sor mo gnyis kyis 〉mdun rgyab steng 'og tu sprugs pa lan gsum gsum bya ste dang po'i la /〈sems skyil khu tshur brla bzhag dmigs gsal med pa rnams 'dra 〉mig gnyis g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor zhing / steng 'og dang / g.ya sa g.yon du 〈spel ma 〉 lan gsum gsum blta zhing sgril ba ni gnyis pa'o/ /g.yas kyi sor mo bzhis sna'i rtsa ba mnyes/ mthe bong mdzub mo bkug pas sna bug bsdams te 〈g.yas g.yon 〉bskor zhing 〈33〉sprug de rjes sna 'phur de bzhin du g.yon pas kyang bya ste gsum pa'o/ /kha gdangs te lce sgril zhing brkyangs la g.yas g.yon 〈bskor 〉dbus 〈thad gcig 〉gsum du shugs gcud pa lan gsum ste bzhi pa'o/ /mgo drag tu sprug pa lan gsum bya ste lnga pa'o/ / de bzhin du g.yas g.yon du rna ba dpung pa la reg cing gdong phyir phyogs te gcu ba dang / mdun du lan mang du 〈7〉bkug ste 〈mgo 〉g.yas g.yon du gsum gsum bskor ba ni drug pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa spyi gtsug tu brdeg cing spyi bo nas skra rma/tshams kyi bar 〈bskor zhing 〉lan gsum du mnye ba ni bdun pa'o /lag pa gnyis 〈g.yas steng g.yon 'og kha bub tu byas 〉brtsegs pas ltag pa steng 'og 〈6〉g.yas g.yon du lan drug mnye ba ni brgyad pa'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje bsdams pas mur gong g.yas g.yon gyi mthar thug par dpral ba'i steng 'og phan tshun du 'phur zhing bcur ba ni 〈6〉dgu pa'o/ /—403—

gong rtsa sbyong gi skabs su bshad pa ltar dpung pa 〈rnams 〉bskor ba ni bcu pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bsnol te/ sor mo lngas mchan khung mnye zhing btsir 〈bzhi grod la 〉 ro stod gcud pa ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du nu ma gnyis la'ang sbyar te 〈skrud pa ni 〉 bcu gnyis pa'o/ /lte ba'i g.yas g.yon nas/ khu tshur gnyis kyi bzung ste 〈g.yas g.yon du 33〉bskor zhing / nang gi rlung dang bcas bskyod pa ni bcu gsum pa'o/ /kha btsum ste mchu g.yas 〈3〉 g.yon 〈3〉 du bskor zhing gcu ba dang /kha bgrad cing so bsgrigs la 〈so 〉g.yas g.yon du gcud 〈pa spel ba 6 〉 de nas 〈kha gdang zhing lce brkyang ba 1〉seng ge'i g.yal byed pa ni bcu bzhi pa'o/ /lkog mas ol mdud mnan te g.yas g.yon dbus 〈su yar 'then 〉gsum du gcu/ 〈mgo 〉sil li li sprug pa ni bco lnga pa'o/ / lag pa gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la btsugs/ brang g.yas g.yon du gcud cing skyed 〈mdun du dgye wo 〉 sgur bya/ yang lag pa rgyab tu btsugs te skyed kyis byas nas g.yas g.yon du gcud/ stegs bu'i steng du sbo bzhag la brdeb pa'am/ nu khar khu tshur brdeg pa'i ha 'don bya ste 〈snga ma rnams bzhi shaṃ lta bu dang gong bcu gsum nas bcu drug gi bar rlung khug gcig gis ha 'don byas nas rlung rngub ste 'beb chung 〉bcu dra mig pa'o/〈khu tshur snying khar bsnol te 〉langs nas rkang pa bgrad la dpyi mgo g.yas g.yon du gcud pa ni bcu bdun pa'o /—404—

de nyid las 'og sgo 'byed 'dzu/ma drag tu byed cing / 〈'dom/ 'jal byas te 〉'phong tshos dang gzhug chung khu tshur gyis re mos brdung 〈ba lan spel ba gnyis bya 〉ba ni bco brgyad pa'o/ /brla gnyis khu tshur gyis 〈mang du 〉brdung zhing bdo/da 〈1〉pa ni bcu dgu pa'o/ /byin pa gnyis la de bzhin du byed pa ni nyi shu pa'o/ /bol gong gnyis la de ltar byed pa ni nyer gcig 〈langs pa lnga wo rlung khug gcig 〉pa'o / / /〈bzhengs te 〉pus mo'i lhang nga gnyis nas lag pas bsdams/ lto ba g.yas 〈3〉g.yon 〈3〉du drag tu bskor/ 'phong stan la phebs pa brdeb cing rkang ba brkyangs/ yang pus mo nas 'jus lto ba 〈g.yas skor3 g.yon skor3 yar 〉bskyod de nyer gnyis pa'o/ /〈rkang sor mtheb bcas 'ju bzheng zhing bsdam nas 〉 de nyid dang 'dra ba las lhe/ ba bskyod pa'i tshab tu ha ha ka ces rlung phyi la bus shing / lus 'dar sil gyis sngu/gas te nyer ga sda/ma pa'o / / /〈tshan gnyis rlung khug gcig gam 〉khu tshur gnyis kyis rgyab kyi sked pa drag tu brdung zhing / de rjes mgo lus thams cad lan gcig byug pa ni nyer bzhi pa'o/ /〈yar bsnan pa'am rlung khug gcig〉bcu bdun pa nas nyer gcig pa'i bar langs pa yin zhing / de nas gnyis po langs 'dug gnyis ka dang / lhag ma 'dug pa'i zhakhru la 'khor ra ro / /nyer gsum pa'i skabs su pus mo nas mi 'ju bar rkang sor gyi rtse nas 'jus —405—

na/ na ga 〈ni rkang sor brgyad dang 〉 ra dang / 〈rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis〉ma rle'i gnas sbyang ba tshang bar 'gyur bas legs sam snyam pa ni kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /de ltar na rtsa ba nyi shu dang / yan lag nyer bzhi ste bzhi bcu zhe bzhi po de dag ni/ dpal chen rga lo'i man ngag ste/ de'i dngos slob khams pa rdor rgyal dang / zhang mtshal pa brtson 'grus grags pa gnyis kyis so sor yi ge mdzad pa'i dus 'khor sbyor drug gi man ngag dang / sa skya ba chen po'i kyi rdor sbyor drug gi man ngag ste/ gsum ka khungs mthun pas yan lag drug po'i sngon /'gro yin pas sngon 'gro nyi shu pa la sogs pa'i ming thogs pa yin gyis/ phyis nā ro chos drug dang / lam 'bras kyi dpe bum na'ang rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu bcug pa ni/ nyer mkho thun tshags bsdus pa yin pa shes par bya'o/ /〈rje 〉phag 〈mo 〉gru 〈pa 〉nas brgyud pa rga lo'i sbyor drug la sngar bshad bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i 'phros la/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi shu sor mo'i rtse nas drangs kyi bar 'khrul 'khore yan lag nyi shu da dung yod na'ang / bdag gi bla ma dam pa rnams phyag len mi mdzad cing / mkhas mchog bu ston chen pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi tho na lus sbyong zhe bzhi'i gzhug tu/ bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i man ngag yin gsungs pa'i/ mgo bo skor zhing mgo bo 'then/ /zhes pa nas/ rlung gi zhags pa 'phen dang lnga/ /zhes pa'i bar khyab byed la sogs pa rlung lnga sbyong ba'i tha snyad mdzad pa yod cing / de'i 'phros la/ thams cad mnye zhing steng gsum brkyang / /zhes sogs brgyud pa tha dad las byung ba'i 'khrul 'khor thor bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa mang rab dang bcas pa yod kyang / rtsa sbyong chen —4()6—

mo la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dang / da 'chad 'gyur rnams kyi nang du de dag gi gnad rnams phal cher 'dus shing / phyag len gyi rgyun ma thob pas 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /༈ yang gnad kyi sbyong ba bcu gnyis pa'am bcu bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje'i skyi' krung bca'/ khu tshur 'phong tshos g.yas g.yon thad kyi sa la btsugs/ lus bteg ste 〈rdo rje skyil krung 〉g.yas g.yon du gcud cing brdeb pa 〈3〉ni dang po'o//rdo rje skyil krung gi skyid khung 〈gnyis 〉nas lag pa btang / khu tshur sa la btsugs/ skyil krung bteg cing brdeb pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /de gnyis sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong ngam/ byin pa nas lag pas bzung / langs shing 'chun dang bcas pas 〈'phong dang bcas pa 〉sa la brdeb pa ni gsum pa'o/ /langs te rting 'khrab 〈1〉byas/ khu tshur dpyangs phrag brdeb/ yang 〈mdun thad du 〉khu tshur brkyangs/ 〈rting 'brab nas 〉lan gsum 〈9〉bya ste bzhi pa'o/ /de gnyis langs pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rgyab gzhud sa la btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas g.yo ni khu tshur bcangs nas brkyang bskum byed cing / lag pa brkyang ba dang lhan cig 〈tu〉/ rkang mthil la sogs la drag tu brdeb 〈4〉pa ni lnga pa'o/ /nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor ra ro/ /lnga po de rnams re re la'ang rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i ngang nas byed pa dang / hā ring 'don pa dang / ha thung 'don pas byed pa ste/ rlung gnad kyi dbye bas gsum gsum du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams bi bhu ti'i ring brgyud man ngag go /—407—

lag pa gnyis rgyab nas bsnol te/ rdo rje skyil krung gi mthe bong g.yas g.yon nas 'then/ lus 〈yar 〉skyed cing 〈mar 〉srubs la/ thog mar 'phong btsugs te skyil krung brdeb/ de nas skyil krung btsugs la 'phong brdeb ste drug pa'o/ /rkang pa gnyis dpung pa'i rgyab ngos nas ltag par bsnol/ lag pa gnyis brla'i rtsa ba nas mdun du khu tshur bcangs pa rlung kha sbyor g.yas g.yon du 'chun dang bcas pas/ rgyab sa la skyur thabs su 'bebs shing / yang g.yas g.yon du gcud nas langs te/ bdun pa'o/ /'di gnyis rgyud kyi dngos bstan las 'byung zhing / man ngag brgyud pa thams cad las so/ /〈'dir sngar gyi nyi shu pa'i langs ba'i 'khrul 'khor bcu po ma gtogs 'di dag 'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin lags/ rlung 'brab sogs med/〉dang por 〈sems skyil 〉skyil krung bcas te khu tshur brla'i 'phra mtshams su bzhag rlung pho stod du bsdigs te lto ba tshigs pa la bcer nas 〈hro 〉g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 〈thams cad g.yas bskor〉 lan bdun bdun bskor zhing /rlung dgram 〈de lus thams cad sprugs pa 〉lan gsum bya/ de nas langs te 'dom 'jal gyi mthar khu tshur gzhabs te sa la btsugs/ 〈khu oṃ mdun du phyir bstan 〉lag ngar gshibs te bsrangs/ gru mo'i steng du pho ba bkal/ rkang pa brkyangs lus bteg ste rlung pho bar 〈yar 〉sgril/ mgo rkang re mos su sa la reg par 〈6〉bya ste brgyad pa'o/ /sgal tshigs sa la btsugs shing / rkang lag bzhi nam mkhar mnyam du —408—

'phang zhing / ha zhes drag tu 'don pa lan dgu'i bar du byed pa ni dgu pa'o/ /rkang pa zlum po'i stabs kyis langs/ mthe bong sta zur gyi rgyab dang /sor mo bzhis mkhal ma'i mdun 'og nas brdeg rlung phyir bus te/ stod smad chab gcig tu g.yas g.yon du gcud pa ni bcu pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung rkang mgo g.yas g.yon brla'i phyi rol tu thon par bya/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong 〈gnyis so sor phral pa'i ngang 〉 gis g.yas g.yon du ska rags 'ching tshul byed cing lus yongs rdzogs g.yas g.yon du lan gsum 〈6〉bskor/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis mdun rgyab gang rung du bsnol nas rkang mgo la 'jus/ ltag pa skyed de 〈g.yas g.yon lus mar 〉 srubs pa ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /bzhi po de dag ni paṇa chen zla mgon gyi man ngag go /dang por snying gar 'khyud rgya byas la 〈khu tshur 〉 g.yas g.yon du 〈spel ba 3〉gcud/ steng gi rlung g.yas g.yon du gnod 'then bya 〈ba spel blte〉de nas gan skyal du 'dug la rkang pa nywa bzhi bsgrims te brkyang bskum dal bus shugs bskyed de byed cing / brkyang pa'i tshe thur sel glod/ bskum pa'i tshe 'then te 〈3〉bcu gnyis pa'o/ /'di ni paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa dpyal lugs kyi man ngag go /de ltar bcu gnyis sam/ yang gnyis bsnan pa ni/ langs te rlud 'khrab byas/ 'dom 'jal bskor nas rkang gnyis bar du khru gang bzhagalag pa pus mo la 'ju sa/ 〈pus mgo 〉g.yas g.yon du gcud nas/ 〈spel blte〉thur du 'bebs pa'i skabs rkang pa ma gug par brla dang byin pa 'phong rnams dus gcig tu bsdeb/ 'di la gling bzhi gcud 'bebs zer te bcu gsum —409—

pa'o// lus tsog pu lag pa g.yas g.yon rkang pa'i phyi nas btang ste/ rkang pa'i sgyid khung nas sor mo bzhis 'jus/ rlung kha sbyor drag po dang / sked pa skyed sgur g.yas 'then g.yon 'then gyi ngang nas lag pas yar 'then/ rkang pas mar gnon pa 〈spel ba 〉ni/ gling bzhi gcud pa zhes bya ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la 'phong stegs bu'i steng du bzhag rkang mthil gnyis rten med kyi ngang nas gong bzhin byas nas 'dun che bar 'ong / 'di gnyis 〈o rgyan 〉bsnyen sgrub kyi nang gi de dang phal cher 'dra bas/ de las blangs sam snyam mo/ /de ltar na rtsa sbyong chen mo nas brtsams te/ 'di yan chad la 'khrul 'khor lnga bcu nga dgu yod de/ thams cad kyang srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba lus dag par byed pa dang / gegs sel ba dang / bogs 'don du 'gyur ba sna tshogs te/ 'di rnams cha tshang bar nyin dang nyin la ma 'chag par byed cing /bum pa can la nan tan du bsgrubs na nad rnying pa thams cad 'khyang ba dang /gsar pa mi skyed par the tshom med cing myong bas grub la/ las kyi lhongs bdo ba yin na ma rtogs/ sgom gegs kyang rnying pa thams cad sel zhing / gsar pa mi 'byung ngo / /de dag gi bar bar du lus sbyong spyi 'gros la dgos pa'i 'bebs kyi rigs/ skyil krung bcas lag pa pus mo la bkab ste/ 'phong bteg cing brdeb pa dang / 'a rje lag pa khu tshur snying khar bsnol 〉skyil krung bcas pa 'phag cing brdeb/lag pa yang 〈g.yas g.yon rim pa'i 〉mgo la bskor zhing sprugs pa dang / skyil krung gi ngang nas pus mo btsugs nas ldang ba dang / lag pa khu tshur nam mkhar —410—

'phang / 'phong sa la brdeb pa dang / khu tshur nu steng du brdeb pa ste/ 'bebs chung nyid las phye ba'i chung 'bring chen po gsum yin la/〈rma khug snyag de lan bdun 〉de bzhin du 'bebs 'bring po 〈las nga/ khu tshur snying gar bsno la rkang ba 〉brkyang 〈ba dang sems skyil gyi 〉 bskum 〈pa 〉 gnyis dang / 〈rlung khug gcig de 7〉 'bebs chen po brkyang 〈sems skyil 〉bskum 〈pa rdo rje'i 〉skyil krung ste/ gsum la'ang bslab bar bya'o ma/〈rlung bug gcig de bdun lta bu'o〉 de ltar na 'khru/la 'khore drug cu re lnga ste/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i 'khrid thob pa rnams 'a/ bstan par bya'o/ / rdzi/na mo gu sa rjes dran gyi 'khrid bla ma'i zhal lung dang bcas pa legs par thob na/ 'khrul 'khore 'di rnams kyi lag len tshig gi 'grel pa dang bcas te sbyin par bya ste/ de la dang po sbyor ba drug ldan ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ kha bub tu pus mo bskums shing gh+ra/ mo sa la bcugs/〈1〉 lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur ma/gul du bsnol/〈2〉 lus nywa bzhi bsgrim/sa/ 'og sgo glod/ lto ba tshogs pa la gcer/〈3〉 lte sgril zhing rkan la gtad/〈4〉 ltag pa bsrang ste/mig gtsug tor du blta/ 〈5〉 chi hu dang hal 〈6〉zhes brjod de sbyor ba drug dang ldan par bya/ 〈rlung mi bzung 〉 ya nga de nyid las 'a rje 〉skyil krung bcas te/ lag pa 〈gnyis 〉rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya sked pa'i thad nas bsngams/ sbyor ba drug po gzhan 'dra ba la/ 'og sgo bsdams shing gsus pa phyir bskyed/ rlung gnad 〈phyir bzung ba'i 〉rang 'gags/ sems nam mkha' la yas sda/ gzhu/ga gode /gnyis pa stag mo'i skyug stangs ni/ langs te lag pa brgyangs nga 'i rje la mdun du mthe bong gnyis gcig gis gcig bzung nas khru gang tsam gyi mdun du —411—

btsugs/ rlung thur du bsdigs pa dang mnyam du pus mo dang gru mo 'phrad tsam lag ngar dang / ngar gdong gnyis sa la gtad/ de nas ha ha ka ces rkang lag bsrangs/ rgyab shed 'then/ g.yas 〈yar de'i ngang nas 〉g.yon dbus gsum du 〈ro stod 〉gcud/ yang hūṃ thung gis brngubs nas khong sgra dang bcas pas kyang gcud/〈g.yas g.yon dbus su rlung 〉 de nas 〈pus 'dug bzhag gam sems skyil 〉khu tshur mchan khung du brdeb la ha ka ces bsdo da rga /gsum pa glang po'i 'gying ba ni/ bca' lugs phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ 〈langs te sogs gong dang 'dra 〉 lag pa khu tshur mtho gang tsam bar du bzhag pa sa la bcugs/ 〈rlung thur du bsdigs nga dang mnyam du pus mo dang gru mo 'phrad tsam lag ngar dang / ngar gdong sa la btsugs de nas ha ha ka ces pa la ha thes brjod la〉 sdo/ga bzhi bsrang ba'i skabs gsang rlung khong 〈ri gi 〉sgra dang bcas te 'then/ 〈g.yas g.yon 〉 gcud 〈glang r+ṣa 'gying tshul 〉pa'i skabs phaṭa 〈brjod mi dgos 〉kyi sbyor bas bar rlung brgyangs/ yang gru mo dang pus mo sa la reg tsam byas nas/ lto ba phyir bskyed bzhin 〈lag pa sa ya sa g.yon du 〉 sa la gcud/ slar yang rkang lag bsrangs/ rgyab shed 'then ba'i na pas hi hing zhes brjod/bzhi pa ni wa'i bsnom ste/ pus btsugs kyis langs/ khu tshur snying gar bsnol la gru mo cung zad bsrangs/ sna nas hu phra mo 〈rma 'bud 〉dang bcas gru mo 〈dang po g.yas su 3〉gcud/ ro stod 〈g.yas 〉'then/ rlung 'bud pa rdzogs mtshams su bsnom pa'i tshul 〈du 〉gsum lnga bdun sogs gang rigs bya/ 〈rlung bzung ba dang 1 de bzhin tu g.yon dang gnyis ka la brkyang 〉g.yas ga sku1na dang gnyis ka'i dbye —412—

bas gsum mo/ /lnga pa ni seng ge'i rnam rol te/ mthe bos rna ba/ mdzub mos migagung mos sna rnams bkag srin lag dang mthe chung bar du mchu bsdams/ rting pa gcig gis bshang sgo dang / gcig shos kyi gsang ba bsdams/ gru mo bsrangs te 〈dal bus 〉 g.yas bskor g.yon bskor 〈gnyis lhag 〉gsum gsum/ 〈myur bar 〉gsor ltar sgril ba 〈g.yas g.yon 〉lan drug sgo dgu bkag pa btang ste/ i ha zhes sprugs 〈sgo dgu 〉brdeb bya/ lag pa gnyis re mos kyis sna bsdams nas yang sprugs 〈g.yas g.yon 〉brdeb bya/drug pa ni dgang sprugs te/ sug bzhi'i bar du khru gang re yong bar byas te/ pus mo dang khu tshur sa la btsugs/ rlung gsus smad du drag tu bsdigs te/dpung pa g.yas 〈1〉dang g.yon 〈2〉 dang gnyis ka 〈3〉 bcag pa'i tshul gyis sprugs thengs re bya zhing / de nyid las rkang pa bsrang 〈zhing 〉sna dang mchu'i dbus nas rlung bus te hu hu zhes 〈mgo 〉 sprugs/bdun pa ni yi dwags pre ta ka ste/ langs bzhin du rlung sprugs byas nas/rkang pa zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang / lag pa 'dom 'jal tshur bsdus te/gsang ba'i thad nas khu tshur 'chun dang bcas pa thur du 'bebs bzhin du/'phong sa la ma reg tsam dang / khu tshur sa la phab/ hi hika ces 〈rgyab 〉sgur 'then bya/ de nas g.yas g.yon du 〈rgyab 〉 gcud cing sprugs/ yang drag tu brngubs nas 'chun dang bcas pas langs te/ khu tshur 〈lag pa tshi bsdus te nas: sa la phab hi smi ces bar gong dang 'dra 〉 gnyis rgyab tu brgyangs/ ltag pa skyed de hi hika —413—

ces bya/ lus kyi gnad de ka dang 'dra ba las/ rlung gnad kha sbyor thur tu bsdigs pa kho na'i ngang nas kyang de ltar bya 〈ste 〉lan gsum mo/ /de ltar bdun ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po nas brgyud pa 'bro lugs kyi man ngag ste/ dang po bzung ba/ de nas gsum bzlog pa/ phyi ma gsum khyab par byed pa'o/ /'di rnams la lag len mi 'dra ba gnyis gda' na'ang / 'di 'chun che bas bkod do/ /brgyad pa ni/ 'a rje 〉skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag dgang 'then gyi ngang nas bzhi sprugs byed cing / lus thams cad sprugs pa ste 'dren chung ba'o/ /dgu pa ni/ langs te 'dom 'jal gyi mthar lag pa gnyis brla nang nas 'byud/ rkang sor nas 'then zhing / 'phong gyen du bzlog la i 〈rlung gi sgra gdangs 〉zhes khong skad phra mo rtsa 'khor lo drug tu drag tu drangs par mos/ mthar mgo skyed la ha zhes 'bud pa ni/ 'dren pa bar pa khong 'dren zhes bya ba'o/ /bcu pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs pa'i tsog pu'i 'phong stegs can gyi skyil krung las/ 〈sto ba 〉dgang 〈yar 〉 'then 〈lto ba 〉dgang 〈mar 〉gnon dang bcas bzhin pa las langs te/ rkang ngar bsrangs/ rkang gag tha/ga nas lag pas drag tu 'then/ mgo skyed de hu zhes brjod 〈bzhi nga 'i rlung bzung 〉 de nas rkang pa ma gug par brla dang byin pa 'phong rnams mnyam por brdab ste/ yang rkang gsherwa ga nas 〈g.yas g.yon gnyis nas 〉gcud cing 〈yar 〉'then la mgo dgug de ma thag hū zhes ltag pa skyed pa ni 'dren che ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ langs te rkang pa g.yas pa'i brla'i 'phra 'tshams la —414—

———rkang pa g.yon pa'i bol gong gtad/ lag pa khu tshur 'dom 'jal las brkyang bskum byed cing lan bdun tsam 'phar zhing g.yas bskor bya/ de nyid du mgro dang / rtsib logs/ nu ma/ rgyab dang / dpyi dang / lto ba rnams khu tshur 〈gnyes 〉gyis brdung zhing / lus thams cad 'phur mnye byas nas 〈'phong 〉sa la 'bebs/de bzhin du g.yon la'ang bya ste 'phar g.yo zhes bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ khung 'dren dang bca' gzhi 'dra ba las/ i dang he'i ngag 'dren mi byed par rlung dgang zhing 'then pa'i ngang nas bzhi sprugs dang /〈rkang sor nas 〉g.yas 'then dang g.yon 'then dbus 'then rnams 'chun dang bcas te byed/ de nas rkang sor bzung ba btang ste 〈'phong 〉sa la phab nas/lus kyi cha thams cad la mnye ba dang / 'then nga/ dang / 〈lag gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya'i gung mo'i phug tshul lam/ mtheb mdzub gung gsum gyis 〉zur phus/ dang / thal lcag brdegs pa sogs gang nus bya'ol /bcu gsum pa ni/ gan rkyal du gnas pas pus 〈mo 〉brang 〈la 〉sbyar/lag pa khu tshur 'phong gi thad du drag tu brkyangs/ rlung kha sbyor rgyu zhabs su phul nas/ 〈rlud 〉g.yas g.yon du lan gsum 〈gsum spel 〉gcud/ de nas yan lag thams cad brkyang bskum drag tu bya ste/ lag pa g.yas dang rkang pa g.yon dus gcig〈3〉 lag pa g.yon dang rkang pa g.yas dus gcig ste/〈3〉 'di snyel 'ang skyil krung bcas te 'dug nas mnye/ 'then phur zug thal lcag brdeb pa sogs ci nus bya ste/ rab brkyang zhes bya'o/ /de ltar drug las snga ma gsum 'dren dang / phyi ma gsum 'grems gtso bor gyur pa ste/ dpe med (sna tsho —415—

gdams ngag rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ci rigs pa ste/ de dag ni bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i lugs ring brgyud do/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ pho ba sa la btsugs la rlud pho bar rab tu 〈mnan pa'am 〉gcud/ yan lag bzhi brkyang bskum 〈3〉drag tu bya ste/ seng ge rtsal sprugs so//bco lnga pa ni/ rkang pa mdun du brkyangs/ lag pa g.yas pas rting pa ga yon 〈pa 〉nas 'then/ lag pa g.yon gyis dpung pa g.yas pa nas 'then 〈bzhin pa'i 〉g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du gcud/ 〈de nyid g.yon du'ang go bzlog〉rlung gnad kyang ma ning dang / 〈bum can bzung bzhi pa'i lto ba phyir bskyed bzhi byed pa ni ma ning dang bum can gnyis sbrags ma yin gsungs〉 bum can gnyis sbrags byed de gcud 'then zhes bya'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ skyil krung bcas la lag pa spyi bo'i steng thad du thal mo sbyar/ mgo bo sgril bkug mgrin pa skor/ ro stod sprugs/ sked pa skyogs/ ro smad gcud/ gnas so so'i lus sbyong dang bstun/ thal mo yang de dag tu reg cing gru mo brkyangs te 'chun btsal/ mthar 'phong sa la btsugs/ lus 〈rgyab tu 〉cung zad 〈skyed 〉skyed nas/ sug bzhi brkyang bskum lan gsum bya/ de nas drag tu sprugs pa ste gsum 'grems so/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ 〈rma phyir ba45 la nang tu mi sas〉 rkang pa'i brang pa sa la btsugs/ khu tshur gnyis 〈bsnol nas〉dpung par sbyar la gru mo brkyangs/ pus mo gnyis kyang ngang pa'i gshoge pa ltar bya/ mgo 〈pus mo la gas 〉bstungs/ lus 'dar thon par byed/ ma ning gi rlung 〈lto bar 〉drag tu gtad de/ lus g.yas —416—

g.yon du cung zad bsgyur ba ni/ seng ge'i 'gying ngo / /bco brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung byas/ pus mo g.yon la lag pa gnyis bsnol nas 'khyud/ mgo pus mo'i steng du bsgyur 〈bkug〉zhing dpung pa g.yas 〈pa'i 〉steng du 'then/ yang de nyid go bzlog pa'ang bya ste rma bya'i 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lnga ni 'dren 'grems bzung ba gsum kar byed pa ste/ tsa mi dang rga lo'i lugs/ gnyos ston 'od ma dang / zhang mtshal pa'i man ngag rnams nas zab cing gal che ba rnams blangs pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ 'a rje'i skyil krung 〉khu tshur brla bzhag mgo bo skur/ 'og rlung yar 'then 〈rma phyir bsal la 〉stong 'dren drag po bya/〈bzhi pa'i ngang 〉 der hu ri nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bsdud/ de 'phral langs te lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab nas kyang rlung gnad snga ma de dang 'dra bar bya/ rlung nang du drangs/ mgo bkug ste mchil ma mid la steng rlung mnan pa'i ngang nas 'og rlung rim gyis 'then pa dang ltag pa skyed kyis btang ngo / /bsdad nas hū nyer gcig gi skabs dang /langs nas hū nyer gcig gi skabs dang / ltag pa skyed kyis btang ba gsum po 'di la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum drag tu 'then no/ /de rjes ha thung dang rting 'khrab nyer gcig hā ring dang 'drab chen nyer gcig bya ste sbags 'dren zhes bya'o/ /nyi shu pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas lus sgur/ gru mo 〈dang 〉pus mo sa la btsugs te/ steng rlung ha zhes phyir 'bud pa dang mnyam du thur sel bshang sgor bsdigs la glod/ ma ning gi rlung thub tshad du brgyangs/ yang brngubs nas —417—

langs te rkang lag bgrad/ ltag pa skyed pa'i ngang nas rlung gi gnad gsum sngar bzhin bya/ yang brngubs ste stan gyi steng du brdeb/ tsog pu'am skyil krung gi ngang nas rlung gi gnad sogs sngar bzhin byed/ de nas gsang rtsa bsdams pa'i 'bebs chung lan gsum las mi nyung ba bya ste yongs 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de ltar gnyis las snga ma 'dren 'grems sbrags ma dang / phyi ma 'di bzung bskyil bzlog gsum sbrags ma ste/ bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra la sha wa ri pas dngos su gdams pa'i nye brgyud kyi man ngag go /de rnams kyi mthar gong du bshad pa'i 'bebs rnams gal che'o/ /de ltar na rjes dran gdams ngag can gyi lugs srol phal cher 'dus pa'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu mon me brag kha ba grags pa seng ge dang / sron pa chos dpal bzang po la sogs pas sdom tshig tu mdzad nga/'i lag len ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'o/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i lam la nye bar mkho ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len gsal byed 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gab pa dang dkrugs pa med cing shin tu gsal bar sbyar ba'o/ /〈spo dang a gu rnams ni/ dpal 'dzam thang dgon gyi phyag len thub bstan 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i gsungs rgyun ltar dang / dge bshes rin po che dang / bla ma rig mchog rnam gnyis sogs kyi gsung rgyun ltar yin pas khungs ldan yin yang yi ge'i gzhung du ma bri lags/ 〉 dge legs 'phel/rab dkar 'di bskrun pas/ /ma lus 'gro tshogs kyi/ /gnas skabs mthar thug gi /dpal yon mtha' med shog /'di yang ma tis bris/—418—
